article.articleHeadline: Daftar Varian COVID-19 dari Wuhan hingga 2026, Delta Masih jadi yang Paling Mematikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: List of COVID-19 Variants from Wuhan Through 2026, Delta Remains the Deadliest
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 SARS-CoV-2 variants traced from Wuhan to 2026 show Delta as the deadliest while Omicron remains the dominant lineage. The original Wuhan strain (late 2019–early 2020) acquired the D614G spike mutation, boosting transmissibility. Alpha (B.1.1.7) emerged in the United Kingdom in 2020 and spread globally, becoming dominant in parts of 2021. Beta (B.1.351), identified in South Africa, carried E484K, raising immune escape concerns. Gamma (P.1) from Brazil in 2020 also had spike mutations associated with higher transmission and reinfection risk. Epsilon (B.1.427/B.1.429) first identified in California; increased spread and reduced neutralization, later surpassed. Lambda (C.37) detected in Peru also raised immune-escape concerns but did not sustain global dominance after Delta and Omicron. Delta (B.1.617.2) from India drove major waves in 2021 with higher severity. By 2026, Omicron subvariants predominate, underscoring ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 武漢から2026年までのCOVID-19変異株一覧、デルタが依然として最も致死的
triage.triage_reason: 過去から現在までのCOVID-19変異株の歴史的解説記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のCOVID-19変異株（武漢株、アルファ、ベータ、ガンマ、イプシロン、ラムダ、デルタ、オミクロン）の歴史的まとめであり、特定の現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、いずれの対象国も現時点での発生国として検証できない。

article.articleHeadline: Tudo o que se sabe sobre a nova variante e a alta de covid-19 no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: All we know about the new variant and the rise in COVID-19 cases in Brazil
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports rising COVID-19 activity in 18 states in 2026, driven by variant XFG Stratus (descendant of Omicron). Genomic surveillance of 2,199 samples through week 42 found 127 lineages; WHO labels XFG as a Variant Under Monitoring, with mutations under study but no evidence of greater severity or hospital overload. Main symptom shift is hoarseness, with frequent sore throat and altered voice. By week 43, 118,851 influenza-like illness cases due to coronavirus were recorded, with six-week increases in São Paulo, Bahia, Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul, Alagoas, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí, Paraná, Roraima, Maranhão, Rondônia, Santa Catarina, Ceará, Rio de Janeiro, and the Federal District; mild upticks in severe cases in Mato Grosso, DF, RJ, SP, SC, but overall low incidence. Vaccination remains a priority: three-dose schedule for 6 months–5 years; annual doses for comorbidities, health workers, LTC residents/staff, Indigenous, quilombolas, riverine communities, homeless, postal workers, and incarcerated populations. Vaccines show modest neutralization reduction but protect against severe disease. SUS offers free doses; >7.4 million administered this year. Maintain vaccination and masking.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける新変異株とCOVID-19急増についてわかっていること
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19新系統XFG StratusはWHOにより監視下変異株(VUM)とされ、ブラジル18州で感染報告が増加しているが、重症度や病院逼迫の増加は確認されておらず、社会的関心の高まりも記事からは明確でないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: WHOはXFG StratusをVariant Under Monitoringに分類しており、現時点で重症度増加や医療逼迫の証拠はない。ブラジル全土18州で感染報告の増加が見られるが、全体の発生率は低く、ワクチン接種を含む通常の公衆衛生対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Захворюваність на туберкульоз у світі знизилася на 1,6% у 2025 році -- Health Policy Watch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global tuberculosis incidence declined by 1.6% in 2025 -- Health Policy Watch
article.articleSummary: Global tuberculosis incidence declined 1.6% in 2025 to 129 new cases per 100,000, with mortality about 1.13 million (down 4% from 2024 and 35% from 2015). Over 2015–2025, incidence fell 14%, but progress falls short of End TB targets (50% reduction by 2025, 80% by 2030). The first interim End TB mortality reduction target was achieved earlier than planned (2020). About 88% of cases occur in 30 high-burden countries, with India contributing roughly a quarter of cases; eight countries (India, Indonesia, Philippines, China, Pakistan, Nigeria, Democratic Republic of Congo, Bangladesh) together host about two-thirds of global cases. Distribution among those infected: 54% male, 35% female, 11% children. Notable progress in Africa and Europe, and in China and India. WHO warns of funding shortfalls: 2025 prevention/diagnosis/treatment funding reached $6.6 billion, only 30% of the $22 billion annual target for 2027; some high-burden countries increased domestic funding, but delays may follow.

triage.headline_ja: 世界の結核罹患率、2025年に1.6%減少 -- Health Policy Watch
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次統計報告であり、世界的な結核罹患率・死亡率の減少傾向を報告する定例的な内容。異常事態や緊急対応を要する事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO/Health Policy Watchによる世界全体の結核統計の年次報告。特定国での異常発生や急激な悪化を報じるものではなく、既知の慢性疾患の継続的な傾向報告であるためDISMISSと判定。対象国（インド、インドネシア、フィリピン、中国、DRC等）は高負担国として言及されているが、個別の発生イベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo doctors say Ebola cases growing
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, DR Congo’s Mambasa reports Ebola cases rising to about 20 new infections per week over the past three weeks. A total of 127 Mambasa cases have been recorded since the outbreak began, with 57 deaths. Containment is hampered by bed shortages and logistical problems. The outbreak was triggered by improper handling of a patient’s body; the patient died in Mandima roughly three weeks ago. Since May 15, the eastern DR Congo outbreak, extending into Uganda and now reported in eight Congolese provinces, is the second-deadliest Ebola event in Africa. DR Congo labs confirm 11,042 cases with 5,387 fatalities nationwide. Uganda’s outbreak ended on 28 July (confirmed by WHO on 25 August). Kenya reported a first case on 6 October and Nigeria on 20 October. The strain is Bundibugyo virus, for which a vaccine is still under development.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の医師、エボラ出血熱患者が増加していると発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ患者が週20件規模で増加し、複数州・隣国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）へ拡大していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事内のナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC国内の感染拡大（8州、127例・57死亡のマンバサ地域、全国で11,042例・5,387死亡）が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Attack Toll Hits 66 in Ebola Zone
article.articleSummary: 66 civilians were killed in Cantine-Aloya, North Kivu, Congo, during 5–6 November 2026 in an attack blamed on the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), an Islamic State–linked group; three of the dead were health workers. The toll rose from an early count of 33 to 66 as heavy rain hindered search efforts and authorities. Three confirmed Ebola cases are unaccounted for and more than 1,000 contacts of patients are lost to follow-up, compromising tracing. The attack also looted three health facilities and forced patients to flee, hindering the Ebola response in the Congo outbreak declared 15 May, which has 11,114 infections and 5,433 deaths per Congolese government data. WHO chief Tedros termed the incident a major humanitarian emergency and setback to the response; Africa CDC reports intensified violence, including four armed attacks, 16 assaults on responders, and 11 health facilities burned or targeted, worsening outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行地域での攻撃による死者数が66人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCの大規模エボラ流行（感染11,114人、死亡5,433人）において武装勢力による攻撃で医療施設が破壊され、確認患者や接触者多数が追跡不能となり、WHO事務局長が人道的緊急事態と表明するなど国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 武力攻撃によりエボラ対応（接触者追跡、医療提供）が著しく妨げられており、感染拡大の再燃リスクが高い。WHOおよびAfrica CDCが直接関与・声明を発出している点からも国際的な懸念が極めて大きい。

article.articleHeadline: 安特羅腸病毒疫苗新加坡送件，搶進東協指標市場
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antro Enterovirus Vaccine Filed in Singapore, Aiming to Break into ASEAN Benchmark Market
article.articleSummary: On 12 November 2026, Antro Biotech announced that its Enterovirus 71 vaccine EnVAX-A71 has filed a New Drug Application with Singapore's Health Sciences Authority, signaling a strategic entry into the ASEAN benchmark market via Singapore as a gateway to Southeast Asia. No EV71 vaccine is currently marketed in ASEAN. The company has existing licenses in Taiwan and Macau, and previously filed in Vietnam (July 2025) and Thailand (August 2026); the NDA was submitted through Singapore-based Enimmune Biotech Pte. Ltd. A sales agreement with Malaysia's Duopharma Biotech aims to bolster presence in Singapore and Malaysia to accelerate Southeast Asian expansion. Production occurs at Guoguang Biotech's Tanzi Plant in Taichung using an advanced bioreactor process, with annual capacity of at least 1 million doses for Taiwan and ASEAN. The vaccine targets active immunization for children aged 2 months to under 6 years, with an efficacy of 99.21%.

triage.headline_ja: 安特羅腸病毒疫苗新加坡送件，搶進東協指標市場（Antro社のエンテロウイルス71型ワクチン、シンガポールに申請、ASEAN指標市場参入を目指す）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチンの承認申請・事業展開に関する企業発表であり、感染症の発生や流行を報じるものではないため、公衆衛生上の懸念事項に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチンの規制申請・市場展開に関する企業ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。発生地域リストの国々（台湾・ベトナム・中国・タイ・マレーシア・マカオ・シンガポール）はワクチン申請・販売先として言及されているのみで、感染症イベントの発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes Kerja Keras Kejar Target Penemuan 972.000 Kasus TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health Working Hard to Meet Target of Identifying 972,000 TB Cases
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Ministry of Health is intensifying tuberculosis (TB) control to reach the target of identifying 972,000 TB cases and breaking transmission through active case finding, contact investigation, and expanding screening within the free health check program (CKG). By October 2026, 666,985 TB cases had been identified nationally, roughly 61% of the target, while the estimated TB burden for 2026 remains about 1.08 million. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus, during a visit to Sumedang, West Java on 12 November 2026, announced the opening of a pulmonary clinic at Cimalaka Hospital and stressed that screening should extend beyond symptomatic individuals to household, neighbor, and workplace contacts. Of the 666,985 detected cases, 599,425 (about 90%) had started treatment. Integration of TB screening into the CKG program and expansion to families, workplaces, and pesantren aims to reach high-risk groups and curb transmission; success hinges on sustained treatment adherence.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、結核症例97万2000件の発見目標達成に向け尽力
triage.triage_reason: 既知の流行病である結核に関する通常の政策・プログラム報告であり、突発的・異常な公衆衛生事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 結核対策の進捗報告であり、通常の保健行政活動の一環。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Boletim da Fiocruz aponta aumento de casos de Covid na última semana em todo o país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz bulletin indicates a rise in COVID-19 cases in the last week across the country.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz bulletin shows a rise in COVID-19 cases in the last week across Brazil, as of 12 November 2026. The virus remains circulating, with higher activity in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Bahia, and the Federal District. Researchers are investigating the emergence of a new mutation. Since January, Brazil has reported more than 170,000 suspected cases of severe acute respiratory syndrome; 92,000 tested positive for some respiratory virus, including SARS-CoV-2. Experts say the numbers warrant caution but the epidemiological situation is not yet alarming. Authorities emphasize vaccination in full, especially for vulnerable groups such as children and the elderly. Additional preventive measures include hand hygiene and, when symptomatic, wearing a mask and avoiding close contact with others.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルズ速報、ブラジル全土で先週のCOVID-19症例が増加と指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19症例の増加と新変異株の調査が報告されているが、専門家は現時点で警戒レベルには至っていないとしており、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 新たな変異株の出現が調査中とされているが、詳細（病原性・感染性の変化等）は記事に記載なし。重症化動向や変異株の特性について続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance for zoonotic viruses in human population at the human-animal interface in North Sulawesi, Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Surveillance was conducted in Minahasa District, North Sulawesi, Indonesia, as part of the USAID Emerging Pandemic Threats (EPT) PREDICT project, from November 2017 to December 2018, at Noongan Hospital and Puskesmas Kawangkoan. The study targets high risk populations engaging in wildlife hunting, trade and consumption, in a region with documented wildlife related activities and prior reports of potential zoonotic viruses in bats (henipavirus, filovirus, hantavirus). Objectives: establish baseline data on viruses within selected zoonotic families and identify behavioral risk factors for spillover at the human–wildlife interface. Enrollment included syndromic patients aged >2 years presenting with fever (>38 C) for 24 h to 7 days, including SARI, ILI, fever of unknown origin, encephalitis, or hemorrhagic fever. Biological samples collected: oral/nasal, rectal, blood, urine; stored in TRIzol/VTM and shipped to Eijkman Research Center. Molecular detection by RNA extraction and cDNA synthesis followed prior surveillance protocols to detect viruses within zoonotic families.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア北スラウェシにおけるヒト-動物接点でのヒト集団における人獣共通ウイルスのサーベイランス
triage.triage_reason: 2017-2018年に実施された学術的サーベイランス研究の報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はUSAID PREDICTプロジェクトの一環として2017-2018年に実施された後ろ向きサーベイランス研究の学術論文であり、現時点での新規感染症発生や公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではない。研究自体はコウモリ由来の人獣共通感染症（ヘニパウイルス、フィロウイルス、ハンタウイルス）のベースラインデータ収集を目的としている。

article.articleHeadline: लखनऊ में 72 घंटों में एक ही परिवार के तीन बच्चों की मौत, बुखार के बाद बारी-बारी बिगड़ी तबीयत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Lucknow, within 72 hours, three children from the same family died, their health deteriorated one after another after a fever.
article.articleSummary: Three children from the same family died in Malihabad's Khandsara village, Lucknow, within four days after fever. Divyansh, 3, fell ill with mild fever on November 9 around 2:30 pm and died en route to hospital. Kartik, 7, deteriorated the next day and died. Lakshmi, 10, developed fever and abdominal pain on the night of November 10, was admitted to a private hospital, and died on Thursday morning. Postmortems are pending. The third child's blood tests were negative for typhoid, dengue, and malaria; chest X-ray showed severe bilateral pneumonia. Initial suspicion of food poisoning by health officials; the exact cause to be clarified after autopsies. Health authorities, including CMO Dr NB Singh and a team, visited the village; questions were raised about actions after the first two deaths. Investigation ongoing; no confirmed source or imported/exported cases identified.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウで72時間以内に同一家族の子供3人が死亡、発熱後に次々と体調悪化
triage.triage_reason: 同一家族の子供3人が短期間で死亡し重症度は高いが、デング・マラリア・腸チフスは検査陰性で原因不明。食中毒の可能性も示唆されており、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠や地域拡大は確認されていないため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 死因は未確定（剖検待ち）。デング・マラリア・腸チフスは検査で否定されており、重症肺炎の所見あり。食中毒や他の感染症・環境要因の可能性も含め原因調査中。

article.articleHeadline: Com El Niño no radar, Paraná terá Dia D contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With El Niño on the radar, Paraná will have D-Day against dengue.
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil risks a dengue surge as El Niño drives heavier rains and hotter conditions that favor Aedes aegypti. The Dia D de Mobilização Nacional contra a dengue is set for 28 November, with simultaneous mass cleaning campaigns, educational activities, and communications to mobilize residents in vector control. Despite historically low dengue numbers in 2026, down 93% from 2025, health officials warn that the probable-case curve remains above the historical average, signaling potential uptick. César Neves, Secretary of State of Health, urges continued prevention through elimination of breeding sites even during lulls. The initiative seeks to curb transmission by engaging communities ahead of peak transmission periods linked to climate shifts from El Niño, addressing ongoing risks in Paraná.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ接近で、パラナ州はデング熱対策の「D-Day」を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は2025年比93%減と低水準であり、予防啓発キャンペーンに関する内容で、現時点で公衆衛生上の深刻な異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、記事は予防キャンペーンの告知が主旨であり、症例数は過去と比べ大幅減少傾向。エルニーニョによる今後のリスク増大への警戒喚起に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Parvovirus B19 Sustains Endemic Circulation in Southern Brazil
article.articleSummary: Parvovirus B19 (B19V) sustains endemic circulation in Rio Grande do Sul, southern Brazil, based on 4,118 serum samples from exanthematous illness (2015–2024). IgM ELISA found 553 positives (13.4%), with yearly positivity from 28.2% (2015) to 3.7% (2021); 2023 had no positives in 54 samples. Infections affected all ages, were more frequent in females, and highest age-specific positivity was 6–10 years (22.3%). Circulation was year-round with a July uptick and September peak. An amplicon-based whole-genome sequencing protocol yielded 47 genomes. Phylogeny confirms genotype 1 across RS; MRCA of genotype 1 around 1977, clock rate 2.0×10⁻⁴ substitutions/site/year. RS genomes cluster in a Brazilian-dominant clade (MRCA 1994), including a 2012 Brazilian subclade; five RS genomes lie outside, clustering with Argentina. A sister lineage to Brazil includes Italy and China (≈2009). COVID-19 did not trigger a rebound; dengue expansion may mask B19V infections. The study underscores sustained local transmission and supports genome-based phylogeny.

triage.headline_ja: パルボウイルスB19がブラジル南部で地域流行を継続
triage.triage_reason: 過去10年間の血清サーベイランスに基づく学術研究であり、新規の公衆衛生緊急事態や異常な増加は報告されていない。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2015-2024年の血清サーベイランスに基づく遺伝学的・疫学的研究報告であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントではない。イタリア・中国・アルゼンチンは系統学的関連性の言及のみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lote de queijo suspenso pela Anvisa: conheça os perigos da bactéria Listeria para a saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cheese batch suspended by Anvisa: learn about the health risks posed by Listeria bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian health regulator Anvisa suspended a sliced mozzarella batch from the Italy brand after detecting Listeria monocytogenes, the agent behind listeriosis. Listeria monocytogenes is a bacterium found naturally in soil, water, vegetables, and animal feces, capable of causing severe infection. Infections are rare but can be fatal for high-risk groups. According to the World Health Organization, pregnant women have about 20 times higher risk than healthy adults, with potential for miscarriage or stillbirth; elderly and immunocompromised individuals also face serious disease. In newborns, maternal infection can lead to low birth weight, septicemia, and meningitis. The article highlights soft cheeses, cold-smoked fish, and ready-to-eat meats as high-risk foods. To prevent contamination, authorities urge following Anvisa alerts, checking product provenance, and practicing proper hygiene and refrigeration. The case underscores food-safety vigilance for households, especially during pregnancy.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisaがチーズロットを出荷停止：リステリア菌の健康リスクについて
triage.triage_reason: 単一製品のリコール事案であり、集団感染の報告や異常な拡大は確認されず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: イタリアブランドの製品がブラジルで販売・回収された事例であり、イタリアでの発生ではない。公衆衛生当局による予防的措置の段階で、実際の感染例報告は記事内に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Musim Pancaroba, ISPA dan Diare di Bangkalan Capai Ratusan Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transitional Season Brings Hundreds of Cases of Acute Respiratory Infections and Diarrhea in Bangkalan
article.articleSummary: Acute Respiratory Infections (ISPA) and diarrhea are surging in Bangkalan Regency, East Java, during the transitional season. In week 44 (early November 2026), health authorities reported 679 ISPA cases, 330 diarrhea cases, 270 influenza-like illness (ILI) cases, 146 typhoid, and 144 pneumonia. Head of the Bangkalan Health Department, Dr. Nunuk Kristiani, attributes the ISPA surge to hot, dry air during seasonal change. Prevention emphasizes clean living, complete immunization, regular meals and exercise, adequate water intake, avoiding contact with the sick, and mask use to reduce transmission. Symptoms typically appear about three days after exposure and last 7–10 days, though can persist up to three weeks in some individuals. Residents with cough, fever, runny nose, fatigue, or respiratory distress should seek medical care if symptoms do not improve.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目、バンカラン県で急性呼吸器感染症と下痢が数百件に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症・下痢の増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常の季節変動報告と判断される。
triage.notes: 季節の変わり目に伴う地域的な呼吸器疾患・下痢の増加であり、地方保健当局が通常の予防啓発を行っている内容。国際的懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: China Sustains Over 99.6 Percent Hepatitis B Mother-to-Child Prevention
article.articleSummary: China reports nationwide hepatitis B PMTCT success >99.6% from 2023–2025, based on 569,730 infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers across 31 provinces. Antenatal screening remained ~99.94–99.95%, with birth‑dose vaccination plus 100 IU hepatitis B immunoglobulin within 12 hours, subsequent vaccines at 1 and 6 months, and maternal antiviral prophylaxis for eligible women; post‑vaccination serology occurs at 7–12 months. Prevention success was 99.73% (2023), 99.66% (2024), and 99.68% (2025). Pediatric HBV infection among screened children declined from 9.09 to 7.52 to 2.92 per 100,000 live births. Among residual infections, 37.77% produced anti‑HBs, indicating serological heterogeneity. Regional infection rates remained higher in the western region (11.69→8.80→3.52 per 100,000), with central (7.70→7.64→3.06) and eastern (8.42→6.48→2.37) also showing declines. Findings support progress toward WHO 2030 HBV elimination targets; Maldives achieved triple elimination by May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、B型肝炎母子感染予防の成功率99.6%以上を維持
triage.triage_reason: 母子感染予防プログラムの成功を報告する内容で、公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態ではなく、むしろ良好な進展を示す成果報告であるため。
triage.notes: モルディブについても言及があるが、三重排除（triple elimination）達成という肯定的な成果報告であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。本記事はB型肝炎母子感染予防プログラムの成功事例報告であり、感染症危機シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: BFAR warns vs eating shellfish from 4 Eastern Visayas bays
article.articleSummary: Paralytic shellfish toxins linked to red tide were detected in shellfish from four Eastern Visayas bays, prompting BFAR-8 to issue a Nov. 12 advisory prohibiting gathering, selling, and consumption of all shellfish, including Acetes (alamang), from Carigara Bay (Leyte: Babatngon, San Miguel, Capoocan, Barugo, Carigara), Irong-Irong Bay (Samar: Catbalogan City), Matarinao Bay (Eastern Samar: General MacArthur, Quinapondan, Hernani, Salcedo), and Cambatutay Bay (Tarangnan, Samar). Local red tide warning issued for Cambatutay Bay while confirmatory tests are awaited from the BFAR National Fisheries Laboratory Division using the Receptor Binding Assay. Shellfish toxins include saxitoxin causing paralytic shellfish poisoning with numbness, tingling, difficulty breathing, and potentially death; cooking does not destroy the toxin. The advisory notes fish, squid, shrimp and crabs from these sites remain safe if fresh and gutted of internal organs and thoroughly washed. BFAR continues coastal monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: BFAR、東ビサヤ4湾の貝類摂取について警告
triage.triage_reason: 赤潮による貝毒検出に伴う予防的な採取・販売・摂取禁止の行政勧告であり、人への健康被害の報告はなく、フィリピンで季節的に繰り返される既知の事象のため経過観察の必要性も低い。
triage.notes: 赤潮（red tide）による麻痺性貝毒（saxitoxin）の検出に基づく予防的勧告で、人の罹患事例の報告はない。BFAR（フィリピン水産資源局）による地域管理の範囲内の事案であり、沿岸監視は継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Study Uncovers Drug-Resistant Tuberculosis Mutations and Lineage Patterns
article.articleSummary: In Shantou, China, 148 Mycobacterium tuberculosis isolates collected in 2024 show substantial drug resistance. Phenotypic resistance to at least one drug occurred in 31.8% of isolates, while 98.6% harbored detectable resistance mutations across analyzed loci. Isoniazid resistance was most common (20.9%), followed by streptomycin (10.1%), with rifampicin and ethambutol each at 6.2%. Retreated cases (20.4% of samples) exhibited significantly higher resistance than newly diagnosed cases (p<0.05). Genetic analysis found katG Arg463Leu in 66.2% and gyrA Ser95Thr in 98.0% of strains. Genotyping via IS6110 and 8-locus MIRU-VNTR differentiated 134 genotypes with a 9.46% overall clustering rate. Lineage 2 dominated; resistance mutations localized to inhA, rpsL, rrs, and pncA within this lineage. Phylogeny and mutation patterns align with Erdman and CDC1551 references. Methods included Löwenstein-Jensen DST, PCR/SnapGene, and MEGA11 phylogeny; Fisher’s exact and chi-squared tests assessed associations.

triage.headline_ja: 薬剤耐性結核の変異株と系統パターンを解明する研究
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は汕頭市における2024年採取の結核菌分離株の薬剤耐性変異・遺伝子型解析に関する学術研究報告であり、アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 湖北流感呈上升态势 湖北疾控提醒：绝大多数感染者是轻症
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza in Hubei on the rise; Hubei CDC warns: the vast majority of those infected have mild symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, influenza activity in Hubei Province is rising, with three strains circulating and A(H3N2) predominant alongside A(H1N1) and influenza B. Surveillance shows rising influenza-like illness and positive tests; the trend is multi-strain but not yet at peak. Most infections are mild; typical symptoms include abrupt high fever, chills, myalgia, fatigue, headache, sore throat, and cough; high-risk individuals may develop pneumonia or myocarditis. The article stresses influenza vs common cold differentiation. Vaccination is urged for eight high-risk groups: healthcare workers; adults ≥60; those with cardiovascular, metabolic, or chronic lung diseases; residents/staff of elder care facilities; children 6–59 months; household contacts of infants <6 months; school/childcare personnel; and pregnant women. Even those previously infected should vaccinate; protection lasts about 6–8 months. Optimal window is Sept–Oct, but vaccination during the season is beneficial; continue masks, ventilation, and hand hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 湖北省でインフルエンザが増加傾向、湖北省疾病予防管理センターが注意喚起：大多数の感染者は軽症
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、大多数が軽症との公式発表。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、通常の季節性公衆衛生情報の範囲内。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A(H3N2)優勢、A(H1N1)・B型混在）の通常の流行状況報告。ワクチン接種呼びかけなど公衆衛生の定例的な注意喚起。

article.articleHeadline: रहस्यमयी बीमारी या कुछ और? लखनऊ में चार दिन के अंदर एक ही परिवार के तीन बच्चों की मौत, नाक-मुंह से निकला खून
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious illness or something else? In Lucknow, three children from the same family died within four days, blood coming from their noses and mouths.
article.articleSummary: Three children from the same family in Khandasara village, Malihabad, Lucknow, died within four days in early November amid a suspected illness. The first, 3-year-old Divyansh, collapsed while playing on 9 November after a fever and died en route to hospital. The second, 7-year-old Kartik, died the next day under similar circumstances. The third, 10-year-old Lakshmi, developed fever and abdominal pain the night of 10 November and died early after admission to a private hospital in Dubagga. Lakshmi’s blood tests did not show typhoid, dengue, or malaria, while chest X-ray revealed severe bilateral pneumonia. Initial health-th department speculation included food poisoning; the ultimate cause will be clarified by postmortem findings and further investigations. Authorities led by CMO NB Singh will determine the cause and may exhume earlier deaths if needed; no charges yet.

triage.headline_ja: 謎の病気か、それとも別の原因か？ラクナウで同一家族の子供3人が4日以内に死亡、鼻や口から出血
triage.triage_reason: 同一家族の子供3人が短期間に原因不明のまま死亡し、鼻口からの出血や重度肺炎という重篤な症状を呈しており、デング・マラリア・腸チフスが否定されたことで異常性が高く、公衆衛生上の懸念が強いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 原因不明の家族内クラスター死亡事例。デング・マラリア・腸チフスは血液検査で否定されており、剖検結果待ち。鼻口からの出血という症状は出血熱等の可能性も否定できず、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sinh viên Nông nghiệp chung tay phòng chống bệnh dại từ gốc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agricultural students join forces to prevent rabies at its source.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention at its source takes center stage in Hanoi, Vietnam, as nearly 500 students, veterinarians, and faculty from the Vietnam Academy of Agriculture participated in an event on November 11. The project 'Pilot Model for Rabies Prevention, Sustainable Economic Development, and Gradual Transition of the Dog and Cat Meat Trade in 14 wards of Hanoi' was approved by the Hanoi People's Committee on July 24, 2025. Led by the Hanoi Department of Agriculture and Environment, with Soi Dog Foundation as an international partner and SBCC Vietnam providing technical support and behavior-change communications, the initiative adopts a One Health approach, linking disease control with livelihoods. Its three-stage pathway—training, startup support, and market linkage—seeks to eliminate human rabies deaths by 2030, aligning with Vietnam’s national target and WHO guidance. Veterinary students and future animal-health professionals act as ambassadors to translate academic knowledge into community health actions in Hanoi.

triage.headline_ja: 農業大学生、狂犬病の根本的予防に向けて協力
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病予防の啓発・教育イベントに関する内容であり、新規症例や異常な公衆衛生事象の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はハノイにおける狂犬病予防の啓発プロジェクト・教育活動に関する報道であり、感染症発生イベントではない。政府（ハノイ人民委員会）が関与する公衆衛生政策的な取り組みとして言及されている程度。

article.articleHeadline: India accounts for a quarter of global tuberculosis cases, deaths fall 38% since 2015: WHO
article.articleSummary: India accounts for about a quarter of the TB burden, per the WHO Global TB Report 2026. In 2025 TB incidence reached 10.6 million, down 75,000 from 2024, while India's share remained near 25%. TB deaths in India fell 38% since 2015, with mortality dropping from 28 to 18 per lakh; treatment success for drug-susceptible TB reached 94%. Globally, incidence declined 1.6% from 131 to 129 per lakh between 2024 and 2025, but the 2015–2025 decade shows a 14% drop, short of the End TB targets of 50% by 2025 and 80% by 2030. The National TB Elimination Programme expanded active case finding under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan: 28 crore people screened (Dec 2024–Mar 2026), with 39.0 lakh cases notified, including 1.3 lakh asymptomatic. Molecular testing expanded to 11,000 facilities; roughly 60% of presumptive TB had molecular tests in 2024. Innovations include nPoC and tongue-swab diagnostics and testing strategies.

triage.headline_ja: インドが世界の結核症例の4分の1を占める、2015年以降死亡者数は38%減少:WHO
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次報告に基づく統計的トレンド記事であり、結核罹患率・死亡率は改善傾向にある。異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 既知の疾患であり、むしろ改善傾向を示す統計報告。新規または異常な公衆衛生事象ではないためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 Variant Spread: PJ.2.1 Detected Across Eight Countries on Four Continents - Best Breaking News and Beyond: Singapore, Batam and some say JB
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a newly identified SARS-CoV-2 lineage, has been detected in eight countries across North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania, including Canada (Ontario first detected May 2, 2026), United States (New York City, June 30, 2026), France, Spain, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, and Israel. Ontario sequencing shows PJ.2.1 comprised 25.2% of SARS-CoV-2 samples from Sept 20–Oct 17, 2026, up 16.9 percentage points from the prior four weeks, signaling rising prevalence. Described as a saltation variant with an unusually large cluster of spike-protein mutations, it may enhance ACE2 receptor binding; overall evidence does not indicate more severe disease, higher hospitalizations, or more deaths. Laboratory tests suggest LP.8.1-adapted vaccine-neutralization remains; however, real-world effectiveness is unknown. Common COVID-19 symptoms persist: fever, cough, sore throat, congestion, headaches, muscle aches, fatigue. Ongoing genomic surveillance noted, highlighting regional monitoring relevance for Singapore, Indonesia, and others.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス変異株拡大：PJ.2.1が4大陸8カ国で検出
triage.triage_reason: 新規のスパイク変異クラスターを持つ変異株（PJ.2.1）が複数大陸で検出され国際的拡大傾向が見られるが、重症化・死亡増加のエビデンスはなく、対象国での具体的な発生確認もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事では検出国としてカナダ、米国、フランス、スペイン、シンガポール、オーストラリア、ニュージーランド、イスラエルが挙げられているが、いずれも評価対象国リストに含まれない。インドネシアは『地域的な監視の関連性』として言及されているのみで、実際の検出国としては記載がないため、verified_locationsから除外した。重症度増加のエビデンスがない点から深刻な公衆衛生イベントとは言えないが、新規変異株の国際拡大という点でゲノムサーベイランス動向の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: New Flu Strain May Have Emerged in China Following Zoonotic Spillover
article.articleSummary: Potentially new influenza strain emerging in China after suspected zoonotic spillover involving avian H9N2 and swine-origin H1N2v. In the past seven days, unverified reports indicate rising severe respiratory infections and hospitalizations in Liaoning, Guangxi and Jiangxi, with Hubei showing a trend in the last three days. October–November 2026 human infections have been reported in several provinces. Preliminary suspicions from anonymous Chinese virologists suggest reassortment between H9N2 and H1N2v could produce a new strain; H9N2 circulates in poultry and has contributed genes to other strains, while H1N2v is a swine-origin variant capable of infecting humans. There is concern that infections linked to the suspected strain could be more severe. Officials have not issued official statements; emphasis is on expanded genomic surveillance, rapid identification of unusual respiratory infections, and close monitoring of animal-to-human transmission to assess pathogenicity and adaptation.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で人獣共通感染後に新型インフルエンザ株が出現した可能性
triage.triage_reason: H9N2とH1N2vの再集合による新型インフルエンザ株出現の疑いがあり、複数省で重症呼吸器感染症・入院増加の未検証報告があるため、パンデミックポテンシャルの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 情報源は匿名の中国人ウイルス学者による未検証の報告であり、中国当局からの公式声明は出ていない。新型株の病原性・ヒト-ヒト感染能力の評価が急務であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pastoral Case Series Details HIV and Brucellosis Coinfection Management in
article.articleSummary: Seven consecutive male people living with HIV (PWH) with laboratory-confirmed Brucella infection were treated at the Fourth People’s Hospital of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, northwest China, from July 2021 to May 2025. All had pastoral exposure to sheep or cattle. Presentations combined fever, fatigue, night sweats, with focal lesions (two with lumbar spondylitis/spondylodiscitis; two with epididymo-orchitis/hydroceles; four with testicular fluid collections). Antibacterial regimens plus antiretroviral therapy produced clinical improvement or stabilization in all, with no microbiologically confirmed recurrences during up to 54 months of follow-up. Brucellosis in China reached 62,055 cases in 2024 (4.41/100,000; ~90% northern). Ningxia reported rising local incidence (2022: 86.76/100k; 2023: 63.17; 2024: 34.81; 2,538 cases). Brucella melitensis was the predominant species. Diagnosis relied on culture or tube agglutination ≥1:100; four patients had positive blood cultures; six had agglutination titers 1:100–1:800; one culture-positive but agglutination-negative in an immunocompromised host.

triage.headline_ja: 牧畜従事者におけるHIVとブルセラ症の重複感染管理に関する症例シリーズ
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設における7例の症例シリーズ報告であり、臨床管理の記述が主眼。新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心も低いと判断される。
triage.notes: ブルセラ症は中国北部で既知の地方病であり、本記事は臨床症例シリーズの学術的報告。HIVとの重複感染は家畜との接触による職業曝露が背景で、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 dão sinal de crescimento no Brasil, aponta Fiocruz - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases show signs of growth in Brazil, according to Fiocruz - Sim Notícias
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin for 1–7 November shows growth in SRAG (severe acute respiratory syndrome) cases linked to Covid-19 in Brazil, though overall severe cases remain low. Hospitalizations for Covid-19–associated SRAG rose in Centro-Sul states (Distrito Federal, Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná) and in Bahia (Nordeste), while Mato Grosso shows slowing growth. By epidemiological week 44, no state has a rising SRAG alert; Roraima and Mato Grosso are at alert levels but have had no increases in six weeks. Emphasizing ongoing circulation, the report recommends full vaccination and annual boosters for priority groups. In the four most recent weeks, among positive respiratory-virus cases: influenza A 4.3%, influenza B 3.9%, RSV 8.9%, rhinovirus 49%, SARS-CoV-2 11.5%; among deaths: influenza A 7.7%, influenza B 10.3%, RSV 2.6%, rhinovirus 43.6%, SARS-CoV-2 26.9%.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでCOVID-19重症例が増加傾向、Fiocruzが指摘
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性呼吸器感染症サーベイランス報告であり、重症例全体は低水準かつ上昇アラートの出ている州もないため、特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: Fiocrizの定期的なInfoGripe監視報告に基づく記事で、既知の季節性病原体（COVID-19、インフルエンザA/B、RSV）の国内サーベイランス動向を示すもの。新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dosen Unpad Kembangkan Biosensor Deteksi TB hingga DNA Babi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unpad Lecturer Develops Biosensor for Detecting TB up to Pig DNA
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Padjadjaran University (Unpad) analytical chemistry lecturer Irkham is developing CRISPR-based electrochemical biosensors to detect infectious diseases and halal-quality markers. The chip-sized sensors operate on electrochemical principles akin to glucose meters, targeting tuberculosis and rifampicin-resistance mutations, with the aim of affordable, portable point-of-care testing accessible near patients and potentially at home. In halal-food testing, the sensor detects pork DNA and alcohol to verify products. The approach uses boron-doped diamond electrodes and nanoceria, employing green synthesis methods. Major challenges include ensuring reproducibility and securing investment, while fostering collaborations for broader deployment. Reported from Jakarta on 13 November 2026, the work seeks to expand TB diagnostics and halal verification across Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: Unpad大学講師、結核検出から豚DNA検出まで対応するバイオセンサーを開発
triage.triage_reason: これは結核診断技術の研究開発に関する学術記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核や豚DNA検出用のバイオセンサー技術開発に関する研究紹介であり、感染症発生事例ではないため、対象国の発生地域としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Concerns Rise That New Sars-CoV-2 Variants Could Be at Play as Severe COVID-19 Cases Rises Across Brazil
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-13, Brazil sees rising severe COVID-19 hospitalizations in Central-South and Northeastern states—Federal District, Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, and Bahia—with Mato Grosso slowing. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe Bulletin (Nov 12) notes increasing COVID-19–related SARI, though overall activity remains relatively low and no nationwide emergency is declared. Authorities seek to know if emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants are driving the trend; genomic sequencing is needed for confirmation. Roraima and Mato Grosso remain at alert but have not had case increases in six weeks. Vaccination, including boosters for vulnerable groups, remains crucial. In four weeks of data, rhinovirus accounted for 49% of respiratory-virus detections, SARS-CoV-2 11.5%; deaths with identified viruses: rhinovirus 43.6%, SARS-CoV-2 26.9%, influenza B 10.3%, influenza A 7.7%, RSV 2.6%. Ongoing surveillance is essential to distinguish fluctuations from resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル全土で重症COVID-19症例が増加、新たなSARS-CoV-2変異株の関与への懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州で重症COVID-19入院が増加し新変異株の関与が懸念されているが、全国的活動は依然低水準で緊急事態宣言もなく、変異株の確定にはゲノム解析待ちのため情報不足。
triage.notes: 新変異株の関与は未確認でゲノム解析待ち。呼吸器ウイルス全体ではライノウイルスが優勢（49%）でSARS-CoV-2は11.5%。続報（特にゲノムサーベイランス結果）を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 'Coronavirus might be evolving': Professor Suresh V Kuchipudi
article.articleSummary: Coronavirus may still be circulating in animals, warns Suresh V Kuchipudi of the University of Pittsburgh. In U.S. white-tailed deer, infection is widespread; the original strain has circulated for more than four years and has changed significantly, potentially escaping more than 70% of antibody protection while still infecting humans and deer. Genomic surveillance of human cases has largely stopped, suggesting the virus could be evolving unseen. The concern extends to H5N1 bird flu, now found in birds and animals on every continent and in dairy cattle in America; each spillover from birds to mammals moves the virus closer to human adaptation. Nipah outbreaks recur in a northern pocket of Kerala (Keralam); cases are picked up only when infections reach hospitals, implying local exposure patterns. Policymakers and scientists should study local conditions and monitor evolving threats.

triage.headline_ja: 「コロナウイルスは進化しているかもしれない」：スレシュ・V・クチプディ教授
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な新規症例や急性アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、専門家によるコロナウイルス・H5N1・ニパウイルスの進化・再興リスクに関する一般的な警鐘・解説記事であるため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家の意見・警告記事であり、米国のシカにおけるコロナウイルス変異やH5N1の家畜への拡大、インド・ケーララ州での再発性ニパウイルス流行パターンについて言及しているが、いずれも新規の確定アウトブレイク報告ではない。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ケーララ（インド）のニパ再発傾向のみ地域検証対象として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Sechs Monate Ebola-Ausbruch: Mehr als 5.000 Tote - Ebola im Kongo ist längst nicht besiegt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six months into the Ebola outbreak: More than 5,000 dead — Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is far from defeated.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 11,000 cases and about 5,500 deaths have been recorded across eight provinces, with North Kivu as the current epicenter and Ituri as a key front. Case fatality hovers around 50%, and authorities fear underreporting means true tolls are higher. Health workers report overwhelmed Ebola treatment centers (ETCs) and late patient arrivals, driving higher mortality. The eastern region’s security situation—approximately 100 armed groups and ongoing clashes—complicates response and endangers staff. Prevention is hampered by persistent social activity (bars, weddings, schools) and gaps in hygiene practices and facility decontamination. Community denial and traditional caregiving/burial practices sustain transmission; about 60% of deaths are reported from communities rather than treatment centers. A licensed vaccine, Ervebo, targets Zaire ebolavirus; workers are being vaccinated in hopes it may also protect against Bundibugyo virus driving this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱発生から6か月：死者5,000人超──コンゴのエボラは依然として終息せず
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で8州にまたがり11,000例・死者約5,500人（致死率約50%）に達する大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、治安悪化や地域社会での感染持続によりIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: 男子为清火明目一口吞下蛇胆：三个月后脑子里长满寄生虫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man swallowed a snake's gallbladder in one gulp to clear heat and improve his vision: three months later, his brain was filled with parasites.
article.articleSummary: 50-year-old man from Taizhou, Zhejiang, China, swallowed a fresh wild snake gallbladder hoping to 'clear heat and improve vision.' Within 2-3 months he developed left-sided weakness and seizures. Brain imaging revealed multiple intracranial cysts with scattered lesions; after ruling out stroke and tumor, he was diagnosed with neurocysticercosis from a taenia tapeworm carried in via the snake bile. Wild snakes can harbor parasites and eggs; raw snake bile does not kill them. Ingestion allows parasite eggs to hatch, larvae travel through the bloodstream, cross the blood-brain barrier, and establish in brain tissue, causing seizures, weakness, and potentially life-threatening complications. Antiparasitic treatment led to gradual recovery of motor function, but long-term therapy and regular follow-up were required. Public health message: there is no scientific basis for snake bile cleansing; raw intake poses risks; thoroughly cook foods to kill pathogens, ideally reaching 100 degrees Celsius.

article.articleHeadline: More than 5,500 dead as Congo's Ebola epidemic continues rapid spread
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists, with North Kivu Province as the epicentre. About 11,000 Ebola cases have been recorded in the past six months, and nearly 5,500 deaths have occurred, a toll that could be higher due to undetected transmission since February and the May 15 official declaration. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved specific treatment, complicating containment. Cases have spread to eight provinces and crossed borders to Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Early symptoms mimic malaria, delaying isolation and care; advanced disease causes fluid loss, inflammatory responses, coagulation disorders, and organ failure. At Butembo Ebola Treatment Centre, 24 of 30 pediatric admissions (June–Sept 2026) died, most under age 5. MSF reports overwhelmed facilities amid ongoing conflict involving around 100 armed groups in Ituri and North Kivu.

article.articleHeadline: В Кении выписали последнего пациента с лихорадкой Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kenya, the last patient with Ebola fever has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: Kenya discharged the seventh and final patient with Ebola fever, launching a 42-day countdown to an official end of the outbreak. No new cases have been reported since October 20, 2026. The index patient—an entrepreneur who contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and died after returning to Nairobi via Uganda—triggered the domestic cluster; his mother also died, but transmission within Kenya was avoided. Authorities report 135 contacts completed a 21-day observation; seven recovered patients—including four health workers—were released (five on November 3, the sixth after three days, and the last after negative tests on a Wednesday). The WHO requires 42 days after the last recovery or safe burial to declare eradication. Kenya maintains strict surveillance at airports, hospitals, and borders, with quarantine for travelers from affected areas; domestic travel restrictions are not planned. The Congo outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccines or treatments exist yet, though trials are ongoing.

article.articleHeadline: Severe Scrub Typhus Triggers Multi-Organ Failure Without Classic Eschar in
article.articleSummary: Severe scrub typhus (tsutsugamushi disease) triggered life-threatening systemic inflammation and multi-organ failure in a 47-year-old Shenzhen chef without a diagnostic eschar. Orientia tsutsugamushi, transmitted by chigger mites, causes tsutsugamushi disease, endemic across the Asia–Pacific including southern China, with ~1 million infections annually and rising Guangdong incidence. The patient developed acute respiratory distress syndrome, disseminated intravascular coagulation, hepatic injury, and myocardial damage after an unrecognized arthropod bite. He presented after ten days of fever and myalgia; on admission he had SOFA 7, severe thrombocytopenia (platelets 70→33×10^9/L), PaO2/FiO2 ~165, CRP 102.61 mg/L, D-dimer >20 mg/L FEU, and prolonged aPTT 48.9 s with DIC features. ALT 216 U/L and bilirubin 30.9 μmol/L indicated hepatic injury; ARDS met Berlin criteria. Murine typhus and dengue were considered but eschar absence complicated recognition. The case, treated at Peking University Shenzhen Hospital in June 2024, underscores eschar-negative scrub typhus in China.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's first domestically produced chikungunya virus antigen test kit approved for market; a rapid screening tool debuts.
article.articleSummary: China has approved the first domestically produced chikungunya virus antigen test kit for market, introducing a rapid on-site screening tool for grassroots clinics and border ports. The assay uses colloidal gold immunochromatography, requiring only a sample and producing a visually readable result in 15–30 minutes without specialized equipment, and it can be stored at room temperature. This enables immediate screening and clinical support, bolstering vector-borne disease surveillance and early response in the Greater Bay Area. The kit is developed by DaAn Gene (Zhongshan) Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Guangzhou DaAn Gene Co., under Guangzhou Pharmaceutical Group’s indirect control since 2026. DaAn Gene’s broader diagnostic portfolio includes hepatitis, HIV, syphilis, EBV, and influenza, underscoring enhanced public health supply chains and regional diagnostic capacity.

article.articleHeadline: Sinh viên ngành Thú y lan tỏa tri thức, chung tay phòng dịch dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Veterinary students spread knowledge, join hands to prevent rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains the focus: In Hanoi, Vietnam, nearly 500 veterinary students, faculty, and staff from the Vietnam Agricultural University’s Faculty of Veterinary Medicine joined a pilot project connecting rabies prevention with livelihoods. The event, part of the 14-ward Hanoi One Health model, is organized by SBCC Vietnam and Soi Dog Foundation; aims to turn knowledge into action by training students as ambassadors to disseminate accurate rabies information to families and communities, and to help convert dog and cat meat trade activities into safe, sustainable livelihoods. CDC Hanoi outlined rabies status and infection risks linked to dog/cat meat collection, transport, and slaughter. The program, approved in 2025 by Hanoi's municipal People’s Committee and led by the Hanoi Department of Agriculture and Environment, links disease control with livelihood transformation to support the goal of zero human rabies deaths by 2030, leveraging career training and market access to promote One Health.

article.articleHeadline: 三种毒株同时活跃，流感季这些防护要点请收好
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains are active simultaneously; please take note of these precautions for the flu season.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-13, China reports three circulating influenza strains: A(H3N2) slightly dominant, with A(H1N1) rising and influenza B also active, creating a complex mix that may prolong the season and enable sequential infections. Beijing YouAn Hospital (Capital Medical University) cautions that cross-protection between strains is weak. High‑risk groups—65+, children under 5, pregnant or peripartum women, immunocompromised individuals, those with chronic disease, and obesity—should monitor for persistent fever, poor response to antipyretics, or symptoms lasting more than five days. Symptoms of A(H1N1) and A(H3N2) overlap; influenza B in children more often causes GI symptoms. The trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine remains the best prevention and can be co-administered with other inactivated vaccines at different sites; rabies exposure takes priority, and nasal live vaccines require a 28-day interval. Vaccination is advised even after infection to reduce severe disease and protect families; recovery should be 2–4 weeks before vaccination. Antivirals oseltamivir and baloxavir marboxil are prescription-only; misuse risks side effects and resistance; baloxavir not for under 1 year; oseltamivir from 2 weeks old.

article.articleSummary: South Halmahera Regency, North Maluku, Indonesia, faces tuberculosis (TB) concerns as Regent Bassam Kasuba urges intensified TB management. Speaking at the National Health Day 62 ceremony on November 12, 2026, he called for mapping prevalence and stronger prevention through the Dinas Kesehatan. Halmahera Selatan has achieved 95% BPJS Kesehatan coverage under Universal Health Coverage, ensuring free access to health services. TB, a contagious bacterial infection primarily affecting the lungs but able to involve other organs, requires timely care. WHO data cited: 1.5 million TB deaths in 2020; TB ranks 13th in mortality and is the second deadliest infectious disease after COVID-19. Indonesia ranks third globally in TB cases, with about 845,000 cases in 2019. TB is curable and preventable, underscoring the need to improve prevention and access to care.

article.articleHeadline: Health Canada flags safety risks of unapproved peptides after bacterial contamination
article.articleSummary: Health Canada warned against unauthorised peptide products after laboratory tests detected bacterial contamination in an injectable product seized from an Ottawa wellness store linked to Sage & Summit Wellness Co. The products include BPC-157, promoted for injury recovery, and retatrutide, an experimental obesity treatment by Eli Lilly that is not approved; other unauthorised injectables and oral peptides, including the 'Wolverine Stack' (BPC-157 plus TB-500). Injecting contaminated substances could cause serious infections, hospitalisation and, in severe cases, life-threatening sepsis. Labels such as 'For Research Purposes Only' do not exempt products from regulatory requirements or human-use legality. In a separate development, Health Canada flagged bacterial contamination in unauthorised injectable peptides seized from China-based Shanghai ERP Peptide Biotechnology Co., with more than 11,400 vials seized from the manufacturer and two Canadian online retailers.

article.articleHeadline: Study Uncovers Microbial Risks in Takeaway Salads Despite Consumer
article.articleSummary: China’s Jinan City, Shandong Province, a mixed-methods study found microbial contamination, not pesticide residues, is the primary post-harvest hazard for ready-to-eat salads. The survey of 349 consumers—predominantly urban women aged 21–30 with bachelor’s degrees—showed pesticide residues as the top safety concern, followed by microbial contamination. Lab analyses of commercially sold salads found pesticides largely undetectable (two weak positives in round lettuce) but pronounced bacterial contamination across channels. On purchase day, aerobic plate counts exceeded 5 log CFU/g in takeout and supermarket salads; E. coli exceeded limits in takeout and rose during five days of 4°C storage. Online/e-commerce salads stayed within guidelines. Household decontamination regimens (10-minute tap rinse vs 10-minute 1% sodium bicarbonate soak plus rinse) were evaluated, with initial contamination varying by produce type. Trust in processors was lower than trust in farm producers, and safety concerns correlated with purchasing choices when supply chains lack transparency.

article.articleHeadline: Govt reveals latest talks with Saudi Arabia over Ebola restrictions on Kenyans
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola infections and two deaths since the first case on Oct 5, 2026, linked to a single cluster traced to a Kenyan man who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda to Nairobi on Oct 3. As of Nov 11, the last patient treated for the Bundibugyo strain was discharged; 11 contacts completed monitoring. Kenya began a 42-day countdown on Nov 12, with Dec 23 eyed for declaring the outbreak over if no new cases emerge. Kenya maintains containment, with initial infection detected and isolated and no community transmission reported. Saudi Arabia imposed Oct 30, 2026 travel restrictions including visa suspensions for Kenyans and barring travelers from Kenya, prompting criticism; Mutua and Saudi authorities held talks in Riyadh on Nov 12 to seek lifting and restoration of work access. Africa CDC urged countries to isolate the virus, not nations, amid calls for cooperation.

article.articleHeadline: Guangdong Identified as Primary Origin of HIV-1 Introductions to Haikou
article.articleSummary: Guangdong is identified as the primary external source of HIV-1 introductions into Haikou, China, across four major subtypes (CRF07_BC, CRF01_AE, CRF65_cpx, CRF55_01B). In a 2021–2024 study of 1,125 pol sequences plus a cross-sectional field survey, CRF07_BC (38.6%) and CRF01_AE (35.6%) were most prevalent; local clustering was 33.6% (CRF07_BC), 36.7% (CRF01_AE), 54.9% (CRF55_01B), and 86.4% (CRF65_cpx). Bayesian relaxed clock and Skygrid phylogeography placed Guangdong as the primary source for all four subtypes; Beijing contributed CRF01_AE_C1 and CRF65_cpx, Shanghai CRF07_BC. Within Hainan, CRF01_AE showed bidirectional spread between Haikou and Sanya/Dongfang; CRF07_BC and CRF65_cpx spread from Haikou to six other cities. Field data from 451 participants found 52.3% acquired HIV outside Haikou; Guangdong accounted for 16.95% of externals (40 cases), with Sanya driving internal cases (18, 7.63%). The findings support cross-regional prevention for mobile populations.

article.articleHeadline: India makes progress in TB elimination with 38 percent drop in mortality - Connected to India News I Singapore l UAE l UK l USA l NRI
article.articleSummary: India reduced TB mortality by 38% since 2015, surpassing the global 35% decline, per the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026 released November 12, 2026. The country also reports a 94% treatment success rate among patients with drug-susceptible TB. Achievements arise from intensified National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) efforts, including proactive case finding, AI-enabled chest X-rays, rapid diagnostics, timely treatment, differentiated TB care, and nutritional support via Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana and Ni-kshay Mitra. AI tools such as Khushi (an AI-powered chatbot and avatar-based videobot) identify hotspots, predict high-risk cases, and strengthen patient engagement. Under Prime Minister Narendra Modi, TB elimination efforts are coordinated through Jan Andolan and the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, expanding community-based screening, molecular diagnostics, TB preventive treatment, and nutrition. Notably, 96% of TB programme funding comes from domestic resources, reflecting sustained political commitment and a whole-of-government, whole-of-society approach.

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC di Majalengka: Temuan dan Target Pengobatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB cases in Majalengka: Findings and Treatment Targets
article.articleSummary: Majalengka Regency, West Java, Indonesia, reported 2,669 tuberculosis (TB) cases from January to July 2026. The Case Notification Rate (CNR) was 172 per 100,000 population. Treatment coverage reached 87.2% of the 90% target, while enrollment rate stood at 84.05% of 100%. Seven months’ findings cannot be directly compared to full-year totals; earlier years saw 4,434 cases in 2024 and 3,600 in 2025. TB treatment success reached 91.6% of the 95% target; the service delivery standard (SPM) was 81.9% of 100%. TB preventive therapy (TPT) achieved 250.5% of target. Deputy Health Minister dr. Benjamin Paulus Octavianus called for expanded case finding, increased screening, and patient adherence, including integrating TB checks with free health-check programs. Local government will strengthen cross-sector TB control, integrating actions into RPJMD, RKPD, and APBD, leveraging 32 puskesmas, three regional hospitals, and TB Village Cadres to improve education and early detection.

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis deaths decline 38 pc in India since 2015: WHO report - english.punjabkesari.com
article.articleSummary: India reduced tuberculosis deaths by 38% since 2015, per WHO Global TB Report 2026, with mortality dropping from 280 to 180 deaths per million. Despite progress, India accounted for 25% of global TB cases in 2025; other major shares are Indonesia (10%), Philippines (6.8%), China (6.5%), Pakistan (6.4%), Nigeria (4.9%), DR Congo (3.9%), and Bangladesh (3.7%). India remains among four countries with >50% of global multidrug-resistant (MDR) TB cases in 2025, though MDR-TB incidence is gradually declining. The TB profile will be updated after district-level sentinel surveillance data are analyzed with the Central TB Division and ICMR, with an updated country profile due in early 2027. Health authorities cite a 94% treatment success rate and the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, which screened over 25 crore people, conducted over 11 crore chest X-rays, and identified 48.64 lakh new TB cases (including 14.97 lakh asymptomatic).

triage.headline_ja: インドにおける結核死亡者数、2015年以降38%減少：WHO報告書
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次結核報告書に基づく統計・進捗報告であり、新規の異常事態や急性の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの結核死亡率低下という定期的統計報告であり、他国（インドネシア、フィリピン、中国等）は世界的な症例シェアの比較として言及されているのみで、実際の発生イベントの主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Lubang Tambang Emas Ilegal di Sumba Timur Diduga Picu Lonjakan Kasus Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Illegal gold mining pits in East Sumba suspected to have triggered a spike in malaria cases.
article.articleSummary: Illegal gold mining pits in Matawai La Pawu and surrounding areas of East Sumba Regency, Indonesia, are suspected to drive a malaria spike. Abandoned mining holes serve as Anopheles mosquito breeding sites. Preliminary health department findings link most cases to Melolo sub-district (Puskesmas Melolo), which accounts for 56% of malaria in the district. In Umalulu District, 47 malaria cases were found; miners typically stay 4–5 days at the sites and return on weekends, aiding transmission. In 2026, malaria cases total 250, more than five times the 46 cases in 2025, with about 10 positives per 1,000 population on average. After Melolo, the highest counts are in Kambata Mapambuhang and Kananggar, API 7.9 and 6.6 respectively. About 81 miners are spread across several sub-districts. Six elimination priorities are: case finding, epidemiologic investigation, mapping receptive zones and vectors, integrating malaria with maternal and child health programs, migration surveillance, and prevention education.

triage.headline_ja: 東スンバの違法金鉱採掘跡がマラリア症例急増の原因と疑われる
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定のマラリア症例急増で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、違法鉱山活動による媒介蚊増殖という予想外の要因があり、労働者移動によるさらなる感染拡大の可能性があるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は地域紙(kupang.tribunnews.com)によるローカル報道で、保健当局による症例調査・マッピング等の対応が進行中。死亡例や重症度の具体的データは記載されておらず、国際的な関心の高まりも確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Incertidumbre por la escasez de la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uncertainty over the Yellow Fever vaccine shortage.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccine shortage hits pharmacies in Buenos Aires as the 2026 summer season nears. Free vaccination ended in 2025, making the dose mandatory for entry to many Latin American destinations, with stock exhausted in Buenos Aires hospitals by mid-2026 and inoculation shifting to private purchase. The national Health Ministry limited free access to high-risk regions, raising equity concerns for travelers and public health. In practice, pharmacies report widespread shortages, with some outlets carrying minimal stock or operating on order; vaccination requires official training to administer and issue the certificate. In La Plata, only about 50–60 of 330 pharmacies have completed the course. Each dose costs over 300,000 pesos, potentially exceeding 1 million pesos for a four-person family. Endemic zones (Bolivia, Peru, Colombia, Paraguay, Cuba, Panama, Venezuela, parts of Brazil) require the certificate; some northern Argentine provinces (Misiones, Corrientes, Formosa, Salta, Jujuy, Chaco) still offer free doses.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病ワクチン不足への不安広がる
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおける黄熱病ワクチンの供給・アクセス問題に関する記事であり、対象国リストに該当する国での感染症発生事例ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチン国内でのワクチン供給不足・価格高騰に関する内容であり、黄熱病の発生・流行自体を報じたものではない。発生地域に挙げられているBrazil等も記事中では渡航先の流行地として言及されているのみで、対象国リストのいずれも感染症発生の主題国ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 男子为滋补生食花生米大小蛇胆，3 个月后突发抽搐倒地，检查发现脑内长满寄生虫Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻 - NEWS.CHINA.COM.AU 这里是生活在墨尔本咱自家人的地盘！把客场当主场，视异乡为故园。澳洲唐人街 - 中华澳网 China Town News澳洲唐人街;澳大利亚华人社区和主流新闻媒体
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man eats a peanut-sized snake gallbladder raw as a tonic; three months later he suddenly had convulsions and collapsed, and examination revealed his brain was infested with parasites.
article.articleSummary: A 50-year-old man from Taizhou, Zhejiang Province, developed sudden left-sided weakness and seizures in mid-October 2026, three months after his father gave him a wild snake’s fresh gallbladder as a tonic. Imaging revealed numerous intracerebral lesions with a 1.6 × 1.1 cm cyst in the right temporal lobe displaying ring enhancement, consistent with brain parasitic infection. The infectious diseases team diagnosed neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia (chain-tailed tapeworm) infection, likely from ingesting eggs via the raw snake gallbladder. Eggs hatch; larvae migrate to the brain, forming cysts that trigger epileptic seizures and focal deficits. Treatment aimed to control seizures and eradicate parasites; the patient recovered motor function and was discharged on ongoing antiparasitic therapy with regular follow-up. The report cautions that raw snake gallbladder and similar folk remedies are dangerous and not beneficial, urging medical consultation for illnesses instead of relying on traditional tonics.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が滋養強壮のため生のヘビの胆嚢（ピーナッツ大）を食べ、3か月後に突然けいれんを起こして倒れ、検査の結果、脳内に寄生虫が多数発生していたことが判明
triage.triage_reason: 単一個人の食習慣による孤発性の有鉤嚢虫症（神経嚢虫症）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の広がりのリスクはなく、国際的な関心事項にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 個人の生食習慣（生のヘビの胆嚢摂取）による孤発例であり、感染経路はヒト-ヒト感染ではなく虫卵の経口摂取によるもの。公衆衛生上の緊急対応は不要だが、民間療法の危険性に関する啓発記事としての性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Di Balik Temuan 676 Orang Terindikasi TB, Cek Kesehatan Gratis Wonogiri Baru Jangkau 72 Persen Warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Behind the finding of 676 people suspected of TB, Wonogiri's free health screenings have only reached 72 percent of residents.
article.articleSummary: In Wonogiri Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, free health screenings (CKG) target 1,016,049 residents. By November 2026, 734,613 people have undergone screening (72.3%), leaving about 281,436 unscreened. Active TB screening identified 676 residents with indications of tuberculosis. The program aims to achieve 100% coverage by January 2027. This marks a substantial improvement from 2025, when 39% coverage was reported, and Wonogiri ranks fourth-fastest in Central Java for CKG implementation. Regent Setyo Sukarno emphasizes ongoing outreach to boost utilization of free health screenings to enable early disease detection and strengthen public health services.

triage.headline_ja: 676人がTB疑いと判明した背景、ウォノギリの無料健康診断はまだ住民の72%にしか届いていない
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核スクリーニングプログラムの進捗報告であり、異常な集団発生や急性の公衆衛生リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定期的な結核スクリーニングプログラムの進捗報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクを示すものではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 三甲医生回应今年流感毒株不一样 多毒株共流行需警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top-tier doctors say this year's influenza virus strains are different; with multiple strains circulating, vigilance is needed.
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains—H3N2, H1N1, and influenza B Victoria lineage—are co-circulating in Beijing, China. Beijing You’an Hospital infectious disease chief Li Tongzeng notes an atypical season: transmission began in early November, peaked in December, and declined by January, indicating an earlier start and end than usual. The three strains do not confer cross-protection, so infection with one strain does not shield against others. Co-circulation raises the risk of successive infections in a short time and may extend the overall influenza season, increasing total cases. Distinguishing influenza from a common cold remains essential: influenza starts abruptly with high fever and systemic symptoms and lasts about 7–10 days, whereas a cold has slower onset, milder, localized nasal symptoms, and resolves in 3–5 days. These findings underscore vigilance during the autumn–winter period.

triage.headline_ja: 三甲医師が回答、今年のインフルエンザウイルス株は例年と異なる、複数株の共流行に警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの複数株共流行という通常の公衆衛生情報であり、重篤な異常事態の証拠はないが、流行拡大・症例増加の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの複数株共流行に関する医療専門家のコメント記事。重症例数や死亡者数などの定量データはなく、通常の季節性流行情報に近い内容。北京地域における流行パターンの変化（開始・終息時期の前倒し）が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Santé publique : face au risque épidémique, la Guinée renforce la coordination sanitaire avec ses voisins
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public Health: Facing Epidemic Risk, Guinea Strengthens Health Coordination with Its Neighbors.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo lineage) outbreak, first declared May 15, 2026 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has reached eight provinces with 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths as of November 11, per WHO/ECDC. The spread prompts cross-border West African coordination as Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone convene November 11–13, 2026 in Guéckédou, Guinea, to harmonize border alerting, information sharing, and a joint operational roadmap amid evolving regional transmission linked to Central/Eastern Africa spread. A case imported into Nigeria on October 20 from Uganda marks the first export fragment; as of November 11, no further confirmed Nigerian cases or deaths, with 62 contacts identified (52 completed 21-day follow-up; 10 under surveillance). Past regional collaborations include the 2014–2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic (28,600 cases, 11,325 deaths) and the 2022 Lassa fever meeting in Guéckédou; Ivory Coast and Ghana have strengthened border surveillance and traveler monitoring in response.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生：疫学的リスクに直面し、ギニアが近隣諸国との保健協力を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ系統)アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し11,114症例・5,433死亡、ナイジェリアへの越境輸入例も発生しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的な対応強化の動きがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクを主題とし、西アフリカ諸国（ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ等、対象国リスト外）が国境監視を協調強化している内容。ガーナ・コートジボワールは対応強化国として言及されているが発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ナイジェリアも輸入症例1件のみで対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Study Finds High Macrolide Resistance During Pediatric Mycoplasma Pneumonia
article.articleSummary: Beijing, China, at Peking University First Hospital, retrospective study of 255 bronchoalveolar lavage fluid samples from June 1, 2023, to May 31, 2024 found Mycoplasma pneumoniae in 188 (73.7%) pediatric inpatients with pneumonia. Among positives, the macrolide-resistance 23S rRNA A2063G mutation was detected in 138 cases (73.4%), with 101 of 131 infected children aged 6–11 years carrying the mutation (77.1%). Infection peaked in autumn (91.7%) and was highest in school-aged children (6–11 years, 84%). Metagenomic NGS revealed co-infections with Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae, plus viral agents adenovirus, bocavirus, and rhinovirus. Infected kids showed significantly reduced lower-respiratory microbiome diversity (lower Shannon and Simpson indices, p<0.001) and age-related shifts in microbial composition—<3 years dominated by Streptococcus and viruses; 12–18 years enriched in Cutibacterium acnes and Prevotella. Findings support age-specific diagnostics and antimicrobial strategies amid macrolide-resistant outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 小児マイコプラズマ肺炎流行時に高いマクロライド耐性が確認された研究
triage.triage_reason: 北京の単一病院における後方視的研究で、マクロライド耐性マイコプラズマ肺炎の高い検出率を報告しているが、新規アウトブレイクの発生や公衆衛生上の緊急対応を示す情報はなく、学術的知見の域にとどまる。
triage.notes: 本記事は2023年6月〜2024年5月の後方視的研究データに基づく学術論文の紹介であり、現在進行形のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。マクロライド耐性の疫学的動向として継続的な情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Bukan Covid-19 Varian PJ.2.1, Ternyata Paling Banyak Secara Global Varian ST.1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not the COVID-19 Variant PJ.2.1, Turns Out to Be the Globally Most Prevalent ST.1 Variant.
article.articleSummary: Global SARS-CoV-2 variant ST.1 is the most prevalent in November 2026 per GISAID, accounting for 28.57% of sequences, with PJ.2.1 subvariant second at 14.29%. Other Variant Under Monitoring include XFG, TK.1, TA.1 at 7.14% each. Indonesian Health Ministry spokesman Aji Muhawarman said surveillance continues through detection, data collection, and reporting of infectious diseases with potential outbreaks; no variant-specific concerns at this time. ST.1 shows no distinctive symptoms beyond general COVID-19 features. Transmission is mainly through respiratory droplets and aerosols. Based on surveillance data, ST.1 is not more transmissible than XFG, and disease severity from ST.1 is reportedly milder than XFG. The article notes these findings from GISAID as of November 2026; no case counts or travel-related import/export details were provided.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19変異株PJ.2.1ではなく、世界的に最も多いのはST.1変異株であることが判明
triage.triage_reason: 新規変異株に関する通常のサーベイランス報告であり、重症度増加や異常な拡大などの懸念事項は示されておらず、インドネシア保健省も特段の懸念を表明していない。
triage.notes: 記事はGISAIDの世界的な変異株分布の統計報告であり、ST.1はXFGより重症度が低く、伝播性も高くないとされている。インドネシア特有の発生事例ではなくグローバルなサーベイランスデータの紹介であるためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: India logra avances significativos en erradicación de tuberculosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India makes significant strides toward eradicating tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: India is advancing toward tuberculosis eradication, according to the WHO Global TB Report 2026 cited by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The country reports a 38% drop in TB mortality and a 94% treatment success rate. A government drive for early detection screens more than 250 million rural residents, including over 110 million chest X-rays and 30 million molecular tests. The intensified strategy has detected 4.86 million TB cases, of which 1.49 million are asymptomatic. About 96% of TB program funding is sourced domestically. AI-supported tools identify hotspots, predict high-risk cases, and India also uses a chatbot and avatar-based videobot within the program. TB is an airborne infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primarily affecting the lungs; globally, about a quarter of people are infected, most asymptomatic, with 5–10% developing disease and possible death without treatment.

triage.headline_ja: インドが結核撲滅に向け顕著な進展を達成
triage.triage_reason: 記事はインドの結核対策における進展（死亡率低下、治療成功率向上）を報じる肯定的な内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新たな脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核対策の成果を伝える前向きなニュースであり、シグナルトリアージの対象となる公衆衛生上の脅威・異常事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Three Children of a Family Die Within Three Days in Mysterious Circumstances in Lucknow's Malihabad; Panic Grips Locality
article.articleSummary: Three children from the same family died within three days in Khandasra village, Malihabad, Lucknow, amid concerns of a mysterious illness. Divyansh Yadav, 3, died November 9; Kartik Yadav, a Class 1 student, died November 10; Lakshmi Yadav, 10, a Class 2 student, died November 12 after fever development. Family reports blood in the mouths at death. Police retrieved bodies for post-mortems; a medical camp is planned for November 13 to screen residents. Health teams have been deployed; food poisoning is among suspected causes but not confirmed. Chief Medical Officer Dr NB Singh says post-mortem findings will determine the exact cause, with CHC Superintendent Dr Dhananjay Kushwaha urging an impartial probe. No laboratory-confirmed diagnosis reported yet; authorities seek to establish the illness source and ensure community safety.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウのマリハバードで一家の子供3人が3日間のうちに原因不明の状況で死亡、地域に不安広がる
triage.triage_reason: 同一家族内で3日間に3人の子供が原因不明の症状（死亡時に口から出血）で死亡しており、異常性と重症度が高く、地域住民・保健当局の関心も高いためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 死因は未確定（検視結果待ち）で、食中毒の可能性も疑われているが感染症との確定診断はない。続報でラボ結果・感染経路の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 콩고민주공화국 에볼라 반년...최근 한 달 사망자 약 3분의 2가 치료센터 밖에서
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six months of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: In the most recent month, about two-thirds of deaths occurred outside treatment centers.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, by Nov 10, 2026, 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths have been reported across eight provinces. Ituri accounts for about 70% of cases; recent transmission is rising in North Kivu. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, ranks as the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. In the latest month, about two-thirds of deaths occurred in communities outside treatment centers, despite expanded testing and facilities. MSF says only about 9% of treated patients were identified as known contacts; surveillance is hampered by weak alert systems, limited ambulance fuel, and unpaid staff. In Beni, North Kivu, roughly three-quarters of infections are believed to be acquired in healthcare facilities. An attack on a North Kivu village killed 66, including 3 health workers, disrupting contact tracing for over 1,000 contacts. A vaccine trial began in Bunia on Oct 23; no Bundibugyo vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が発生から半年、直近1か月の死者の約3分の2は治療センター外で発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に加え、WPRO基準も複数該当し、国際的な支援（MSF、ワクチン治験）が既に展開されている大規模エボラ流行であるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーでは言及がないためverified_locationsから除外。過去6か月で11,114症例・5,433死亡、Bundibugyoウイルス型として史上2番目の規模。医療施設内感染や武装勢力による接触者追跡の妨害など、対応困難な状況が継続している点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Tập huấn nâng cao năng lực giám sát, phòng chống bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Advanced training to strengthen capacity for rabies surveillance and control.
article.articleSummary: On November 13, 2026, Thanh Hoa Department of Health, in collaboration with the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology and the Department of Agriculture and Environment, organized a training on surveillance and intersectoral rabies control (Health–Animal) for the IBCM model, focusing on bite victims seeking vaccination in 2026. More than 190 delegates from public and private general hospitals, the Children’s Hospital, vaccination service units, and veterinary clinics in Thanh Hoa attended. The program updated the rabies situation in humans and animals in Vietnam and the Northern region, including Thanh Hoa (2022–2026), and provided an overview of IBCM surveillance based on bite data. Experts taught recognition of rabies symptoms in animals, risk screening, outbreak surveillance and response in humans and animals, sampling, biosafety, and specimen handling. Additional topics included human post-exposure prophylaxis with vaccines and rabies immunoglobulin, and advances in monoclonal antibodies; plans to expand immunoglobulin vaccination sites and risk communication strategies.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の監視・対策能力強化のための研修
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病の研修プログラムに関する報告であり、新規の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 研修・能力強化活動の報告であり、具体的な流行や症例急増の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Fever, bleeding, death: 3 Lucknow siblings die in 72 hours, cause still a mystery
article.articleSummary: Three Lucknow siblings aged three, six and nine died within 72 hours, prompting a Health Department investigation as post-mortems await results. The three-year-old developed high fever on Monday and died en route to a health centre; the six-year-old died the next day; the nine-year-old girl, who later had severe stomach pain, died during treatment on Thursday. She exhibited bleeding from the nose and mouth, raising initial concern for food poisoning, though blood tests were negative for dengue, malaria and typhoid. Chest X-ray revealed severe bilateral pneumonia. A four-member medical team, including a paediatrician, found no obvious infectious disease in early inquiries. A precautionary medical camp will screen residents. Post-mortem reports are needed to confirm the cause, with authorities potentially exhuming bodies for examinations if required. The investigation continues in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱、出血、そして死：ラクナウの兄弟3人が72時間以内に死亡、原因は依然謎
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明のまま72時間以内に同一家族内で3人の子どもが死亡し、出血やび漫性肺炎など重篤な症状を呈している点は異常かつ深刻であり、感染症の可能性も否定できないためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱・マラリア・腸チフスの検査は陰性で、原因病原体は未特定。病理解剖結果待ちであり、続報を注視する必要がある。同一家族内での集団発生のため、感染性か遺伝性・環境要因かの判断が今後の鍵となる。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Faces Fresh Ebola Concerns as U.S., UK Warn of Outbreak Risk in South Sudan
article.articleSummary: UK and US warn of high Ebola outbreak risk in South Sudan as Kenyan authorities monitor cross-border spillover from the DRC, where Bundibugyo Ebola virus has not yet appeared in South Sudan but importation risk is 99% per WHO given ongoing DRC transmission. DRC confirmed >10,900 cases as of Nov 9. South Sudan, border 813 km from DRC, reports suspected cases; Morobo County fatal hemorrhagic fever initially tested negative for Ebola and later identified as yellow fever on Nov 10, 2026, while a Yei case awaits lab confirmation. Kenya records 800–1,500 daily border crossings with South Sudan and plans 42 days of monitoring before Ebola-free status on Dec 23, 2026; its Oct importations total eight cases with two deaths, others recovered. WHO urges surveillance, facility screening, lab capacity, and health worker preparedness. South Sudan remains subject to travel restrictions by the U.S., Canada, Saudi Arabia, and UAE.
