article.articleHeadline: Telangana DPH issues flu advisory as temperatures drop
article.articleSummary: Flu advisory issued by the Telangana Directorate of Public Health (DPH) in Hyderabad on November 12, 2026, as temperatures drop. Director of Public Health B Ravinder Nayak warns that pregnant women, children under five, people over 65, and those with chronic diseases are particularly vulnerable. The advisory follows IMD forecasts of dry weather with minimum temperatures 2–3°C below normal; Hyderabad is slated for partly cloudy skies with highs near 32°C and lows around 16°C. Flu is a contagious respiratory infection spread through coughs and sneezes; common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, body aches and fatigue, with most people recovering within a week with rest and fluids. Preventive guidance for Hyderabad residents includes wearing masks outdoors, frequent hand washing, avoiding public places with fever, ensuring ventilation with outdoor air, and adequate sleep. Do not shake hands, reuse tissues, or touch mouth/eyes, and consult doctors before self-medicating.

article.articleHeadline: Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone Strengthen Cross-Border Health Coordination Over Epidemic Risk
article.articleSummary: Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone convene in Guéckédou, southeastern Guinea, November 11–13, 2026, to bolster cross-border disease surveillance and epidemic response, focusing on harmonizing border alert systems, exchanging health information, and a joint operational roadmap led by Guinea’s ANSS. The meeting sits against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in Central and East Africa; the DRC had 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths in eight provinces as of November 11, with Kenya reporting cases and Uganda’s outbreak declared over. Nigeria reported an imported case on October 20 from Uganda; 62 contacts identified, 52 completed 21-day monitoring, 10 under surveillance. West Africa has tightened border surveillance and airport preparedness in Côte d’Ivoire and Ghana. The gathering builds on 2014–2016 Ebola coordination and 2022 Lassa fever efforts, though funding and personnel remain critical for lasting cooperation.

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Cirebon menyebut Desa Siaga TB telah berjalan di 61 lokasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Cirebon Health Office says TB-Alert Village has been rolled out in 61 locations
article.articleSummary: TB-Alert Village (Desa Siaga TB) program rolled out in Cirebon, West Java, Indonesia. As of 13 November 2026, 61 of 424 villages/kelurahan have committed to implementing Desa Siaga TB to monitor and support tuberculosis patients. The Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten Cirebon notes that commitment, rather than high case counts, is key, with involvement of Babinsa (village military), Bhabinkamtibmas (police liaisons), village heads, and health workers. The aim is to supervise patients, remind them to adhere to the six-month TB treatment to completion, and reduce household transmission. Families are encouraged to participate to ensure daily medication intake. The initiative seeks district-wide expansion to reinforce surveillance, early detection, and treatment adherence, preventing interruption or relapse and improving outcomes for those diagnosed with TB in the community.

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis deaths decline 38% in India since 2015: WHO
article.articleSummary: India’s TB deaths declined 38% since 2015, with mortality dropping from 280 to 180 deaths per million by 2025, per WHO’s Global TB Report 2026. India now accounts for 25% of global TB cases in 2025 and remains among four countries that together represented over 50% of global MDR-TB cases in 2025, though MDR-TB incidence is gradually declining. The report notes most TB cases occur in 30 high-burden countries. India’s TB profile will be updated after district-level sentinel surveillance data are analyzed, with a revised country profile expected in early 2027. The government cites a 94% treatment success rate and large-scale screening under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan: over 250 million people screened, more than 11 crore chest X-rays, and 48.64 lakh new TB cases identified, including 14.97 lakh asymptomatic cases.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Strains Ravage Simultaneously: Prior Infections Can Still Lead to Reinfection, High-Risk Groups Must Be Highly Vigilant.
article.articleSummary: China faces simultaneous circulation of three influenza strains this season, with A(H3N2) slightly dominant and A(H1N1) rising in neighboring regions; cross-protection between strains is weak, so prior infection with one does not prevent infection with others. High‑risk groups—65+, children under 5, pregnant and perinatal women, immunocompromised individuals, those with chronic diseases, and obesity—should be especially vigilant, as prolonged fever or poor response to antipyretics may indicate severe disease. Symptoms for influenza A strains are fever, headache, sore throat, cough, myalgia and fatigue; influenza B in children is more likely to cause GI symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and diarrhea. Vaccination remains the best prevention; the trivalent inactivated vaccine can be co‑administered with other inactivated vaccines at different sites, with rabies vaccination prioritized after exposure. Antivirals oseltamivir and baloxavir are effective when used within 48 hours; baloxavir is a single-dose option and not approved for under 1 year. Rest and seek care for persistent symptoms or chest discomfort.

article.articleHeadline: Jenguk Bayi Baru Lahir: Gendong, Cium, dan Selfie Jadi Celah Virus RSV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Visiting a Newborn Baby: Carrying, Kissing, and Selfies Become a Gateway for RSV
article.articleSummary: RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) poses infection risk to newborns in Jakarta, Indonesia. A physician, Dr. Ulul Albab, warns that common visiting practices—holding, kissing, and selfies with a newborn—can undermine prevention because visitors’ health status is often unknown. Cultural and family expectations in Indonesia make limiting visits difficult; parents risk social judgment for restricting contact. Options such as viewing the baby from behind glass or via video call are mentioned, but not easily accepted culturally. Hand hygiene and cleanliness are hard to enforce at every visit, and airport-style health checks or heavy PPE are not practical for routine family visits. The article emphasizes that protecting newborns can be achieved without forgoing affection: families should balance warmth with cautious interactions, asking visitors to consider the infant’s health before touching or kissing.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Tuberculosis Report 2026: India's major achievement against TB, 38% reduction in deaths in 10 years; treatment success rate 94%
article.articleSummary: TB in India shows major progress per WHO TB Report 2026. From 2015 to 2025, TB deaths fell by 38% in India, against a 35% global drop. Drug-susceptible TB treatment success reached 94%. Per-lakh TB mortality declined from 28 to 18. The National TB Elimination Programme attributes gains to earlier diagnosis, rapid testing, AI-assisted chest X-rays, and timely treatment, plus patient-centred care and nutritional support. The Nikshay Poshan Yojana and Nikshay Mitra are highlighted for nutrition and support. AI tools like Happiness AI chatbot and Avatar Videobot are deployed to improve TB services. The campaign under Prime Minister Narendra Modi has turned TB elimination into a national movement with strong domestic funding (96% of TB program funding from domestic resources).

article.articleHeadline: Attacks on health workers hamper Congo Ebola fight, Africa CDC warns | CNBC Africa
article.articleSummary: Attacks on health workers and facilities are hampering the Congo Ebola response as Africa CDC warns of a Bundibugyo virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Since May 15, the outbreak has infected 11,114 people and killed 5,433, per Congolese government data. Violent incidents include four armed attacks, 16 assaults on responders, and 11 health facilities burned or targeted, with violence escalating since late September. An assault on Cantine-Aloya in North Kivu killed 66 people, including three health workers. More than 1,000 contacts have been lost to follow-up, and three confirmed Ebola cases remain unaccounted for. WHO experts say continued insecurity could reverse the progress made over the past six months; Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called insecurity one of the greatest obstacles to rapid, effective response and access.

article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 391 severe influenza cases and 57 deaths nationwide since Oct 1 this season, with 99.7% of severe cases unvaccinated. People can check contracted clinics on the Yilan County Health Bureau site or call 1922 or 03-9357011 for inquiries.

article.articleHeadline: 三毒株同步活跃！避开这些误区，流感季防护指南来了→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains are active simultaneously! Avoid these misconceptions—the flu season protection guide is here.
article.articleSummary: In China, influenza activity rises in November, with three strains co-circulating: A(H3N2), A(H1N1), and B, broadening the season. High-risk groups: adults ≥65, children ≤5, pregnant women, immunocompromised individuals, those with chronic diseases, and obesity. Warning signals: persistent high fever that returns after defervescence; symptoms lasting >5 days; elderly with altered mental status. Influenza A and B share fever, headache, sore throat, cough, myalgias, and can cause pneumonia; B infections in children often include GI symptoms. Vaccination remains the most effective protection; vaccination is advised even after infection; allow 2–4 weeks recovery before vaccinating. Vaccines: inactivated trivalent can be co-administered with PCV and varicella vaccines at different sites; nasal spray requires 28 days from other live vaccines. Rabies exposure takes priority; egg allergy no longer a contraindication. Antivirals Oseltamivir and Baloxavir Marboxil are prescription-only; best within 48 hours; avoid self-medication. Recovery should avoid intense exercise for 1–3 weeks; persistent cough is common.

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculoza a ucis 1,13 milioane de persoane în 2025. OMS avertizează asupra "progreselor insuficiente" în lupta împotriva acestei boli.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis killed 1.13 million people in 2025. WHO warns of 'insufficient progress' in the fight against this disease.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis killed 1.13 million people worldwide in 2025, with 10.6 million new infections (54% men, 35% women, 11% children). TB remains the leading infectious killer, transmitted via airborne droplets. Progress is insufficient to meet targets: deaths fell 4% and new cases 0.7% since 2024, with just a 14% reduction versus 2015; the goals aimed for a 50% reduction by 2025 and 80% by 2030. Thirty high-burden countries account for 88% of cases, led by India (~25%), followed by Indonesia (10%), Philippines (6.8%), China (6.5%), Pakistan (6.4%), and Nigeria (4.9%). Financing rose to $6.6 billion in 2025 from $6.0B in 2024, still well below the $22B annual target for 2027. 8.4 million people were diagnosed in 2025 (79% of total); TB killed 137,000 people living with HIV last year. Romania has the highest TB incidence in the European Union.

article.articleHeadline: Disdik Palangka Raya ingatkan sekolah waspadai wabah DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palangka Raya Education Office reminds schools to watch out for a dengue outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) poses a potential risk in Palangka Raya, Central Kalimantan, as humid conditions persist, prompting the Palangka Raya Education Office to urge schools to heighten vigilance. Secretariat Aprae Vico Ranan of Disdik emphasizes preventing Aedes aegypti breeding by maintaining clean school environments, implementing healthy living practices (PHBS), and ensuring proper waste disposal. Schools should regularly clean drains to avoid debris buildup and standing water, which can serve as mosquito habitats. Prevention must be ongoing and involve all members of the school community—principals, teachers, staff, and students—plus reinforce habits beyond school, including at home. The aim is a healthy, safe learning environment and to mitigate potential dengue transmission amid changing weather conditions. No case counts are reported in the article.

article.articleHeadline: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh: Tăng cường phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết và tay chân miệng ở các địa phương
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: Strengthening the prevention and control of dengue fever and hand, foot and mouth disease across localities.
article.articleSummary: On 13 November 2026, Lai Thieu Ward in Ho Chi Minh City launched a district-wide campaign across 15 neighborhoods to intensify prevention and control of dengue fever and hand-foot-mouth disease. The initiative emphasizes surveillance, environmental hygiene, and eliminating standing water to disrupt mosquito breeding, mobilizing the local government, mass organizations, and residents. Key actions include community education, early detection, and ongoing environmental checks in households and schools, with special attention to nurseries and childcare settings. Families are urged to maintain hygiene, wash hands with soap, clean toys, and cover water containers; dengue suspects should seek prompt medical care, not self-treat, as progression can include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, unusual bleeding, or faintness. The campaign seeks to sustain prevention beyond single events, reinforcing community roles to protect children and reduce transmission.

triage.notes: 記事は行政による季節性感染症の予防啓発キャンペーンの告知であり、新規の異常事態発生を示すものではない。重症例数や死亡者数など具体的な被害規模の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Fena.ba | Više od 5.500 osoba preminulo od epidemije ebole u Kongu, među najugroženijima djeca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 5,500 people have died from the Ebola epidemic in Congo, with children among the most vulnerable.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 13 November 2026 — Ebola is driving a major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 5,500 deaths and over 11,000 cases reported in the past six months. The epidemic continues to spread rapidly despite ongoing efforts by health and humanitarian organizations. The headline notes that children are among the most vulnerable groups affected by the outbreak. The data indicate sustained transmission across the country’s affected areas, underscoring the urgency of intensified public health responses to detect new infections, isolate cases, and curb further spread. No laboratory confirmation details or specific regional hotspots are provided in the briefing, but the figures reflect a persistent and accelerating Ebola situation in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行により5,500人以上が死亡、最も脆弱な層には子供も含まれる
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ大規模流行で死者5,500人超・症例11,000超と公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、持続的な人から人への感染拡大が示唆されるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は死者数・症例数のみでラボ確認情報や具体的流行地域の詳細は不明。既知の継続中の大規模エボラ流行に関する続報と考えられ、フルRRAでの詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Parada cardíaca por doença de Chagas levou à morte de passageira em voo que saiu de Brasília para Porto Velho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cardiac arrest due to Chagas disease led to the death of a female passenger on a flight from Brasília to Porto Velho.
article.articleSummary: A 76-year-old woman, Nair Carrier Dinis, died on a Brasília-to-Porto Velho flight from cardiac arrest linked to Chagas disease. The death, confirmed by Brasília’s SVO, was attributed to chronic chagasic cardiomyopathy caused by Trypanosoma cruzi infection, with the death certificate citing a mixed shock (cardiogenic, distributive, hemorrhagic, obstructive) following the arrest. Passengers reported nose and mouth bleeding after takeoff; onboard volunteers performed CPR for about 20 minutes before declaring death. The aircraft departed Brasília at 21:30 on Sunday the 8th, circled, then returned, with FlightAware listing a 46-minute flight. The body arrived Porto Velho the night of the 11th, was transported ~200 km to Ariquemes (RO) for wake beginning at 5:00 on the 12th, and burial started around 9:30. Documents found included a history of chagasic cardiomegaly and megacolon and a cardiovascular medication prescription, indicating prior cardiac and digestive involvement due to Chagas disease.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病による心停止で、ブラジリア発ポルトベリョ行きの機内で女性乗客が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 慢性シャーガス病による個別の死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常性・拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: シャーガス病の慢性合併症による個人の死亡事例で、感染拡大や公衆衛生上の新規脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Patient Evacuated From Nigeria Recovers, Discharged From Swiss Hospital
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, patient evacuated from Abuja, Nigeria to Switzerland on Oct 26, 2026, with her husband. At Geneva's University Hospitals of Geneva, she received supportive care (hydration and management of potential complications) and has recovered; discharged Nov 12, 2026. The husband was quarantined and freed from quarantine on Nov 4, 2026; he showed no symptoms. Nigeria announced the case on Oct 20, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible for the latest outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where more than 11,000 infections and over 5,400 deaths have occurred; no specific treatment or vaccine exists for this strain. Cases have also been detected in Uganda and Kenya. The article references an imported/exported case to Switzerland, with no reports of local transmission in Switzerland.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアから退避されたエボラ患者が回復、スイスの病院から退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000人以上の感染・5,400人以上の死亡者を出しているブンディブギョ株エボラのアウトブレイクを背景に、ナイジェリアからスイスへの国際的な患者移送事例が発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生中のブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクに由来する国際的な輸出症例（ナイジェリア→スイス）。ナイジェリア、スイス、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは背景説明のアウトブレイク発生国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Weltweit tödlichste Infektionskrankheit fordert 1,13 Millionen Opfer - doch es gibt Hoffnung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The world's deadliest infectious disease claims 1.13 million lives — but there is hope.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) remains the world's deadliest infectious disease. The WHO reports 2025 TB deaths at 1.13 million, down 35% from 1.7 million in 2015, a milestone, though progress is too slow to end epidemic. Africa and Europe halved TB deaths, and India and China also saw ~35% declines. In 2025, 10.6 million people contracted TB, 75,000 fewer than 2024. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis and spreads via coughs; poverty, malnutrition, and HIV infection raise risk. Six-month treatments remain burdensome with adherence challenges and side effects; drug-resistant TB, especially Rifampicin resistance, remains a threat, but cases fell from 550,000 in 2015 to 370,000 in 2025. Funding for prevention, treatment, and care reached $6.6 billion in 2025, far below the $22 billion per year targeted by 2027, though India, Indonesia, and Russia increased domestic spending. The M72 vaccine is in development; trials by 2028 could be pivotal, but access remains bottleneck.

triage.headline_ja: 世界で最も致死率の高い感染症、113万人の犠牲者 — しかし希望はある
triage.triage_reason: WHOのグローバルTB報告に基づく年次統計・傾向の報告であり、突発的な異常事態や新規アウトブレイクではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOの年次結核報告に関する一般的な解説記事であり、特定国での突発的アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。地域（Africa, Russia, Indonesia, India, China）は統計の文脈で言及されているのみで、個別の発生イベントではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rutan Karimun Lakukan Skrining Tuberkolosis Bagi Petugas dan Warga Binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Karimun Detention Center Conducts Tuberculosis Screening for Officers and Inmates
article.articleSummary: Karimun Detention Center (Rutan Kelas IIB Tanjung Balai Karimun) conducted free health checks (CKG) and tuberculosis (TB) screening for officers and inmates on 11 November 2026 in Karimun Regency, Indonesia. The event was attended by Karimun Regent Iskandarsyah, Head of Karimun Health Office drg. Soerjadi, and Head of Class I BKK Tanjung Balai Karimun Agus Jamaludin, underscoring cross-agency collaboration between the jail and local government. The screening aims to detect health issues early and ensure the right to health services for staff and detainees, addressing TB—a highly contagious disease of particular concern in congregate settings. Rutan Karimun Head Yoga Hadhi Wijaya thanked officials for support and emphasized that health-care provision is essential to humane, safe, and professional correctional administration, with the healthy facility seen as foundational to quality rehabilitation and security.

triage.headline_ja: カリムン拘置所、職員と収容者を対象に結核スクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的健康診断・スクリーニング活動の報道であり、異常な集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の集団発生事例ではなく、拘置所における定期的な健康診断・スクリーニングプログラムの実施報告である。

article.articleHeadline: Post-pandemic immunity debt and environmental decoupling reshape urban influenza transmission
article.articleSummary: Post-pandemic influenza dynamics in Macau and Hong Kong show immunity-debt–driven excess amid environmental decoupling and mobility. Analysis of ~1.88 million Macau clinical influenza tests (2010–2025) plus meteorology, air quality, digital information-seeking data, and viral genomes, with global surveillance, finds a post-pandemic excess in influenza activity consistent with immunity debt. A susceptible–exposed–infectious–recovered–susceptible model yields best-fit debt fraction 42%; ABC posterior 58% (95% UI 32–77%). Susceptibility rises more in adults than children; vaccination coverage in high-risk groups does not decline, arguing against uptake loss as driver. Time-varying models reveal environmental decoupling: high susceptibility weakens meteorological constraints and sustains influenza A transmission, with asymmetric suppression of influenza B. Spatiotemporal and phylogenetic evidence supports travel-linked reintroduction from ports of entry into dense neighbourhoods. Digital information-seeking shifts from lagging to leading clinical burden, indicating a regime shift; adaptive, multi-source surveillance is needed in high-density cities.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミック後の免疫負債と環境デカップリングが都市部インフルエンザ伝播様式を再形成
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究論文であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な新規発生を報告するものではなく、過去データに基づく疫学モデリング研究であるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術論文（Nature Communications）であり、香港・マカオにおける2010-2025年の季節性インフルエンザの疫学的傾向を分析した研究。急性の公衆衛生イベントではないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。香港・マカオは中国(China)に含めて評価。

article.articleHeadline: Especialistas recomendam vacinação após onda de covid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts recommend vaccination after a COVID-19 wave.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil, with increases identified in 18 states and the Federal District, including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Minas Gerais. Experts urge vaccination to prevent severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, though not everyone needs new doses. Routine vaccination is offered to children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant people, and adults 60+, with immunocompromised individuals and cancer patients on treatment advised to vaccinate semiannually, and health workers annually. People who have never been vaccinated should receive a dose, via the public health system (SUS) or Basic Health Units (UBS), preferably with the vaccination card. Data through Oct 31 show a six-week rise in notifications. Despite increased circulation, protection remains high and the overall risk is low; no defined seasonal pattern, and no new doses recommended for those outside risk groups, per Dr. Marco Aurélio Safadi at the SBGG forum on Nov 11.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、COVID-19の流行後にワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのCOVID-19症例増加は季節的な範囲内であり、記事中でも全体リスクは低いと明記されている。高リスク群への通常のワクチン接種推奨であり、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的なCOVID-19症例増加とハイリスク群への定期ワクチン接種推奨に関する通常の公衆衛生情報であり、全体リスクは低いと専門家が明言している。

article.articleHeadline: 15 Lakh Asymptomatic TB Cases Detected In India; Can You Have Tuberculosis Without A Cough Or Fever?
article.articleSummary: India detected nearly 1.5 million asymptomatic TB cases during the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (Dec 2024–Nov 2026) among 48.64 lakh new cases from over 25 crore screened; 11 crore chest X‑rays and 3 crore NAAT tests were conducted. Asymptomatic TB (subclinical) is active lung disease confirmed by labs but with no or mild symptoms, distinct from latent TB. Transmission is possible without a persistent cough; Lancet analyses show sputum positivity without cough, and a University of Cape Town study found normal breathing can release TB bacteria. Treatment uses the standard drug-susceptible TB regimen; India reports ~94% treatment success. WHO notes TB mortality fell from 28 to 18 per lakh between 2015 and 2025. Key lessons: screen household contacts; chest X‑ray/NAAT in high-risk groups; absence of cough does not rule out TB.

triage.headline_ja: インドで無症候性結核症例150万件を検出;咳や発熱がなくても結核にかかる可能性はあるのか?
triage.triage_reason: インドの既存の結核撲滅プログラム(TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan)による検診結果を報告する内容であり、結核は同国で既知のエンデミック疾患であるため異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は国家的なTBスクリーニングキャンペーンの成果報告であり、アウトブレイクや新規事象ではない。ケープタウンの研究は呼吸による結核菌放出に関する学術的言及のみで、発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mắc cúm A , Nam bệnh nhân khỏe mạnh phải dùng ECMO để cứu sống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthy male patient infected with influenza A had to be placed on ECMO to save his life.
article.articleSummary: A 55-year-old previously healthy man in Phú Thọ Province General Hospital, Vietnam, developed influenza A with severe pneumonia and life-threatening respiratory failure. He required endotracheal intubation and venovenous ECMO to sustain oxygenation. After 7 days of intensive care, pulmonary function improved enough to discontinue ECMO, and by day 10 he was awake, breathing more stably, and extubated, with continued monitoring during recovery. This case illustrates that influenza A can cause viral pneumonia and acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) even in healthy adults, presenting with fever and dyspnea; alarming signs include rapid breathing, chest pain, cyanosis, fatigue, and altered consciousness. The illness involves alveolar damage that impairs gas exchange, with risk of co-infection and progression to severe hypoxemia. In severe influenza or high-risk patients, early antiviral treatment may reduce complications and improve outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAに感染した健康な男性患者、命を救うためECMOを使用
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の季節性インフルエンザA重症化事例であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 単一の重症インフルエンザA症例報告であり、クラスター発生やアウトブレイクを示唆する情報はない。季節性インフルエンザの一例として経過観察の必要性も低い。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa steps up Ebola screening as festive-season travel approaches
article.articleSummary: South Africa is bolstering Ebola screening ahead of travel, designating 36 hospitals to receive suspected or confirmed cases and expanding port screening via the Border Management Authority. A health questionnaire for travelers from the DRC and Uganda, completed up to 24 hours before travel, includes travel histories and symptoms, with monitoring for 21 days after exposure. Port health uses thermal scanning, travel-history reviews, and visual assessments, prioritising flights from affected countries. Testing is centralised through the NICD. Bundibugyo-virus outbreak in the DRC since May has triggered cases in Kenya and Nigeria in October, while Uganda’s outbreak has ended; the total exceeds 10,700 cases and 5,300 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola epidemic in DRC history and the second-largest globally. Ervebo offers limited protection against Bundibugyo; trials are ongoing. MSF warns of high child mortality; WHO PHEIC since May, emphasising surveillance, cross-border coordination, and community engagement. A SADC meeting discusses preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 祝祭シーズンの渡航増加を控え、南アフリカがエボラ出血熱の検疫体制を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱はWHOがPHEICを宣言した重大な公衆衛生事象であり、死者5,300人超・DRC史上最悪規模で国境を越えケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南アフリカの水際対策強化だが、根本的な感染症イベントはDRCで続くブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（PHEIC宣言下、死者5,300人超）。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。南アフリカも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola odnijela više od 5.500 života u Kongu: Među žrtvama veliki broj djece
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has claimed more than 5,500 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a large number of the victims are children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has claimed more than 5,500 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with over 11,000 confirmed cases in the past six months as of 2026-11-13, as the outbreak continues to spread rapidly despite humanitarian efforts. The epidemic, likely started earlier than the May 15 official declaration, spans eight provinces and has produced cases in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Children bear a disproportionate burden: in North Kivu, those under five account for 24% of confirmed cases, and among them 54% are infants under one year. At the Ebola treatment center in Butembo, from June to September 2026, 24 of 30 hospitalized children died, mostly under five. MSF cites rapid community transmission and limited access to specialized care, worsened by armed clashes in Ituri and North Kivu that hamper aid delivery.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで5,500人以上の死者を出す：犠牲者の多くは子ども
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ大規模流行（死者5,500人超、症例1万1000人超）が8州に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダにも症例が波及しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当が認められる重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでの症例発生にも言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主たる発生地域であり、流行が8州に拡大、医療・治安状況の悪化（武力衝突によるアクセス制限）も深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 多種病毒齊襲中國！官方承認毒株複雜 高危人群當心 | 三種流感毒 | 甲型H1N1 | 甲型H3N2
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Several viruses strike China simultaneously! Officials acknowledge that the strains are complex. High-risk groups, beware | Three influenza viruses | Influenza A H1N1 | Influenza A H3N2
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-13, China is facing simultaneous activity of three influenza strains: Influenza A (H1N1), Influenza A (H3N2), and Influenza B (Victoria lineage). China CDC monitoring notes a more complex strain mix, potentially extending the flu season and raising infection risk. Cross-protection between strains is limited, so individuals can be infected by one strain after another, including A(H3N2) followed by A(H1N1) or B after A strains. Common symptoms include fever, headache, sore throat, cough, myalgia, and fatigue; Influenza B in children often presents with GI symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and diarrhea. High-risk groups: adults 65+, children under 5, pregnant/peripartum women, immunocompromised, chronic disease patients, and obesity. Seek medical care for persistent high fever or symptoms lasting >5 days; avoid self-medicating with antivirals like oseltamivir or baloxavir, which require prescription. Rest and monitor for chest symptoms. COVID-19 reportedly persists in China but is downplayed as influenza.

triage.headline_ja: 複数のウイルスが中国を同時に襲撃！当局は株の複雑さを認める　高リスク群は要注意（3種類のインフルエンザ株｜H1N1｜H3N2）
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ複数株の同時流行であり、例年の季節性流行の範囲内とみられるが、COVID-19の過小評価示唆など情報不足な点もあり経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの複数株同時流行は例年見られる現象であり、特段の異常性は低いが、COVID-19がインフルエンザとして過小評価されているとの指摘があり、今後の情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 6개월째 확산에도 대응 부실...국경없는의사회 "현장 지원 공백 심각" - 매일일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even after six months of Ebola spread, the response is inadequate... Doctors Without Borders: "Serious gaps in on-the-ground support"
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Doctors Without Borders says the frontline response is deeply inadequate. Despite substantial international aid, frontline staff lack adequate pay and training; transport and fuel for patient transfers are scarce; and essential supplies, including PPE, are insufficient. Disease surveillance is weak—paper-based systems with limited field activity—and community workers lack mobile phones or data access. Contact tracing and rapid transfer to treatment centers remain poor, with about two-thirds of recent Ebola deaths occurring in the community. In Ituri, only 9% of treated patients were previously identified as contacts. Regional disparities persist: North Kivu and Haut-Uele are under-resourced, and in North Kivu’s Beni health zone roughly 75% of facility-acquired infections occur there. MSF calls for broader involvement of private clinics and traditional healers, better resource management, and prioritization of high-risk areas, alongside ongoing diagnostic and clinical trials progress.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行6か月、対応は依然不十分…国境なき医師団「現場支援に深刻な空白」
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が6か月に及び、サーベイランスや接触者追跡、医療資源の不備が深刻であるとMSFが警告しており、国際支援の必要性が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: 既知のDRCエボラ流行の継続報道だが、現場の対応不備とコミュニティ内死亡の多さ（死亡の約2/3）、サーベイランス機能不全が強調されており、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Musim Pancaroba, Dinkes Kota Malang Imbau Warga Waspadai DBD hingga Penyakit Pencernaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Transitional Season: Malang City Health Office Urges Residents to Beware of Dengue Fever as Well as Digestive Diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 13 November 2026, Malang City Health Office (Dinkes Kota Malang) urged residents to watch for a dengue fever surge and digestive illnesses as the transitional season (pancaroba) begins. Climate shifts during this period increase conditions favorable for Aedes aegypti breeding, with standing water a key risk. Authorities instructed Puskesmas staff to intensify prevention now to blunt a potential dengue peak, historically centered in February–March. Separately, the rainy season-driven rise of flies raises the risk of digestive diseases tied to environmental factors; residents are advised to maintain cleanliness, regularly drain water storage, and ensure food hygiene to curb transmission. No current case counts are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目、マラン市保健局がデング熱や消化器系疾患への注意を住民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱流行に対する予防的注意喚起であり、現時点での症例数報告や異常な拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: 毎年の季節的流行への予防的注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数データは記事に含まれていない。デング熱はインドネシアで例年発生する疾患であり、異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, oltre 11mila casi in Congo: il virus si diffonde rapidamente, ecco perché l'epidemia è difficile da fermare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, more than 11,000 cases in Congo: the virus is spreading rapidly, and here's why the epidemic is difficult to stop.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases, driven by population movements and diagnostic/health-system gaps. First detected May 15, 2026 in Ituri, the virus likely circulated weeks earlier. Between May 10 and June 1, health zones with cases rose by 12 and affected zones by 49, with a initial case doubling time of about 10 days. Researchers combined case data with molecular tests, mobility patterns, travel times, healthcare access, and demographics to model early growth and cross‑zone spread, confirming rapid epidemic expansion and the value of movement data for planning. Containment is hampered by diagnostic delays, poorly preserved samples, limited local test sensitivity, and security issues from armed groups, violence against facilities, and public distrust. A Sierra Leone–style isolation-space strategy is proposed, but requires substantial logistics and international support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで1万1000人超の感染者：ウイルスは急速に拡大しており、流行を止めるのが難しい理由
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が1万1000例を超え急速に拡大しており、治安問題や診断体制の脆弱性により封じ込めが困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: シエラレオネは過去の隔離戦略の事例として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola scare: Swiss woman evacuated from Nigeria discharged - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: Swiss woman infected with Bundibugyo strain of Ebola linked to a Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak recovered and discharged from Geneva's University Hospitals (HUG) on Nov 12, 2026. Evacuated from Nigeria with her husband on Oct 26 after contracting the virus; Nigeria had confirmed an Ebola case on Oct 20. The husband, an embassy employee, completed quarantine and showed no symptoms; quarantine lifted on Nov 4. Bundibugyo is an Ebola variant with no specifically approved vaccine or treatment. The DRC outbreak, detected in May, has reported more than 11,000 infections and over 5,400 deaths; cases have also been detected in Uganda and Kenya, raising concerns about regional spread. The patient received supportive care, including hydration and management of potential complications, and has recovered. Public health efforts continue to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の懸念：ナイジェリアから避難したスイス人女性が退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが1万人超の感染・5,400人超の死亡に達し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへも拡大、さらにスイスへの輸入症例（退避事例）も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・スイスは本件の関連国だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCの大規模アウトブレイクが主たる発生源であり、国際的拡大の実例として輸入症例（スイス）が確認されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: XFG responde por cerca de 90% dos sequenciamentos de covid no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: XFG accounts for about 90% of COVID-19 sequencing in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: XFG, a subvariant of Omicron, and its descendants account for about 90% of the COVID-19 sequencing analyzed in Brazil in 2026, based on samples selected for genetic analysis, not the total number of cases. The Ministry of Health report notes a rise in severe COVID-19 cases in Mato Grosso, the Federal District, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo and Santa Catarina, though incidence remains low. Sequencing data reflect predominance among tested samples, not all circulating infections, so they do not measure case counts. By 4 November 2026, the surveillance recorded 118,851 COVID-19 respiratory syndrome notifications with a 16.66% positivity rate, showing an upward trend over six weeks. XFG may have higher transmissibility, but there is no evidence of more severe disease. The Ministry calls for vaccination, especially for the elderly, children, and immunocompromised individuals. Official confirmation of XFG in Brazil occurred in July 2025; Stratus has been mentioned but is unconfirmed.

triage.headline_ja: XFGがブラジルのCOVID-19シークエンシングの約90%を占める
triage.triage_reason: 既知のオミクロン系統XFGの拡大と一部地域での重症例増加が報告されているが、重症度上昇の明確なエビデンスはなく、現時点では継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: XFGは既知のOmicron系統であり、感染性上昇の可能性はあるが重症度増加のエビデンスはなし。複数州（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ、サンタカタリーナ等）で重症例増加が報告されているが発生率自体は低い。ワクチン接種呼びかけあり。

article.articleHeadline: "India's fight against Tuberculosis showing encouraging results": JP Nadda highlights India's 38% decline in TB deaths
article.articleSummary: India reports a 38% decline in TB mortality since 2015, surpassing the global 35% decline, per the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026. The country’s TB treatment success rate is 94%. Under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, intensified screening covered over 25 crore people, with 11 crore+ chest X-rays and 3 crore+ molecular tests, detecting 48.64 lakh TB cases, including nearly 15 lakh asymptomatic cases, enabling early treatment. AI-enabled diagnostics and Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana nutritional support, plus Ni-kshay Mitras, bolster patient-centric TB care nationwide. WHO calls for stronger SE Asia Region action, stressing political leadership and investment, as the region accounts for substantial rifampicin-resistant and multidrug-resistant TB (~140,000 cases). India’s Jan Bhagidari approach reinforces momentum toward a TB-Mukt Bharat.

triage.headline_ja: 「インドの結核対策が明るい成果を示す」：JPナッダ氏がインドのTB死亡率38%減少を強調
triage.triage_reason: 結核死亡率の改善という肯定的な政策成果の報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクはいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 政府高官による結核対策の成果発表であり、多剤耐性結核（MDR-TB）の存在は言及されているが新規の緊急事態ではなく、既知の慢性的課題。

article.articleHeadline: Embassies Warn of Ebola Risk in South Sudan
article.articleSummary: Six embassies—Germany, Japan, the Netherlands, Norway, the United Kingdom and the United States—warn that South Sudan faces a high risk of an Ebola outbreak, though no case has been confirmed in Juba as of 12 November 2026. They urged the government to use public revenue to pay health workers’ salaries and grant aid groups full nationwide access, echoing a July 2026 appeal (Canada not named). The EU’s ECDC cites 11,114 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,433 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 11 November 2026, with Bundibugyo virus and ongoing community transmission. South Sudan maintains temperature screening and health declaration forms at Juba International Airport and other entry points. Prediction markets priced South Sudan’s odds of a case in 2026 at 22%. The CDC renewed an Ebola entry ban for 30 days from 10 November 2026, expiring around 10 December 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 大使館、南スーダンにおけるエボラリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,114症例・5,433死亡の進行中のエボラ流行が継続しており、複数国大使館が南スーダンへの拡大リスクを警告、CDCが入国禁止を延長するなど国際的対応が強まっているためIHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南スーダンへのエボラ拡大リスク警告だが、南スーダン自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。実際に確定症例・継続流行があるDRCのみをverified_locationsとした。南スーダンでの症例確認は2026年11月12日時点で未確認。

article.articleHeadline: 京都爆高致病性H5　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kyoto outbreak of highly pathogenic H5 avian influenza; Hong Kong temporarily suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Kyoto Prefecture, Japan reports an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5 avian influenza. Hong Kong’s Food and Environmental Hygiene Department’s Food Safety Centre immediately suspends imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from the region to protect public health. The Centre has alerted Japanese authorities and will monitor updates from the World Organisation for Animal Health and relevant authorities to adjust measures as needed. In the first nine months of this year, Hong Kong imported about 1,030 tonnes of chilled poultry meat and around 249.94 million eggs from Japan. The suspension targets products from Kyoto Prefecture and reflects ongoing vigilance against avian influenza risks. Keywords: outbreak, import suspension, Kyoto, Hong Kong, H5 avian influenza, eggs, poultry meat, MAFF, OIE.

triage.headline_ja: 京都で高病原性H5型鳥インフルエンザが発生、香港が家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 日本・京都での家禽（動物）における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ発生であり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。対象国リストに日本は含まれず、香港は輸入停止措置を実施したのみで発生国ではないため、公衆衛生上の重大性は低いと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地は日本・京都府であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。香港は輸入停止措置を取った側であり、発生国ではないためChinaとしても計上しない。家禽の動物衛生イベントでヒトへの感染は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo: Najgora epidemija kolere posljednjih decenija
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The Worst Cholera Epidemic in Recent Decades.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is experiencing its worst cholera epidemic in decades, with more than 60,000 cases and about 1,800 deaths in 2026. Three new cases were reported in Kingabva, an eastern district of Kinshasa, raising concern about spread in the capital as the rainy season approaches. The World Health Organization notes a case-fatality rate near 3% this year. Eastern North Kivu and South Kivu are the epicenters, where ongoing armed conflict, including the M23 movement, hampers centralized response. In Kinshasa, February 2026 saw over 80% of cases in Limete, Kingabva, Kalamu II, Binza Ozon and Kingasani, with fears of urban spread along the Congo River basin. MSF urges preventive measures—safe drinking water, sanitation, hand hygiene, oral cholera vaccination campaigns, and rapid logistics—but access remains uneven and response faces insecurity. DRC also faces its deadliest Ebola outbreak, intensifying the public health strain.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ：過去数十年で最悪のコレラ流行
triage.triage_reason: 6万人超の症例と1800人の死亡という大規模流行で、紛争地域での対応困難、首都キンシャサへの拡大懸念、さらにエボラ流行も併発しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコレラが主題だが、同国で同時進行中の最悪のエボラ流行にも言及されており、公衆衛生システムへの複合的負荷が懸念される。武力紛争（M23）により対応が妨げられている点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Mais uma cidade da Grande BH suspende aulas após casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another city in Greater Belo Horizonte suspends classes after cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: São José da Lapa, a city in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, suspended municipal schools, CEMEIs, and related education facilities on 13 November 2026 after confirmed human scabies cases in the school community. The notice, released late on 12 November, follows a prior decision by Vespasiano in the same metro area. The one-day closure aims to permit cleaning and preventive measures, with activities set to resume on Monday, 16 November 2026. The municipality is working with Health Surveillance to reinforce precautions and protect students, education staff, and the wider community from transmission.

triage.headline_ja: グレーテル・ベロオリゾンテ圏のもう一つの市が、ヒト疥癬の症例発生を受けて授業を停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大性が低く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず、国際的拡大のリスクもないため見送り。
triage.notes: ブラジルで発生しているが、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれているものの、疥癬自体がシグナル基準に該当しないため見送り。地域的な学校閉鎖対応に留まる事案。

article.articleHeadline: India Surpasses Global TB Decline With 38 Percent Mortality Drop
article.articleSummary: India records a 38% drop in TB mortality since 2015, exceeding the global 35% decline, according to the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026, and a 94% treatment success rate. The progress is driven by the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, technology-enabled diagnostics, community participation and patient-centric care. Through intensified screening, over 25 crore people were covered, with 11 crore+ chest X-rays and 3 crore+ molecular tests; 48.64 lakh TB cases were detected, including nearly 15 lakh asymptomatic cases, enabling early treatment. AI-enabled diagnostics and Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana nutrition support, plus Ni-kshay Mitras, bolster TB care nationwide. Published 13 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インドが結核死亡率38%減少を達成、世界平均の減少率を上回る
triage.triage_reason: WHO報告に基づくインドの結核対策の前向きな進展を伝える内容であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核対策の成功事例を報告するものであり、シグナルトリアージの対象となる新規発生や異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : la surveillance épidémiologique révèle ses failles | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Epidemiological Surveillance Reveals Its Shortcomings | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: As of November 13, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows major surveillance gaps despite urgent response needs. The outbreak has surpassed 11,000 cases and 5,000 deaths. Médecins Sans Frontières warns that surveillance coverage is uneven, with undercovered zones, a shortage of qualified staff, and insufficient equipment and logistics. In Ituri, only 9% of Ebola patients treated by MSF were previously listed as contacts, underscoring gaps in contact tracing. MSF urges authorities and UN agencies to convert announced funding into concrete actions: better resource tracking, stronger supervision, and improved working conditions, including training, pay, equipment, and personnel support. From North Kivu to Haut-Uélé, the response remains uneven, with some areas severely under-equipped. Every missed contact or delay in detection risks compromising the entire prevention and care chain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：疫学サーベイランスがその欠陥を露呈
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱で11,000人超の症例・5,000人超の死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、サーベイランス体制の不備によりヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが継続しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はMSFによるサーベイランス体制の欠陥（人員不足、機器不足、接触者追跡の不備）を強調しており、既存の大規模アウトブレイクの継続的リスクを示す内容。コンタクトトレーシングの不備（患者の9%のみが接触者リストに記載）は流行拡大リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Više od 11.000 ljudi zaraženo ebolom u Kongu, gotovo polovica umrla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 11,000 people infected with Ebola in the Congo, nearly half have died.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded more than 11,000 Ebola cases in the past six months, with nearly half of those infected dying, per DPA. The true toll may be higher, as experts warn the Bundibugyo Ebola virus may have circulated since February, before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Ebola is a highly infectious disease causing rapid fluid loss, inflammatory responses, coagulation disturbances, and potential organ failure; mortality rises with delayed treatment. For the Bundibugyo strain involved, there is no approved vaccine or specific drug. Early symptoms resemble malaria, risking delays in isolation and care. The outbreak has spread to eight provinces in the DR Congo and has been detected in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Health officials note that children are hardest hit, making up a significant portion of confirmed cases and facing higher mortality risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1万1000人以上がエボラに感染、約半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000人超の感染、致死率約50%、ワクチン未承認株で8州に拡大しケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダでも検出されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアでも検出と報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症状がマラリアと類似し診断・隔離の遅延リスクがある点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Više od 11 tisuća slučajeva ebole u Kongu: Gotovo polovica zaraženih je umrla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 11,000 Ebola cases in Congo: Almost half of those infected have died.
article.articleSummary: Over 11,000 Ebola virus disease cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the last six months through November 2026, with nearly half of those infected dying. Officials warn the true toll may be higher, as the virus may have circulated since February, months before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. The outbreak is difficult to contain; early symptoms resemble malaria, delaying isolation and treatment. The Bundibugyo strain currently involved has no vaccine or approved specific drug. The disease has spread across eight provinces in the DRC and crossed borders, with cases detected in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Children are disproportionately affected, comprising a significant share of confirmed cases and facing higher mortality. Surveillance gaps may undercount the true incidence.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1万1000人超のエボラ感染者、感染者のほぼ半数が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000例超、致死率約50%のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへも越境している重大事案であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ワクチン・特効薬のないブンディブギョ株であり、早期症状がマラリアと類似するため隔離・治療が遅れている点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: बिना खांसी-बुखार के भी हो सकती है टीबी! भारत में मिले 14.97 लाख बिना लक्षण वाले मरीज, जानें कैसे फैलती है यह बीमारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB can occur even without coughing or fever! 1.497 million asymptomatic patients found in India—learn how this disease spreads.
article.articleSummary: India identified 48.64 lakh new TB patients during the TB Free India initiative from 7 December 2024 to 8 November 2026, of which 31% (14.97 lakh) were asymptomatic. Asymptomatic TB, or subclinical TB, can harbor active infection without coughing, fever, or weight loss. The program screened over 25 crore people, with more than 11 crore chest X-rays and over 3 crore molecular tests, aided by AI-based chest X-ray analysis and NAAT. TB is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, primarily affecting the lungs but also bones, brain, and kidneys. Transmission occurs via airborne spread from coughing, sneezing, or talking; some asymptomatic individuals with active TB can spread infection, though not all do. High-risk groups include TB contacts, diabetes, HIV, malnutrition, elderly, smokers, and prior TB treatment. Deaths from TB fell by 38% in 2025 vs 2015, but asymptomatic cases remain a major challenge requiring timely screening and full treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 咳や発熱がなくてもTBになり得る！インドで無症状の患者149.7万人が検出、この病気がどのように広がるかを知ろう
triage.triage_reason: インド国内の既存の結核対策プログラムに関する公衆衛生報告であり、新規異常事態ではなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: TB Free India イニシアチブの進捗報告記事であり、死亡率は低下傾向。既知の風土病に関する定期的な公衆衛生情報であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola en RDC : malgré des centaines de millions de dollars mobilisés, des équipes restent sans moyens, alerte MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response in the DRC: despite hundreds of millions of dollars mobilized, teams are left without resources, MSF warns.
article.articleSummary: Six months after the Ebola outbreak declaration in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, MSF warns of a persistent gap between hundreds of millions mobilized and real on-ground resources. More than 11,000 Ebola cases and over 5,000 deaths have been recorded. Despite advances in diagnostic capacity, isolation and treatment units, and intensified community mobilization, frontline workers remain unpaid or undertrained, with some striking. Ambulances and vehicles sit idle for lack of fuel; community agents lack phones or Internet to transmit alerts. Surveillance shows only about 9% of Ebola patients were identified as contacts before care. In the past month, two-thirds of deaths occurred in communities rather than in treatment centers. In North Kivu’s Beni zone, nearly 75% of infections occurred in medical facilities. MSF urges the Congolese government and UN agencies to improve monitoring and transparency of resource use, ensure staff training and pay, equip responders, and target funding to highest-need areas. The outbreak surpasses 11,000 cases and 5,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ対応:数億ドルが動員されたにもかかわらず、現場チームは資源不足に直面——MSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は11,000例超・死亡5,000人超に達し、資金はあるが現場への資源配分が機能しておらず、医療施設内感染が多発するなど制御不全の兆候があるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 累計11,000例超・死亡5,000人超という大規模流行が6か月以上継続中。医療施設内感染（北キブ州ベニで75%）や接触者特定率の低さ（9%）など、サーベイランス・対応体制の機能不全が示唆される。国際的拡大や渡航制限の有無については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ngãi siết biên giới Lào kiểm soát dịch tả heo châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quảng Ngãi tightens the border with Laos to control African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, African swine fever (ASF) is spreading in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, with outbreaks across 37 communes and 416 households, and 3,043 pigs culled weighing over 146 metric tons. To curb cross-border introduction from Laos, the provincial People’s Committee issued Plan 430 to strengthen ASF prevention and to inspect pig and pig-product transport and trade of unknown origin, tightening border controls with Laos. In November, the province’s Police will lead an inter-agency inspection team focusing on the Vietnam–Laos border, interprovincial routes, collection points, transfer hubs, slaughterhouses, and pig markets; the plan runs through 28 February 2027. Laos’s ASF situation is described as complex and a potential source of cross-border spread. An Giang Province has culled 660 pigs (35.3 tonnes) as part of its response.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省、ラオスとの国境を強化しアフリカ豚熱(ASF)を抑制
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・クアンガイ省で37コミューンにわたりASFが拡大し、ラオスとの国境を越えた感染拡大リスクがあるため、貿易・輸送規制が強化されている。
triage.notes: 本事例はアフリカ豚熱（ASF）という動物感染症であり、人への直接的健康被害は報告されていない。ただし、ラオスとの国境を越えた拡大や貿易規制の強化が確認されており、農業・経済面でのリスク管理が必要。ラオス（Laos）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Fatalna bolest i dalje se širi: Najteže su pogođena djeca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly disease continues to spread: Children are hardest hit.
article.articleSummary: Over the last six months, the Democratic Republic of Congo has reported more than 11,000 Ebola cases, with nearly half of those infected dying. The true toll may be higher, as experts warn the virus may have circulated since February, months before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Ebola is a highly contagious disease caused by a group of viruses that can rapidly cause dehydration, inflammatory responses, coagulation disorders, and organ failure; delaying treatment increases mortality. Early symptoms can resemble malaria, delaying isolation and care. The outbreak is difficult to curb because there is no vaccine or specific drug approved for the Bundibugyo strain. Ebola has spread to eight provinces within the DRC and beyond its borders, with confirmed cases reported in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Children are the hardest hit, making up a significant share of confirmed cases and being more likely to die.

triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000件超のエボラ症例と約50%の死亡率が報告され、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: VIDEO Širi se ebola u Africi: U Kongu više od 5,5 tisuća mrtvih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: VIDEO: Ebola spreading in Africa: More than 5,500 dead in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) faces an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Over 11,000 cases have been recorded in the past six months, with nearly half of confirmed patients dying. The true toll may be higher, since transmission could have begun as early as February before the outbreak was officially declared on 15 May. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific therapy, hindering containment. The outbreak has spread across eight provinces and crossed borders to Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Children are among the hardest hit, forming a significant share of cases with higher mortality. Early symptoms resemble malaria, delaying isolation and treatment and highlighting the need for rapid supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: 動画:アフリカでエボラ拡大 コンゴで死者5,500人超
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱が11,000例以上・致死率約50%で拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへ越境しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境が報じられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。マラリアとの初期症状類似が隔離・治療の遅れを招いている点も注意。ワクチン・特効薬が未承認のブンディブギョ株である点が重大リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de SP alerta para alta de casos de Covid-19 e reforça importância da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo Health Department warns of a rise in COVID-19 cases and reinforces the importance of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases and ICU admissions are rising gradually in São Paulo state, Brazil, prompting renewed emphasis on vaccination. In 2026, the state reported 1,405 COVID-19 cases and 196 deaths. The SES-SP underscores vaccination as the most effective shield against severe disease and death. The immunization schedule targets multiple groups: children 6 months to under 5 years should complete a three-dose primary series; adults 60+ should receive two annual doses; immunocompromised individuals get semiannual doses; pregnant and puerperal individuals receive one dose per gestation. Other priority groups—healthcare workers, people with comorbidities, Indigenous communities, Quilombolas, and vulnerable workers—receive one annual dose at Basic Health Units (UBS). Early symptoms resemble cold/flu (fever, dry cough, runny nose, body aches, fatigue) and may appear up to two weeks after exposure; warning signs include severe shortness of breath, persistent chest pain, confusion, or bluish lips, requiring urgent care. Check vaccination history at the nearest health post to update all vaccines through SUS.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州保健局、COVID-19症例増加を警告しワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、季節的な症例増加とワクチン接種啓発に関する内容で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz aponta leve alta nos casos graves de covid-19 no início de novembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz notes a slight uptick in severe COVID-19 cases in early November.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports a rise in severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) cases caused by COVID-19 during the first week of November, according to Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin. Analyzed from November 1–7 via Sivep-Gripe, SARS-CoV-2 accounted for 11.5% of hospitalizations and 26.9% of deaths caused by respiratory viruses in the past four weeks. The uptick is most pronounced in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Bahia, and the Federal District. Among capitals, Boa Vista, João Pessoa, Porto Velho, and Rio de Janeiro show risk or high-risk levels, with higher incidence among young children in the first three and older adults in Rio. Aracaju, Brasília, Cuiabá, and Florianópolis remain at alert, with no sustained growth. Tatiana Portella of Fiocruz emphasizes active circulation, urges vaccination updates, prioritizing yearly immunization, with boosters every six months for elderly and immunocompromised individuals. Continue hand hygiene and use high-filtration masks (PFF2/N95) when leaving home with symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス、11月初旬に新型コロナウイルス重症例のわずかな増加を指摘

triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）による季節的な重症例増加の定例サーベイランス報告。ワクチン接種呼びかけ等、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: 三种毒株同时活跃 流感季这些防护要点请收好
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza virus strains are circulating simultaneously; during flu season, take note of these protective measures.
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains are circulating concurrently in China this flu season, with influenza A H3N2 slightly dominant; influenza A H1N1 is rising in neighboring countries and may become prevalent in the near term. Co-circulation with weak cross-protection heightens the risk of sequential infections and could prolong the season. High‑risk groups (65+, children under 5, pregnant or perinatal women, immunocompromised, chronic disease patients, and obesity) require vigilant monitoring. Common symptoms for H3N2/H1N1 include fever, sore throat, cough, myalgia, and fatigue; influenza B in children more often presents with GI symptoms (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea). Vaccination remains best prevention: a trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine can be co-administered with pneumococcal or zoster vaccines at different sites; rabies vaccination takes priority after exposure; nasal live vaccines require a 28‑day interval from other live vaccines. Egg allergy is no longer a barrier due to purification. Antivirals (oseltamivir and baloxavir) are prescription-only; start within 48 hours when possible. Do not self-medicate; complete courses; after fever resolves, avoid strenuous activity for 1–3 weeks to reduce myocarditis risk.

article.articleHeadline: Conflict, Disease Outbreaks Worsen DR Congo Hunger Crisis
article.articleSummary: Conflict and displacement in the Democratic Republic of the Congo push Projected Crisis or worse (IPC 3+) hunger to 30.3 million from January–June 2027, with nearly 29 million in Crisis or worse from September–December 2026 and 3.6 million in Emergency; early 2027 Emergency rises to 4.2 million. Eastern DRC bears the sharpest needs, with more than 11 million people in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri facing Crisis or worse, and nine territories in Emergency: Djugu (Ituri); Lubero, Masisi, Oïcha (North Kivu); Fizi, Kalehe, Mwenga, Shabunda, Walungu (South Kivu). Across Tanganyika, Maniema, Kasaï, Haut-Lomami, Lomami, Kwango and Haut-Uele, large populations also face Crisis levels. Ebola, mpox, cholera and other outbreaks compound hunger, as conflict disrupts farming, markets and access to services. WFP, FAO, UNICEF and WHO warn aid is lagging; urgent response is needed to seed early 2027 planting and harvest by mid-year, reducing malnutrition risk in children under five.

triage.headline_ja: 紛争と感染症アウトブレイクがコンゴ民主共和国の飢餓危機を悪化させる

triage.notes: 記事はWFP/FAO/UNICEF/WHOによる人道支援の必要性を訴える食糧危機報告であり、感染症（エボラ、mpox、コレラ）は飢餓を悪化させる複合要因として言及されているのみ。具体的な症例数・発生地詳細・新規性は記載なし。Fijiは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文に関連言及なしのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 正值流感季，中疾控提醒：重点人群优先接种流感疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu season is here: China CDC urges priority groups to receive the influenza vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination is prioritized in China as the country enters the annual flu season. At a National Health Commission briefing, China CDC researcher Wang Dayan urged vaccination during November–March, noting vaccines are the most cost-effective protection. Policies include: employees’ medical insurance personal accounts covering vaccine fees and injection service charges; rural areas will receive state funds to provide free vaccination for residents aged 65+ and for students in compulsory education; unions will support vaccination for workers in new employment forms; most township health centers and community health service centers offer weekend vaccination. Priority groups: children aged 6 months and older, the elderly, people with chronic diseases, and staff in schools, nurseries, eldercare facilities, and healthcare institutions. Vaccination requires 2–4 weeks to develop protective antibodies (lasting 6–8 months); antivirals offer only short-term protection and must be prescribed. It remains the optimal time, but vaccination can be done anytime during the season.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザシーズン到来：中国疾病予防コントロールセンターが重点人群にワクチン優先接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種を促す通常の公衆衛生広報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク等の基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 通常の季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種推奨に関する広報記事であり、特定の異常な流行や重症化事例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: NEET student leaves hostel due to jaundice outbreak, denied refund, wins Rs 75,000
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, India, a NEET coaching institute faced a jaundice outbreak at its hostel in June 2025, leading to temporary closure and the daughter leaving in July 2025. The family paid Rs 79,095 (academic, hostel, caution deposit, other charges). The state consumer commission, in an October 31 order, found deficiency in service, rejecting the institute’s claim that the departure was due to homesickness and linking the outbreak to the purported low-quality, contaminated food. It ordered the institute to refund Rs 4,245 of the academic fee (10% as per policy) and Rs 11,000 caution deposit, plus Rs 50,000 as compensation and Rs 10,000 in costs, totaling Rs 75,245. The commission noted lack of evidence for a laptop or further liability for academics. The ruling underscores issues of food hygiene, outbreak control, and student grievance handling at the institute, with imported refunds and damages awarded.

triage.headline_ja: NEET受験生、黄疸の集団発生で宿舎を退去し返金を拒否されるも7万5000ルピーの支払いを勝ち取る
triage.triage_reason: 2025年6月に発生した単一施設内の黄疸（ジョンダイス）アウトブレイクに関する消費者紛争の法的判決記事であり、公衆衛生上の新規性や拡大リスクはなく、既に過去の出来事として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: JP Nadda hails WHO report on India's fight against tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: India reduced TB mortality by 38% since 2015, per the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026, outpacing the global 35% decline and achieving a 94% treatment success rate. Health Minister JP Nadda credited Prime Minister Modi’s TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, highlighting intensified screening that reached over 25 crore people, more than 11 crore chest X-rays, and 3 crore+ molecular tests, resulting in 48.64 lakh TB cases detected, including about 15 lakh asymptomatic cases. AI-enabled diagnostics and Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana nutrition support under Ni-kshay Mitras strengthen care. The WHO notes India’s TB mortality fell from 280 to 180 deaths per million between 2015 and 2025. India accounted for 25% of global TB cases in 2025 and remains among the four countries with >50% of global MDR-TB cases, though MDR-TB incidence is declining. The TB profile will be updated after sentinel surveillance is reviewed by the Central TB Division and ICMR, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: JPナッダ氏、インドの結核対策に関するWHO報告を称賛
triage.triage_reason: WHO報告書に基づく結核対策の成果を称える内容であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。既存の国家プログラムの進捗報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの結核対策の成果（死亡率低下、治療成功率向上）を政府が肯定的に報告する内容。MDR-TB（多剤耐性結核）の高い割合に言及があるが、これは既知の継続的課題であり新規シグナルではない。対象国リストにインドは含まれるが、本記事は既存プログラムの成果報告であり、トリアージ対象としてのピックアップは不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Swiss woman evacuated from Nigeria discharged after recovery
article.articleSummary: An Ugandan-born Swiss woman who contracted Ebola in Nigeria has been discharged from Geneva University Hospitals after full recovery, with her evacuation to Switzerland on 26 October and discharge on 11 November 2026. She and her Swiss diplomat husband were evacuated after she returned to Abuja from Uganda on 3 October, developed symptoms days later, and tested positive on 20 October. Nigeria’s NCDC reports as of 11 November one confirmed case, zero deaths, and seven negative results, with 62 contacts identified; 52 completed the 21-day follow-up and 10 remain under monitoring. The Nigerian response includes contact tracing, testing, IPC measures, and entry-point surveillance, and the country notes no further confirmed cases since the imported infection. Regionally, Bundibugyo virus disease remains a cross‑border outbreak in Africa; WHO’s 6 November update tallies DRC: 10,668 cases, 5,198 deaths across 67 health zones; Kenya: 9 cases, 2 deaths; Nigeria: 1 imported case, with no new confirmed cases in Kenya or Nigeria since prior update.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアから退避したスイス人女性、回復後に退院
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）流行が継続（症例10,668件、死亡5,198件）し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大・輸入症例も発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例（スイス人女性）だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、記事中で言及されるDRCでの大規模流行（10,668症例、5,198死亡）は対象国リストに含まれるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに計上。ケニア・スイス・ウガンダも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: le Kenya libère son dernier patient et entame 42 jours de surveillance avant une éventuelle déclaration de fin de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kenya releases its last patient and begins 42 days of surveillance before a possible declaration of the end of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists. Kenya reports nine cases linked to an imported DRC case, with two deaths, and has released its last patient, starting a 42-day countdown to possibly declare Ebola-free. Nigeria reports an imported case involving a Swiss national evacuated to Switzerland with a spouse. The first Bundibugyo-strain Ebola case was registered in Nairobi in early October; the patient arrived Oct 3 from eastern DRC, via Entebbe, Uganda, and died in Nairobi hospital after isolation; 28 contacts identified, 23 still being sought. WHO Director‑General Tedros urged regional preparedness, especially along borders, with surveillance, alert investigations, testing, isolation, clinical care, and PPE; called for lifting generalized travel bans in favor of targeted, data-driven measures. The outbreak in the DRC continues amidst significant challenges.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:ケニアが最後の患者を退院させ、流行終息宣言の可能性に向けて42日間の監視を開始
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大し死亡例もあり、WHOが地域的な警戒と国境対策強化を呼びかけるなど国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC由来のエボラ流行がケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへ越境輸出された事例を中心に報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・スイスは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 está diferente? Sintomas que parecem gripe podem esconder infecção pelo coronavírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is COVID-19 different? Symptoms that resemble the flu may mask a coronavirus infection.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, COVID-19 remains circulating and may present with influenza-like symptoms. Sore throat, runny nose, and cough are currently among the most common signs, while loss of smell and taste are less frequent than in the early pandemic. A Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin reports an uptick in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases associated with COVID-19 in five Brazilian states: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Federal District, Mato Grosso, and Santa Catarina. An infectious disease expert explains what signs to watch for. The report underscores that COVID-19 can mimic flu or cold symptoms, challenging clinical assessment, and signals an ongoing outbreak trend that requires vigilance among health authorities and the public.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19は変化している？インフルエンザに似た症状がコロナウイルス感染を隠している可能性
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の症状に関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、特定の異常な集団発生や重症化傾向、国際的拡大リスクを示す具体的データは乏しい。
triage.notes: ブラジル複数州でSARS症例の増加がInfoGripe速報で報告されているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・重症度の詳細情報は記事に含まれず、既知の病原体（COVID-19）の季節的変動の範囲内と考えられる。続報があれば経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Повеќе од 5.500 мртви од ебола во Конго во епидемијата што продолжува да се шири
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 5,500 Ebola deaths in Congo as the outbreak continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: More than 5,500 Ebola deaths and over 11,000 cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo over the last six months, with nearly half of those infected dying. The true toll may be higher, as experts warn the virus could have circulated undetected since February before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain underpins this outbreak, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The epidemic has spread to eight provinces within DR Congo and has been reported in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Children are disproportionately affected and face higher mortality. Early symptoms can resemble malaria, delaying isolation and care, underscoring the need for rapid laboratory confirmation and a strengthened public health response.

triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8州に拡大し死者5,500人超・致死率約50%、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境伝播も報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Barrick Furloughs Some Kibali Workers as Ebola Precaution - Shanghai Metals Market (SMM)
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola deaths in a nearby community prompted Barrick Mining to place some Kibali gold mine workers and subcontractors on temporary leave as a precaution, an internal memo cited by Reuters on 12 November 2026 (article date 2026-11-13). The furlough targets non-essential personnel while Barrick investigates possible links to its workforce; the company did not quantify staffing reductions or any impact on gold production. Kibali is owned 45% by Barrick, 45% by AngloGold Ashanti, and 10% by state-owned SOKIMO. This action reflects precautionary measures in the Democratic Republic of the Congo near mine operations following Ebola deaths. No further details on case counts were provided.

triage.headline_ja: バリック、エボラ予防措置としてキバリ鉱山労働者の一部を一時帰休に - 上海金属市場(SMM)
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による死亡例が鉱山近隣コミュニティで発生し、国際的に操業する大手鉱山企業が予防的措置を取っていることから、公衆衛生上の深刻性と拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: キバリ金鉱山（DRC、マニエマ州近郊）周辺コミュニティでのエボラ死亡例を受け、多国籍資本（バリック、アングロゴールド・アシャンティ、SOKIMO）の鉱山で非必須人員が一時帰休となった。症例数や感染経路の詳細は不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија на ебола во Африка: повеќе од 11.000 заразени, илјадници мртви
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic in Africa: More Than 11,000 Infected, Thousands Dead
article.articleSummary: More than 11,000 Ebola cases have been identified in the past six months in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with about half dying; the official death toll may be higher. Experts warn the Bundibugyo strain may have circulated silently since February, months before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Ebola, a highly contagious viral disease, can rapidly cause fluid loss, inflammatory responses, coagulation disorders, and organ failure; earlier treatment reduces mortality. For this Bundibugyo strain, there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Early symptoms resemble malaria, which can delay isolation and care. The outbreak has spread to eight provinces within DRC and crossed borders, with cases reported in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Health authorities note that children are hardest hit, comprising a substantial share of confirmed cases and facing higher mortality risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ流行：感染者1万1000人超、数千人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）が6ヶ国8州に拡大し、致死率約50%、国境を越えてケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダにも波及しており、ワクチン・特効薬が存在しないため国際的な公衆衛生上の重大なリスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛警告剛果（金）伊波拉疫情嚴峻 暴力衝突阻礙應對
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is severe; violent clashes hinder the response.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is severe, with ongoing transmission and about 400–500 new cases weekly, representing the largest outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest globally. As of the latest update, the country has 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths (case fatality ~48.9%). Security instability remains a major barrier, with 81 attacks on health facilities since May. On Nov 5, an armed attack in North Kivu’s Beni region (Cantin-Aloya) killed 66 civilians, including three health workers; three health facilities were looted or burned, and over 1,000 contacts are unaccounted for. Diagnostic capacity has risen from two laboratories to more than 20, enabling processing of >600 samples per day, and 109 transit and treatment centers provide about 2,000 beds. Research includes two Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidates in clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: 世衛警告剛果（金）エボラ疫情嚴峻　暴力衝突阻礙應對（WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の深刻さを警告、暴力衝突が対応を妨げる）
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、週400-500例の新規感染が続く大規模流行であり、医療施設への攻撃や治安不安が対応を著しく妨げている。IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念事案。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に警告を発している大規模エボラ流行であり、治安悪化により対応が著しく阻害されている。国際的な支援ニーズが高く、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : plus de 40 000 enfants ciblés par une campagne contre la rougeole à Shabunda - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: more than 40,000 children targeted by a measles campaign in Shabunda - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination campaign targets more than 40,000 children aged 9 months to 15 years in Shabunda Rural Health Zone, South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Launched 7 November 2026 for 25 days, the effort—supported by MSF Spain—seeks to boost protection and reach those who missed doses during previous campaigns or routine services. The campaign combines measles vaccination with screening for malaria and malnutrition; children testing positive receive immediate care through the health zone and partners. Two operating modes are used: fixed-post vaccination within health facilities and an outreach strategy to bring services to remote communities. Dr. Guillaume Kiatughu, medical chief of the Shabunda Rural Health Zone, says this combined approach expands coverage and reduces measles transmission. Health authorities urge parents to vaccinate, highlighting immunization as essential for preventing vaccine-preventable diseases and improving child health.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ州：シャブンダで4万人以上の子供を対象とした麻疹予防接種キャンペーン - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 予防的な麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施を報じる内容であり、異常な流行や重症事例の急増等は報告されていないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はMSFスペイン支援による予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生や異常な症例増加を示す記述はない。
