article.articleHeadline: RDC : anticipation de l'impact des interventions contre la rougeole et le choléra - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Anticipating the Impact of Interventions Against Measles and Cholera - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 13 November 2026 - An expert workshop in Kinshasa, DRC, focused on epidemiological modeling to anticipate the impact of interventions against measles and cholera under the Gates Foundation-supported Orcas project. Led by INRB's epidemiological modeling unit, the event brings together DSE, PEV, and PNECO to identify operational questions that models can answer to reverse the epidemic curve and reduce measles and cholera cases. The consortium includes Redeemer's University (Nigeria), University of Oxford (UK), and Nigeria's NCDC. Outcomes include stakeholder mapping, data-source inventory, and defined modeling questions to guide predictive tools. Planned decision-support resources will include an analysis platform, policy briefs, and situation reports for decision-makers. Methodologically, the team will blend mechanistic mathematical modeling with AI, leveraging Google's population-dynamics models and neural networks to forecast hotspots and case trajectories, incorporating climate, flood, and mobility data, especially in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：麻疹とコレラへの介入影響を予測する取り組み - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はコンゴ民主共和国における麻疹・コレラ対策の効果予測のための疫学モデリングワークショップに関する報告であり、新規発生や症例急増などの実際の感染症イベントを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はGates財団支援のOrcasプロジェクトによる疫学モデリング構築に関するもので、具体的な症例数や流行状況のデータは示されていない。ナイジェリア・英国は研究コンソーシアム参加国であり、発生地域ではないため対象国リストから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Caught Between Killers: Ebola on One Side, Islamic State on the Other
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, six months after Ebola was first detected in May 2026 in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the outbreak has expanded from a single cluster to eight provinces, splintering into numerous hot spots across a rainforest the size of Britain. While health workers have corralled the virus where it was detected first, infections are soaring elsewhere, with Biakato town in the deep forest accounting for as many as a quarter of new cases nationally. Residents there face dangerously little protection against the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history, underscoring recurring containment challenges. Complicating the response, a new threat has emerged: an Islamic State campaign that hinders efforts to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 殺し屋たちに挟まれて：一方にエボラ、もう一方にイスラム国
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で発生したエボラ流行は史上最速の拡大速度で8州に拡大しており、IHR4基準すべて該当かつWPRO基準も複数該当する重大シグナル。武装勢力ISISによる対応妨害も重なり国際支援が必要な状況。
triage.notes: ニューヨーク・タイムズによる報道で、史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行がISISの妨害活動と相まって封じ込めが極めて困難な状況にあることが強調されている。フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mpox ultrapassam mil em 2026 e se concentram em seis estados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases exceed one thousand in 2026 and are concentrated in six states.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Brazil surpassed 1,000 cases in 2026, with 1,023 confirmed, 46 probable, 581 suspected, and 1 death as of November 12, 2026. The highest case counts are in Rio de Janeiro (390) and São Paulo (388), followed by Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), Distrito Federal (41), and Santa Catarina (24). Confirmed cases rose sharply in November (227) and October (293), together comprising more than half of 2026’s total. Since the disease’s notification began in Brazil, 15,455 cases and 19 deaths have been recorded. Mpox is caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV), an Orthopoxvirus zoonosis, with most infections ranging from mild to moderate. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily secretions, contaminated objects, or prolonged close contact with respiratory secretions. The Ministry of Health recently acquired 25,000 vaccine doses for at‑risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年のMpox症例数が1000人を超え、6州に集中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が2026年に1000例を超え、10-11月に急増するなど異常な増加傾向が見られ、複数州への拡大とヒト-ヒト感染の継続的リスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の複数州（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、セアラ、ミナスジェライス、連邦区、サンタカタリーナ）における症例集中を報告。保健省はワクチン2.5万回分を確保済みだが、国際支援の必要性については言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Government insists no Ebola cases confirmed despite embassy warning of outbreak risk
article.articleSummary: South Sudan reports no confirmed Ebola cases amid warnings from six foreign embassies (Germany, Japan, the Netherlands, Norway, the United Kingdom and the United States) of outbreak risk. The embassies urged increased health-sector funding and salary payments for public health workers. The government acknowledged international support for preparedness but asserted that concerns must be based on verified information to avoid fear and unnecessary alarm, urging diplomatic channels for raising concerns. The warnings come as the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola continues to spread in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. The World Health Organization estimates a 99% risk of the virus being imported into South Sudan due to porous borders, cross-border trade, and population movements. Despite the heightened risk, the government maintains that no Ebola case has been confirmed and reiterates its commitment to public health and preparedness to prevent transmission, including monitoring cross-border risks.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、大使館による発生リスク警告にもかかわらずエボラ確定例はないと主張
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続し、WHOが南スーダンへの越境流入リスクを99%と推定するなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南スーダンにおける未確認エボラ警戒だが、実際の感染発生（ブンディブギョ株の流行）は隣国コンゴ民主共和国で進行中であるため、同国を発生地域として検証した。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ngãi siết kiểm soát biên giới Lào để ngăn dịch tả heo châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quang Ngai tightens Laos border controls to prevent African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, on 13 November 2026 issued Plan 430 to strengthen African swine fever (ASF) prevention and control, focusing on transport and trade of pigs and pig products of unknown origin, especially near the Vietnam–Laos border. Since the start of 2026, ASF cases have affected 416 households across 116 hamlets in 37 communes, with 3,043 pigs culled and total weight over 146 tonnes. Laos reports a complex ASF outbreak, heightening cross-border transmission risk via movement of pigs and pig products. In November, provincial authorities task the police with proposing an inter-sectoral inspection team to monitor border zones, transport routes, collection points, markets, and slaughterhouses. Plan implementation runs through 28 February 2027, aiming to prevent further spread amid ongoing cross-border concerns.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省、アフリカ豚コレラ対策のためラオス国境の管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）は家畜（豚）のみに影響する動物疾病であり、人への感染性はなく公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは認められないため。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては優先度が低い。国境を越えた豚・豚製品の移動による家畜間感染拡大リスクはあるが、人への健康影響は報告されていない。ラオスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'OMS s'alarme des conséquences des attaques armées sur la riposte à l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: WHO alarmed by the consequences of armed attacks on the outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns insecurity in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is the main obstacle to the Ebola response. On 5 November 2026, the Allied Democratic Forces attacked Cantine-Aloya, 60 km west of Beni, North Kivu, destroying three health facilities and killing three health workers; thousands were displaced, including contact cases. Three confirmed Ebola cases disappeared and about 1,000 contacts are unaccounted for, complicating containment, per WHO's Dr. Marie Roseline Belizaire. Since the outbreak began six months ago, 81 attacks against health centers or personnel have been recorded. Official figures as of 13 November 2026 show over 11,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths in eight of the DRC's 26 provinces. The eastern region has endured decades of violence; the ADF, linked to ISIS, is a key actor.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 in DRC: 武装勢力の攻撃が流行対応に及ぼす影響にWHOが警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の感染者が11,000人超、死者5,387人に達する大規模流行が続いており、武装勢力の攻撃により接触者追跡が困難になるなど公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常事態であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 武装勢力（ADF、ISIS系列）による医療施設・要員への攻撃が流行対応の主要な障害となっており、確認済み感染者3名と接触者約1,000人が行方不明になっている点が特に懸念される。
