article.articleHeadline: جنوب السودان يرفض مخاوف البعثات الدبلوماسية بشأن الإيبولا - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sudan rejects concerns of diplomatic missions regarding Ebola.
article.articleSummary: South Sudan rejected concerns from six diplomatic missions—Germany, Japan, the Netherlands, Norway, the United Kingdom, and the United States—about a potential Ebola outbreak, stating there are no confirmed cases and urging concerns be channelled through official diplomacy to avoid panic. The missions warned of elevated risk amid regional Ebola activity linked to the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with spillovers to Uganda and Kenya. WHO updates show DRC with 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths by Nov 3; Kenya 9 cases; Uganda under control. South Sudan borders the DRC; cross-border movement and displacement heighten risk. A WHO October assessment put the introduction risk into South Sudan at 99%. Sept 3,450 people crossed from the DRC. As of Oct 30, 76 alerts for suspected Ebola, 33 negatives; no confirmed cases. National preparedness was 72.5%, targeting 15 high-risk provinces. Calls persist for increased domestic health funding and unhindered humanitarian access.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン、エボラ出血熱に関する外交使節団の懸念を否定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1万人超の確定症例・5千人超の死亡が続くエボラ流行があり、国境を越えた人の移動によりウガンダ・ケニアへの波及や南スーダンへの導入リスク（WHO評価99%）が指摘されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的・外交的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南スーダンにおけるエボラ導入リスクへの外交的懸念と政府の反応だが、実際の確定症例・死亡者数はDRCで発生しているためDRCを発生地域として検証した。南スーダン、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: السل الصامت في الهند: 1.5 مليون إصابة بدون أعراض
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Silent TB in India: 1.5 million asymptomatic infections.
article.articleSummary: In India, a nationwide TB campaign uncovering about 1.5 million asymptomatic infections underscores the burden of silent tuberculosis. The Ministry of Health reported 14.97 million asymptomatic cases among 48.64 million newly detected infections from 7 Dec 2024 to 8 Nov 2026, after screening over 250 million people. Silent (subclinical) TB is active bacterial disease confirmed by laboratory tests or radiographic changes, yet lacking common symptoms such as chronic cough, night sweats, fever, weight loss, or chest pain. Transmission can occur during normal breathing, not solely coughing, with some individuals without a persistent cough yielding positive sputum results. Delayed care in asymptomatic cases heightens ongoing transmission. Treatment relies on standard anti-TB drugs with strict adherence to prescribed doses and duration to prevent drug resistance. The findings stress targeted screening for contacts and high-risk groups, since absence of cough or fever does not exclude infection.

triage.headline_ja: インドの静かな結核：150万人の無症状感染
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドにおいて既知の風土病であり、本記事は全国スクリーニングキャンペーンの統計報告であって、異常な発生や急性公衆衛生イベントを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核は長年の風土病であり、本記事はスクリーニング事業の進捗報告に過ぎず、突発的な感染症イベントのシグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: New pandemic fears sweep Russia as second mystery virus takes hold - symptoms
article.articleSummary: Russia reels as a second mystery illness strikes holidaymakers in Vietnam’s Nha Trang, with dozens reportedly falling seriously ill. Patients report high fever, severe headaches, runny nose and a heavy cough that can linger for weeks, while Vietnamese doctors describe the illness as a circulating flu virus and have yet to pin down a diagnosis. Rospotrebnadzor has formally requested data from Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia to clarify the outbreak. This follows a prior Coxsackie virus scare among Russian tourists in Vietnam; results are awaited from Hanoi. Five weeks earlier, Russia faced fears of a deadly plague in Siberia after a lab worker died at an anti-plague institute in Irkutsk. Moscow experts suggest seasonal respiratory infections or standard flu strains rather than a new pathogen; officials downplay the crisis, with the Ho Chi Minh City consulate reporting no citizens seeking help.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアに広がる新たなパンデミックの恐怖、2つ目の謎のウイルスが猛威を振るう―その症状とは
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客数十人が高熱・重度の頭痛・持続する咳を伴う原因不明の疾患に罹患し、ロシア当局（Rospotrebnadzor）が公式に情報提供を要請するなど、異常性と国際的拡大の可能性が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナム・ニャチャンでのロシア人観光客の集団感染であり、Ho Chi Minh Cityは領事館報告の文脈でのみ言及されているため主題地域として扱わない。ロシア（モスクワ・イルクーツク）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。診断未確定であり、インフルエンザ様疾患またはCoxsackieウイルスの可能性が議論されているが確証なし。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تشيد بالتقدم في التصدي لفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations commends progress in tackling the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows progress, with United Nations health officials praising declines in cases in eastern districts that were previously hot spots. In a briefing, WHO's Health Emergencies Programme head Chikwe Ihekweazu said the signs are encouraging, noting lower case counts in areas such as Bunia and Nizi in eastern DRC. However, he warned that transmission continues and is shifting into more dangerous, harder-to-reach regions of the country, complicating surveillance and response. The single greatest obstacle to controlling the outbreak remains increasing insecurity and conflict, which impede access for health workers and delivery of vaccines and treatment. The statement underscores cautious optimism while stressing sustained, secure operations to stop Ebola spread in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラウイルスへの対応における進展を称賛
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについて、WHOが一部地域での症例減少を評価する一方、治安悪化によりアクセス困難な地域への感染拡大が懸念されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: WHO Health Emergencies Programme責任者が治安悪化とアクセス困難地域への感染拡大リスクを警告しており、継続的な監視と国際支援が必要とされる状況。

article.articleHeadline: Post-Pandemic Immunity Debt Reshaped Urban Influenza Transmission Dynamics,
article.articleSummary: Post-pandemic influenza transmission in Macau shows immunity debt–driven excess activity after relaxing COVID-19 NPIs, shaped by environmental decoupling from meteorology and mobility. Analyzing ~1.88 million Macau influenza tests (2010–2025) with meteorological data, air quality, and digital search patterns, alongside Hong Kong viral genomes and global surveillance metrics, the study attributes the excess to an immunity debt. Best-fit debt fraction: 42%; approximate Bayesian computation yields a posterior debt fraction of 58% (95% UI 32–77%). Susceptibility rose more among adults than children; vaccine coverage in high-risk groups did not decline, implicating uptake as not the primary driver. Time-varying models and convergent cross mapping reveal environmental decoupling: high host susceptibility weakened meteorological constraints, sustaining influenza A while suppressing influenza B. Travel-linked reintroductions from ports of entry spread to dense neighborhoods; digital search trends shifted to leading indicators. Conclusion: a durable post-pandemic regime shift necessitating adaptive, multi-source urban surveillance (Macau, Hong Kong).

triage.headline_ja: パンデミック後の免疫負債が都市部のインフルエンザ伝播動態を再構築:研究結果
triage.triage_reason: 学術研究論文であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する新規アウトブレイクではない。免疫負債に関する疫学的分析結果の報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマカオ・香港における季節性インフルエンザの疫学研究論文であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではなく学術的知見の紹介。トリアージ対象外のため地域検証はマカオ・香港を中国(1814991)として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 voltam a crescer no Brasil, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases are rising again in Brazil, according to Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: Brazil records rising SARI (severe acute respiratory infection) hospitalizations linked to COVID-19, though national incidence remains low, per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin released Nov 12, 2026. Increases are seen in the Central-South and Northeast regions, including São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Paraná, the Distrito Federal, and Bahia; Mato Grosso shows signs of slower growth. As of epidemiological week 44, no state has both an alert/risk level for SARI and a growth trend; Roraima and Mato Grosso were at alert but without a six-week rise. The bulletin emphasizes vaccination, advising full schedules and annual boosters for priority groups. Among detected respiratory viruses in the last four weeks, rhinovirus led at 49%, followed by SARS-CoV-2 (11.5%), RSV (8.9%), influenza A (4.3%), and influenza B (3.9%). Among deaths, rhinovirus 43.6%, SARS-CoV-2 26.9%, influenza B 10.3%, influenza A 7.7%, and RSV 2.6%.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新型コロナウイルス感染症の重症例が再び増加、Fiocruzが報告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19関連の重症急性呼吸器感染症（SARI）入院が一部地域で増加しているが、全国的な発生率は低く、警報レベルと増加傾向が重なる州はないため、季節性の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: Fiocruz InfoGripe速報に基づく定例サーベイランス情報。既知の季節性呼吸器病原体（ライノウイルス、SARS-CoV-2、RSV、インフルエンザA/B）の動向報告であり、新規性・異常性は低い。続報で全国的な増加傾向や重症度上昇が確認されれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أطباء بلا حدود تحذر من انتشار فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns of the spread of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues with over 11,000 confirmed cases, making it the second-worst recorded outbreak. It began in mid-May and is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no approved treatments or vaccines exist. Doctors Without Borders warns that transmission remains unchecked in some areas, including within hospitals, amid a weak health response and insufficient resources. Aid is not reaching the most affected people, with two health workers reportedly unpaid and untrained, fuel shortages hindering ambulance operations, and limited surveillance teams and essential supplies to safely manage suspected cases. These challenges hinder containment and raise ongoing transmission risk across affected regions as of November 13, 2026. Keywords: outbreak, vaccination, hospitalization, public health response.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がDRCで1万1千例超に拡大し、院内感染や医療体制の脆弱性により制御不能な状況にあるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認治療薬がないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、院内感染・医療資源不足・燃料不足等によりアウトブレイク制御が困難な状況。既に大規模流行（11,000例超）であり、史上2番目に大きい記録的流行とされている点からもフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DBD di Kota Malang Tembus 500 Kasus hingga Oktober 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever in Malang City Surpasses 500 Cases as of October 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue Fever in Malang City, East Java, Indonesia, has surpassed 500 confirmed cases as of October 2026, per the Malang City Health Office (Dinkes Kota Malang). Across January–September 2026, the dengue tally is about 500; November–December figures are not yet released. Historical data show 2024: 777 cases with 4 deaths; 2025: 715 cases with 5 deaths. Officials attribute the rise to the pancaroba—the transition from dry to rainy season—and heavy rainfall that can cause flooding and standing water, creating breeding sites for Aedes aegypti, the dengue virus vector. Authorities urge heightened vigilance now to prevent a larger surge during February–March, the typical peak. The health office also notes awareness of environment-related risks during the rainy season, including pests like flies that may affect gastrointestinal health.

triage.headline_ja: マラン市のデング熱、2026年10月までに500件突破
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・マラン市における季節性デング熱の増加で、例年と同程度の規模であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、2-3月のピークに向けた動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 過去数年（2024年777件・死亡4名、2025年715件・死亡5名）と比較して2026年は現時点で同程度の水準であり、顕著な異常増加は確認されていない。雨季のピーク（2-3月）に向けた継続的な発生動向の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 外遊期間與男子敦倫　34歲漢染猴痘需隔離
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sex with a man during an overseas trip; 34-year-old man contracts monkeypox and needs isolation.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox case in Hong Kong: A 34-year-old man returning from overseas developed fever, fatigue, and a skin rash starting on his arms on November 9, 2026, with the rash spreading to the genitals, abdomen and chest. He sought care at Queen Elizabeth Hospital on November 11 and is in isolation; his condition is stable. Laboratory testing by the Centre for Health Protection's Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox. The case is imported; health authorities are conducting epidemiological investigations and will report to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 120 monkeypox cases: 94 locally acquired, 26 imported, all male. From August 2026, 27 local cases reported high-risk sexual activity during incubation, including sex with stranger men or multiple partners without condoms; most had not received monkeypox vaccination. Some patients used dating apps, and contact tracing was hampered when new partners could not be reached.

triage.headline_ja: 海外渡航中に男性と性交渉、34歳男性が猴痘に感染し隔離へ
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入例の単発mpox症例であり、容体は安定・隔離対応済みで重篤性は低いが、性的接触によるヒト-ヒト感染が継続している地域的背景があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2022年以降、香港では120例のmpox症例（うち94例が地域内感染）が報告されており、特に2026年8月以降は高リスク性行動を伴う地域感染が継続している。本件は単発の輸入症例で重症度は低いが、地域内での性的接触を介した感染拡大の継続的リスクを示す背景情報として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: L'UNICEF salue les progrès de la riposte contre Ebola et réaffirme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF hails progress in the Ebola response and reaffirms.
article.articleSummary: During a visit to Bunia, UNICEF's Associate Director for Health Emergencies, Dr. Douglas Noble, commended progress in combating the seventeenth Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri region. After meeting military governor General Gaby Kasongo Mulumba, Noble emphasised continued collaboration with Congolese authorities to eradicate the outbreak. UNICEF support spans hygiene installations in schools and rural areas, specialized training, and prevention-kit distribution, with logistics delivering to Bunia substantial supplies including more than half a billion metric tons of PPE and medical equipment. The agency has trained over 1,000 community health actors to boost household risk-communication, enhanced active case finding, and ensured drinking-water access in health facilities and schools. Noble reaffirmed UNICEF's commitment to supporting efforts until the outbreak is fully extinguished in the region.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF、エボラ対応の進展を称賛し支援継続を再確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州における第17次エボラ流行対応の進捗報告であり新規感染拡大の情報はないが、エボラという重篤感染症であり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中アウトブレイク（第17次）に関する国際支援の進捗報告。新規症例数や終息見込みなど続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UN hails progress in Ebola response, cites insecurity as biggest challenge
article.articleSummary: By 13 November 2026, six months after the outbreak was flagged in mid-May, confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 11,000, making it the second-worst outbreak on record. The epidemic is driven by the Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines, and has spread across eastern, central, and western Congo. Cases are now appearing in more rural, hard-to-reach areas, complicating response. Insecurity is the biggest current obstacle, with about 80 attacks on health sites and workers. Médecins Sans Frontières says supplies are missing and the virus is still spreading out of control, while UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis notes the operation covers a vast area but is able to operate about 80% of the time. Bunia in eastern DRC previously served as a hotspot.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ対応の進展を称賛するも治安悪化を最大の課題として指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス、ワクチン・治療薬未承認）がコンゴ民主共和国東部・中部・西部に拡大し、確認症例が1万1000人を超え史上2番目の規模となっており、治安悪化による対応困難も深刻であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のブンディブギョウイルス株による大規模流行であり、治安悪化と医療従事者への攻撃により対応が著しく困難化している。国際的な注視と支援継続が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : L'aéroport de Bunia maintenu fermé aux vols commerciaux face à la persistance de l'épidémie d'Ebola en Ituri - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Bunia Airport Remains Closed to Commercial Flights Amid Persistent Ebola Outbreak in Ituri - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, persists with Bunia airport closed to commercial flights until February 8, 2027, reserved for humanitarian rotations since May 23. Ituri accounts for nearly 70% of all cases and over two-thirds of deaths. Border controls include temperature checks, thermal cameras, and rigorous medical testing overseen by the hygiene service, but the strategy faces local opposition, with politicians such as Luc Malembe criticizing geographic fairness and economic impact while not fully halting viral movement to enclaves. Community resistance and rural fatalities continue to strain the response. Public health experts warn that preserving essential supply chains while preventing regional spread is highly complex. Reopening will depend on a clear reversal in the outbreak’s trajectory in the epicenter and the ability of medical teams to bend the curve.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：イツリ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が続く中、ブニア空港は商業便に対し閉鎖継続
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、空港閉鎖など渡航制限措置が取られていること、症例・死亡者数が多いことからIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: イツリ州が全症例の約70%、死亡者の3分の2以上を占めており、空港閉鎖が2027年2月まで継続予定。地域住民の抵抗や政治的批判もあり、社会的関心が高い事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 11,000 at 6-month mark, challenges remain: Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: As of Nov. 13, 2026, six months since the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak began, Africa CDC reports 11,145 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,437 deaths (48.8% CFR), with 3,058 recoveries, across multiple countries. The Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the epicenter, facing rising community transmission, insecurity, and health worker infections that hinder response. Only about 11% of new cases are linked to known contacts, far below the 95% target, underscoring gaps in contact tracing amid conflict. Kenya, from its first imported case on Oct. 6, has 9 cases and 2 deaths; the last patient was discharged Oct. 19 after 21‑day monitoring of 11 contacts. Nigeria reports 62 contacts identified; 59 completed monitoring, 3 ongoing. Other high‑risk nations include South Sudan, Rwanda, and Tanzania. May 18, 2026 continental security emergency; May 19, 2026 WHO PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、発生6カ月で症例数1万1000人超、課題なお残る：アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、コンゴ民主共和国を中心に複数国へ拡大し、致死率約49%と深刻。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスーダン、ルワンダ、タンザニア、ケニア、ナイジェリアも含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはコンゴ民主共和国のみ。既にWHO PHEIC宣言済みのため、フルリスク評価の継続的更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- El brote de ébola en RDC roza las barreras de los 11.200...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo - The Ebola outbreak in DR Congo nears the 11,200 mark.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared just under six months ago, is approaching 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths, the deadliest in the country’s history and potentially the most lethal globally. The National Institute of Public Health (INSP) reports 11,197 cases and 5,471 deaths, including 83 new cases and 38 deaths in the last 24 hours, for a case-fatality rate of 48.9%. There are 1,676 people hospitalized or in isolation, and 3,045 have recovered. Contact tracing stands at 80.9%. The outbreak spans eight provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter, accounting for 69.3% of cases; other affected areas include North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Ubangi North, and Ubangi South. Response is hampered by insecurity and resource shortages.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - エボラ出血熱の発生が11,200例に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、死者5,500人規模の大規模エボラ流行であり、複数州に拡大し治安・資源不足で対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最大級・最も致死率の高いエボラ流行の一つとされ、8州に拡大、治安悪化により対応が困難。国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 14個月大女童早前染甲流　延至今日不治　屬今年第三宗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 14-month-old girl who previously contracted H1N1 influenza has died today, the third death this year.
article.articleSummary: An unvaccinated 14-month-old girl in Hong Kong died on 13 November 2026 from influenza A (H1) infection, marking the territory’s third pediatric influenza death this year. She developed fever and cough on 26 October, then had a seizure and was rushed to Tseung Kwan O Hospital, later transferred to United Christian Hospital for admission. She required intensive care in the pediatric ICU, and her condition deteriorated to acute necrotizing encephalopathy with multi-organ failure. Laboratory tests confirmed influenza A (H1) virus infection. Preliminary investigation found no travel during the incubation period; she had not received the seasonal flu vaccine. A household contact had mild upper respiratory symptoms recently but did not require hospitalization. Since late June, Hong Kong’s flu season has persisted, with 29 pediatric severe influenza cases: 22 recovered, 2 stable, 2 critical, and 3 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 甲型インフルエンザに感染していた14か月齢の女児が本日死亡、今年3人目の死亡例
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児重症・死亡例であり、香港では例年見られる現象だが、今シーズンの重症/死亡例の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1)による小児死亡例で、今年3例目。香港の季節性流行は6月末以降継続しており、重症小児例29例（回復22、安定2、重症2、死亡3）。渡航歴なし、未接種。通常の季節性流行パターンであり、特段の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められないが、流行状況の推移は継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Goma : six mois après le début de l'épidémie, MSF réclame efficacité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goma: six months after the outbreak began, MSF calls for effectiveness.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak response in Goma, Democratic Republic of Congo, MSF says efforts are insufficient despite substantial funding and calls for greater effectiveness and transparency in resource use. In a November 12 statement, MSF cites a persistent gap between announced funds and field reality, with frontline health structures facing major logistical and operational shortages: untrained or unpaid health workers, ambulances stranded for lack of fuel, and chronically weak epidemiological surveillance teams in affected zones. A large share of deaths still occurs within communities without prior care, while health centers in North Kivu and Haut-Uélé lack essential hygiene equipment, risking further transmission. MSF urges Congolese authorities and partners to tighten oversight of resource allocation so aid reaches the ground quickly, aiming to curb the outbreak and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: ゴマ：流行開始から6か月、MSFが対応の実効性を求める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ゴマで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについて、MSFが資金と現場対応のギャップ、衛生体制の不備、地域内未治療死亡の多さを指摘しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大・支援の必要性が認められるためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は既に6か月継続しており『異常/予想外』ではなく既知の進行中アウトブレイクとして評価。MSFは資金と現場対応の実効性・透明性向上を要求しており、流行制御のための外部支援強化の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox sob controle no Pará: estado registra dois casos em 2026 e garante doses finais de vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox under control in Pará: state records two cases in 2026 and secures the final vaccine doses.
article.articleSummary: Mpox remains under control in Pará, Brazil, with two confirmed cases in 2026 and no deaths reported to date. The cases are concentrated mainly in the Metropolitan Region of Belém, with no signs of a regional outbreak. The state’s vaccination campaign is targeted rather than mass, receiving 160 vaccine doses aimed at completing second-dose schedules for those who had first doses from December 2025 to March 2026, and prioritizing pre-exposure HIV prophylaxis (PrEP) users and Lacen-PA laboratory staff who handle viral samples. As new vaccine batches are negotiated at the national level, Pará maintains stability through ongoing surveillance. Public health guidance emphasizes case-avoidance of close contact when symptomatic, mask use, prompt medical evaluation for skin lesions or compatible symptoms, and strict hand hygiene to block transmission.

triage.headline_ja: パラ州でMpoxは管理下に：2026年に2例を記録、最終ワクチン接種分を確保
triage.triage_reason: 感染は管理下にあり死亡者もなく、地域的流行の兆候もないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・パラ州における局地的かつ管理下にあるMpox事例の報告であり、ワクチン供給状況の説明が中心。拡大や重症化の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Armed Unrest Hinders DR Congo Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: Armed unrest in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to hamper the Ebola response as attacks by armed groups, notably the Allied Democratic Forces, kill civilians and frontline workers and disrupt transmission-control efforts in Ituri and North Kivu. UN Ebola Response Coordinator Julien Harneis notes more people have been killed by ADF fighters than by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in recent days. WHO reports ongoing transmission, with about 400–500 new infections weekly, driven by cases in rural and hard-to-reach areas. Despite progress in hotspots such as Bunia, Mongbwalu, Rampara and Nizi (Ituri), violence complicates containment. Since May 2026, the outbreak in eastern DRC has become the largest yet, with over 11,000 confirmed cases and more than 5,000 deaths. WFP warns nearly 29 million people face acute food insecurity, with 30.3 million projected in crisis by Jan–Jun 2027, especially in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 武装紛争がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で過去最大規模のエボラ流行（11,000人超感染、5,000人超死亡）が継続し、週400-500人の新規感染と武装紛争による対応阻害があり、国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBangladesh（Rāmpāra, Rājshāhi）が含まれているが、これはBluedotの地名誤認識（Ituri州のRampara地区と混同）と考えられ、記事はDRCのみを対象としているため除外した。South Kivu Provinceも記事内で言及されているが同一国（DRC）としてまとめた。

article.articleHeadline: Trump Gutted USAID. Congo Pays the Price in an Ebola Epidemic
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus has killed about 5,400, the largest in the country, with first detection in Mongbwalu, Ituri province; earliest suspected case Apr 24 in Bunia. Lab confirmation on May 15. The epidemic spans eight provinces, with roughly 65% of new cases occurring in the community, indicating widespread undetected transmission. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected blood or bodily fluids or contaminated materials; zoonotic spillover from wildlife is possible. The outbreak has crossed borders to Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. Obstacles to containment include no effective vaccine for Bundibugyo virus, armed conflict in eastern Congo, weak healthcare infrastructure, and cuts to international health aid. The article links governance failures and U.S. funding cuts (USAID, CDC, WHO) to delayed response, unpaid frontline workers, and deaths in Kisangani, where about 65% of fatalities occurred outside treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権がUSAIDを解体、コンゴはエボラ流行でその代償を払う
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行が発生し、死者約5,400人、8州に拡大、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大に言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。有効なワクチンが存在しないブンディブギョウイルス株であること、武装紛争や国際援助削減が対応を妨げている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC roza las barreras de los 11.200 casos y los 5.500 muertos en poco menos de seis meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC nears the 11,200-case and 5,500-death threshold in just under six months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo nears 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths after just under six months, the deadliest in the country’s history and potentially the most lethal globally. The National Public Health Institute (INSP) reports 11,197 cases and 5,471 deaths to date, including 83 new infections and 38 deaths in the last 24 hours, for a case-fatality rate of 48.9%. Currently, 1,676 people are hospitalized or in isolation, and 3,045 have recovered. Contact tracing stands at 80.9% amid a response hampered by insecurity and resource shortages. Ituri remains the epicenter, with 69.3% of cases, among eight affected provinces: North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Nord-Uele, Nord-Ubangi, and Sud-Ubangi (Ituri plus the others).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、約6ヶ月弱で症例数1万1200件、死者数5500人に迫る
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.9%、死者5471人という極めて深刻な公衆衛生インパクトを有し、8州に拡大するエボラ出血熱の大規模流行であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行で、治安悪化・資源不足により対応が困難化しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。接触者追跡率80.9%だが感染拡大は継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa manda retirar lote de muçarela após detectar bactéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa orders recall of mozzarella batch after detecting bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's health regulator Anvisa ordered the recall of lot 180926 of Italy-sliced mozzarella, produced by Agroindústria Santo Anjo Ltda, after tests identified Listeria monocytogenes in a 25-gram sample (Test Report 56058/2026). The recall, published Nov 12, 2026 in the Diário Oficial da União, bans sale, distribution, advertising, and consumption of the affected units. The manufacturer initiated a voluntary recall and is investigating the contamination source, informing customers and establishments to suspend sales and return the lot; the measure is limited to this batch and not a general ban on Italy mozzarella or other products. Listeria monocytogenes can cause listeriosis, with fever, muscle pains, nausea, and diarrhea; severe outcomes include meningitis and sepsis, particularly in pregnant individuals, newborns, the elderly, and the immunocompromised. Consumers should check packaging for lot 180926, avoid the product, and seek medical care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: アンヴィザ、細菌検出によりモッツァレラチーズのロットを回収命令
triage.triage_reason: 単一ロットの製品回収事例であり、人感染の拡大や公衆衛生上の重大な脅威を示す情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: イタリア産モッツァレラチーズの一ロットに限定された自主回収事例。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例報告や感染拡大の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño, mosquitos y baja percepción del riesgo: especialistas llaman a anticipar la prevención del dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño, mosquitoes and low risk perception: specialists urge proactive dengue prevention.
article.articleSummary: El Niño is consolidated with near-certain persistence through February 2027 and expected to reach very strong intensity by year-end, potentially altering temperatures and precipitation and increasing extreme-weather risk. In northern Argentina, Uruguay, and southern Brazil, above-average rainfall and flood risk are anticipated. Dengue transmission is linked to climate trends that shape mosquito habitats; Aedes aegypti, urban-adapted, breeds in water-filled containers around homes. Warmer temperatures speed mosquito development (egg-to-adult in 7–10 days); both heavy rains and drought can create new breeding sites. Argentina experienced its largest dengue outbreak in 2024, with more than half a million cases. Infected travelers can carry the virus in blood, risking local transmission if competent mosquitoes and favorable conditions exist. Prevention combines eliminating breeding sites, covering water storage, using repellents, sustaining surveillance, and seeking early care; vaccination is used where indicated. Dengue has four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); prior infection is serotype-specific and a risk factor for severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ、蚊、そして低いリスク認識：専門家らがデング熱予防の前倒しを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動（エルニーニョ）によるデング熱媒介蚊の生息環境拡大への懸念を示す予防啓発的な記事であり、現時点で具体的な新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はエルニーニョ現象による気候変動がデング熱媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）の生息環境に与える影響についての予防啓発記事。アルゼンチンの2024年の過去の大流行（50万人超）に言及しているが、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。対象国リストに含まれるウルグアイ・アルゼンチンは対象外のためverified_locationsから除外し、ブラジル南部への言及のみ該当国として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: São José da Lapa, na Grande BH, suspende aulas por causa de casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São José da Lapa, in the Greater Belo Horizonte area, suspends classes due to cases of scabies.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreaks in the Greater Belo Horizonte area prompted school closures in São José da Lapa and Vespasiano. On 13 November 2026, São José da Lapa suspended classes across all municipal schools and child-education facilities (Cemeis), plus sites including NAPE, Educarte and Bombeiro Mirim, for sanitation; classes are to resume on 16 November. In Vespasiano, closures were issued on 12 November 2026 and run through 17 November, after confirmed cases in five municipal schools and one state school. Scabies is a skin disease caused by a mite; the main symptom is intense itching, sometimes with skin lesions. Transmission occurs mainly through prolonged direct contact and, at times, via shared towels, clothes or objects. Authorities are disinfecting schools and reinforcing health measures; parents are advised to monitor for symptoms and seek medical evaluation if skin changes or persistent itching appear. Treatments exist; health officials urge following guidance and avoiding unverified information.

triage.headline_ja: ベロオリゾンテ都市圏のサンジョゼ・ダ・ラパ、疥癬感染拡大により休校
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度が低く治療法も確立された一般的な皮膚疾患であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当せず、国際的関心も低いため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 疥癬はブラジル国内の学校単位での局所的な衛生対応事案であり、対象国リスト（Brazilは含まれるが、本件のような軽微な皮膚疾患アウトブレイクはトリアージ対象外と判断）。地域は学校の衛生管理で対応可能なレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Krankheiten: Ebola breitet sich im Kongo in ländliche Gebiete aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diseases: Ebola spreads to rural areas in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, cases are falling in the original districts but rising in remote, hard-to-reach areas where access is blocked by fighting. In Bunia, treatment centers are intermittently underutilized (beds about half full). Security hindrances impede deploying new centers and scaling response; WHO aims to move faster to reach affected people. UN OCHA Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis warns violence by armed groups, notably the ADF, is killing more civilians than Ebola in recent days. Last week, an ADF attack killed 66 civilians, including three health workers; Africa CDC reports three health facilities looted and burned. More than 1,000 contact persons are out of reach, and three confirmed Ebola cases are untraceable after fleeing treatment centers. Ongoing rural outbreaks require urgent access and protective measures.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病:エボラがコンゴで農村部に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が6ヶ月継続中で、武装勢力の攻撃により対応が妨げられ、1000人以上の接触者が追跡不能、感染者も行方不明となっており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大・管理不能のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 武装勢力（ADF）による攻撃で保健従事者・医療施設が被害を受け、接触者追跡や治療センターへのアクセスが著しく困難になっている点がリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 14個月大女嬰染甲流併發多重器官衰竭　延至今日不治 (19:19) - 20261113
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14-month-old girl infected with influenza A develops multiple organ failure, succumbs today (19:19) - 20261113
article.articleSummary: A 14‑month‑old girl in Hong Kong died from influenza A (H1), marking the year’s third pediatric influenza death as of 13 November 2026. The Centre for Health Protection said the child developed fever and cough on October 26, then had a seizure on October 27 and was treated in the Paediatric Intensive Care Unit at United Christian Hospital. Respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A (H1); clinical diagnosis was influenza A with acute necrotizing encephalopathy and multi‑organ failure. She had not received the seasonal influenza vaccine. Hong Kong remains in the influenza season, with activity above baseline despite a recent decline. The centre urged all individuals aged six months and older, unless contraindicated, to receive the seasonal flu vaccine promptly. The case underscores severe influenza outcomes in very young children during ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 生後14カ月の女児がインフルエンザA型に感染し多臓器不全を発症、本日死亡（19:19）- 2026年11月13日
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による小児重症死亡例だが、既知の季節性株であり異常性・国際的拡大の兆候はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港での季節性インフルエンザ流行期における小児死亡例（今年3例目）。既知のH1N1株であり、新規性・異常性は認められないが、重症度と季節性流行の継続状況から引き続き動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Butembo: les prestataires de la riposte à Ebola en grève appelés au dialogue - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butembo: Ebola response providers on strike urged to engage in dialogue.
article.articleSummary: An appeal for dialogue was issued Friday to Ebola response workers on strike in Butembo, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, on 13 November 2026. Ebola Response Provincial Coordinator Dr. Celestin Mwanzembe urged the strikers to contact the coordination to explain their grievances and explore provincial solutions, with escalation to national level if needed, emphasizing the sanctity of life and humanitarian care in patient management. The call is directed at health workers in the Butembo, Katwa, and Musienene health zones, including nurses, hygienists, transit-center supervisors, and staff in infection prevention and control (IPC) and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH). He warned that the strike could seriously affect care for Ebola patients at Treatment Centers and for those in isolation, risking preventable deaths. The protesters seek formal employment contracts and higher risk allowances, pointing to disparities among categories; dialogue is urged to resolve the dispute.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボ:エボラ対応従事者のストライキ、対話を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ対応従事者によるストライキが患者ケアの中断と予防可能な死亡リスクを招く恐れがあり、公衆衛生上深刻な影響が懸念されるため。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規エボラ発生情報ではなく、既存の北キヴ州エボラ対応における医療従事者ストライキに関する報道。ストライキが患者管理・隔離対応に重大な支障をきたす可能性があり、対応体制の脆弱化という観点からフルリスク評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: إشادة دولية بالتقدم المحرز في مكافحة إيبولا وتحذيرات من مخاطر أمنية بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International praise for the progress made in the fight against Ebola and warnings of security risks in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, UN health officials praise notable progress against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with tangible gains in containing the outbreak despite significant field challenges. They warn transmission persists in areas deemed more dangerous and hard to reach, where insecurity hampers delivery of medical aid and vaccines to local populations, threatening final elimination of remaining foci in remote regions. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of the WHO Health Emergencies Programme, stated teams are already registering encouraging signs across multiple fronts and emphasized the need for continued international support to prevent a rebound to previous levels.

triage.headline_ja: 国連保健当局、コンゴのエボラ対策進展を称賛も治安面のリスクに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対応進展を評価しつつ、治安悪化地域での感染継続と国際支援の必要性を強調しており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（重症度・流行継続・管理可能性）の双方で該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中のエボラ対応の進捗報告であり、新規発生ではないが、治安悪化によるワクチン接種・医療支援の遅延が懸念材料として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentam casos de síndrome respiratória aguda por covid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of acute respiratory syndrome caused by COVID are increasing.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports an uptick in confirmed severe acute respiratory syndrome due to COVID-19 at the start of November, per Fiocruz Infogripe, using Sivep-Gripe data up to November 7. Nevertheless, severe COVID-19 cases remain at low levels. In the past four weeks, SARS-CoV-2 caused 11.5% of viral SRAG hospitalizations and 26.9% of SRAG deaths. Vaccination remains essential: annual doses for priority groups, with boosters every six months for the elderly and immunocompromised. Regionally, SRAG-COVID is rising in Bahia, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná and the Federal District. Four capitals—Boa Vista, João Pessoa, Porto Velho, and Rio de Janeiro—show risk trends, with increases mainly in under-4s in the first three and higher burden among 65+ in Rio. Aracaju, Brasília, Cuiabá and Florianópolis are at alert but without sustained growth. Agência Brasil published the original report on 12 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: COVIDによる急性呼吸器症候群の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19による重症急性呼吸器症候群はブラジル国内で一部上昇傾向にあるが、全体の重症例は低水準にとどまり、既知の疾病・季節的変動の範囲内であり新規性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19）による地域的な季節性動向の報告であり、重症例は低水準。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本イベントはルーチンのサーベイランス報告でシグナルとしての新規性に乏しいためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya begins 42-day countdown to ebola-free status after last patient is discharged
article.articleSummary: Kenya began a 42-day countdown toward being declared Ebola-free after the last Bundibugyo virus disease patient was discharged in Nairobi, with 11 people released from quarantine. If no new cases occur by 23 December 2026, Kenya could be declared free; the period doubles the virus’s longest known incubation. Kenya’s first case was confirmed on 6 October; a Kenyan man who had travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda, arriving in Nairobi by air on 3 October, and who later died in a Nairobi hospital. Contact tracing identified 135 close contacts in Kenya and abroad. Eight more people tested positive—four family members and four health workers who had cared for him before Ebola was suspected—yet the virus did not spread beyond the cluster. Kenya recorded nine cases in total; seven recovered, two died, with the last case confirmed on 19 October and no new cases since. WHO urged continued surveillance, screening, and lab preparedness; Duale stressed that the countdown is not the end of the response, with rapid-response teams on alert and ongoing survivor follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最後の患者退院後エボラ終息宣言に向け42日間のカウントダウンを開始
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクは既に収束傾向にあり新規症例もないが、42日間の監視期間が続いているため、終息宣言までは経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 指標国リストに含まれるDRC・ウガンダは感染者の渡航経路として言及されているのみで、実際の発症・感染拡大はケニア国内で発生しており、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola avança no Congo e Estado Islâmico ameaça combate ao surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola advances in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Islamic State threatens to combat the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the town of Biakato at the epicenter in a region troubled by rebel violence. Biakato previously accounted for up to a quarter of the country’s new cases. The outbreak, first detected in May 2026, has now affected eight provinces, with health workers able to control transmission only where the virus was identified initially, while cases rise elsewhere. Local health campaigns face growing challenges as the response competes with a new threat: the Islamic State reportedly plans to combat the outbreak. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, head of the National Biomedical Research Institute of Congo, criticizes the response, saying we see the same mistakes as before; it is like starting from zero, despite his role in identifying Ebola in 1976. The New York Times reports the situation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大、イスラム国が流行対応を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が8州に拡大し感染拡大傾向にあること、紛争地域での対応困難、専門家による対応失敗への批判があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に発生が確認されたエボラ流行が8州に拡大、紛争地域(武装勢力・イスラム国関連の脅威)により対応が困難化。国立生物医学研究所長が「過去と同じ過ちを繰り返している」と対応の不備を批判しており、国際支援の必要性が高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 刘欢死因首次公开：感染性休克，与膀胱癌缠斗十几年，膀胱癌有多凶险？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Liu Huan's cause of death revealed for the first time: septic shock, after more than a decade battling bladder cancer — how dangerous is bladder cancer?
article.articleSummary: Liu Huan, a noted musician, died on September 25, 2026, from septic (infectious) shock after a prolonged battle with bladder cancer. Diagnosed in 2012, he experienced a recurrence in 2017 and refused radical cystectomy to keep his bladder, continuing treatment for nearly a decade. By late 2025, cancer had metastasized, and in 2026 he underwent multiple lines of therapy in Shanghai, including Enfortumab Vedotin plus Pembrolizumab (an antibody-drug conjugate with a PD-1 inhibitor). Lung metastases briefly shrank, but he developed severe enteritis and infection leading to septic shock. He was laid to rest in Beijing near the Great Wall; his wife Lu Lu released a public letter. The article notes bladder cancer’s high recurrence and progression risk, with smoking and aromatic amine exposure as major risk factors, and emphasizes painless hematuria as a key symptom and the role of surveillance and possible cystectomy for high-risk cases.

triage.headline_ja: 劉歓氏の死因が初公開：敗血症性ショック、十数年にわたる膀胱がんとの闘病、膀胱がんはどれほど危険か？
triage.triage_reason: 個人の闘病・死去に関する記事であり、感染症の集団発生や公衆衛生上のリスクを示す内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は著名音楽家の個人的な闘病・死去に関する内容で、敗血症性ショックはがん治療の合併症として発生したものであり、感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 14個月BB女染甲型流感不治 26年第3宗兒童流感死亡個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14-month-old baby girl dies after contracting Influenza A; the third pediatric influenza death case of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a 14-month-old girl who died after contracting Influenza A, the third pediatric influenza death in 2026. She developed fever and cough in late October, then seizures, was treated at Tseung Kwan O Hospital Emergency Department, later transferred to United Christian Hospital for inpatient care, and died on November 13, 2026. The influenza season began in late June and has persisted for over four months, with activity still above baseline despite a recent decline. To date, 29 pediatric severe influenza cases have been recorded this season: 22 recovered/discharged, 2 stable, 2 critical, and 3 deaths. The Centre for Health Protection urges vaccination; pregnant women should receive the influenza vaccine, as maternal antibodies cross the placenta and can protect the fetus. Eligible pregnant individuals can obtain government-funded or subsidized vaccination through family doctors and public or private antenatal clinics; details are on the Vaccine Subsidy Program site and the centre’s pages.

triage.headline_ja: 14ヶ月の女児がA型インフルエンザに感染し死亡、2026年3例目の小児インフルエンザ死亡例
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの重症化・死亡例であり、香港域内で小児死亡が継続しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等のIHR基準には該当せず、通常の季節性流行の枠内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児重症・死亡例の報告。香港特別行政区の事例であり、中国本土のCEPR対象国IDに含める。流行は4ヶ月以上継続し活動レベルは基準値以上だが減少傾向。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تشيد بالتقدم في مكافحة إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations commends progress in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Six months after the outbreak began in May, Ebola has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases, making it the second-worst outbreak of the disease to date. The transmission is occurring in eastern, central, and western Africa, with the rare Bundibugyo strain. No approved treatments or vaccines exist. WHO notes encouraging signs with declines in hotspots such as Bunia in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, but new cases are appearing in more rural, hard-to-reach areas; security issues hinder response, with at least 80 attacks on health sites and workers. MSF remains pessimistic about progress, citing limited supplies and ongoing, uncontrolled spread. UN Ebola Coordinator Julian Harneis says the operation area is vast, but responders can work about 80% of the time across the region.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ対策の進展を称賛
triage.triage_reason: 確認症例が11,000人を超え史上2番目に大きい規模のエボラ流行であり、治療薬・ワクチンが未承認、治安悪化により対応が困難という複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は『東部・中部・西部アフリカ』での伝播に言及しているが、具体的な発生地名（Bunia）はDRC国内であり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。治療薬・ワクチン未承認との記述は実際のエボラ対応状況と齟齬がある可能性があり、事実確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich in ländliche Gebiete im Kongo aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to rural areas in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the WHO warns that the disease is spreading to rural areas, even as cases decline in the original zones and Bunia treatment centers run at about half capacity. In remote regions, infections are rising; progress is fragile and access is hampered by a precarious security situation that complicates building new treatment centers. UN OCHA Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis and WHO emphasize the need for faster, more agile responses amid intensifying violence by the ADF Islamist militia. Last week, the attack killed 66 civilians, including three health workers. Africa CDC reports three health facilities looted and burned. More than 1,000 contacts are out of follow-up; three confirmed Ebola cases are untraceable after fleeing treatment centers, undermining surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ農村部へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が6か月継続し農村部へ拡大、治安悪化により1000人超の接触者が追跡不能となるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき案件。
triage.notes: ADF武装勢力による治安悪化が医療従事者殺害・施設焼失・接触者追跡不能を招いており、サーベイランス機能の崩壊リスクが高い。国境を越えた拡大の可能性についても注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich im Kongo in ländliche Gebiete aus - Chronik | stol.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads into rural areas in the Congo - Chronicle | stol.it
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading into rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo as responders warn that the outbreak is outpacing control efforts due to a volatile security situation. In Bunia, Ebola coordinator says progress is fragile and reaching remote regions is difficult; building new treatment centers is hindered by ongoing clashes among militias. UN OCHA's Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis cautions that violence claims more lives than Ebola in recent days. The ADF Islamist militant group threatens the response. In the last week, 66 civilians were killed, including three health workers; Africa CDC reports three health facilities looted and burned. Surveillance is collapsing: more than 1,000 contact persons are out of reach, and three confirmed Ebola cases are untraceable after fleeing from treatment centers. Attacks on health workers and frontline forces keep the virus ahead of response measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが農村部に拡大 - クロニクル | stol.it
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの農村部に拡大し、治安悪化により対応が追いつかず、1,000人超の接触者が追跡不能・感染者も行方不明となっており、国際的拡大・管理困難性の観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による攻撃と治安悪化がサーベイランス・治療活動を妨げており、接触者追跡が機能不全に陥っている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 34歲男子感染猴痘　潛伏期內離港期間與其他男子有高風險性接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 34-year-old man infected with monkeypox had high-risk sexual contact with another man during the incubation period while he was out of Hong Kong
article.articleSummary: Imported monkeypox case in Hong Kong: a 34-year-old man developed fever, fatigue, and a rash that spread to multiple body sites after overseas travel. He presented to the Queen Elizabeth Hospital emergency department and was admitted for isolation; his condition is stable. Testing by the Centre for Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox virus infection. Epidemiological investigation shows the patient had high-risk sexual contact with another man during the incubation period while outside Hong Kong. Ongoing contact tracing and reporting to the World Health Organization are in progress. Authorities urge high-risk groups to consider monkeypox vaccination and advise the public to avoid close physical contact with suspected cases, as of 13 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 34歳男性が猴痘(サル痘)に感染　潜伏期間中に香港を離れていた際に他の男性と高リスクの性的接触があった
triage.triage_reason: 香港における単発の輸入サル痘症例であり、重症度は安定、クラスターや二次感染の証拠は現時点でないが、続報・接触者調査結果を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例はChina(1814991)に含める。単発の輸入症例で、感染経路は海外での性的接触と特定されており、現地での二次感染拡大の報告はない。WHOへの報告が進行中とのことで、続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: XFG: Entenda a variante da Covid-19 que causa alta de casos no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: XFG: Understand the COVID-19 variant causing a surge in cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Brazil is driven by the Omicron subvariant XFG, first detected January 2025 and now predominant. A 2026 health surveillance report records 127 SARS-CoV-2 lineages, with XFG and its descendants representing about 88% of sequencing; regional distribution is similar across Brazil, though state-level details aren’t provided. In Mato Grosso do Sul, the trend is declining while national cases rise; by epidemiological week 44 (through Nov 7), MS had 61 of the country’s 3,641 severe COVID-19 cases and 12 of 445 deaths. Including mild cases, Brazil totals 118,920 infections in 2026. XFG is more transmissible but there is no evidence of greater severity or mortality. Main symptoms are sore throat, nasal congestion, hoarseness, and low-grade fever, with loss of smell/taste less common but possible. Vaccination remains essential, with Campo Grande reporting 84.5% two-dose, 53% three-dose, and 20% four-dose coverage; vaccines are available year-round at all USFs.

triage.headline_ja: XFG：ブラジルで感染増加を引き起こしているCOVID-19変異株を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 既に2025年1月から確認され優勢となっているXFG変異株に関する定例サーベイランス報告であり、重症度や死亡率の増加の証拠はなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: XFGはより伝播力が高いが重症度・死亡率の増加は確認されていない。ワクチン接種率も報告されており、既存の公衆衛生対応で管理可能な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Streit um die "Hoffnung" in der Ebola-Epidemie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dispute over the "Hope" in the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: WHO is testing three vaccines against Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an outbreak. The Tumaini platform, launched in late October and led by Kinshasa’s INRB with the University of Antwerp, uses Merck’s Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) as the lead. The Phase 2/3 study allocates about 20,000 Ervebo doses to evaluate safety, dosing, and efficacy in contacts of infected individuals. Design: one group receives an immediate dose; controls get a placebo; all participants receive Ervebo on day 29. First results aren’t expected before early 2027. Ituri, with over four million people across 66 health centers, spans eight provinces with dozens of outbreaks. MSF’s BRAVO vaccinates up to 20,000 health workers to assess protection. WHO warns mass vaccination could overwhelm the health system and boost hesitancy; 50,000 doses are reserved for medical staff outside the trial. Merck should release doses to a global stockpile; wealthy nations should avoid hoarding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行における「希望」をめぐる論争
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo種）流行に対するワクチン治験・大規模接種を巡る内容で、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的関心が高く、IHR・WPRO両基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのIturi州等におけるエボラ（Bundibugyo種）流行とWHO/MSF/Merckによるワクチン治験・接種戦略を中心に報じている。Kinshasaは治験実施機関(INRB)の所在地であり発生地というより調整拠点。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil ultrapassa mil casos de mpox em 2026; Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo concentram 76% das infecções - Agência Aids
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil surpasses one thousand mpox cases in 2026; Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo account for 76% of infections - Agência Aids.
article.articleSummary: Brazil surpassed 1,000 mpox (monkeypox) cases in 2026, reaching 1,023 confirmed, 46 probable, and 581 under investigation, with one death. Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo together account for about 76% of confirmed infections; Ceará, Minas Gerais, the Federal District, and Santa Catarina comprise the remainder, collectively ~93% of diagnoses to date. The surge is concentrated in Oct–Nov 2026, with 293 and 227 cases respectively (520 in two months); national totals rose roughly 23% in six days, from 832 to 1,023. Since mpox notification began in 2022, Brazil has reported 15,455 cases and 19 deaths. The Health Ministry will purchase 25,000 mpox vaccine doses via PAHO, adding 5,000 to the prior plan, with a two-dose schedule 28 days apart. Vaccination prioritizes people with HIV/AIDS, significant immunosuppression, PrEP users, laboratory workers, and close contacts. Prevention focuses on avoiding contact with lesions, hand hygiene, and isolation when suspected or confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで2026年のエムポックス感染者数が1,000人を超える;リオデジャネイロとサンパウロが感染の76%を占める - Agência Aids
triage.triage_reason: 直近6日間で23%増という急激な症例増加があり、国際的に懸念されるエムポックスの地域流行拡大兆候が見られるためIHR基準を2項目満たす。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省はPAHO経由でワクチン2.5万回分を追加購入予定であり、HIV陽性者やPrEP利用者など免疫不全層への接種を優先。死亡率は低いが感染増加速度が急であり継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil ultrapassa mil casos confirmados de mpox em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil surpasses 1,000 confirmed mpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded 1,023 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, plus 46 probable, 581 suspected, and one death. Rio de Janeiro leads with 390 confirmed cases, followed by São Paulo with 388; Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), Distrito Federal (41), and Santa Catarina (24) also reported cases. November 2026 accounted for 227 confirmations; October 293; together these two months total 520 cases, over half of the year's total. Mpox is caused by MPXV, an Orthopoxvirus zoonosis, typically mild to moderate. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, body fluids, contaminated objects, or prolonged close contact with respiratory secretions. A vaccine exists; Brazil's Health Ministry recently purchased 25,000 doses to bolster immunization. Since notifications began, Brazil has documented 15,455 mpox cases and 19 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2026年のエムポックス確定症例が1,000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: 2026年に入りブラジルでのMpox確定症例が1,000件を超え、直近2か月（10-11月）で年間症例の半数以上を占める急増傾向が見られるため、経過確認が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は低い（1,023例中1死亡）が、10-11月の症例急増（年間症例の半数以上）と複数州への拡大が見られるため、流行拡大の兆候として経過観察が望ましい。ブラジル保健省はワクチン追加購入で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Tshwane residents urged to watch for malaria symptoms as Gauteng cases rise
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Gauteng, South Africa, prompts intensified alerts in Tshwane as cases rise. By end of September, Gauteng recorded 17 malaria deaths; 17 fatalities this year had travel histories to malaria-endemic areas. Mozambique accounted for 59% of the province’s malaria deaths. In 2025, Gauteng had 666 malaria cases and seven deaths; by September 2026, 768 cases and 17 deaths, a 38.6% year-on-year increase. Common symptoms include headaches, body aches, weakness, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Travel histories indicate imported risk, with 15 of 17 fatalities having travelled to Southern African Development Community (SADC) countries. Health authorities urge travellers to visit travel clinics and take precautions before and after travel; outreach at taxi ranks and bus stations targets high-risk travellers during holidays. La Niña-driven flooding has boosted regional malaria across DRC, Mozambique, Angola, Tanzania, Zimbabwe, Malawi, Zambia, Madagascar, Comoros, and parts of South Africa (Limpopo, Mpumalanga, KwaZulu-Natal), Namibia, Botswana.

triage.headline_ja: ツワネ住民、ハウテン州でのマラリア症例増加を受け症状への注意を呼びかけられる
triage.triage_reason: ハウテン州でのマラリア症例・死亡数が前年比38.6%増加し、保健当局が注意喚起を行っており、ラニーニャによる洪水で周辺国（ザンビア、DRC含む）にも感染拡大の兆候があるため、社会的・行政的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は南アフリカ（ハウテン州）のマラリア症例増加であるが、ラニーニャによる洪水が周辺SADC諸国（ザンビア、DRC等）でもマラリア増加を引き起こしていると明記されているため、対象国リストに該当する国を含めた。南アフリカ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich im Kongo in ländliche Gebiete aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads to rural areas in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has spread to rural areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The World Health Organization warns of a concerning expansion six months after the outbreak began, with cases in the original hotspots declining while rural transmission rises. In Bunia, treatment centers are now only about half full. The security situation remains precarious, hampered by attacks from the Islamist ADF militia. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO's UN humanitarian coordinator, spoke from Geneva, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance, secure access for health teams, and continued case management to prevent further transmission across rural provinces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国の農村部に拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエボラのコンゴ農村部への拡大を懸念と発表しており、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻性・異常性）とWPRO基準複数に該当するためフルRRAに進めるべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHO職員の発言拠点であり発生国ではないため除外した。アウトブレイク開始から6か月が経過し、治安情勢（ADFの襲撃）が対応を妨げている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: ONU elogia avanços na resposta ao Ebola e aponta insegurança como maior desafio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN praises advances in the Ebola response and cites insecurity as the biggest challenge.
article.articleSummary: Geneva, Nov 13 — The UN commended progress in the Ebola response six months after the outbreak sparked global concern, but cautioned that transmission is moving into more remote, dangerous areas of the Democratic Republic of Congo. Confirmed cases have surpassed 11,000, making this the second-worst Ebola outbreak on record, with spread across East, Central, and Western Africa. The outbreak, identified in mid‑May, is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. WHO official Chikwe Ihekweazu noted encouraging signs, including falling case numbers in traditional hotspots such as Bunia in eastern DRC, yet warned of new cases in rural, hard‑to‑reach areas. The principal hurdle is insecurity, with 80 attacks on health facilities and workers. MSF has warned of shortages and ongoing uncontrolled spread. UN Ebola envoy Julien Harneis emphasized the vast operational theater, stating that in about 80% of cases they can act.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ対応の進展を評価しつつ治安悪化を最大の課題と指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がすでに1万1000人を超える症例数で史上2番目の規模となっており、治安悪化により制御が困難になっているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はジュネーブ（UN本部）発だが、発生地域はDRC。承認済み治療薬・ワクチンがない希少株（ブンディブギョ株）であり、治安問題により保健従事者への攻撃が80件発生するなど対応が困難化している。東・中央・西アフリカへの拡大が言及されているが、DRC以外の対象国の具体名は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda, Rwanda drill together to stop Ebola at Katuna border
article.articleSummary: Uganda and Rwanda conducted a five-day cross-border Ebola preparedness and response field simulation at Katuna/Gatuna border posts to strengthen coordination, information sharing, and referral arrangements under the 'Prepare Together and Respond Together' strategy. The Ugandan delegation was led by Dr Charles Ayume; Rwanda's was represented by Prof Claude Mambo Muvunyi. The exercise, designed to bolster public health protection while supporting safe travel and cross-border trade, emphasized border management, community engagement, and rapid information exchange, including infrastructure needs such as thermal imaging and risk communication. Officials noted that reopening the DR Congo border hastily could cause disease spillover, given the border region lies about 20–30 km inside DRC and Ebola activity there. Separately, 10 Congolese nationals were intercepted entering Uganda via porous routes in Echuya National Park; Kabale’s health authority urged vigilance in Kigezi. The event aligns with ongoing DRC Ebola concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダとルワンダ、カトゥナ国境でエボラ対策合同訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ新規発生の報告ではなく、ウガンダ・ルワンダによる国境合同対応訓練についての記事だが、DRC側での継続的なエボラ活動や不法越境者の検知など、越境感染リスクを示唆する情報があり、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダ・ルワンダ間の国境合同訓練であり、DRCでのエボラ活動は背景情報として言及されているのみで、DRCが直接の発生地として主題化されていないためverified_locationsには含めなかった。ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Russia pandemic fears as tourists 'falling seriously ill' with mystery virus
article.articleSummary: Russia reports a second unexplained illness in two months linked to travelers returning from Vietnam, with dozens of tourists in Nha Trang falling severely ill. Affected individuals exhibit high fever, severe headaches, runny nose, and a heavy cough that can last weeks, while Vietnamese clinicians label the illness only as a circulating flu-like syndrome. No definitive diagnosis has been established. Rospotrebnadzor has sent formal requests to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia seeking urgent verification, with official test results expected from Hanoi. Russian officials and tourism bodies have sought to downplay the situation, citing no mass complaints and no citizens seeking consular help. Moscow physicians suggest the outbreak may reflect seasonal respiratory infections or common flu variants rather than a novel pathogen. The report follows a separate Coxsackie virus inquiry among Russian travelers in Vietnam last month; no confirmation of a link.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで謎のウイルスに『重症化』する観光客が相次ぎ、パンデミックへの懸念が浮上
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム（ニャチャン）から帰国したロシア人観光客数十人が原因不明の重症呼吸器症状を呈し、ロシア当局がベトナム保健省に公式な検証要請を行っている。異常性・国際的拡散の可能性・メディア及び当局の関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 症例の原因病原体は未確定で、ロシア・ベトナム双方の当局が検証中。コクサッキーウイルス感染疑いの過去事例との関連も不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تشيد بالتقدم في مكافحة إيبولا وتحذر من تبعات انعدام الأمن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations commends progress in the fight against Ebola and warns of the consequences of insecurity.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, marking the second-worst Ebola outbreak on record. The six-month-old outbreak began in mid-May and has spread across eastern, central, and western Africa, with Bunia in eastern DRC among early hotspots. Worsening security has pushed transmission into more rural, hard-to-reach areas, complicating control efforts amid 80 reported attacks on health facilities and workers. There are no approved therapies or vaccines for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. MSF warns supplies are scarce and the outbreak remains largely uncontrolled, while WHO’s Chikwe Ihekweazu notes signs of progress—yet the UN Ebola response coordinator Julian Harneys emphasizes the vast operational area and about 80% functional capacity due to security challenges as of 13 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ対策の進展を称賛しつつ治安悪化の影響に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）流行が11,000例を超え史上2番目の規模となり、治療薬・ワクチンが未承認で治安悪化により対応が困難な状況であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在しないBundibugyoエボラウイルスによる流行で、治安悪化により保健施設・従事者への攻撃が約80件発生し、対応能力が約80%に制限されている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Último foco de doença de Newcastle é encerrado após força-tarefa em granja de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Last Newcastle disease outbreak contained after task force at a Santa Catarina farm.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, has been contained. The fifth and final focus, a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, completed cleaning and disinfection on November 10, with the last sanitary barrier removed on November 11. All five affected properties are now in a sanitary empty period under international control protocols; Cidasc veterinarians continue epidemiological surveillance. Initial foci occurred in Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim, with the fourth also in Nova Erechim and the fifth in Nova Itaberaba. In two days, 55 teams inspected 462 bird-keeping properties: 39 commercial farms and 179 subsistence holdings on day 1; 20 commercial farms and 224 domestic on day 2. Newcastle is a viral avian disease not transmitted by meat or eggs; human risk is low. Bird movements require an Animal Transit Guide (GTA), and producers should keep Sigen+ updated.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場でのタスクフォース後、ニューカッスル病の最後の発生地が終息
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症(鳥類)であり、既に全発生地が終息・防疫措置完了している。ヒトへのリスクは低く、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限の懸念も記載なし。
triage.notes: 家禽のニューカッスル病で、記事時点で既に終息済み。ヒト感染リスクは低いと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : le centre de santé de référence de Kirumba fermé pour 21 jours après la détection de deux cas confirmés d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Kirumba Referral Health Center closed for 21 days after the detection of two confirmed cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Two new cases of Ebola Virus Disease have been recorded since 6 November at Kirumba Referral Health Center in Kayna Health Zone, Lubero Territory, North Kivu. In response, health authorities closed Kirumba for 21 days starting 13 November to curb transmission and protect staff and the community. The closure comes amid heightened vigilance as North Kivu battles an Ebola outbreak. The 2 confirmed cases add to surveillance, contact tracing, and infection prevention challenges for response teams. During the shutdown, patient care and continuity of services in Lubero may require special arrangements to avoid service disruption. Local actors urge strengthening prevention and infection-control measures, and increasing community awareness of signs and protection. Population is urged to adhere to hygiene measures and seek early care at health facilities to slow spread.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ確定症例2件検出後、キルンバ基幹保健センターが21日間閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は常にPHEIC相当の重大疾患であり、北キブ州での新規確定症例の発生とそれに伴う医療施設閉鎖は国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響を伴うため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応下での新規症例確認であり、継続的な監視とフルRRAでの進展確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna invade creches em MS - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies Invades Daycare Centers in Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: Human scabies outbreaks hit daycare centers in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with at least 70 people infected in Dourados and Itaporã. In Itaporã, 24 children were infected and the local daycare was closed for eight days; in Dourados, 40 cases prompted an indefinite suspension of classes. The mite infests the skin, causing intense itching and reproduction, and transmission occurs mainly through prolonged contact, as well as sharing clothing, towels, and bed linen. Experts stress that scabies is not a sign of dirt and not contracted from dogs. Prevention requires simultaneous treatment of close contacts and thorough cleaning of fabrics used recently. Merely closing a facility is insufficient; transmission must be interrupted to prevent the classroom from becoming a persistent reservoir.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬がMS州の保育施設に侵入
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬はヒト-ヒト接触で広がる一般的な皮膚疾患であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクともに低く、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は国内の限定的な保育施設クラスターであり、地域の衛生管理課題として対応可能。国際的な脅威とは見なされない。

article.articleHeadline: CHP investigates imported Mpox case
article.articleSummary: Imported Mpox case in Hong Kong: 34-year-old man developed fever, fatigue and a rash on November 9, with the rash spreading to arms, genital area, abdomen and chest. He was admitted for isolation at Queen Elizabeth Hospital on November 11; laboratory confirmation by CHP Public Health Laboratory Services Branch. He reported high-risk sexual contact with men abroad during incubation; epidemiological investigation ongoing and case to be reported to the WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has 120 Mpox cases (94 local, 26 imported), all male. Among 27 cases since August, all involved high-risk sexual activity, many with multiple partners and most unvaccinated. CHP expanded outreach via social media and dating apps; since late September, an additional vaccination centre at the CHP Building and government/NGO clinics have vaccinated over 1,000 high-risk individuals as of September 28. Two-dose vaccination reduces infection risk by 82% and decreases viral spread by 87% in local data. Mpox is not generally transmitted via respiratory droplets; avoid close contact with suspected cases. Hotline: 2125 2373 (9am–6pm).

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心、輸入Mpox症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入Mpox症例の定期的な公衆衛生報告であり、ハイリスク層での散発的感染が続いているが、ワクチン接種体制など既存の対応策で管理されており新規性・深刻性は低い。
triage.notes: 2022年以降の累計120例（うち94例が地域内感染）の一部であり、ハイリスク性行為・未接種者間での継続的な低レベル伝播が示唆されるが、CHPによるワクチン普及や啓発活動が奏功しており管理体制は確立されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS admite que avances en la lucha contra el ébola son "frágiles" tras 6 meses de brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO admits that progress in the fight against Ebola is "fragile" after six months of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains fragile and insufficient after six months, with over 11,000 cases and about 5,400 deaths. WHO notes progress but cites security concerns, reporting more than 80 attacks on facilities and health workers. Weekly new cases have fallen from a peak of 700–800 to about 400–500, a trend that has stabilized. Bunia, the main epicenter, still sees transmission but with fewer new cases and lower bed occupancy in treatment centers. Violence by armed groups in eastern and northern DRC impedes access, surveillance, and care, driving displacement. The UN has a $2.21 billion humanitarian plan; roughly $1.14 billion has been received. The outbreak was declared May 15 and an international emergency two days later. MSF criticized the response for a disconnect between resources mobilized and those reaching affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、6か月に及ぶエボラ流行における対策の進展は「脆弱」だと認める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは発生から6か月で1万1000人超の症例、約5400人の死者を出し、WHOが国際的緊急事態を宣言済みであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既にWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言済みの進行中アウトブレイク。治安悪化が対応の障害となっている点にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola/ONU salută progresele înregistrate în lupta împotriva virusului și declară insecuritatea cea mai mare provocare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/UN welcomes the progress made in the fight against the virus and declares that insecurity is the greatest challenge.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, Africa CDC data show 11,145 confirmed cases and 5,437 deaths (48.8% CFR), with about 3,058 recoveries. The epidemic, first signaled in mid-May, has spread to East, Central, and West Africa, though Bunia (eastern DRC) remains a focal area and new cases are appearing in rural, harder-to-reach zones, with 80 attacks on health facilities and staff. Kenya reported 9 imported cases and 2 deaths (first case Oct 6); last patient discharged Oct 19. Nigeria tracked 62 contacts; 59 completed monitoring; 3 remain under surveillance. Uganda reported cases earlier, but the WHO declared its outbreak over in August. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatments or vaccines; insecurity and resource constraints continue to hinder containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/国連、ウイルスとの闘いにおける進展を歓迎し、治安の悪化が最大の課題であると表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）流行は6か月で11,145症例・死亡5,437人（致死率48.8%）に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大や医療施設への攻撃など深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国連・アフリカCDCも注視している。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの波及も記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株には承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、治安悪化が封じ込めを妨げている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Armadilhas contra o mosquito da dengue serão instaladas nos 72 bairros de Belém
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Traps against the dengue mosquito will be installed in the 72 neighborhoods of Belém.
article.articleSummary: Belém, Brazil expands Aedes aegypti monitoring across 72 neighborhoods with 526 ovitraps in eight administrative districts. The Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesma) via the Dengue Control Program aims to detect the mosquito and quantify eggs laid by females to guide targeted control actions. Ovitraps are dark containers with water and yeast, housing a wooden paddle where eggs are deposited; after about a week, samples are collected for laboratory analysis. Results map areas with higher mosquito activity, directing house visits, removal of breeding sites, and resident education. Installation requires owner approval and placement in sun-protected spots away from children and pets. Public guidance calls for keeping water tanks covered, cleaning gutters, washing water-storage containers, and allocating at least ten minutes weekly to check properties to curb dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ベレンの72地区にデング熱蚊対策の罠が設置される
triage.triage_reason: 通常の媒介蚊監視・予防活動に関する行政広報であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ベレン市の蚊トラップ設置による予防的モニタリング活動を報じるもので、感染症の発生・流行自体を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Flu activity rises in China as multiple strains start circulating
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains—A(H3N2), A(H1N1), and influenza B—are circulating in China, with H1N1 infections rising, according to China CDC surveillance. For the week of Nov 2–8, the influenza-like illness (ILI) positivity rate at sentinel hospitals was the highest among respiratory diseases, followed by rhinoviruses. Flu activity is low but rising in northern provinces and moderate in southern provinces. Children aged 5–14 have the highest flu positivity among age groups. The surge aligns with a peak season from November to March. The China CDC urges prompt vaccination for infants and children, the elderly, people with chronic diseases, and personnel in schools, nursery care, elderly care homes, and hospitals, calling this the golden period for vaccination and noting that earlier vaccination provides better protection.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で複数のインフルエンザ株が流行し始め、インフルエンザ活動が上昇
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H3N2、H1N1、B型）の通常の流行シーズン（11月〜3月）における定例サーベイランス報告であり、新型株の出現や異常な事象は認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ株（H3N2、H1N1、B型）の通常のサーベイランス報告。中国CDCがワクチン接種を呼びかけているが、これは毎年の季節性対応であり、特別な懸念事項は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 本地確診一宗猴痘輸入個案，患者為34歲男子｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One locally confirmed imported case of monkeypox, a 34-year-old man | METROHK.com.hk
article.articleSummary: One locally confirmed imported case of monkeypox in Hong Kong. A 34-year-old man developed fever, fatigue, and a rash last week; he is currently isolated at Queen Elizabeth Hospital with stable condition. Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox virus positive in clinical samples. During the incubation period, the patient reportedly had high-risk contact with another man after leaving Hong Kong. Epidemiological investigations are ongoing, and the case has been reported to the World Health Organization. Health authorities urge vaccination for high-risk groups and advise the public to remain vigilant and avoid close physical contact with individuals suspected of monkeypox.

triage.headline_ja: 本地確診一宗猴痘輸入個案，患者為34歲男子｜METROHK.com.hk
triage.triage_reason: 香港における単一の輸入Mpox症例であり、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大の兆候は限定的だが、WHOへの報告がなされており継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の輸入症例で、患者は安定しており隔離中。高リスク接触歴あり、WHOに報告済み。地域コミュニティへの拡大の証拠は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreading in rural Congo, WHO warns
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading from the initial outbreak zones into remote rural areas of the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), according to WHO. Six months into the outbreak, cases in the original epicenters are declining, with Bunia treatment centers showing under-utilization, but infections are rising in hard-to-reach districts, raising concerns about containment. Responders cite fragile progress and limited ability to scale up treatment facilities amid ongoing insecurity caused by militias. The biggest hurdle is security; UN and WHO aim to be more agile to reach affected communities. Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis of OCHA warns that violence from the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) has recently caused more civilian deaths than the disease itself in the area, with 66 civilians killed last week, including three health workers, and three health facilities looted or burned. Action against the ADF is urged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ農村部で拡大―WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC農村部へ拡大しており、治安悪化により封じ込めが困難な状況。公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 治安悪化（ADFによる攻撃）が対応の最大の障害となっており、医療従事者や施設への被害も発生している。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam's Quang Ngai tightens Laos border controls to curb African swine fever
article.articleSummary: Quang Ngai Province in Vietnam tightens border controls with Laos to curb African swine fever (ASF). Plan 430, issued by the provincial administration, extends through February 28, 2027, boosting inspections of pig transportation, collection, slaughter and pork products of unknown origin to prevent cross-border spread and protect the local pork supply. Since early 2026 ASF has affected 416 households in 116 hamlets across 37 communes, prompting the culling of 3,043 pigs weighing over 146 metric tons. Authorities warn Laos outbreaks remain complicated, raising cross-border transmission risk through the transport of pigs and pork products. An inter-agency border inspection team will monitor the Vietnam-Laos border area, interprovincial roads, markets, slaughterhouses and trading points. Domestic surveillance will target infected pigs and unknown-origin products. ASF is a contagious viral disease of pigs, with symptoms such as fever, weakness and skin hemorrhages, and mortality up to 100%; it does not affect humans per FAO.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム・クアンガイ省、アフリカ豚熱の拡大防止へラオス国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)は豚のみに感染し人への健康影響はないため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）はFAOによるとヒトには感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上のリスクはない。養豚業・食料供給への経済的影響として地域行政が国境管理を強化している事例。ラオス側の発生も言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 voltam a subir em seis estados, indica boletim InfoGripe
