article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise again in six states, according to the InfoGripe bulletin.
article.articleSummary: Six Brazilian states show a renewed rise in severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) linked to COVID-19, though hospitalizations remain low and the national SARI trend is downward over 3- and 6-week frames (SE 44: 1–7 Nov). Increases concentrate in Distrito Federal, Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, and Bahia; Mato Grosso shows waning growth. Over the past four weeks, SARS-CoV-2 accounted for 11.5% of identified SARI cases and 26.9% of deaths with identified viruses. No state is at alert or high-risk with rising trend. Capitals with notable activity: Boa Vista (under 2), João Pessoa (under 2), Porto Velho (up to 4; 50–64), and Rio de Janeiro (65+). Metapneumovirus continues to sustain hospitalizations in Bahia, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro, with limited impact on overall SARI. In 2026, 174,427 SARI cases; positives 92,776 (RSV 38.3%, rhinovirus 33.7%, influenza A 15.4%, influenza B 5.5%, SARS-CoV-2 4%). Rhinovirus dominates last month (positives 49%, deaths 43.6%).

triage.headline_ja: InfoGripe速報によると、6州で新型コロナウイルスの重症例が再び増加
triage.triage_reason: 6州でCOVID-19による重症急性呼吸器感染症（SARI）がやや増加しているが、入院数は低水準で全国的な傾向は減少傾向にあり、警戒・高リスク州は存在しない。季節性呼吸器ウイルスの定例サーベイランス報告であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の定例呼吸器疾患サーベイランス報告（InfoGripe）であり、COVID-19・RSV・メタニューモウイルス・インフルエンザ等の季節性変動を示すもの。警戒レベルの州はなく、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО приветства напредъка в борбата с ебола и посочи нарастващата несигурност за здравните работници като най-голямото предизвикателство
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Welcomes Progress in the Fight Against Ebola and Points to the Growing Insecurity Facing Health Workers as the Greatest Challenge.
article.articleSummary: Six months into a large Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the WHO notes progress but warns that the rare Bundibugyo strain continues to spread into remote, insecure districts, complicating response and endangering health workers and facilities. Reported cases exceed 11,000 (laboratory-confirmed), making this the second-largest Ebola outbreak by cases historically (after West Africa 2014–2016). No approved treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo Ebola. Initial foci around Bunia in eastern DR Congo show declining numbers, yet transmission now extends into more rural, hard-to-reach areas. Since the outbreak began, WHO data record about 80 attacks on health facilities and personnel. Médecins Sans Frontières raises concerns of ongoing supply shortages and uncontrolled spread, while Julien Arneis, UN Ebola special coordinator, underscores the vast operational area but asserts teams can work in about 80% of cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ対策の進展を歓迎するも、医療従事者を取り巻く治安の悪化を最大の課題として指摘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の症例数が11,000例を超え史上第2位の規模に達し、ワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、医療施設への攻撃も頻発しているため、深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事案としてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にBunia周辺および遠隔地）のみが言及されており、Angolaへの拡大は確認されていないため除外した。ブンディブギョ株は稀な株であり、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: SZO: Postignut napredak u reagovanju na epidemiju ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Progress has been made in responding to the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Progress in Ebola response reported by WHO on 2026-11-13, but the virus continues to spread to remote parts of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO notes encouraging signs with declining case numbers in former hotspots such as Bunia in eastern DRC, yet new cases are emerging in rural, hard-to-reach areas. The UN Special Coordinator for Ebola described the affected region as vast, though activities reach about 80% of the area. The outbreak now has confirmed cases surpassing 11,000 and has spread from Congo into eastern, central and western Africa. It is caused by the Bundibugyo virus (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) strain, for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. To date, there have been 80 attacks on health facilities and health workers within the outbreak zone.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ流行への対応で進展が見られる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで継続拡大し、確認症例が11,000人を超え、複数地域（東部・中部・西部アフリカ）に拡大、かつ承認された治療法・ワクチンがない点でIHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ（Bundibugyo株）流行の継続を報告。治療法・ワクチン未承認、医療施設への攻撃80件など深刻な状況が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Παγκόσμια ανησυχία: Φόβοι για νέα πανδημία στη Ρωσία - Εμφανίστηκε και δεύτερη μυστηριώδης ασθένεια
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global concern: Fears of a new pandemic in Russia - a second mysterious disease has emerged.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-13, Russia faces a second mysterious illness alarming residents and travelers, with officials urging calm and noting the possibility of seasonal respiratory infections or circulating influenza strains rather than a new pathogen. Reports describe dozens of Russian tourists who visited Nha Trang, Vietnam, developing severe illness characterized by very high fever, severe headaches, runny nose, and a persistent, intense cough lasting weeks. Vietnamese clinicians have difficulty determining a cause, generally citing influenza in circulation. Rospotrebnadzor has formally asked Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Russian Travel Industry Union for rapid data and awaits official test results from Hanoi. The Russian consulate in Ho Chi Minh City reports no official inquiries from Russians. The situation follows a separate Coxsackie virus incident among Russian tourists in Vietnam last month; investigations continue in parallel with earlier Siberian plague fears linked to Irkutsk.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的懸念：ロシアで新たなパンデミックへの懸念 - 二つ目の謎の病気が出現
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の重篤な呼吸器症状がベトナム・ニャチャン訪問後のロシア人観光客多数に発生し、ロシア当局がベトナム保健省に公式照会するなど国際的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: 発症はロシア人観光客がベトナム・ニャチャンを訪問後に発生しており、曝露地はベトナムと判断。ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト懸念は別件として記載されているが本記事の主題ではないため対象外。原因病原体・重症度・死亡例など詳細情報が不足しており、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mpox passam de mil no Brasil e acendem alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases surpass 1,000 in Brazil, triggering an alert.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox cases in Brazil exceed 1,000 in 2026, with 1,023 confirmed, 46 probable, 581 suspected, and 1 death as of December 12, according to the Health Ministry surveillance dashboard. More than half of total cases occurred in October–November. Six states report most activity, led by Rio de Janeiro (390) and São Paulo (388), Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), Federal District (41), and Santa Catarina (24). This late-2026 surge echoes patterns seen in 2024, but current numbers are well below the 2022 Brazilian peak of over 10,500 cases. Monkeypox is a zoonosis caused by MPXV. Transmission mainly through direct skin-to-skin contact with lesions, contaminated objects, or prolonged close respiratory contact. Vaccination exists in Brazil through the public SUS, restricted to high-risk groups; a new batch of 25,000 doses was recently acquired. Since monitoring began, Brazil has recorded 15,455 cases and 19 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでmpox症例が1,000例を超え、警戒感が高まる
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（流行しやすさ・持続的曝露）に該当し、見出しで「警戒」が強調されるなど社会的関心も示唆されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 2026年後半の増加は2024年と類似パターンであり、2022年のピーク（10,500例超）と比較すると現状は低水準。ワクチン供給（SUS経由、2.5万回分追加）など対応体制は整っている模様。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : une campagne de sensibilisation de 15 jours lancée dans une commune - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: a 15-day awareness campaign launched in a municipality.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease awareness campaign lasting fifteen days was launched in Mbunya commune, Bunia, Ituri, in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, by municipal councilor Paul Kamba to strengthen prevention and bring health messages closer to communities. With a resurgence of Ebola cases in the Bankoko neighborhood, the campaign will operate primarily in Mbunya, engaging schools, churches, and associations and urging leaders to install handwashing facilities to promote regular hand hygiene. The initiative aims to boost community vigilance and reinforce preventive measures to curb transmission. The effort underscores the social impact of Ebola, noting that the disease has left orphans, widows, and widowers. No specific case or death counts are provided in the report. The date referenced is 13 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでエボラ出血熱：ある行政区で15日間の啓発キャンペーン開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ブニアでエボラ出血熱の症例再燃が報告され、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡散リスクを有するため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はブニア市ムブニャ区における啓発活動が主題で、具体的な症例数・死亡数は報告されていないが、バンココ地区でのエボラ症例再燃が言及されている。症例数等の詳細情報が不足しているため続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong halts Kyoto poultry imports following avian influenza outbreak
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong imposed an immediate precautionary ban on poultry meat and related products, including eggs, from Kyoto Prefecture, Japan, after Japan reported a highly pathogenic H5 avian influenza outbreak. The Centre for Food Safety said the suspension covers all Kyoto-origin poultry consignments and will remain while veterinary containment proceeds; officials will monitor updates from the World Organisation for Animal Health and Japanese authorities, with potential further regulatory actions if needed. The move follows an alert from Japan’s Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries and rapid communications with Hong Kong authorities. Hong Kong relies heavily on Japanese poultry, importing about 1,030 tonnes of frozen poultry meat and 249.94 million poultry eggs in the first nine months of the year. Border inspections remain in force; importers should track sourcing origins during the suspension.

triage.headline_ja: 香港、京都の鳥インフルエンザ発生を受け京都産家禽の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 日本（京都）での高病原性H5鳥インフルエンザ発生を受け香港が輸入停止措置を取ったという貿易・動物衛生上の対応が主内容で、人感染の報告はなく、IHR基準は貿易制限のみ該当のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は日本・京都での家禽における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ発生に伴う香港の輸入停止措置を報じたものであり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）での発生ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。人への感染報告は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Patient Recovers, Discharged From Swiss Hospital - NCDC
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case in Nigeria confirmed on Oct 20, 2026, with patient evacuated to Switzerland on Oct 26, where initial tests remained positive but later turned negative and the patient was discharged after recovery. No secondary transmission reported: 62 contacts completed a 21-day monitoring period, with the last contact discharged around 2026-11-13; 13 contacts reported fever or non-specific symptoms but all tested negative. Seven suspected Ebola alerts from Adamawa, Rivers, Borno, Lagos and Ekiti states were investigated and all were negative. Nigeria has not been declared outbreak-free; status will follow public health criteria and WHO protocols. National Emergency Operations Centre remains at Level Three; ongoing surveillance, infection prevention and control, and laboratory investigations continue to guard against importation, with vigilance due to ongoing EVD in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Travelers are advised to report exposures and maintain sanitation and medical support, especially during December

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が回復、スイスの病院から退院 - ナイジェリアCDC
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアへの輸入エボラ症例という異常事象であり、NCDC・国家緊急対応センターが関与するなど政府の関心が高いため、フルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアへの輸入エボラ症例の回復・退院報告であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは進行中のエボラ流行の背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。二次感染なく、接触者62名の21日間モニタリングも完了済みで、現時点での国際的拡大リスクは低いと評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Não é falta de higiene nem transmitido por cães: Entenda o surto de sarna em creches de MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: It's not poor hygiene, nor is it transmitted by dogs: Understand the scabies outbreak in daycares in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) affecting at least 70 people across two Mato Grosso do Sul daycares in Dourados and Itaporã. In Dourados, 24 children and 16 staff at Ceim Recanto Raízes are infected, prompting indefinite closure; in Itaporã, 24 children at Cmei Milton Melani are affected, with eight-day closure and reopening anticipated on Monday 16. The article debunks myths linking scabies to dog transmission or poor hygiene, noting the disease is caused by a human-specific mite and spreads mainly through direct prolonged skin contact and via contaminated clothing or bedding, with mites surviving 20–48 hours on fomites. Symptoms include intense nocturnal itching, red papules, lesions, and skin tunnels. Prevention emphasizes treating close contacts, washing fabrics at temperatures above 55°C, ironing, and avoiding sharing personal items; reinfestation risk is reduced by simultaneous treatment and environmental cleansing.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生不足でも犬からの感染でもない：マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州の保育施設における疥癬の集団発生を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低く、局地的な保育施設での集団発生に限定されており、IHR・WPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒト特異的なダニによる皮膚感染症で、致死性や国際伝播リスクは低い。地域の保育施設2か所、計70名程度の限定的な集団発生であり、地方衛生当局で対応可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : à Oicha, le centre Ebola manque de place pour une trentaine de patients - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: In Oicha, the Ebola treatment center lacks space for about thirty patients - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: In Oicha, North Kivu, DRC, the Ebola treatment center at the Oicha General Referral Hospital is overcrowded, hosting about thirty patients. Rooms are shared by three: two sleeping on mats on the floor and one on a bed, without mosquito nets. The overflow raises fears of cross-infection after a patient who tested negative shared a room with someone whose test later came back positive. The ETC occupies a former transit facility used in 2018 during the tenth Ebola outbreak. Dr. Melchi Lukumbola says confirmed cases rose rapidly, exceeding the initial capacity of ten beds for confirmed and ten for suspected, prompting the addition of tents. The hospital also opened new rooms for suspected cases awaiting laboratory results. Officials are calling for urgent construction of a properly-equipped Ebola treatment center with sufficient capacity.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：オイチャのエボラ治療センターが約30人の患者で満床状態
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ確診症例が急増し治療センターが過密化、院内感染（交差感染）リスクが顕在化しており、既存のアウトブレイク対応の深刻化を示すシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事は2018年の第10次エボラ流行時に使用された施設を再利用している旨を記載しており、現在進行中のアウトブレイクの一部と考えられる。確診患者と疑い患者の病室共有による交差感染の懸念、ベッド不足、蚊帳の欠如など医療体制の逼迫が報告されている。関係者は緊急の施設拡充を求めており、既存アウトブレイクの深刻化を示すためフルリスク評価（RRA）が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО упозорава: Ебола јењава у старим жариштима, али се шири ка неприступачним областима Конга
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Ebola is waning in old hotspots, but spreading to hard-to-reach areas of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of Nov 13, 2026, over 11,000 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported since the outbreak began, with 80 attacks on health facilities and workers. WHO warns progress in the response coincides with the virus’s spread into remote, hard-to-reach areas of the Democratic Republic of Congo, amid rising insecurity. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO's emergencies chief, notes encouraging signs, including declines in cases in former hotspots such as Bunia in eastern DRC, but new infections are emerging in rural regions. The UN Ebola Emergency Coordinator says the affected area is unimaginably vast, though response activities reach about 80% of that space. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. Since it began, the epidemic has extended from Congo to parts of eastern, central, and western Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告:エボラは旧流行地では沈静化するも、コンゴの奥地へと拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が1万人を超える確定症例を伴い、治療薬・ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株によりコンゴ国内の奥地・複数国へ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベント。
triage.notes: WHO・国連エボラ緊急調整官が発信する公式情報に基づく大規模継続中のアウトブレイク。治療薬・ワクチン未承認株であり、治安悪化によりアクセス困難な地域への拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : l'utilisation d'essence sur les dépouilles de victimes d'Ebola inquiète les acteurs de la riposte | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: The use of gasoline on the corpses of Ebola victims concerns the actors in the response
article.articleSummary: Gasoline is being sprayed on Ebola victims' corpses in Mangala health zone, Ituri, Djugu territory, as a misguided belief that fuel disinfects the virus. The practice, driven by circulating misinformation, is fueling a renewed outbreak. On November 11, Dr. Jacques Savo, the health zone medical chief, reported that funeral rites posing risks were resumed; Mandje health area logged 24 suspected cases in a single day and about 25 confirmed within a week. Liliane Malossi of PRODAWI, a community outreach NGO, cited response delays and field demotivation, worsened by poor road conditions during the rainy season and lack of transport for response teams. Health actors are calling for intensified community sensitization to counter false information and curb the Ebola resurgence in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ：エボラ犠牲者の遺体へのガソリン使用が対応関係者を懸念させる
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でエボラ出血熱の再燃が報告され、短期間に多数の疑い例・確定例が発生し、誤った慣習（遺体へのガソリン散布）や葬儀儀礼がヒト-ヒト感染を助長している。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的拡大リスクもあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はイツリ州ジュグ準州マンガラ保健圏でのエボラ再燃を報告。遺体へのガソリン散布という誤った慣習と葬儀儀礼の再開が感染拡大の主因。マンジェ保健圏で1日に24件の疑い例、1週間で約25件の確定例が報告されており、対応の遅延や雨季による道路状況悪化も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich im Kongo in ländliche Gebiete aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading to rural areas in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports alarming spread of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo to rural areas. Six months into the outbreak, cases in original zones are declining, with Bunia treatment centers now only about half full. However, in hard-to-reach, remote districts infections are rising, hindered by poor access and unstable security amid militia violence. The UN notes that in recent days more people have died from Islamist militia violence (ADF) than from Ebola; last week an ADF attack killed 66 civilians, including three health workers. Health facilities have been looted and set on fire. The situation complicates case detection, care, and containment, highlighting the need for safe access for healthcare teams and protection of facilities amid ongoing clashes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが農村部に拡大
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生から6か月が経過し、僻地・農村部への感染拡大と治安悪化（民兵による攻撃、医療施設破壊）を報告しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: 治安悪化（ADFによる攻撃）が感染制御・医療アクセスを著しく阻害しており、既存の発生に対する悪化シグナルとして注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: IS-linked fighters killed 66 civilians in Ebola-hit east DR Congo: Africa CDC - Africa - World
article.articleSummary: IS-linked gunmen killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, in the Cantine-Aloya area of eastern DR Congo last week, as Ebola outbreak declared in May continues to rage—the worst in the DRC to date. More than 11,000 Ebola cases have been confirmed and over 5,000 deaths reported. The virus has spread across eastern and northeastern DRC amid years of armed-group violence, hampering response efforts. Africa CDC official Wessam Mankoula said insecurity is a major obstacle to containment. The Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), an IS-affiliated group active in North Kivu and Ituri, is suspected of the attack, which saw three health facilities looted and burned. After the assault, three confirmed Ebola cases were unaccounted for and more than 1,000 contacts lost to follow-up. WHO director-general Tedros warned of the setback; two weeks earlier, a nurse was killed and another health worker injured during an Ebola alert in Tshopo province.

triage.headline_ja: IS関連武装勢力がエボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国東部で民間人66人を殺害:アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（感染11,000例超・死亡5,000例超）が継続中で、武装勢力の攻撃により医療従事者殺害や接触者追跡喪失など対応が著しく阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（Ituri、Tshopo州含む）でのエボラ流行継続と武装勢力による攻撃を報告。『Africa』は大陸区分でありverified_locationsからは除外。既存の大規模流行事案の継続報道だが、治安悪化による対応阻害という新たな深刻化要素があるため改めてPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Minas tem 45 casos de Mpox em 2026; Brasil ultrapassa mil registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais has 45 Mpox cases in 2026; Brazil surpasses one thousand records.
article.articleSummary: Minas Gerais reports 45 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, ranking fourth in Brazil as national totals exceed 1,023. Rio de Janeiro leads with 390, São Paulo 388, Ceará 61; Minas Gerais is followed by Distrito Federal (41) and Santa Catarina (24). Brazil records 46 probable and 581 suspected cases under investigation, with one mpox death in 2026. November accounts for 227 and October 293 cases, together over half of this year’s confirmed infections. Mpox is caused by the MPXV Orthopoxvirus, a zoonosis; most cases are mild to moderate. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with lesions or body fluids, contaminated objects, or prolonged close contact with respiratory secretions. Vaccination exists for at-risk groups; the Health Ministry recently purchased 25,000 doses to reinforce immunization. Since mpox notifications began in Brazil: 15,455 cases and 19 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州で2026年に45件のMpox症例、ブラジル全体で1000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で継続的なヒト-ヒト感染が確認され累計1,023例・死亡例もあり、政府がワクチン追加調達を行うなど対応強化が見られるため、スクリーニング基準（持続曝露・流行性）と社会的関心（政府対応）の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内での既存のMpox流行の継続報告であり、症例の大半は軽症〜中等症。死亡例は限定的だが、持続的な感染拡大とワクチン追加調達という政府対応が確認されるためPICKUPと判定。新規の異常事象ではなく、既存流行のモニタリング継続が主目的。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola's Toll on Children Six Months into Outbreak: UNICEF
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, UNICEF reports transmission across 51 of 67 health zones. As of 4 November, 2,959 children under 18 have Ebola and 1,737 have died (28% of cases, 35% of deaths). The under-five group is most at risk: 14% of cases, 21% of deaths, and nearly 72% of under-fives infected have died. About 80% of child deaths occur outside Ebola Treatment Centres; one in three under-fives admitted dies within 24 hours. Women and girls account for 53% of cases; among 10–17-year-olds, 15–17-year-olds are two-thirds of cases and 60% of deaths. Over 2,280 children have been orphaned; nearly 7,500 schools lack infection prevention. Mental health concerns: 81% of children feel afraid; 89% of parents stressed; 21,000 children supported. UNICEF calls for pediatric care, family support, health-worker protection, and sustained humanitarian action; 14.9 million people in DRC need aid, including 8 million children.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の子どもへの影響：発生から6か月、UNICEF報告
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で発生から6か月が経過したエボラ出血熱が67保健地区中51地区に拡大し、子どもの死亡率が高く人道支援ニーズが極めて高いため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: UNICEFの報告に基づく記事。発生地域はDRC東部で、51/67保健地区に拡大しており、子どもと若年層の死亡率が極めて高い。国際的な人道支援の継続・拡大が強く求められている。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.โคราช เตือนสายกินดิบ! ระวัง ไข้หูดับ พบปี 69 ป่วยแล้ว 76 เสียชีวิต 9 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nakhon Ratchasima Public Health Office warns raw-food eaters! Beware of Ear Deafness Fever. In 2026 there have been 76 cases and 9 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infection linked to pork is causing illness in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand. From Jan 1 to Nov 11, 2026, Nakhon Ratchasima reported 76 cases and 9 deaths, the highest in Health Zone 9; neighboring provinces Chaiyaphum 27, Buriram 25, Surin 15. Cumulative incidence is 2.75 per 100,000, below the 3-year median of 3.90 (99 cases, 9 deaths). Over 2567–2569, 122 cases/8 deaths; 87/13; 76/9. Transmission occurs via consumption of raw or undercooked pork or pork blood, and contact with pig tissues through broken skin or mucous membranes. Symptoms include fever, chills, body aches, severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, and ear fullness or hearing loss; severe cases may progress to meningitis, sepsis, endocarditis, deafness, or death. Prevention emphasizes avoiding raw pork, separating raw/cooked utensils, buying from reputable sources, and protective hygiene for workers; seek care promptly if symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: ナコンラチャシマ県保健局が生肉愛好者に警告！耳が聞こえなくなる熱（ストレプトコッカス・スイス感染症）に注意、2026年は76例発症・9名死亡
triage.triage_reason: タイ東北部で豚肉由来のStreptococcus suis感染症が報告されているが、罹患率は過去3年中央値を下回り、地域限定・既知の風土病であるため緊急性は低いが、季節性の動向として注視が必要。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suis感染症はタイで毎年報告される既知の豚肉関連人獣共通感染症であり、今回の罹患率（10万人対2.75）は過去3年中央値（3.90）を下回っている。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域の食習慣（生豚肉・豚血の喫食）に起因する継続的曝露があるため、季節的な経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño Alert: अल-नीनो से भारत में बढ़ सकता है स्वास्थ्य संकट, WHO ने जारी किया सबसे बड़ा अलर्ट; डेंगू-मलेरिया और लू का खतरा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño Alert: Health crisis could rise in India due to El Niño; WHO has issued the largest alert; the risk of dengue, malaria, and heatwaves.
article.articleSummary: El Niño raises health risks in India and other South Asian countries, with the WHO declaring its highest-level global emergency (Grade-3) for Oct 2026–Sept 2027, citing heatwaves, water scarcity, infectious diseases, and food insecurity. India is categorized as high/very high health risk in the Sept 5, 2026 WHO assessment, with extreme heat, dehydration, and malnutrition straining health systems. Climate-driven shifts could elevate dengue and malaria transmission, heatstroke and dehydration risks, and waterborne infections such as leptospirosis, particularly affecting children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with preexisting conditions. El Niño may influence India's monsoon, though effects depend on other oceanic conditions. WHO seeks about $35 million for the first six months, emphasizing disease surveillance, hospital readiness, safe drinking water, vector control, and timely alerts.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ警報：エルニーニョによりインドで健康危機が深刻化する恐れ、WHOが最大級の警告を発令。デング熱・マラリア・熱波のリスクを指摘
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエルニーニョに起因する健康危機として史上最高レベル（Grade-3）の緊急事態を宣言し、インドを高リスク地域に分類。デング熱・マラリア・レプトスピラ症等複数の感染症リスクと国際支援要請（約3500万ドル）があり、社会的・政策的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な発生事例の報告ではなく、WHOによるエルニーニョ関連の健康リスク予測・警告に関するもの。デング熱・マラリア・レプトスピラ症の実際の症例数や発生状況は記載されておらず、今後の続報（具体的な症例報告等）を注視する必要がある。南アジア地域全体に言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはインドのみ。

article.articleHeadline: El Nino health alert: WHO raises global emergency response to highest level, India at high risk
article.articleSummary: WHO has elevated its global health emergency response to Grade 3—the highest level—for El Niño-related health risks from October 2026 through September 2027, with about $35 million planned for the first six months. India is among high- to very high-risk countries as South Asia faces above-normal temperatures and below-average rainfall. Key threats include heatwaves and heat-related illnesses; dengue (high/very high risk for India) and malaria (Northeast); leptospirosis and other waterborne infections from floods and poor sanitation; and food shortages that raise malnutrition risk for children under five and pregnant or breastfeeding women. Extreme conditions could strain hospitals and disrupt medicine supplies. El Niño does not directly cause disease, but weather shifts can foster infections and healthcare disruption. An August 2026 government assessment cited IMD’s forecast of below-normal rainfall for the 2026 southwest monsoon, around 90% of LPA with a 4% model error, though regional heavy rains are possible.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ健康警報：WHOが世界的緊急対応を最高レベルに引き上げ、インドが高リスク国に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがエルニーニョ関連の健康リスクに対し最高レベル（グレード3）の緊急対応を発令し、インドを高リスク国として指定。デング熱・マラリア・レプトスピラ症等の増加リスクと国際支援（約3500万ドル）の必要性が明記されており、WPRO基準と社会的関心の両面で該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOによる気候関連リスク予測（El Niñoによる今後のデング熱・マラリア・レプトスピラ症等の増加リスク）に関するものであり、現時点で具体的な症例数や確定アウトブレイクの報告はない。続報で実際の感染拡大状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sumedang Genjot Penanganan TBC, Obat Diantar Langsung ke Rumah Pasien
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sumedang Steps Up TB Treatment, Medicines Delivered Directly to Patients' Homes
article.articleSummary: Sumedang Regency, Indonesia, strengthens tuberculosis control with Ngarantang, a home-delivery TB medication service, and housing improvements for patients under the rutilahu program in coordination with the Ministry of Public Works and Housing. About 2,056 housing units are allocated, focusing on better ventilation and lighting to reduce transmission. The Desa Siaga TB program has expanded to 175 villages, up from 22, with socialization and support reaching 63.2% of total villages. The Health Department intensifies active case finding through field visits, involving health workers, village authorities, and religious and community leaders to map readily exposed relatives and neighbors. The initiative also ensures strict medication adherence and doorstep dispensing, aiming to reduce treatment interruptions and raise cure rates, thereby strengthening the community health ecosystem against TB.

triage.headline_ja: スメダン県、TB対策を強化 薬を患者宅へ直接配送
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラムの拡充に関する行政報告であり、異常な発生や急激な増加を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の流行病であり、本記事はインドネシア・スメダン県の既存の対策プログラム（住宅改善・薬剤配送・地域活動）の拡充に関する通常業務報告。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の記述なし。

article.articleHeadline: Intoxicação alimentar: Anvisa suspende venda de queijo contaminado com bactéria; veja marca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food Poisoning: Anvisa Suspends Sale of Cheese Contaminated with Bacteria; See the Brand.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa suspended sale, distribution, dissemination, and consumption of lot 180926 of Italy-brand Sliced Mozzarella cheese in Brazil after a microbiological test detected Listeria monocytogenes in a 25-gram sample. Manufacturer Agroindústria Santo Anjo Ltda. has initiated a voluntary recall. No illnesses linked to the cheese had been identified at the time. Listeria monocytogenes causes listeriosis, with symptoms ranging from diarrhea, vomiting, fever, and muscle aches to severe outcomes such as sepsis or meningitis, especially in pregnant individuals, the elderly, and immunocompromised. The bacterium can survive refrigeration and contaminate foods during production, processing, packaging, transport, or storage; pasteurization and proper cooking kill it, though post-processing contamination remains possible. Consumers who purchased the product should check the lot number; if 180926, do not consume and contact the retailer or manufacturer for returns. Those with symptoms should seek medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 食中毒：Anvisaが細菌汚染チーズの販売を停止；ブランド名を確認
triage.triage_reason: 単一ロットの製品回収事案であり、現時点で関連する発症報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: イタリアは製品ブランド名（Italy印のモッツァレラ）であり、発生国はブラジルのみ。感染者報告なしの自主回収事案。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Patient Recovers, Discharged From Swiss Hospital - NCDC
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola case in Nigeria confirmed Oct 20, 2026; patient evacuated to Switzerland on Oct 26, 2026, where initial tests on arrival were positive but later negative, leading to discharge after recovery. Nigeria’s NCDC reports no secondary transmission: 62 contacts completed a 21‑day monitoring period with the last contact discharged on 2026-11-13; 13 contacts developed fever or non‑specific symptoms but all tested negative. Seven suspected Ebola alerts from Adamawa, Rivers, Borno, Lagos and Ekiti were negative. National Emergency Operations Centre remains at Level Three, with ongoing surveillance, infection prevention and control measures, and laboratory investigations nationwide. Completion of contact monitoring does not automatically declare the outbreak over per WHO criteria. Ongoing risk persists due to Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo; Nigeria will maintain vigilance, urging early medical attention and disclosure of travel history to prevent importation and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が回復、スイスの病院から退院 - NCDC
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでの輸入エボラ症例は二次感染なく収束傾向にあり、対象国リストに該当する国（DRC）は背景的なリスク要因としての言及に留まり本記事の主題ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本記事はナイジェリアの輸入エボラ症例（対象国リスト外）に関するもので、62名の接触者の21日間監視が完了し二次感染は確認されていない。DRCでのエボラ活動への言及は継続的リスク要因としての背景説明であり、本記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: UN hails progress in Ebola response, but says rising insecurity is biggest challenge
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo ebolavirus, continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo six months after it prompted global concerns, with confirmed cases surpassing 11,000—the second-worst Ebola outbreak on record. The outbreak has spread across East, Central, and West Africa, flagged by health authorities in mid-May. No approved treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The UN and WHO report some progress, including falling case numbers in former hotspots such as Bunia in eastern DRC, yet cases are now emerging in more rural and hard-to-reach areas. The biggest challenge is rising insecurity, with WHO data citing about 80 attacks on health sites and workers. Médecins Sans Frontières says supplies are missing and transmission remains hard to curb. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis notes the operation spans a vast area, with about 80% operability.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ対応の進展を称賛するも、治安悪化が最大の課題と指摘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で記録的規模（11,000例超）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが6ヶ月以上継続し、治安悪化により対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMozambiqueとAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（Bunia含む東部）での発生のみ言及されており、これらは除外した。Central Africaは地域名であり対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads into rural areas of DRC as violence hampers response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo virus, BDBV) is spreading into rural communities, despite declines in early epicenters. By mid-November 2026, the DRC reported more than 11,000 confirmed cases and over 5,400 deaths across eight provinces and about 68 health zones, with case fatality near 49% though thousands recovered. Declines in Bunia and Ituri contrast with rising transmission in North Kivu and other isolated areas; insecurity and difficult terrain hinder case finding and treatment. Declared May 15, 2026, this is the largest outbreak in the DRC’s history and the second-largest globally. Armed groups, especially the ADF, have escalated violence, killing civilians (66 dead in early November, including three health workers) and looting/burning three health facilities, disrupting surveillance and contact tracing. Authorities expanded diagnostics, treatment capacity, and labs; vaccine and treatment trials have begun, but security risks threaten containment.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱が農村部へ拡大、暴力が対応を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の感染者と5400人超の死者を出すDRC史上最大のエボラ流行が続き、武装勢力の暴力により対応が阻害され国際的拡大・管理困難性が高い。
triage.notes: DRC史上最大規模・世界第2位のエボラ流行。武装勢力(ADF)による暴力が公衆衛生対応を妨害し、感染拡大リスクと国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Varian Covid-19 PJ.2.1 Menyebar di Sejumlah Negara, Kemenkes: Belum Ditemukan di RI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 PJ.2.1 Variant Spreading in Several Countries, Ministry of Health: Not Yet Found in Indonesia
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a subvariant of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron, is circulating in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific as of 13 November 2026, but has not been detected in Indonesia. Indonesian Ministry of Health says confirmation requires whole-genome sequencing (WGS). Originating from the MC.10.1.7 subline and classified as a saltation variant, PJ.2.1 was first identified in Ontario, Canada, on 2 May 2026. In the United States, first detected in New York City on 30 June 2026, with cases in multiple states. Abroad, detections include Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, France, and Spain, where transmission is suspected. Public Health Ontario reported PJ.2.1 accounted for 25.2% of sequenced genomes from Sep 20 to Oct 17, 2026, up 16.9 percentage points in four weeks. Lab data show spike mutations increase ACE2 binding; immune evasion is not markedly higher; symptoms resemble typical COVID-19. LP.8.1 vaccine antibodies can neutralize PJ.2.1 in vitro.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19変異株PJ.2.1が複数国で拡大、インドネシア保健省：国内未検出
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1の拡大情報だが、対象国（インドネシア含む）での検出は確認されておらず、現時点では重症度上昇の明確な根拠もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はPJ.2.1変異株の国際的な拡散状況を報じているが、インドネシア保健省は『国内未検出（WGS確認待ち）』と明言しており、対象国リスト内での実際の発生は確認されていない。検出国（米国・カナダ・シンガポール・豪州・NZ・イスラエル・仏・西）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Alarmantno: Ebola odnela hiljade života, više od 11.000 zaraženih za šest meseci, strahuje se da je broj mrtvih mnogo veći - gotovo svaki zaraženi do sada preminuo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming: Ebola has claimed thousands of lives, more than 11,000 infected in six months, it is feared that the death toll is much higher — almost every infected person has died so far.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to eight provinces, with more than 11,000 infections reported in six months since the epidemic was officially declared on May 15. Experts warn the true toll could be higher, as the virus may have circulated undetected for months. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugjo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Early Ebola symptoms can resemble malaria, delaying diagnosis, isolation, and care. Cases have been detected beyond the DRC in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Children are among the most affected, comprising a substantial share of confirmed cases and facing a higher mortality risk. Ebola causes severe dehydration, inflammatory responses, coagulation disturbances, and organ failure, with mortality rising if treatment is delayed.

triage.headline_ja: 警鐘：エボラ出血熱が数千人の命を奪う、6か月で感染者1万1000人超――死者数はさらに多いとの懸念、感染者のほぼ全員がこれまでに死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が6か月で1万1000人超の感染者を出し、承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、複数国への拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビア語メディアによる報道で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。感染者のほぼ全員が死亡との記述は致死率として極端であり、実際の致死率は確認が必要。ブンディブギョ株は承認ワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、マラリアとの症状類似による診断遅延も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: DF está entre os estados com mais casos de mpox, veja o painel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Federal District is among the states with the most mpox cases; see the panel.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil surpassed 1,000 confirmed cases in early 2026, with 1,023 confirmed and one death. The epidemiological panel from the Ministry of Health shows 46 probable and 581 suspected cases under investigation. Distrito Federal (DF) has 41 confirmed cases, ranking fifth among states. The heaviest concentrations are in Rio de Janeiro (390) and São Paulo (388), followed by Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), and DF (41). The country recorded a roughly 23% rise from 832 confirmed cases as of November 6, an increase of 191 in six days. The graph indicates accelerating case numbers in recent weeks, though cumulative totals remain below 2022’s peak when approximately 10,500 diagnoses and 14 deaths were recorded. Mpox is transmitted mainly via direct contact with skin lesions; most patients have mild/moderate symptoms, but severe complications can occur, especially in immunocompromised individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区(DF)はmpox症例数が多い州の一つ、パネルで確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでmpox確定例が1,000例を超え、直近6日間で23%増という急増傾向が見られ、国内メディア・保健省の注目度も高いため。
triage.notes: 死亡率は低く2022年のピークと比べ規模は小さいが、直近の増加率が加速している点が注目される。クレード情報（Clade I/II）は記事中に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa suspende lote de mussarela após bactéria ser encontrada; veja marca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa suspends mozzarella batch after bacteria are found; see brand.
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s health regulator Anvisa suspended sale, distribution, and consumption of a lot of Italy-brand sliced mozzarella after microbiological testing detected Listeria monocytogenes in a 25-gram sample. The affected lot is 180926, produced by Agroindústria Santo Anjo Ltda. The action, published in the Diário Oficial da União, took effect on 11 November 2026 under Resolution RE No. 4.423, following Laudo de Ensaio No. 56058/2026. The company initiated a voluntary recall. Consumers should check for lot 180926 and not consume if matched; the measure blocks sale and distribution of the affected units. Listeria monocytogenes can cause listeriosis, a serious infection especially dangerous for pregnant individuals, the elderly, and immunocompromised people. No consumer case counts or deaths are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、リステリア菌検出によりモッツァレラチーズの1ロットを販売停止。該当ブランドを確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル当局が予防的に特定ロットの乳製品を回収した事案で、ヒトへの感染症例や死亡例は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は食品安全規制当局（Anvisa）による製品リコールに関するもので、ヒトの感染症例数は報告されていない。「Italy」はブランド名であり、発生国はブラジルのみ。イタリア（国）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πάνω από 11.000 τα κρούσματα - Ανησυχία του ΟΗΕ για επιθέσεις σε δομές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Over 11,000 cases — UN expresses concern over attacks on facilities.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-13, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases, marking the second-worst outbreak on record and spreading across eastern, central, and western Africa, six months after it began in mid-May. The outbreak, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, has no approved treatments or vaccines. UN health officials note progress, especially declines in previously hard-hit Bunia in eastern DRC, but transmission is now occurring in more rural, hard-to-reach areas. Ongoing insecurity hampers response, with 80 attacks on health facilities and workers reported. MSF warns of continued supply shortages and uncontrolled transmission. Julien Arnès, the UN Ebola response coordinator, acknowledged the vast operational area but said they can operate in 80% of it. The report underscores the need for strengthened security and sustained international support to curb spread and protect responders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：症例数11,000人超 ― 施設への攻撃に国連が懸念表明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000人超の症例数となる史上2番目に深刻なエボラ流行が継続しており、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認で、治安悪化により対応が困難化していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 希少なBundibugyo株による流行で承認済みの治療法・ワクチンがなく、医療施設への攻撃（80件）や治安悪化が対応を阻害している。農村部への拡大や国際支援の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: إشادة أممية بالتقدم في مكافحة إيبولا بالكونغو وتحذير من انعدام الأمن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN commends progress in the fight against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and warns of insecurity.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a major outbreak, now the second-worst on record with over 11,000 confirmed cases. The outbreak began mid-May 2026 due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no approved treatments or vaccines. After declines in earlier hotspots Bunia and Nizi in eastern DRC, new cases are emerging in more remote, hard-to-reach rural areas. Security constraints hinder response, with 80 attacks on health facilities and workers reported. Doctors Without Borders warns that supplies are scarce, frontline staff are unpaid, ambulances lack fuel, and surveillance and essential response teams are in short supply. The UN and WHO stress ongoing need for resources on the ground. Epidemiologist Neil Ferguson warns transmission could persist beyond a year; his team estimates 2,000–3,000 current infections, with detections potentially representing only about half of actual cases.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱対策の進展を称賛、治安悪化に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）が史上2番目の規模（確認症例11,000例超）に達し、治安悪化により対応が困難化、国連・WHOが資源不足を指摘するなど国際的関心・公衆衛生上の深刻性が高い。
triage.notes: 承認された治療薬・ワクチンがない希少株（ブンディブギョ型）であり、治安悪化（医療施設・従事者への攻撃80件）により対応が妨げられている。専門家は感染拡大が1年以上続く可能性を指摘し、実際の感染者数は確認数の約2倍に上る可能性があるとしている。国境を越えた拡大の明示的記載はないが、リスクは高いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Barrick Furloughs Some Kibali Workers After Ebola Deaths Nearby | TokenPost
article.articleSummary: Barrick Mining furloughs non-essential staff and subcontractors at its Kibali gold mine in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo after two Ebola-related deaths were reported in a nearby community. The furlough covers personnel whose presence is not essential; affected workers will be contacted directly. Barrick said staff who feel ill should stay home and contact mine medical staff, and it did not identify an infected Kibali worker or disclose the furlough count. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing Bundibugyo virus disease outbreaks, with 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 confirmed deaths reported as of Nov. 10. Haut-Uele province, where Kibali is located, is among affected areas. Barrick is reviewing whether there are any links between the outbreak and its workforce. Kibali JV owners: Barrick 45%, AngloGold Ashanti 45%, SMC 10%.

triage.headline_ja: バリック、近隣でのエボラ死亡事例を受けキバリ鉱山の一部労働者を一時帰休
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが継続しており、死亡者数が5,000人を超える深刻な状況。多国籍企業の鉱山操業にも影響が及び、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はビジネス（鉱山操業）視点だが、背景にあるDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）アウトブレイクは症例11,114件・死亡5,433件と非常に大規模であり、公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。続報で感染経路・労働者への影響・国際的拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Ebola breitet sich in ländliche Gebiete aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola spreads to rural areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola spreads to rural areas in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as the World Health Organization warns of alarming expansion into Nord-Kivu and Ituri provinces. Africa CDC cites a precarious security situation after an ISIS-linked Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) attack last week that killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, and looted and burned three health facilities. Following the assault, three people with confirmed Ebola infections are unaccounted for, and more than 1,000 contact persons have been lost to follow-up. Six months into the outbreak, cases are declining in the original zones, and treatment centers in Bunia are only partially full; however, infections are rising in hard-to-reach, insecure regions. The UN and WHO warn that progress is fragile and insufficient, complicating new treatment-center construction. WHO aims to move more quickly to reach affected communities and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ:エボラが農村部に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCのNord-Kivu・Ituri州で農村部に拡大しており、治安悪化により患者・接触者の追跡が困難になっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 治安悪化（ADFによる攻撃）により確定患者3名が行方不明、接触者1000人以上が追跡不能となっており、感染拡大リスクが高い状況。WHO・UN・Africa CDCが懸念を表明している。

article.articleHeadline: ΟΗΕ: Πρόοδος κατά του Έμπολα, ανησυχία για την ασφάλεια
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Progress against Ebola, concerns about security.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches over 11,000 confirmed cases six months after it began in mid-May, marking it as the second-worst on record with spread across eastern, central, and western Africa. The surge is linked to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there are no approved therapies or vaccines. WHO reports encouraging declines in cases in Bunia, eastern DRC, but warns the virus is advancing into more rural and hard-to-reach areas amid rising insecurity that hampers response. Approximately 80 attacks have targeted health facilities and workers. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) cautions about ongoing supply shortages and uncontrolled transmission. The UN acknowledges progress but highlights persistent transmission in remote regions, underscoring continued challenges for outbreak control and health-system protection.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:エボラ対策で進展、治安面への懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が11,000例を超え史上2番目の規模となり、ワクチン・治療薬のない希少株(ブンディブギョ株)が拡大、治安悪化により対応が困難化しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域に'Africa'(大陸)が含まれるが対象国ではないため除外。Buniaは東部DRC内の都市であり国としてはDRCに統合。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil supera los mil casos de mpox en 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil surpasses one thousand mpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil, as of November 13, 2026, reports 1,023 confirmed cases, 46 probable, 581 suspected, and one associated death. The distribution is led by Rio de Janeiro with 390 cases and Sao Paulo with 388, followed by Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), the Federal District (41), and Santa Catarina (24). Of confirmed cases this year, 293 occurred in October and 227 in November. Since surveillance began, Brazil has recorded 15,455 mpox infections and 19 deaths. Mpox virus (MPXV) is an Orthopoxvirus zoonosis, mainly spread via direct contact with lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects. Symptoms include skin eruptions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, chills, and fatigue. Brazil acquired 25,000 doses of mpox vaccine from a Danish manufacturer through PAHO; intradermal administration aims to extend coverage up to fivefold in high-risk groups (including people with HIV, PrEP users, and lab workers handling MPXV).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2026年のmpox症例が1000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでは2022年来のmpox流行が継続しており、今回の報告は累積症例数の定期更新に過ぎず、致死率も低く新規性・異常性は乏しいが、HIV陽性者など高リスク層での持続的伝播とワクチン接種拡大の動きがあり、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジルは既にmpoxの地域流行国であり、本記事は保健省等の定期サーベイランス報告に基づく累積数値の更新。重症度は低いが、PrEP利用者やHIV陽性者を含む高リスク層での伝播継続とワクチン接種拡大（PAHO経由のデンマーク製ワクチン2.5万回分）が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: Roundup: WHO warns Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains concerning amid rising infections, violence
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains deeply concerning six months after the May 15 declaration, with transmission intensifying in conflict-hit eastern provinces. As of Nov 10, DR Congo reported 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths (case fatality 48.9%), affecting 67 health zones across eight provinces. WHO notes high, sustained transmission with about 400–500 new cases weekly; 21 days ending Nov 7 saw 1,472 new cases, with declines in Ituri but a 31% rise in North Kivu. Violence hampers response: 81 attacks on health facilities since start; Nov 5 Cantine-Aloya attack in Beni killed 66 civilians, including three health workers, three facilities looted/burned, leaving hundreds of contacts unmonitored. Cross-border risks persist with Kenya reporting 9 cases (2 deaths) and Nigeria one imported case; no sustained transmission. WHO enhances cross-border surveillance; two experimental vaccines against Bundibugyo virus recommended for Tumaini trial, candidates include ChAdOx1.

triage.headline_ja: まとめ：WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は感染増加と暴力の中で依然として懸念される状況にあると警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行が深刻化（死亡率約49%、週400-500例の新規感染）し、国境を越えた拡散（ケニア・ナイジェリア）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア（9例、2死亡）およびナイジェリア（輸入例1）での越境感染が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。紛争による保健施設への攻撃（81件）が対応を著しく妨げている点も重要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: armed groups unrest hold back response - Media Monitors Network (MMN)
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as armed groups repeatedly attack civilians and frontline health workers, UN responders said on Friday. Ongoing violence and insecurity are obstructing efforts to stop transmission, hindering surveillance, case management, and access to affected communities. No case or death counts are provided in the report. As of 2026-11-13, the outbreak remains unsettled due to impediments posed by armed groups, with transmission control measures and response activities disrupted. The piece highlights that attacks target both civilians and health personnel, complicating international and local response coordination. No details on infection source or imported/exported cases are mentioned. Location: DRC; Disease: Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ・エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：武装勢力による騒乱が対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症がDRCで継続流行し、武装勢力の攻撃により対応・サーベイランスが妨げられている状況はIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡数は本記事に記載なし。武装勢力による攻撃がサーベイランスと対応活動を妨げている点が主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: OHE: χαιρετίζει την πρόοδο στην αντιμετώπιση του Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: OHE: welcomes progress in addressing Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, WHO officials welcomed progress but warned the virus continues to spread in remote, dangerous areas. Confirmed cases have surpassed 11,000, making it the second-worst Ebola outbreak on record, extending across parts of East, Central, and West Africa, and linked to the Bundibugyo strain for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. Case numbers have declined in former epicenters such as Bunia in eastern DRC, but new infections are reported in more rural, hard-to-reach districts. Insecurity remains a major obstacle, with about 80 attacks on health facilities and workers cited by the WHO. MSF cautioned about supply shortages and ongoing, uncontrolled transmission. Julien Arnis, UN Ebola emergency coordinator, said the area of operations is vast, but in 80% of locales teams can still operate.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:エボラ対策の進展を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は確認症例が11,000例を超え史上2番目に深刻な規模となっており、治療法・ワクチンのないBundibugyo株が複数地域に拡大、ヘルスケア施設への攻撃も頻発しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMozambique、Angolaが含まれるが記事本文での言及はなく、主題はDRC（Bunia含む東部・中部・西部アフリカにまたがる拡大）であるため、対象国リストに該当するDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Warning over peptides after batch contaminated with bacteria
article.articleSummary: Canada’s Health Canada warned about unauthorized peptides contaminated with Sphingomonas aquatilis/melonis found in an Ottawa-based retailer’s batch, prompting seizure of products from Sage & Summit Wellness Co. One testing batch contained the bacterium, which can cause bloodstream infection and sepsis, especially via injection or in immunocompromised individuals. The products, including BPC-157 and retatrutide (Eli Lilly), are not approved for medical use in Canada or the US, and injectables are generally regulated as prescriptions in Canada. Some vials bore 'For Research Purposes Only' labels and were not manufactured to safety standards. Health Canada has seized other illegal peptides—over 11,400 vials previously—imported via Shanghai ERP Peptide Biotechnology Co., some contaminated with bacteria, including the 'Wolverine Stack' (BPC-157 + TB-500). Authorities urge consumers not to purchase, discard existing supplies, and seek medical care if experiencing symptoms. Canada will continue enforcement with CBSA to disrupt illicit peptide shipments.

triage.headline_ja: ペプチド製品が細菌汚染、注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 感染症アウトブレイクではなく、未承認ペプチド製品（BPC-157等）の細菌汚染による製品回収・規制措置に関する記事であり、疾患名タグ『結核』は製品名TB-500との誤マッチングと考えられる。ヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の重大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名タグ『Tuberculosis』は誤分類（記事中の製品名TB-500に起因するものと推測）。実際の内容はカナダにおける未承認ペプチド製品の細菌汚染と規制当局による回収措置。上海は輸入元企業の所在地として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 50岁男子为清火明目，生吞新鲜蛇胆，3个月后手脚不听使唤、抽搐倒地，检查结果让人吓一跳：脑子里长满寄生虫；医生：不要迷信偏方
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 50-year-old man swallows fresh snake gallbladder to clear heat and improve eyesight; three months later his hands and feet no longer obeyed his commands, he convulsed and collapsed; the test results were shocking: his brain was filled with parasites; the doctor says: Don't rely on folk remedies.
article.articleSummary: A 50-year-old man in Taizhou, Zhejiang swallowed fresh snake gallbladder to “clear heat” and improve eyesight. About 2–3 months later he developed left-sided weakness and convulsions, collapsing at home. Neuroimaging showed widespread punctate brain lesions and a peanut-sized intracranial cyst; diagnosed as neurocysticercosis caused by Taenia solium (pork tapeworm) infection. The doctors linked the brain infection to ingestion of raw snake products, which can introduce parasite eggs into the body; larvae migrate to the brain causing seizures, hemiparesis, vision loss, and incontinence. After treatment, his motor function largely recovered, but ongoing medication and regular follow-up are required. The piece cautions that snake gallbladder and similar folk remedies are unsafe and carry high parasitic risk. It also notes that in China, eating snakes (wild or farmed) is prohibited; snakes may only be used for medicine, display, or research, not food.

triage.headline_ja: 50歳男性、清熱明目のため生の蛇の胆を飲み込み、3か月後に手足が麻痺し痙攣して倒れる。検査結果に衝撃：脳内に寄生虫が増殖。医師「民間療法を妄信しないで」
triage.triage_reason: 個人の民間療法による単発の有鉤嚢虫症症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の広がりのリスクはなく、社会的・政治的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は蛇の胆（生）摂取による個人的な有鉤条虫（Taenia solium）感染であり、感染症のアウトブレイクや流行とは無関係。公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola ở Congo diễn biến xấu, nguy cơ lập kỷ lục mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo worsens, risk of setting a new record.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsens; six months into the mid-May outbreak, Ebola Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain continues spreading with over 11,000 confirmed cases, making it the second-largest outbreak in history. MSF warns infections remain under-detected, with healthcare facilities experiencing severe transmission and virus spreading beyond control. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Despite substantial funding, frontline responders face shortages: undertrained or unpaid health workers, ambulances without fuel, insufficient surveillance staff and medical supplies to handle suspected cases safely. MSF urges the DRC government and UN agencies, including WHO, to ensure resources reach those in need. The DRC government has not issued an official response. Epidemiologist Neil Ferguson notes ongoing case detection challenges and warns the outbreak could continue into next year, potentially surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (28,600+ cases, 11,000+ deaths).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が悪化、新記録樹立のリスク
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が11,000例を超え史上2番目の規模に達し、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ医療リソース不足が深刻化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCでの流行のみを主題としており、Angolaへの言及はないため除外した。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株であり、西アフリカ流行（2014-2016年）を上回る可能性が指摘されている点は特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: إشادة أممية بالتقدم في مكافحة إيبولا بالكونغو وتحذير من انعدام الأمن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN commends progress in the fight against Ebola in Congo and warns of insecurity.
article.articleSummary: UN health officials laud progress against Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, noting declines in Bunia and Nizi, but warn the outbreak persists in rural, hard-to-reach areas amid insecurity and attacks on health workers. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) cautions that the virus remains uncontrolled, with shortages of supplies and trained staff, urging concrete support from the DRC government and UN agencies. Epidemiologist Neil Ferguson warns ongoing transmission could continue for over a year, estimating 2,000–3,000 current infections. WHO Emergency Programme head Chikwe Ihekweazu attributes early gains to fewer cases in former hotspots yet emphasizes monitoring in a vast, insecure region, with 80 assaults on facilities and staff to date. UN Ebola response coordinator Julian Harries notes the area is enormous but operations are feasible about 80% of the time. After six months, confirmed cases exceed 11,000; Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴでのエボラ対策の進展を称賛するも治安悪化に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: DRCで確認症例が11,000例を超え、Bundibugyo株には承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、治安悪化により制御が困難な状況が続いているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中アウトブレイクの続報だが、11,000例超・治安悪化・ワクチン未承認（Bundibugyo株）という重大要素が継続しており、WHO・MSF・UNが国際支援の必要性を強調している。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina confirma 24 casos de mpox em 2026 em meio à alta de registros no país - Visor Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina confirms 24 mpox cases in 2026 amid a surge in reported cases nationwide - Visor Notícias
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil reached 24 confirmed cases in Santa Catarina for 2026 as of November 12, according to the Health Ministry monitoring dashboard. Nationally, Brazil totals 1,023 diagnosed, 46 probable, 581 suspected, and 1 death in 2026. Santa Catarina is among states with higher counts, with Rio de Janeiro leading at 390 and São Paulo at 388, followed by Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), and Distrito Federal (41). In October, 293 cases were confirmed nationwide, and by November 12, 227 more cases were reported, together representing more than half of 2026 confirmations. Mpox virus MPXV is transmitted mainly by direct contact with lesions, body fluids, or contaminated objects, and also through prolonged close contact and respiratory secretions; disease is typically mild to moderate. Brazil has purchased 25,000 mpox vaccine doses; since notifications began, 15,455 cases and 19 deaths have been recorded.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、2026年の国内症例急増の中でmpox24例を確認 - Visor Notícias
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でmpox症例が継続的に急増しており(2026年累計1,023確定例、死亡例あり)、保健省が監視・ワクチン調達など対応を強化していることから、社会的・政治的関心とスクリーニング基準の該当が認められる。
triage.notes: Mpoxはブラジルで既に地域流行が確認されている疾患であり、今回の報告は国内サーベイランスによる症例数増加の継続的報告。重症度は軽度〜中等度が主体だが、死亡例の累積(19例)やワクチン調達など政府対応の動きから経過観察・評価の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 14個月大女童流感併發腦病變不治　屬本港今年第3宗兒童死亡個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 14-month-old girl dies from influenza with encephalopathy; Hong Kong's third pediatric death this year.
article.articleSummary: A 14-month-old girl in Hong Kong died from influenza A(H1) with acute necrotizing encephalopathy and multi-organ failure. Respiratory sample tested positive for influenza A(H1); she was transferred from Tseung Kwan O Hospital to United Christian Hospital’s Pediatric Intensive Care Unit for advanced care. Preliminary investigation found no travel during the incubation period and that she had not received the seasonal flu vaccine. A household contact had recent mild upper respiratory symptoms but recovered without hospitalization. The Centre for Health Protection reported influenza activity remains above baseline despite some easing in recent weeks. Since late June, the flu season has lasted over four months with 29 severe pediatric influenza cases: 22 recovered, 2 stable, 2 critical, and 3 deaths; this patient is one of the three pediatric fatalities this year. As of 13 November 2026, Hong Kong’s third pediatric death this year.

triage.headline_ja: 14ヶ月女児がインフルエンザ併発脳症で死亡　香港で今年3人目の小児死亡例
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザA(H1)の重症小児死亡例であり、新規性・異常性は認められないが、重症小児例が継続していることから経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1)による小児重症/死亡例の定例報告。渡航歴なし、ワクチン未接種。流行株の変異や異常拡大の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: ملل متحد از پیشرفت در مهار ایبولا خبر داد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations reports progress in containing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases and about 5,400 deaths since it was first identified in mid-May. UN and WHO report progress in containment, with fewer cases in previously affected areas, but new infections are now detected in more rural, remote regions with limited access, and rising insecurity continues to hinder response. The outbreak has seen 80 armed attacks on health facilities and workers. MSF warns many cases remain unidentified six months in, with transmission widespread and not under control. UN Ebola envoy Julien Harnais says the operational area is vast, though responders can operate in roughly 80% of it. There is no vaccine or therapy approved for Bundibugyo; WHO notes Ervebo (Zaire ebolavirus vaccine) will enter full human trials in DRC to test cross-protection against Bundibugyo. The only other Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012), both much smaller.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ出血熱の封じ込めに進展があったと発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス流行で11,000例超・死者約5,400人に達し、治療薬・ワクチン未承認かつ治安悪化により対応が困難化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは過去の小規模流行の文脈で言及されているのみで、現行アウトブレイクの発生地ではないため除外。現在の流行はDRCイトゥリ州に限定。

article.articleHeadline: São José da Lapa suspende aulas após casos de sarna nas escolas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São José da Lapa suspends classes after cases of scabies in schools.
article.articleSummary: São José da Lapa, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan region, suspended classes in all municipal schools and child centers (Cemeis) on 13 November 2026 after confirmed human scabies cases. Municipal facilities NAPE, Educarte, and Bombeiro Mirim were also closed for cleaning and preventive work, with normal activities expected to resume on 16 November. In nearby Vespasiano, Greater Belo Horizonte, municipal schools have been closed since 12 November through 17 November after scabies was confirmed in five municipal schools and one state unit; disinfection procedures will be conducted and updates shared with parents via school channels. Scabies is a skin disease caused by a mite, presenting with intense itching and possible small skin lesions. Transmission occurs mainly through prolonged direct contact and, less commonly, via sharing clothing or towels. Authorities advise healthcare consultation for persistent itching or skin changes and adherence to prescribed treatment.

triage.headline_ja: サンジョゼ・ダ・ラパ、学校での疥癬症例確認後に授業を休止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は一般的に重症度が低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない局地的な学校での発生であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。地域的な学校閉鎖対応であり、地方自治体レベルで管理可能な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Παγκόσμια ανησυχία: Φόβοι για νέα πανδημία στη Ρωσία - Εμφανίστηκε και δεύτερη μυστηριώδης ασθένεια
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global concern: Fears of a new pandemic in Russia — a second mysterious disease has emerged.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, Russia faces renewed pandemic fears amid reports of a second mysterious disease. State media note dozens of tourists have been infected by a previously unidentified infection, with officials not yet confirming the pathogen. Health authorities have launched an urgent investigation after cases of severe illness were documented in Russian holidaymakers who visited Nha Trang, a popular tourist city in Vietnam, within the past two months. The article provides no laboratory confirmation, official case counts, or symptom details. The situation highlights travel-associated health concerns, involving residents and travelers, as authorities work to determine the infection source and whether further cases have been imported or could spread beyond this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な懸念:ロシアで新たなパンデミックへの懸念 — 第二の謎の病気が出現
triage.triage_reason: 病原体未特定・検査確認なしの『謎の病気』でロシア人観光客がベトナム・ニャチャンで感染したとされるが、詳細情報が乏しく続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は未確認情報が多く、病原体・症状・検査結果の詳細が不明。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。実際の発生地（感染源の可能性が高い場所）はベトナムのニャチャンとされるため、Vietnamのみ verified_locations に含めた。続報待ちでWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: La ONU alerta de un aumento de la inseguridad alimentaria en RDC por el conflicto y los brotes de enfermedades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN warns of rising food insecurity in the DRC due to the conflict and disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: UN agencies warn that conflict and disease outbreaks are deepening hunger in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 30 million people projected to face severe food insecurity by mid-2027. IPC mid-2027 projections show 30.3 million in acute food-insecurity crisis from January to June 2027, up from 26.5 million in the first half of 2026, including 4.2 million in emergency. The Ebola outbreak—nearly 11,200 cases and about 5,500 deaths in under six months—adds to other outbreaks of pneumonia and cholera, straining the health system. The eastern provinces bear the heaviest burden: over 11 million residents in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri are expected to be in crisis, with nine territories (Lubero, Masisi, Oicha; Fizi, Kalehe, Mwenga, Shabunda, Walungu; Djugu) in emergency. Other affected areas include Tanganyika, Maniema, Kasaï, Haut-Lomami, Lomami, Kwango and Alto Uélé. Children under five face high malnutrition risk. Calls for urgent, safe access, large-scale food assistance and increased funding.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴ民主共和国における紛争と感染症流行による食料不安の増大を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（約11,200例・死亡約5,500人）に加えコレラ・肺炎も流行し、紛争下で3000万人超が深刻な食料不安に直面するなど、公衆衛生・人道両面で深刻な影響が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が極めて高く（約49%）通常のエボラ流行より深刻化している可能性があり、数値の正確性について続報確認が必要。対象国リストにある国のうち記事主題として扱われているのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: الإصابات تتجاوز 11 ألف حالة بالكونغو.. تحذيرات من خروح "إيبولا" عن السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infections exceed 11,000 cases in Congo; warnings that Ebola is getting out of control.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 11,000 confirmed cases, making this the second-largest outbreak by case count. The epidemic, which began mid-May, is driven by a rare Bundibugyo strain for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. The UN and World Health Organization report some regional improvements, with case reductions in urban hotspots such as Bunia in eastern DRC, but new infections continue in rural and hard-to-reach areas, complicating containment. Security deteriorates, with about 80 attacks on health facilities and personnel, constraining access to affected communities and the delivery of care. MSF offers a bleaker assessment due to ongoing transmission and supplies shortages. UN Ebola emergency chief notes the operation spans vast terrain and remains limited by access and security.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで感染者数が11,000例を超える…エボラが制御不能になるとの警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）流行が11,000例を超え、治療薬・ワクチンがなく、治安悪化でアクセス困難という異常事態であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 治療薬・ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による大規模流行で、治安悪化がアクセスと封じ込めを妨げている。国際支援（UN、WHO、MSF）が既に関与しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Drones ajudam a identificar focos de dengue em locais de difícil acesso em Estância Velha; confira imagens | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drones Help Identify Dengue Hotspots in Hard-to-Reach Areas in Estância Velha; Check Out Images | abc+.
article.articleSummary: Estância Velha, Brazil, uses drones operated by the Municipal Civil Guard to identify dengue hotspots by inspecting hard-to-reach properties for Aedes aegypti—the transmitter of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Implemented about three years ago, the program complements traditional health surveillance by surveying pools, water tanks, cisterns, and gutters from up to 120 meters altitude. In 2026, 86 properties were inspected with drone assistance; in 80% of confirmed hotspots, owners were notified and resolved the issue. In 2025, inspections reached 102 properties. Health Surveillance biologist Karen Krause notes drones guide targeted verifications, with joint operations gathering addresses for on-site follow-up. Drones do not replace in-person visits; each agent typically inspects 20–25 residences daily, totaling about 100 properties per day and 500 per week. Training has spread to Novo Hamburgo, São Leopoldo, and Sapiranga. El Niño-linked weather increases rainfall and sun, raising dengue risk and prompting ongoing prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ドローンがエスタンシア・ヴェーリャのアクセス困難地域でデング熱発生源の特定を支援;画像で確認 | abc+
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介疾患対策（ドローンを用いた予防活動）に関する内容であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の予防・サーベイランス活動（ドローン活用）を紹介する内容であり、症例数や重症度に関する具体的データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: જામનગરમાં મિશ્ર ઋતુને કારણે રોગચાળા વકર્યો: ડેન્ગ્યુ, મલેરિયા સહિતના મચ્છરજન્ય રોગોના કેસમાં સતત વધારો
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Jamnagar, the outbreak has spread due to the transitional season: a continuous rise in dengue, malaria, and other mosquito-borne diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, Jamnagar is experiencing a surge in mosquito-borne diseases linked to the mixed season. Dengue and malaria cases are rising, with more than 10 cases per day reported over the past 15 days. At GJ Hospital's OPD in Jamnagar, about 2,000 patients seek treatment daily. Common symptoms among patients include cold, fever, breathlessness, and vomiting. The medicine department is recording 100–150 more patients than on ordinary days. Health authorities have urged residents to remain vigilant and maintain cleanliness to curb transmission. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムナガルで季節の変わり目により疫病が悪化：デング熱、マラリアなど蚊媒介性疾患の症例が継続的に増加
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域で季節性のデング熱・マラリア症例が増加しているが、検査確認や重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染等の詳細情報がなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性の蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱・マラリア）の増加であり、毎年発生し得る地域的な公衆衛生問題。検査確認情報や死亡者数などの重症度データが不足しているため、WATCHとして経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: OMS admite que avanços no combate à Ébola são frágeis após quase meio ano de epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO admits that progress in the fight against Ebola is fragile after nearly six months into the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists near six months after being declared May 15, with WHO declaring an international emergency two days later. Official figures exceed 5,400 deaths and at least 11,042 confirmed cases, yielding a case fatality around 48.9%. Weekly cases now 400–500, down from a peak of 700–800, with Bunia the main epicenter showing reduced transmission and lower bed occupancy in treatment centers. Security constraints—armed violence in eastern and northern regions—hamper access, interrupt surveillance and care, and drive displacement, with WHO recording more than 80 attacks on facilities and health workers. MSF criticizes a disconnect between mobilized resources and aid reaching affected areas. The UN-led humanitarian plan seeks about $2.210 million (roughly €19.994 million). Four UN agencies warn that 30.3 million people in DRC may face acute food insecurity in early 2027, underscoring broader humanitarian strain in Ituri and North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ流行開始から半年近くが経過し対策の進展は脆弱であると認める
triage.triage_reason: WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済みのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、死者5,400人超・致死率約48.9%と深刻かつ長期化しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOはすでに国際的緊急事態を宣言済みであり、本記事は半年経過時点での進捗評価・治安情勢（武装勢力による医療施設攻撃80件超）・人道支援資金（約22億ユーロ規模）に関する続報。食料不安（3030万人）の悪化も指摘されており、複合的人道危機の様相。

article.articleHeadline: Child previously reported as severe case of paediatric influenza infection passes away
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed influenza A death in a 14-month-old girl in Hong Kong on November 13, announced by the Centre for Health Protection; the case was classified as severe on October 29, the third paediatric influenza fatality in Hong Kong this year. The influenza season began in late June and has lasted over four months; overall activity remains above baseline despite a recent decline. A cumulative 29 severe paediatric influenza infections have been reported this season: 22 recovered/discharged; 2 stable; 2 critical; 3 deaths. Unvaccinated children face about five times higher risk of severe complications or death than vaccinated peers. Seasonal influenza vaccination (SIV) has been underway for about two months, with adequate vaccine supply and access at roughly 270 public-service points and 3,200+ private vaccination sites, plus 1,900 private doctors under the Vaccination Subsidy Scheme. High-risk individuals should wear masks and seek urgent care if symptoms worsen (shortness of breath, blue lips, chest pain, persistent fever, convulsions).

triage.headline_ja: 小児の重症インフルエンザ感染症例として以前報告されていた子どもが死亡（香港）
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児死亡例だが、香港では例年の流行パターン内であり、IHR基準には該当しない。重症例・死亡例の継続報告があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港政府衛生防護中心（CHP）による公式発表に基づく季節性インフルエンザの重症小児例報告。今季3例目の死亡で、流行は例年の季節性パターン内と見られ、ワクチン供給・医療体制も整っているため国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ただし重症例の継続があるため動向注視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Φόβοι για νέα πανδημία στη Ρωσία εκφράζουν ειδικοί | AlphaTV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts express fears of a new pandemic in Russia | AlphaTV
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Russian tourists who visited Nha Trang, Vietnam, report high fever, headache, runny nose, and persistent cough, prompting Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor to investigate potential illness. Official cause is not yet determined; authorities have requested data from Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and Russian tour operators. Local Vietnamese doctors have not pinpointed a specific pathogen; preliminary assessments attribute symptoms to an influenza strain circulating regionally, while awaiting lab results from Hanoi. Russian authorities remain vigilant; the Russian Association of the Tourism Industry says no widespread complaints, and the Russian consulate in Ho Chi Minh City reports no formal aid requests. Moscow physicians urge calm, suggesting the cases may reflect seasonal respiratory infections or known influenza strains, with no evidence of a new pathogen. This follows a separate Coxsackie virus concern in Russian tourists in Vietnam and a prior Siberian bubonic plague scare linked to an Irkutsk plague research employee’s death and quarantine of contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで新たなパンデミックへの懸念を専門家が表明
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム訪問後のロシア人観光客に発熱・咳等の症状が報告されているが、病原体は未特定で専門家は季節性インフルエンザの可能性が高いとし沈静化を呼びかけている。確証に乏しく続報を要する。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア国内メディアによる懸念報道で、病原体未特定・専門家は否定的見解。過去のコクサッキーウイルスやシベリアのペスト事例は別件として言及されているのみで、本イベントの主題ではない。ロシア（Russia）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Νέοι φόβοι για πανδημία στη Ρωσία μετά την εμφάνιση δεύτερης μυστηριώδους ασθένειας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New fears of a pandemic in Russia after the emergence of a second mysterious disease.
article.articleSummary: Russia faces renewed fears of a pandemic as a second mysterious illness emerges, affecting both residents and tourists. Within two months, online reports describe dozens of tourists infected by this new, unknown infection, intensifying public concern. Health authorities have launched an urgent investigation into the cases of severe illness among Russian vacationers. The state news agency RIA says the inquiry is progressing, as officials seek to identify the illness’s scope, characteristics, and potential public health risks. The epidemiological picture centers on Russian holidaymakers who had visited Nha Trang, a popular tourist city in Vietnam. Investigators are examining whether the illnesses are linked to travelers’ return from that region, with authorities stressing the rapid response underscores worries about possible wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで2例目の謎の病気が発生し、パンデミックへの新たな懸念
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の疾患がロシア人観光客の間で複数報告され、国際的な拡大懸念があるため、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）が2つ以上該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア国内（およびロシア人観光客）で発生した原因不明疾患であり、ベトナム（ニャチャン）は渡航歴として言及されているのみで、ベトナム国内での発生は確認されていないため対象国として含めない。疾患の病原体・感染経路は未特定であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den verem raporu: Bir yılda 1,13 milyon kişi hayatını kaybetti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO tuberculosis report: 1.13 million people died in one year.
article.articleSummary: 2025 global tuberculosis: 10.6 million new infections and 1.13 million deaths (down from 1.18 million in 2024; ~4%). Mortality since 2015 declined 35%, but the 75% reduction target by 2020 was missed. Incidence in 2025 is ~129 per 100,000, down from 131 in 2024; a 14% reduction since 2015, short of the 50% goal. About 2.2 million of the 10.6 million estimated cases were not diagnosed or treated in 2025; only 59% of diagnosed patients received rapid diagnostic tests initially. The burden is highly concentrated: eight countries hold about two-thirds of cases; India accounts for ~25%, followed by Indonesia (10%), Philippines (6.8%), China (6.5%), Pakistan (6.4%), with Nigeria, DRC and Bangladesh also affected. Rifampicin-resistant TB: ~370,000 cases; only 155,333 treated (~42%). Treatment success: ~90% for drug-susceptible TB; ~70% for rifampicin-resistant TB. International TB funding fell 14% to $940M in 2025; domestic funding rose to $5.63B; WHO urges $22B/year by 2027.

triage.headline_ja: WHO結核報告書：年間113万人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: WHOの年次結核報告書による世界全体の統計発表であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではないため、個別のシグナルとしての対応は不要。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOの年次世界結核報告書に基づく統計データの発表であり、個別の突発的な感染症イベントではない。結核は既知の慢性的な公衆衛生課題であり、資金不足や薬剤耐性結核の増加など構造的な課題が指摘されているが、緊急シグナルとしてのトリアージ対象ではなくDISMISS判定とした。
