article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 em alta: Fiocruz aponta avanço de SRAG e especialistas explicam sintomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 on the rise: Fiocruz points to an increase in Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) and experts explain symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Five Brazilian states—São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Distrito Federal, Mato Grosso, and Santa Catarina—trigger warnings as Fiocruz reports a renewed rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) linked to COVID-19. Though overall levels remain well below pandemic peaks, SARS-CoV-2 accounts for 24.1% of laboratory-identified virus deaths in the last four weeks, ranking as the second leading mortality driver among monitored respiratory viruses in Brazil. Experts attribute this to hybrid immunity from prior infections and vaccination, which cushions severe lung disease and ICU overload. Clinically, the pattern has shifted from loss of smell/taste and early dyspnea to upper-airway symptoms resembling a strong cold: sore throat, nasal congestion, runny nose, dry cough, muscle fatigue, and moderate fever. Testing—antigen or RT-PCR—should occur ideally on days 2–4 after onset. Positive results warrant home isolation for five days and mask use around vulnerable groups; seek medical care promptly if warning signs appear.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19が増加傾向：フィオクルスが重症急性呼吸器感染症（SARI）の増加を指摘、専門家が症状を解説
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でCOVID-19関連のSARIが増加しているが、パンデミックピークを大きく下回り、季節性の範囲内と見られるため、継続的な動向確認が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: SARS-CoV-2は過去4週間の呼吸器ウイルス関連死因の24.1%を占め、死亡原因として第2位だが、全体水準はパンデミック期より大幅に低く、ハイブリッド免疫により重症化が抑制されているとされる。ブラジル国内の公衆衛生機関（Fiocruz）による定例的なサーベイランス報告の範囲と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode desencadear mais casos de dengue no verão | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño may trigger more dengue cases in the summer | abc+.
article.articleSummary: El Niño-driven conditions could boost dengue transmission in Brazil during the 2026/2027 summer, with heat and humidity aiding Aedes aegypti reproduction and standing-water containers creating breeding sites. A projection by Fiocruz, Fundação Getúlio Vargas (FGV) and partners estimates about 860,000 probable dengue cases in Brazil in 2027, with a peak in April around 40,000 weekly cases; while not mirroring the 2024 outbreak, risk persists. In Rio Grande do Sul, Novo Hamburgo leads 2026 dengue cases with 1,146 confirmed, about 65% fewer than 2025; Porto Alegre ranks 20th with 15 cases this year. Other Vale do Sinos municipalities among top 20: Estância Velha (4th), São Leopoldo (5th), Campo Bom (8th), Canoas (10th), Sapiranga (11th), Dois Irmãos (14th), Sapucaia do Sul (18th), Esteio (19th). Regional arbovirus activity includes dengue, with potential transmission of Zika and chikungunya by Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョが夏季のデング熱症例増加を引き起こす可能性 | abc+
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける季節性デング熱の将来予測・注意喚起記事であり、既知の流行病に関する定例的な報道で新規性・異常性は低いが、気候要因による拡大リスクへの言及があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の将来予測・季節性リスクに関する一般的な報道であり、突発的な異常事態ではない。ジカ熱・チクングニア熱は同じベクターによる潜在的リスクとして言及されているのみで、実際の症例急増ではない。

article.articleHeadline: São José da Lapa interrompe aulas nesta sexta-feira (13) para higienizar escolas após casos de escabiose - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São José da Lapa suspends classes this Friday the 13th to disinfect schools after cases of scabies - BH 24 Horas.
article.articleSummary: Sao Jose da Lapa in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area suspends schools this Friday, November 13, to disinfect classrooms after confirmed scabies cases among students and staff. The preventive closure, guided by Health Surveillance, aims to reduce transmission and protect pupils, teachers, and other school personnel; classes are expected to resume Monday, November 16. A video explains that scabies is caused by a mite and causes intense itching and skin lesions; transmission occurs mainly through prolonged direct contact, with possible spread via shared clothing, towels, or bedding. Those with persistent itching or skin changes should seek medical care, and doctors may treat close contacts as needed to interrupt transmission. The article notes additional suspensions: Vespasiano halted classes on Nov 12–13 and 16–17, with return planned Nov 18; Lagoa Santa had 178 confirmed cases in September, 253 total notifications, and 12 new cases in the last 24 hours, prompting school closures.

triage.headline_ja: サンジョゼ・ダ・ラパ、疥癬症例発生を受け学校を消毒するため金曜13日の授業を中止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的に重大な公衆衛生リスクとはならないが、学校閉鎖や複数自治体での集団発生が続いているため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒト-ヒト接触による感染症で重症度は低いが、学校単位での集団発生が複数自治体（Vespasiano, Lagoa Santaなど）で継続しており、地域の公衆衛生当局が対応中。国際的な拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Παγκόσμια ανησυχία: Φόβοι για νέα πανδημία στη Ρωσία - Εμφανίστηκε και δεύτερη μυστηριώδης ασθένεια
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global concern: Fears of a new pandemic in Russia - a second mysterious disease has appeared.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Russian tourists in the Vietnamese resort city of Nha Trang have fallen ill with a mysterious infection, prompting an inquiry by Russian health authorities. Patients report a striking symptom cluster: high fever, severe headaches, runny nose, and a persistent, intense cough lasting weeks. Vietnamese clinicians say the illness resembles circulating influenza, but doctors struggle to pinpoint a single cause. Rosporrebnadzor has formally asked Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and Russia’s Tour Operators’ Association for information about the outbreak. Russian tourism officials say there are no mass complaints and no Russians seeking official help in Ho Chi Minh City. Moscow experts urge calm, suggesting seasonal respiratory infections or common flu strains rather than a new pathogen. The case comes after earlier Siberian fears of a deadly plague tied to a death at an Irkutsk plague-research institute, and a pending Coxsackie virus inquiry in Vietnam, with Hanoi awaiting test results.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的懸念：ロシアで新たなパンデミックへの恐怖―2つ目の謎の病気が出現
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に原因不明の呼吸器症状が多発し、ロシア保健当局が公式に調査を要請するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・シベリアでのペスト疑惑やコクサッキーウイルス調査にも言及しているが、主題はベトナム・ニャチャンでのロシア人観光客の謎の呼吸器疾患。専門家は季節性インフルエンザの可能性を示唆しており、確定病原体は不明。ロシア（モスクワ、イルクーツク）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Duas linhagens do vírus da mpox são identificadas no Rio, aponta nota técnica elaborada por pesquisadores da UFRJ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two lineages of the mpox virus are identified in Rio de Janeiro, according to a technical note prepared by researchers from UFRJ.
article.articleSummary: Two mpox lineages (subclades Ib and IIb) are circulating in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, according to a Needier/UFRJ technical note. Surveillance shows mpox test positivity rising from 10.9% in 2025 to 30.4% by early November 2026; 181 positive results from 596 tests this year, with 68 of 89 positives in October (76.4%). Of the 2026 positives, 169 were male (93.4%), predominantly aged 20–39; Rio de Janeiro city accounts for 119 cases (65.7% of state total). Genomic analysis confirms simultaneous circulation of Ib and IIb; IIb is linked to the 2022 international outbreak, and Ib to Central Africa (Democratic Republic of the Congo). There is no evidence yet that either lineage causes more severe disease. Needier provides clinical care, sampling, and molecular diagnosis at Cidade Universitária, CCS, Avenida Carlos Chagas Filho 791; appointments via (21) 96845-8188.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロで2つのmpoxウイルス系統を確認、UFRJ研究者による技術ノートで判明
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロでDRC由来のクレードIbと国際的流行株IIbの同時流行が確認され、陽性率が10.9%から30.4%へ急上昇している点は異常かつ国際拡大のリスクを示唆するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCは系統Ibの起源地として言及されているのみで、実際の発生事象はブラジルのリオデジャネイロ州で起きているためDRCはverified_locationsから除外した。重症度の増加は現時点で確認されていないが、クレードIbの域外伝播とヒト-ヒト感染の継続が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique : inondations, famine, maladies... l'ONU alerte sur une catastrophe humanitaire qui menace des millions de personnes - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: floods, famine, and diseases... the UN warns of a humanitarian catastrophe threatening millions of people.
article.articleSummary: UN agencies warn Africa faces a humanitarian catastrophe driven by floods, famine and disease, with East Africa’s heavy rains causing displacement and heightened infectious-disease risks as well as a slow global fight against tuberculosis. In Somalia, some 170,000 people have been affected by floods; over 2,400 homes destroyed, about 5,900 damaged, 70 schools and 55 health facilities hit, and roughly 5,300 cattle lost. Burundi reports floods affecting over 46,000 people with many displaced and significant damage to schools and farmland. Kenya and Rwanda record displacement and fatalities; Tanzania experiences floods and landslides (1 death, 7 injuries). Ethiopia and South Sudan face droughts, with about 3.9 million Ethiopians needing emergency food and 1.83 million requiring WASH support. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, some 29 million people face a food-security crisis, with aid anticipated through early 2027, including Kinshasa and other regions per IPC-WFP-FAO-Unicef assessments.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：洪水、飢饉、疾病……国連は数百万人を脅かす人道的大惨事を警告
triage.triage_reason: 記事はアフリカ全体の洪水・飢饉による人道危機を扱う一般的な内容で、結核（Tuberculosis）については「世界的な対策の遅れ」という抽象的言及のみであり、特定国での具体的な結核発生・アウトブレイク情報は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカの洪水・飢饉による人道危機全般を扱っており、結核の具体的発生国や症例数などの情報は含まれていない。DRCは食料安全保障危機の文脈で言及されているが、結核発生とは直接関連しないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: O retorno do sarampo e a vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The return of measles and vaccination
article.articleSummary: Measles resurgence in the United States and the Americas highlights risks from falling vaccination coverage. Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia and encephalitis. According to PAHO, more than 95% of confirmed cases in 2026 are concentrated in the United States, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru and Canada. In the United States, 4,410 confirmed cases and 3 deaths were reported through October 15, 2026, the highest in over three decades, signaling how vaccine hesitancy and gaps in coverage enable spread beyond a city and into other countries. Brazil is also affected, with São Paulo reporting 40 confirmed cases in 2026 as of October 1; 30 of these patients had no vaccination or incomplete schedules. The MMR vaccine is given at 12 months with a second at 15 months; a 6–11 month dose may be used in certain situations. Adults should review immunization before international travel at least 15 days prior.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の再流行とワクチン接種について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル(サンパウロ)で麻疹40例確認され、うち30例が未接種または接種不完全であり、米州全体でワクチン忌避による拡大が報告されているため、流行しやすさ・異常性の観点からフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は米州全体（米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルー・カナダ）の麻疹流行を主題としているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジル（サンパウロ）のみ。サンパウロでは2026年に40例確認、うち30例がワクチン未接種または接種不完全。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تحذر من انتشار إيبولا في ريف الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of the spread of Ebola in the rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the World Health Organization. Six months into the outbreak, infections have declined in areas where cases first appeared, while numbers are rising in remote, hard-to-reach zones. In Bunia, some treatment centers are operating at only about half capacity. Access to distant areas remains difficult, even before militia clashes worsened security, complicating the creation of new treatment centers. The WHO is trying to boost flexibility and speed in its response to reach affected populations sooner, as UN OCHA’s Geneva emergency coordinator notes.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国農村部でのエボラ拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な疾患がDRCの遠隔地で拡大しており、治安悪化によりアクセス・対応が困難化しているため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: WHOおよびUN OCHAが言及する進行中のアウトブレイク（発生6か月目）。治安悪化と遠隔地アクセスの困難さが対応を妨げており、継続的な監視が必要。ジュネーブ・スイスは国際機関の所在地であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 这种容易被当成"感冒"的疾病，应该这样预防，@青岛人，市疾控中心提醒→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This disease that is easily mistaken for a common cold should be prevented this way; Qingdao residents, the Municipal Center for Disease Control and Prevention reminds you.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonia, not just a cold, should be watched in Qingdao, China. The Qingdao Municipal Center for Disease Control and Prevention warns that winter coughs and fevers may mask pneumonia, an infection of the lower respiratory tract that can be caused by bacteria, viruses, or mycoplasma; Streptococcus pneumoniae is a leading bacterial cause. Symptoms persisting with fever after three days, worsening cough, or breathing difficulties require attention. Vaccination options exist: 13-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide-conjugate vaccine for children 6 weeks through 5 years; 23-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine for people 2 years and older at higher risk (elderly, chronic illness, immunocompromised). Influenza vaccination also lowers risk of secondary bacterial pneumonia; recommended for those aged 6 months and up before flu season, with catch-up vaccination possible. Precautions include hand hygiene, cough etiquette, ventilation, mask-wearing in crowds, and healthy lifestyle.

triage.headline_ja: 「風邪」と間違えやすいこの病気、こう予防すべき——青島市民の皆さん、市疾病予防コントロールセンターより注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 肺炎球菌・インフルエンザに関する季節性の一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 疾病予防コントロールセンターによる季節性の健康啓発記事で、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Lapas Curup Bengkulu optimalkan pengendalian penyakit menular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Curup Prison, Bengkulu, optimizes infectious disease control.
article.articleSummary: Curup Prison (Lapas Kelas IIA Curup) in Rejang Lebong, Bengkulu, is intensifying infectious disease control focusing on tuberculosis (TB) and HIV for inmates (WBP) and staff. The initiative expands Free Health Checkups (Cek Kesehatan Gratis, CKG) and TB/HIV screening, supported by a Director General of Corrections directive (letter PAS.8.PK.08.03-089, dated 30 October 2026) on budget for CKG and TB screening. The program also funds antiretroviral (ARV) therapy for HIV-positive inmates and trains detainees to serve as health cadres, promoting early detection, prevention, and treatment. By engaging residents as health workers, the prison aims to enhance health access and foster a healthy, safe, productive, humane, and disease-free correctional environment, aligning with government public health objectives for inmates and staff.

triage.headline_ja: ブンクル州チュルプ刑務所、感染症対策を最適化
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内でのTB・HIVに対する定例的・予防的な健康管理プログラムの紹介であり、異常な発生や急性のアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は刑務所内の通常の公衆衛生プログラム（TB/HIVスクリーニング・ARV治療・ヘルスケア人材育成）の案内であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Cidasc mantém vigilância após casos de Newcastle no Oeste de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cidasc maintains surveillance after Newcastle disease cases in western Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease has been confirmed on five rural properties in western Santa Catarina, Brazil. All affected farms are currently in a sanitary fallow period, with the last farm—located in Nova Itaberaba—having completed cleaning and disinfection on 10 November, after which the region’s final sanitary barrier was dismantled. Despite lifting containment measures, Cidasc (the state agricultural defense agency) maintains active surveillance and producer guidance, conducting visits to commercial poultry operations and backyard poultry properties to monitor health status and reinforce biosecurity practices. The ongoing vigilance aims to ensure early detection and rapid response should new Newcastle disease cases emerge and to support producers in the post-outbreak phase. Timeframe referenced: as of 13 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: Cidasc、サンタカタリーナ州西部でのニューカッスル病発生後も監視体制を維持
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）における既知の疾病で、既に封じ込め済み・衛生対策完了の段階にあり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、本記事はヒト感染症ではない。既に5農場で封じ込め・消毒が完了し、衛生バリアも解除されている段階。州当局による通常の事後監視活動を報じたもので、新規感染拡大や公衆衛生リスクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: GHS launches second round of MDA against Onchocerciasis
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service launches the second round of its 2026 Mass Drug Administration (MDA) against Onchocerciasis (river blindness) from November 15–29 across 86 endemic districts in 15 regions, with free medication for eligible residents delivered by health workers and community drug distributors. Onchocerciasis, a parasite transmitted by infected blackflies, can damage skin and eyes and cause blindness, impairing work, schooling and livelihoods. Since interventions began in 1997, districts requiring treatment have fallen from 152 to 86. The first round (June 20–July 10) treated over 4.8 million people with 86.1% national coverage. Household registration gaps are a challenge; registration will be strengthened under Free Primary Healthcare and supervision improved. Noor Dubai FoundationMais (Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Global Initiatives) provides US$7.7 million for a three-year program—twice-yearly MDA, surveillance, and training—aiming to exceed 5 million people treated annually and US$410 million in economic benefits over 30 years, with elimination targeted by 2030. In Round 1, about 4.7 million across 86 districts were treated and 20,000 trained. The campaign emphasizes media collaboration and continued partner support.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ保健サービス、オンコセルカ症対策の集団投薬プログラム第2ラウンドを開始
triage.triage_reason: 既存の疾患制御プログラム（MDA）の定期実施に関する行政的な報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: オンコセルカ症は1997年から継続的に制御プログラムが行われている既知の風土病で、今回は定期的な集団投薬（MDA）の実施報告。2030年までの排除を目標とした計画的な公衆衛生活動であり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Huda nalezljiva bolezen se hitro širi: Med najbolj ogroženimi so otroci
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A serious infectious disease is spreading rapidly: Children are among the most at risk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases in the past six months, with about half of patients dying. The virus began undetected from February and the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. It has spread to eight provinces and crossed borders, with confirmed infections reported in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or approved targeted therapy. Frontline health workers warn the true toll may be higher. Ebola is highly contagious and quickly causes dehydration, inflammatory responses, coagulopathy, and organ failure; delaying treatment markedly increases mortality. Early symptoms resemble malaria, which can mislead clinicians and delay isolation and care. Health authorities urge heightened vigilance and rapid response at first signs of illness.

triage.headline_ja: 重篤な感染症が急速に拡大中：最も危険にさらされているのは子どもたち
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）が11,000例超・致死率約50%で8州に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみが対象国として該当。ワクチン・治療法未承認のBundibugyo株であり、マラリアとの症状類似による診断遅延リスクも指摘されている点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: Fiocruz alerta para alta de casos graves em seis estados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: Fiocruz warns of an increase in severe cases in six states.
article.articleSummary: Six Brazilian states and the Federal District show signals of growth in hospitalizations due to COVID-19–associated severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) per InfoGripe for the week ending 7 November 2026. Bahia, DF, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, and São Paulo report rising severe cases, though overall COVID-19 hospitalizations remain low. In Rio de Janeiro, increases are concentrated among people aged 65 years and older. Four capitals—Boa Vista (Roraima), João Pessoa (Paraíba), Porto Velho (Rondônia), and Rio de Janeiro (RJ)—are at alert to high risk for acute respiratory diseases, with patterns: Boa Vista and João Pessoa rising mainly in young children; Porto Velho in children up to 4 and adults 50–64; Rio de Janeiro in the elderly. Across four weeks, SARS-CoV-2 was identified in 11.5% of lab-confirmed SARS cases; rhinovirus led at 49%, RSV 8.9%, influenza A 4.3%, influenza B 3.9%. COVID-19 accounted for 26.9% of SRAG deaths with viral identification; rhinovirus 43.6%, influenza A 7.7%, influenza B 10.3%, RSV 2.6%. Vaccination and preventive measures are advised; no nationwide emergency.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：フィオクルス、6州で重症例増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内複数州でCOVID-19関連重症呼吸器疾患の増加が報告されているが、全体的な入院数は低水準で、全国的な緊急事態ではないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 複数州で季節性呼吸器疾患（COVID-19、RSV、インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス）の増加が報告されているが、COVID-19の検出率は11.5%と限定的でライノウイルスが主因。全国的な緊急事態宣言はなく、ワクチン接種等の通常対策が推奨されている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Thực hư lời đồn lây nhiễm HIV ở Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The truth behind rumors of HIV transmission in Đắk Lắk.
article.articleSummary: Rumors of HIV transmission in Ea Ning commune, Dak Lak Province, Vietnam prompted local authorities to act on 13 November 2026. The Ea Ning People's Committee, after coordination with the commune Health Center and police, reported no verified cases or credible evidence of ongoing HIV transmission. Officials urged residents to remain calm, avoid speculation, and not share unverified information that could affect community morale, privacy, or reputation. The commune police have summoned two individuals linked to disseminating the rumors to review the matter, and are compiling a dossier for potential legal action under applicable laws. Authorities emphasize obtaining information from official sources and exercising responsibility on social media to prevent misinformation and preserve public order.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でのHIV感染の噂の真相
triage.triage_reason: 地元当局がHIV感染の噂を調査した結果、確認された症例や信頼できる証拠はないと発表しており、公衆衛生上の実質的な脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症発生ではなく、HIV感染に関する根拠のない噂とそれに対する当局の対応（風説の流布者への法的措置検討を含む）を報じたもの。公衆衛生上の実際の脅威は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया और कालाजार के उन्मूलन के लिए शीघ्र जांच... | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid testing for the elimination of malaria and kala-azar... | UNI Varta
article.articleSummary: Lucknow, November 13, 2026: Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS) Microbiology Department, with WHO India, organized a one-day CME-cum-workshop titled 'Malaria and Kala-azar: From Laboratory to Elimination' at HG Khurana Auditorium, Rae Bareli Road, Lucknow. SGPGIMS Director Prof. RK Dhiman inaugurated the event, with Chief Medical Superintendent Dr. Devendra Kumar and WHO representatives in attendance. Experts highlighted rapid laboratory testing, effective treatment, and robust surveillance as essential to eliminating malaria and kala-azar (visceral leishmaniasis). The program underscores strengthening diagnostic confirmation and surveillance systems and reflects ongoing collaboration with WHO India to advance malaria and kala-azar elimination efforts in the region.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアとカラアザールの根絶に向けた迅速検査... | UNI Varta
triage.triage_reason: 記事は疾患アウトブレイクではなく、マラリア・カラアザール根絶に向けたCME/ワークショップ開催の報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾患の発生報告ではなく、WHO Indiaとの協働による教育イベント（ワークショップ）の開催を報じるもの。新規症例数や流行状況への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola nightmare is growing! 5,400 people have died, and one third of the dead are children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists after six months, with more than 11,000 infections and 5,400 deaths, according to WHO. Up to 500 new cases weekly. More than one-third of fatalities are children. Progress reported in Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi, Rwampara, and Butembo areas, where transmission has been substantially reduced; Bunia still sees transmission at serious levels. Over 80 attacks on health facilities in the past six months hinder response, complicating case finding and treatment. WHO official Chikwe Ihekweazu warned that despite some gains, outbreak control remains fragile and insufficient; continued violence disrupts access to health services and disease surveillance. Response partners stress ongoing operations and maintaining essential health and humanitarian services to prevent further spread and to strengthen health systems to withstand future outbreaks in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの悪夢が拡大！5,400人が死亡、死者の3分の1が子ども
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が6か月継続し、死者5,400人超・感染11,000人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、医療施設への攻撃等で対応が困難なため国際的拡大・管理支援の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ルワンダ（Kigali Province）は発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文ではDRC国内（Bunia, Butembo等）の流行に焦点が当てられており、ルワンダでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Covid: o que se sabe sobre a variante XFG e onde se vacinar em BH
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: What Is Known About the XFG Variant and Where to Get Vaccinated in Belo Horizonte
article.articleSummary: XFG, an Omicron subvariant, dominates Covid-19 in 2026 Brazil. In Belo Horizonte, test positivity reached 7% in epidemiological week 43 (Oct 25–31), the year’s high, with 27,885 suspected cases, 449 confirmations and nine deaths in 2026; eight deaths were in people 60+. Nationally, Covid-19–related influenza-like illness fell 68.8% to 118,851 cases through Oct 31; 3,400 SRAG cases and 437 deaths, though 18 states, including Minas Gerais, show a rise in mild cases. Vaccination remains central. Belo Horizonte’s routine immunization covers children 6 months–<5 years, pregnant people, and those 60+ (two doses per year, six months apart). Priority groups (immunocompromised; long-term care residents/workers; Indigenous; riverine; quilombolas; disabilities; comorbidities; health workers; prison system workers; socioeducational youths; postal workers; elder caregivers) may receive doses; 5–11 and 12+ in these groups get one annual dose. Vaccination centers operate in BH; registration at a center is required.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：XFG変異株について分かっていること、ベロオリゾンテでのワクチン接種場所
triage.triage_reason: 既知のオミクロン系統XFGに関する定例的な情報記事であり、全国的には症例数が減少傾向（インフルエンザ様疾患68.8%減）にあるため、特段の異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: ベロオリゾンテ市における地域的なワクチン接種案内と疫学状況の説明記事。全国的にはCOVID関連ILIが減少傾向で、XFGは既知の変異株であり新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly violence disrupting Ebola fight - health officials -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain and declared May 15, has spread to eight provinces, with DR Congo remaining the epicenter as of Nov 10. Across affected countries, 11,145 confirmed infections and 5,437 deaths (case fatality rate 48.8%) have been reported, with 3,058 recoveries as of the Nov 12 briefing. Attacks on health facilities and workers have hindered containment: at least 4 armed attacks, 16 assaults on emergency responders, and 11 facility-targeting incidents since May, with violence intensifying after late September. A deadly incident on Nov 5–6 in Cantine-Aloya, North Kivu, by the Allied Democratic Forces left 66 dead, including three health workers, and forced over 1,000 contacts to flee, disrupting follow-up. WHO warns insecurity blocks access to communities; incidents include a nurse killed and another worker injured in Tshopo. Kenya (nine cases) and Nigeria (one imported) are affected; Uganda and France reported cases but transmission is contained.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的な暴力がエボラ対策を妨害—保健当局
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8州に拡大し、致死率48.8%の深刻な公衆衛生危機となっている上、武装勢力による医療従事者・施設への攻撃が対応を妨げており、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されているため。
triage.notes: ケニア（9例）、ナイジェリア（輸入1例）、ウガンダ、フランスでも症例報告があるが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武装勢力（ADF）による攻撃が封じ込め活動を著しく阻害している点は特筆すべきリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 11.000 cas d'Ebola en RD Congo: des failles dans la riposte malgré des centaines de millions de dollars engloutis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 11,000 Ebola cases in DR Congo: gaps in the response despite hundreds of millions of dollars swallowed up.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,000 cases and 5,300 deaths as of November 2026, making it the second deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. The outbreak began in Ituri province (northeast) and, after a mid‑May declaration, spread to seven other provinces; Ituri and North Kivu hold most cases. The Bundibugyo strain drives transmission and, to date, there is no specific vaccine for this variant. The virus has crossed borders with cases in Uganda, Kenya, and Nigeria. MSF’s November 12 report highlights persistent response failures despite hundreds of millions of dollars mobilized: untrained or unpaid staff, fuel shortages for vehicles and ambulances, surveillance teams absent on the ground, community agents lacking phones or internet, and healthcare workers lacking equipment and technical support. Authorities have pledged stronger monitoring and transparency, but MSF urges concrete, rapid changes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ症例11,000人超：数億ドルを投入したにもかかわらず対応に不備
triage.triage_reason: エボラが11,000例・5,300人以上の死者を出し史上2番目の規模となり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへの越境事例も述べているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。対応体制の不備（人員未訓練・燃料不足・監視体制欠如）がMSFにより指摘されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC Clears 62 Ebola Contacts After 21-Day Monitoring, Confirms Zero Transmission
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Virus Disease (Ebola) in Nigeria: 62 contacts linked to the imported index case completed 21-day monitoring with zero transmission; last contact discharged on Nov 13, 2026. The index patient was evacuated to Switzerland on Oct 26, 2026, recovered and discharged after testing negative there. Thirteen monitored contacts developed fever or symptoms during monitoring, but all tested negative for Bundibugyo Virus Disease. Seven additional alerts from Adamawa, Rivers, Borno, Lagos, and Ekiti over the past three weeks were negative. The NCDC cautions that 21-day monitoring completion does not end the outbreak; Nigeria will maintain vigilance due to ongoing Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Response measures include activation of the National Emergency Operations Centre at Level 3, Incident Management System, intensified contact tracing, strengthened infection prevention and control, PPE provision, training, surveillance, event-based alerts, and public communication. Port Health measures continue; seek prompt care for fever and report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア疾病対策センター(NCDC)、21日間の経過観察を経てエボラ接触者62人の監視終了、感染ゼロを確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアに輸入されたエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)症例に関連する接触者62人全員が21日間の監視で陰性となり、二次感染は確認されなかった。ただし対象国リストに該当する国（DRC等）は本事例の直接発生地ではなく背景情報に留まるため、継続的な動向注視が妥当と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）。DRCは『エボラ活動が継続している』という文脈的言及のみで、本事例の発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。輸入症例起点の二次感染はゼロと確認され、状況は沈静化傾向にあるが、DRCでの継続流行を背景にナイジェリア当局が警戒を維持している点は留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tả lợn châu Phi phát tán rộng tại Vĩnh Long
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever is spreading widely in Vĩnh Long
article.articleSummary: African swine fever is spreading widely in Vĩnh Long province, Vietnam, now detected in 39 communes/wards with some re-infections and ongoing expansion. On November 13, provincial authorities held a meeting to implement control measures. Since the start of the year, about 4,500 pigs have been culled, totaling over 254 metric tons. A new virus strain with no suitable vaccine has been identified. Smallholder, backyard farming and underreporting of sick pigs heighten risk; commune-level veterinary capacity is limited, complicating containment. Provincial leaders demand accountability from local officials for preventing wide outbreaks and emphasize prompt detection, proper disposal of diseased animals, and strict control of pig transport and slaughter, with penalties for selling or moving sick/dead pigs of unknown origin. Three animal quarantine stations are proposed: Đại Ngãi 1 (Lưu Nghiệp Anh), Bình Minh (Cái Vồn), and Rạch Miễu (Phú Túc).

triage.headline_ja: ヴィンロン省でアフリカ豚コレラが拡大
triage.triage_reason: 新規ウイルス株の出現とワクチン未整備、39のコミューンへの拡大、地方当局の緊急会合開催など行政的関心が高く、WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価への移行が適当と判断。
triage.notes: 本事例は豚のアフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）であり、人への感染性はないため人の公衆衛生への直接影響はないが、食料安全保障・畜産経済・地域行政対応の観点から動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر من انتشار إيبولا في ريف الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of Ebola spread in the rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in rural Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading alarmingly, WHO warns. Six months into the outbreak, infections have declined in areas where cases first emerged, but numbers are rising in hard-to-reach rural zones. In Bunia, treatment centers operate at about half capacity, reflecting access and security constraints. Ongoing violence and unstable security hinder response, with Allied Democratic Forces militants responsible for recent deadly attacks: 66 civilians killed last week, including three health workers, and three health facilities looted and burned, per Africa CDC. WHO and UN OCHA stress the biggest challenge is the fragile security situation and call for a more decisive response. Latest Ministry of Health data report 11,042 Ebola cases and 5,387 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴ民主共和国の農村部でのエボラ拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行拡大を警告しており、死者数が非常に多く、治安悪化により対応が困難な状況であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事内の累計症例数・死亡者数（11,042例、5,387人死亡）は通常のエボラ流行規模を大きく超えており、情報の正確性について今後の続報での確認が必要。治安悪化（ADFによる攻撃）が対応を著しく阻害している点も重要な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Nigeria records zero secondary infections as 62 contacts exit monitoring
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Virus Disease (a form of Ebola) in Nigeria: 62 contacts linked to an imported index case in the Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) completed 21‑day monitoring with zero secondary transmission; none developed illness. The index patient was evacuated to Switzerland (arrived Oct 26), remained positive on arrival, then recovered and discharged after testing negative. Of the 62 contacts, 13 reported fever or non‑specific symptoms during monitoring but tested negative; seven alerts in Adamawa, Rivers, Borno, Lagos and Ekiti were investigated and also negative. Nigeria’s NCDC cautions that completing monitoring does not declare the outbreak over; heightened nationwide surveillance is maintained due to ongoing Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Response included rapid case detection, contact tracing, infection prevention, PPE supply, and an Incident Management System at Level 3. Public health messaging urges seeking care with travel history and safe practices during December events.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ナイジェリア、二次感染ゼロで62名の接触者が監視終了
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでの輸入エボラ（ブンディブギョ型）症例は国際的な患者移送を伴ったが、62名の接触者は全員陰性で二次感染はゼロ。流行は制御下にあるが、DRCでの継続流行や今後の輸入例のリスクから継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入エボラ症例とその接触者管理であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。DRCでの継続流行は背景情報として言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため除外。二次感染ゼロという良好な結果だが、エボラの国際移送事例として注視価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Belford Roxo terá combate à Dengue e Vacinação Antirrábica neste fim de semana | Belford Roxo | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belford Roxo will host dengue control and anti-rabies vaccination this weekend | Belford Roxo | O Dia.
article.articleSummary: Belford Roxo, Brazil, will host a weekend combined dengue-control and anti-rabies vaccination campaign in the Santa Amélia and Andrade Araújo neighborhoods. On Friday, November 13, and Saturday, November 14, from 9:00 to 13:00, about 10,000 residents are expected to participate at two sites: Avenida Joaquim da Costa Lima 3098, Santa Amélia, and Policlínica da Palmeirinha, Avenida Nunes Sampaio, s/n, Andrade Araújo. Organized by the City Health Secretariat’s Vector and Zoonoses Coordination, the actions aim to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding and immunize dogs and cats against rabies, targeting over 300 animals, surpassing the previous edition. Activities include pamphleting and health education, rodent control, entomology-lab work, and fumigation in strategic areas. Rabies vaccination remains available during weekdays via home visits and the Central de Atendimento.

triage.headline_ja: ベルフォード・ホショ、今週末にデング対策と狂犬病予防接種を実施 | Belford Roxo | O Dia
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的公衆衛生キャンペーン（デング媒介蚊対策・動物への狂犬病ワクチン接種）の告知であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体による定例的な予防キャンペーンの案内であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況の報告はない。対象国リストのBrazilではあるが、感染症アウトブレイクの事実が確認できないため地域検証上も重大イベントとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a crescer em alguns estados e reforça importância da prevenção : Linkezine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is rising again in some states and reinforces the importance of prevention: Linkezine.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is rising again in Brazil, notably in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, the Federal District, Mato Grosso, and Santa Catarina, per Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin. Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases linked to the coronavirus increased, though hospitalizations have not kept pace with the surge due to population immunity from vaccination and prior infections. In the past four weeks, COVID-19 accounted for 24.1% of deaths with viral identification, making it the second-leading cause of mortality among monitored respiratory viruses in the country. Symptoms now resemble flu, with sore throat, nasal congestion, runny nose, dry cough, moderate fever, and muscle aches; loss of smell/taste is less common. Testing is advised especially 2–4 days after symptom onset. Positive cases: avoid social contact during peak illness; mask in shared spaces, especially for older adults, cancer patients, and those with chronic diseases. Vaccination remains key, particularly for priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19がブラジルの一部州で再び増加、予防の重要性を再認識
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的増加であり、入院は急増していないため重篤性は限定的だが、死亡原因の上位を占めており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の呼吸器系ウイルス（COVID-19、インフルエンザ）の季節的変動に関する国内公衆衛生情報であり、新規性や国際的拡大リスクは低い。ワクチン接種歴等による免疫で入院は抑制されている。

article.articleHeadline: Study Identifies Pathogens in Nearly Seventy Percent of Hospitalized
article.articleSummary: Putian, China, study of 19,382 hospitalized children with acute respiratory tract infections (Jan 1, 2023–Dec 30, 2025) found confirmed pathogens in 69.40% (15,601 detection events). Using multiplex PCR and capillary electrophoresis for 11 pathogens, rhinovirus was the most frequent overall (24.66%), followed by Mycoplasma pneumoniae (23.68%), and RSV (14.52%). Mycoplasma pneumoniae dominated school-aged children (38.57%), while RSV peaked in infants/toddlers (19.53%). Preschoolers had the highest positivity; adolescents the lowest. Single-pathogen infections accounted for 58.89%; dual infections 9.93%; multiple pathogens 0.57%. Seasonal peaks occurred in winter 2023 (73.98%), spring 2024 (77.85%), and autumn 2025 (74.17%). Influenza A/B positivity declined with higher temperatures, whereas RSV and human coronavirus increased with rising temperatures. Median hospital stay was 5 days for single/negative cases and 6 days for dual/multi infections. Limitations: single-center retrospective analysis.

triage.headline_ja: 研究、入院患者の約70%で病原体を同定
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設の後方視的疫学研究であり、既知の呼吸器病原体の季節性・分布を記述したもので、異常な公衆衛生事象や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 学術研究報告であり、既知の季節性呼吸器病原体（ライノウイルス、マイコプラズマ、RSV、インフルエンザ等）の疫学的特徴を記述した論文。新興感染症や異常事態を示すものではないため対象国としても計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: casos de escabiose em Ingaí - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Scabies in Ingaí - Jornal Panorama
article.articleSummary: Ingaí, Brazil, reports 22 cases of scabies (human scabies) as of 13 November 2026. The first case was notified and confirmed by medical staff on 4 November 2026, prompting formation of an intersectoral committee to coordinate prevention and control actions. Decree No. 1,489, issued on 4 November 2026, establishes emergency measures, including a two-day suspension of in-person classes in three municipal schools for sanitization, and the temporary halt of collective activities such as sports on courts/fields, capoeira classes, and social projects. Transmission is described as mainly through direct, close, prolonged contact, with communal living environments facilitating spread. The Health Secretariat continues to refer children with suspected cases for medical evaluation and to file notifications per SINAN. Residents with suspected symptoms are advised to seek medical care and follow public health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: イングアイで疥癬症例22件、予防措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威となる感染症ではなく、局地的な小規模発生で既に対策が取られているため、IHR・WPRO基準いずれも該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低い皮膚感染症であり、地方自治体レベルでの対応で十分管理可能。学校の一時休校等は局地的措置であり国際的関心を要する事案ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 em alta no Brasil: o que se sabe sobre a variante que domina os casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 on the rise in Brazil: what is known about the variant that dominates the cases.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 in Brazil rises again as the XFG subvariant of Omicron becomes dominant, now accounting for about 90% of 2,199 sequenced samples, per Fiocruz and the Health Ministry as of 12 November 2026. Despite the uptick, severe acute respiratory syndrome cases (SRAG) due to the coronavirus remain low; in the past four weeks, COVID-19 represented 11.5% of SRAG hospitalizations and 26.9% of SRAG-related deaths. XFG, first identified in January 2025 and globally predominant by June 2025, has mutations that may aid infection and partial immune escape, but the WHO notes no evidence that it causes more severe disease. In Brazil, rising severe cases are reported in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, and the Federal District. Test positivity increased from 6.62% (Sept) to 16.66% (latest week). Vaccines continue to protect against severe disease; older and immunocompromised individuals may need doses every six months. Public health measures: stay up to date with vaccination, hand hygiene, masking (PFF2/N95), cover coughs, and isolate with symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでCOVID-19が増加：症例の大半を占める変異株について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: XFG変異株による陽性率上昇や複数州での重症例報告があるが、WHOは重症度増加の証拠はないとしており、SRAGに占める割合も低水準にとどまるため、直ちにフルRRAへ進める段階ではないが動向の注視が必要。
triage.notes: XFGは2025年1月に初確認され、同年6月には世界的に優勢株となっており、新規性・異常性は低い。重症呼吸器疾患（SRAG）に占めるCOVID-19の割合は低水準で、WHOも重症度増加の証拠なしとしている。検査陽性率の上昇と複数州での重症例増加は報告されているため、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: La Embajada de Estados Unidos en Perú comunica sobre un nuevo requisito para viajeros por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The U.S. Embassy in Peru announces a new travel requirement due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers a U.S. travel precaution. Since November 3, 2026, the CDC requires all travelers to the United States or transiting through the U.S. to confirm they have not been in the DRC within the previous 21 days; airlines will collect this declaration at check-in. The measure targets preventing cross-border spread from the ongoing outbreak, with no sanctions detailed. The outbreak, declared May 15, is described by the WHO as still concerning six months later, with 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths in the DRC. Kenya and Nigeria have reported recent cases. Diagnostic capacity expanded to more than two dozen laboratories (>600 daily samples); about 2,000 beds in 109 treatment centers, with nearly 3,000 recoveries. Bundibugyo virus involved; two vaccines in trials. Children >25% of cases and ~33% of deaths. Attacks on health facilities hinder response and contact tracing, including Cantine-Aloya.

triage.headline_ja: 在ペルー米国大使館、エボラ出血熱流行に伴う渡航者向け新規要件を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における大規模なエボラ出血熱流行（確定症例11,114件、死亡5,433件）で、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大や米国の渡航制限措置が発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はペルーでの米国渡航要件発表に焦点を当てているが、実際の流行発生国はDRC。ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例報告は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。米国も対象国リストにないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo: em meio a alerta do governo sobre casos no Brasil, saiba onde se vacinar em Pernambuco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles: amid a government alert about cases in Brazil, find out where to get vaccinated in Pernambuco.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases persist in Brazil after eradication in 2024, with Pernambuco reporting 59 infections; the last lab-confirmed case was in 2020, and Recife, Ipojuca, Caruaru, Garanhuns, and Terra Nova have cases under investigation. Authorities warn that imported infections from abroad continue to threaten reintroduction via international travel. The triple viral vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella) is available across roughly 2,800 SUS vaccination rooms in Pernambuco; the basic schedule calls for two doses at 12 and 15 months. Catch-up guidance: individuals 12–29 years without documented full vaccination should start or complete two doses; those 30–59 without documentation should receive one dose. State coverage stands at 93.5% for the first dose and 75% for the second, below the PNI target of 95%. In Olinda, vaccination is offered in all health units and Shopping Patteo; in Jaboatão dos Guararapes, MMR is available in all vaccination rooms, with 1-year-old coverage at 89.26%.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹:ブラジルでの症例に関する政府の警告を受け、ペルナンブコ州でのワクチン接種場所を確認
triage.triage_reason: 2024年に排除宣言されたブラジルで麻疹の再流行が確認され、海外からの輸入例による再導入リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 2024年に麻疹排除を達成したブラジルで、ペルナンブコ州を中心に59例の感染（うち確定例は2020年以降なし、多くが調査中）が報告。連邦政府は海外からの輸入例による再導入リスクを警告しており、ワクチン接種率も目標(95%)を下回る(93.5%/75%)。重症例・死亡の報告はなく、記事の主眼はワクチン接種呼びかけ。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Ebola patient contacts complete 21-day monitoring without signs of infection
article.articleSummary: Ebola case update: Nigeria reports that 62 contacts of a woman who tested positive after returning from Uganda have completed a 21-day monitoring period without signs of infection. The index patient, a Swiss woman who arrived in Abuja after Uganda, was diagnosed on Oct 20 with the Bundibugyo strain circulating in the DRC. She received treatment in Switzerland and has recovered. Completing 21 days without new cases does not end the outbreak; WHO protocols require 42 days without a confirmed infection before Nigeria can be declared Ebola-free. The Bundibugyo strain has caused more than 11,000 infections since its first detection in the DRC in May, with roughly half of those infected dying. A trial of two candidate vaccines is underway. Cases have also been detected in Uganda and Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ患者の接触者、21日間の経過観察を感染兆候なく完了
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のブンディブギョ株によるエボラアウトブレイクは11,000人以上の感染者と致死率約50%という深刻な公衆衛生事案であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスへの国際的拡大も確認されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 本記事自体はナイジェリアでの接触者監視完了という局所的な続報だが、背景にあるDRC起源のブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイク（11,000人以上感染、致死率約50%）は重大な進行中イベントであり、国際的拡大や高致死率からPICKUP判定とした。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・スイスは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、発生起源かつ主要感染地であるDRCのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Swiss Hospital Discharges Woman Infected In Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Swiss woman evacuated from Nigeria recovered from Ebola and discharged November 11 from Geneva University Hospitals. She and her husband, a Swiss diplomat, were flown to Switzerland on October 26 after confirmation of infection; she had returned to Abuja from an East African country on October 3, developed symptoms days later, and was admitted to a private facility before laboratory tests confirmed Ebola on October 20. Nigeria activated response measures and began contact tracing. Nigeria’s November 11 NCDC update records one confirmed infection (the imported case), no deaths, seven negative tests, and 62 contacts (52 completed 21-day monitoring; 10 under surveillance). Surveillance and entry-point monitoring remain ongoing. Regionally, Bundibugyo virus disease outbreaks persist: WHO notes 10,668 DRC cases and 5,198 deaths across 67 health zones in eight provinces as of November 3; Kenya 9 cases, 2 deaths; no further Nigeria/Kenya cases recently reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ナイジェリアで感染した女性、スイスの病院を退院
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアからスイスへのエボラ輸入症例に加え、DRCで大規模なブンディブギョウイルス病流行（67保健区域、10,668症例、5,198死亡）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア由来の輸入エボラ症例（スイスで治療後退院）だが、背景情報としてDRCにおける大規模なブンディブギョウイルス病流行（致死率約49%）の具体的な数値が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重要性からDRCをverified_locationsに含めた。ナイジェリア・スイス・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Amazonas protects itself against malaria with campaigns
article.articleSummary: Malaria prevention campaigns in Amazonas state, Colombia, target Platanillal and Coromoto in the Platanillal parish to mitigate transmission. Environmental Health teams are reinforcing weekly planning and prioritizing individuals and families relocated from other communities, neighboring states, or Colombia. The State Health Directorate reported via Instagram that reactive case searches were conducted to enable early detection and break transmission chains. Vector control included fogging, and long-lasting insecticide-treated nets were distributed. Despite setbacks in the timely arrival of supplies and medical assistance, staff continue to work to provide quality care to affected populations. This initiative underscores ongoing malaria control measures in the Amazonas region amid migrant movements.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州、マラリア対策キャンペーンで防御を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における既存のマラリア対策・予防キャンペーンに関する定例的な報道であり、異常な増加や新規事象は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州（Platanillal, Coromoto）でのマラリア対策活動であり、対象国リストに含まれるBrazil・Colombiaは地名や移民の出身地として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため除外した。ベネズエラ自体も対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Amazonas se blinda contra la malaria con jornadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonas shields itself against malaria with campaigns.
article.articleSummary: Malaria control campaigns are being conducted in Amazonas state to mitigate transmission in the Platanillal and Coromoto communities of the Platanillal parish. Environmental Health teams deployed to reinforce weekly planning and drive early detection. The integrated approach included reactive case-finding in visited sectors to interrupt transmission chains and targeted vector control with nebulization, along with distributing long-lasting insecticide-treated nets. The program prioritizes protection for people and families recently relocated from other communities, neighboring states, or the Republic of Colombia, recognizing their potentially higher exposure. Janeida García, Director of Environmental Health, acknowledged occasional delays in supply deliveries and medical assistance but emphasized that staff are working uninterruptedly to deliver quality care to the affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州、マラリア対策キャンペーンで防御を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラ・アマゾナス州における通常のマラリア対策活動の報告であり、対象国（ブラジル等）での発生事例ではなく、IHR・WPRO基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はベネズエラのアマゾナス州（プラタニジャル地区）での定期的なマラリア対策活動を報告しており、対象国リストに含まれる国（ブラジル、コロンビア等）での発生ではない。発生地域にBrazilが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はベネズエラであるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Index patient recovers as NCDC completes monitoring of 62 contacts
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Nigeria: No secondary transmission after the index patient recovered and was discharged from Switzerland. Nigeria's NCDC said all 62 contacts completed 21-day monitoring without testing positive. Thirteen contacts developed fever or non-specific symptoms, but all tested negative; seven additional alerts in Adamawa, Rivers, Borno, Lagos and Ekiti were negative. The index patient was evacuated to Switzerland on 26 October after initial treatment in Nigeria; she tested positive on arrival, later cleared and discharged. The evacuation did not reflect a lack of confidence in Nigerian care. Nigeria maintains the highest Level 3 Emergency Operations Centre; surveillance continues with states prioritized by exposure risk. The outbreak remains a concern due to Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Authorities urged prompt medical care, travel history disclosure and hygiene measures ahead of the December festive season, and private facilities to report suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：指標症例が回復、NCDCは62名の接触者監視を完了
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアの輸入エボラ症例は回復し二次感染なしで収束したが、DRCでのエボラ流行継続という背景があり、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。対象国リストにナイジェリアは含まれないため地域検証上は該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアで発生した輸入エボラ症例の収束報告であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。DRCは背景情報として言及されているのみで、記事の主題地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: محذرة من انعدام الأمن : الأمم المتحدة تشيد بالتقدم في التصدي لإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning of Insecurity: The United Nations Praises Progress in Combating Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease remains active in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, but United Nations health officials praise progress in reducing transmission and narrowing access barriers. The briefing notes a decline in cases in former hotspots such as Bunia and Nyizi in eastern DRC. Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO’s Health Emergency Programme, called the signs encouraging and linked them to shrinking case numbers in areas previously driving the outbreak. The key warning is rising insecurity, which hampers surveillance, case finding, and delivery of health services. Officials cautioned that transmission persists and could reach more dangerous, hard-to-reach regions, highlighting the need for improved security to sustain outbreak containment as of November 13, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 治安悪化への警告：国連、エボラ対策の進展を称賛
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の感染が継続しており、治安悪化によりサーベイランスや対応が妨げられるリスクが指摘されているため、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既知のアウトブレイクの継続状況報告だが、治安悪化による対応困難化という新たなリスク要因が強調されており、フルリスク評価での経過確認が妥当。BuniaはDRC国内の都市のため別エントリとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Passeio ciclístico chama atenção para a importância da prevenção à poliomielite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cycling Event Draws Attention to the Importance of Poliomyelitis Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Poliomyelitis (polio) prevention highlighted by Rotary International's End Polio Now campaign in Pernambuco, Brazil. On Sunday, November 15, 2026, the End Polio Now Cycling Ride will take place in Recife, with a route from Praça de Casa Forte in the North Zone to Praça do Baobá, starting at 8:00. The event emphasizes that vaccination is the only effective protection against polio, a disease worldwide reduced by over 99.9% since 1985. Organizers present the ride as more than a sport activity, serving as a public health awareness effort to keep children's immunizations up to date and to remind communities that polio is preventable. The campaign underscores ongoing eradication efforts and Rotary clubs’ role in Pernambuco to combat poliomyelitis.

triage.headline_ja: サイクリングイベントがポリオ予防の重要性に注目を集める
triage.triage_reason: 実際のポリオ症例報告ではなく、啓発キャンペーン（自転車イベント）に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ペルナンブコ州でのポリオ予防啓発イベント（ロータリークラブ主催のサイクリングイベント）に関するものであり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Fiebres en anfibios y reptiles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fevers in amphibians and reptiles.
article.articleSummary: Behavioral fever—a rise in body temperature via movement to warmer microhabitats—occurs in amphibians and reptiles when infected. A Brazilian team from the University of São Paulo and Universidade Estadual Paulista analyzed 47 studies published from the 1970s to 2020, comprising 101 measurements in 49 species. They compared healthy and infected individuals, linking field data with high-resolution climate data for wild populations. They found behavioral fever is widespread, with intensity largely explained by local diurnal temperature variation. For every degree of average daily temperature difference, infected animals raised their body temperature by about 0.45°C. Amphibians showed stronger responses than reptiles; bacterial infections yielded clearer increases, while fungal and viral infections were inconclusive. Climate change and landscape changes may reduce thermal heterogeneity, potentially limiting fever-based defenses, and past experiments showed infected lizards died when heat elevation was blocked.

triage.headline_ja: 両生類と爬虫類の発熱
triage.triage_reason: 両生類・爬虫類の行動性発熱に関する学術研究記事であり、感染症の公衆衛生リスクやヒトへの影響に関する内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物生理学・感染症生態学に関する学術研究の紹介であり、公衆衛生上の疾病発生事例ではない。ブラジルの研究機関による研究だが、実際の疾病発生地点ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: All 62 contacts of Nigeria's Bundibugyo case cleared after 21 days -- NCDC - TheNewsGuru
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's Bundibugyo Virus Disease (Ebola) case: 62 contacts monitored; none developed infection; final contact discharged after 21-day observation. Thirteen showed fever or symptoms at some point, but lab tests cleared all. Seven alerts in Adamawa, Rivers, Borno, Lagos, Ekiti tested negative. Ongoing risk persists as Ebola circulates in the Democratic Republic of Congo; Nigeria cautions against complacency; end of monitoring does not equal all-clear. National Emergency Operations Centre activated; Incident Management System at Level Three. Index case confirmed Oct 20 in Federal Capital Territory; evacuated to Switzerland Oct 26 after initial care. On arrival in Switzerland, she tested positive, later recovered and discharged.Inbound travelers require Nigeria Health Declaration Form; emphasis on not misdiagnosing fever as malaria; avoid unprotected contact with blood/bodily fluids of suspected Ebola. Private hospital managed initial treatment; evacuation framed as international health cooperation under IHR; FCT rapid response completed three-week monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのブンディブギョ型エボラ患者の接触者62人全員、21日間の経過観察後に解除——NCDC
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ型）患者がナイジェリアからスイスへ国際搬送され発症するという異常かつ国際的拡大事例であり、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大」の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本事例の主な発生地はナイジェリア（対象国外）およびスイス（対象国外）。DRCは『エボラが流行中』という背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題イベントの発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。接触者は全員陰性で監視終了済みだが、国際搬送事例としての重要性からPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox já soma 25 casos na região de Campinas; veja como estão as cidades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox now totals 25 cases in the Campinas region; see how the cities are faring.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in 2026 totals 25 cases in the Campinas region, with Campinas city accounting for 17 confirmed infections and nearby municipalities Hortolândia, Americana, Indaiatuba, and Santa Bárbara d'Oeste also reporting cases. Vinhedo, Nova Odessa and Sumaré did not respond to information requests by publication. Nationally, Brazil has 1,023 laboratory-confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with 46 probable, 581 suspected, and 1 death as of Nov 12, 2026. Transmission is mainly via close contact with skin lesions and bodily secretions from infected individuals, contact with contaminated objects (clothes, towels, sheets), and prolonged exposure to respiratory secretions. Key symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, body aches, chills, and weakness.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス地域でMpox感染が25例に拡大、各都市の状況
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で既知のMpoxアウトブレイクが継続・拡大しているが、新規性・異常性は低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候も見られないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: Mpoxはブラジルで既に流行が確立しており、本記事は地域的な症例増加を報じるもの。全国で1,023例・1死亡が報告されているが、クレード種別や新たな感染拡大パターンの詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC: Ebola cases top 11,145 with 5,437 deaths at six months
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak across Africa has 11,145 confirmed infections and 5,437 deaths at six months, with 3,058 recoveries (case fatality 48.8 per cent). Most challenges are in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where insecurity and weak contact tracing hinder response; only about 11 per cent of new cases are linked to known contacts (target 95 per cent), highlighting operational gaps and a strained health system amid conflict and displacement. Kenya reports nine cases and two deaths, with the first imported on October 6; the last Ebola patient has been discharged and the final 11 contacts completed 21‑day monitoring, with no new cases since October 19. Nigeria identifies 62 contacts; 59 have completed monitoring, three remain under monitoring. Ten other African nations are designated high‑risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Somalia. Africa CDC declared a public health emergency of continental security on May 18, following the WHO declaring a PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC：エボラ出血熱、発生から6か月で感染者数11,145人、死者5,437人に達する
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、アフリカCDCも大陸規模の公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言した大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率約49％と極めて深刻。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ザンビアは『高リスク国』として言及されているのみで、実際の症例報告はないため verified_locations から除外。主たる発生国はDRCであり、ケニア・ナイジェリア等での症例も報告されているが対象国リストには含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تحذر من تفشّي فيروس "إيبولا" الفتاك في ريف الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of a deadly Ebola virus outbreak in the rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns of a deadly Ebola outbreak spreading through rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Six months into the outbreak, infections persist with 11,042 confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health. In Bonia, treatment centers operate at roughly half capacity, while access to remote areas remains hindered by security challenges amid ongoing militia violence. The main obstacle is a fragile security environment, limiting rapid deployment of care and establishment of new treatment posts. UN OCHA Ebola response coordinator Julian Harnie notes violence by the Allied Democratic Forces has caused more fatalities in recent days than Ebola itself. Last week, 66 civilians were killed, including three health workers, and three health facilities were looted or burned. WHO aims to boost flexible, faster response to reach affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）、コンゴ民主共和国農村部での致死的なエボラウイルス流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが警告する大規模エボラ流行（確定症例11,042件、死者5,387人）であり、治安悪化により対応が困難化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%、発生から6ヶ月経過し依然拡大中。武装勢力（ADF）による治安悪化がエボラ対応を阻害し、医療従事者や医療施設も被害を受けている。国連OCHAも関与しており、国際的な支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ρωσία: Συναγερμός για μυστηριώδη ασθένεια που προσβάλλει τουρίστες στο Βιετνάμ | NEWSFIRE.GR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia: Alarm over a mysterious disease affecting tourists in Vietnam | NEWSFIRE.GR
article.articleSummary: Dozens of Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam, have developed a severe illness with high fever, severe headaches, runny nose, and a persistent cough that can last weeks; several patients are bedbound. Health authorities in Vietnam and Russia are investigating the cause, with no laboratory confirmation yet. Rospotrebnadzor has formally asked Vietnam's Ministry of Health and the Russian Association of Tour Operators for details and clarification on the outbreak, awaiting Hanoi's official results to determine whether this is a known seasonal respiratory infection or a different pathogen. The incident follows a prior Siberian plague scare linked to an Irkutsk lab worker's death from pneumonia of unknown origin, prompting quarantines. Russian experts urge calm, suggesting common influenza strains or other regular respiratory infections; no reports of mass complaints or official requests for assistance have been received. Final assessment pending lab tests from Hanoi.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア：ベトナムで観光客を襲う原因不明の疾患に警戒
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客数十名に原因不明の重篤な呼吸器症状が発生し、ロシア当局がベトナム保健省に正式調査を要請するなど国際的な懸念が生じているため、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未確定（ラボ結果待ち）。ロシア・イルクーツクでのペスト関連死亡事例は別件として言及されているが、対象国リストにロシアは含まれないため除外。続報（ハノイの検査結果）を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 Volta A Crescer Em São Paulo; Fiocruz Alerta Para Casos Graves - Rnews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Is Rising Again in São Paulo; Fiocruz Warns of Severe Cases - Rnews
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is rising again in São Paulo with SRAG cases, per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin (Nov 12, 2026) analyzing 1–7 November. Growth signals are seen in six states—São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Bahia and the Federal District—with Mato Grosso decelerating. No state reports simultaneous SRAG incidence at alert level and sustained growth. Over four weeks, COVID-19 accounted for 11.5% of SRAG cases with identified respiratory viruses and 26.9% of SRAG deaths, indicating ongoing circulation without pandemic-level activity. Brazil’s 2026 totals remain below 2025: about 3,400 severe cases and 437 deaths (roughly 63% and 69% lower). Vaccination remains the main protection; boosters are advised for older adults, pregnant individuals, young children, and other high-risk groups. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, fatigue and muscle pains; seek care for dyspnea, chest pain or confusion. Antiviral treatment via SUS is available for eligible patients if started within five days.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロでCOVID-19が再び増加、フィオクルスが重症例に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 複数州でCOVID-19 SRAG症例の増加傾向が見られるが、2026年の総数は2025年を大きく下回り、パンデミックレベルの活動ではないため緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: Fiocruz InfoGripeによる定期サーベイランス報告であり、季節的な増減の範囲内。重症例・死亡数は前年を大幅に下回る水準で推移。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını telefon verileriyle incelendi: İlk sinyaller kaçırılmış
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak was analyzed using mobile phone data: early signals were missed.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and North Kivu) expanded with 10,000 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths by six months after May 15, the largest Bundibugyo outbreak to date. Researchers used anonymous mobile phone data and lab records to map early transmission, showing the virus circulated weeks before notification and that health surveillance failed to flag signals. The first confirmed patient’s symptoms began around April 25, with cases in Mongbwalu, Bunia, Rwampara, Nyankunde, Butembo, Katwa and Goma. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for healthcare worker infections, geographic spread, and unexplained deaths. The study linked travel along established routes to infections by June, with higher risk near initial centers and resurgence up to 150–200 km away. Absence of Bundibugyo-specific vaccines or therapies and reduced funding for community surveillance hampered control, and labs could only detect Zaire Ebola, delaying confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 携帯電話データでエボラ流行を分析：初期シグナルは見逃されていた
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行は過去最大規模（感染1万人、死亡5,198人）であり、WHOがPHEICを宣言するなど深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は過去（2025年5月以降）の流行経過を振り返る分析記事だが、史上最大規模のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行かつWHOのPHEIC宣言が含まれるため、継続的なリスク評価対象として扱うべき。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが対象国リストにないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : l'acceptation de la maladie et les mesures barrières pour vaincre la peur - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: acceptance of the disease and barrier measures to overcome fear - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola is ongoing in eight provinces, including Beni in North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, as of 13 November 2026. Psychosocial assistant Charlemagne Kambale Liso calls for acceptance to reduce fear, stressing that acknowledging the disease and following barrier measures saves lives. He warns against rumors and misinformation that fuel fear. Stigma around Ebola Treatment Centers (CTEs) is criticized; CTEs are described as care spaces, with quality defined by disease stage and lab confirmation. Early presentation yields about 90% survival if admitted within three days, versus 30% after seven days, absent other complications. Families should regularly visit to provide moral support, reassure patients that they are not abandoned, and show care teams’ efforts to counter rumors.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのエボラ出血熱：恐怖を克服するための病気の受容とバリア対策 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニを含む8州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北キブ州ベニにおけるエボラ対応（受容促進・バリア対策・治療センターへの偏見解消）に関する内容。8州にわたる継続流行であり、致死率が入院タイミングにより30%〜90%と重症度が高い。エボラは歴史的に国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を引き起こした実績があるため、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクについては情報不足だが潜在的に高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Rodents in Southwestern Shanxi Show High Prevalence of Diverse Bartonella
article.articleSummary: Small rodents from Yuncheng City, southwestern Shanxi Province, China, show high Bartonella prevalence and genetic diversity. Among 106 trapped animals, 49 (46.23%) tested positive for Bartonella DNA (95% CI 36.58–55.87%). Seven rodent species were captured; Apodemus agrarius was most numerous (59). Liver, spleen, and kidney tissues were screened by real-time PCR targeting ssrA; overall tissue differences were significant (P=0.03), but pairwise contrasts were not significant after Bonferroni correction. No significant associations were found with sex, habitat (forest vs farmland), or sampling site. Phylogenetic analysis of gltA sequences identified seven Bartonella taxa from 41 sequences, led by Bartonella grahamii (17), followed by Candidatus Bartonella rudakovii (5), B. fuyuanensis (5), B. queenslandensis (4), B. taylorii (4), B. phoceensis (3), and one unclassified lineage (3). B. grahamii was predominant and comprised four haplotypes; Apodemus agrarius carried four haplotypes (Hd = 0.745 ± 0.098).

triage.headline_ja: 中国山西省南西部のげっ歯類、多様なバルトネラ属菌の高い陽性率を示す
triage.triage_reason: げっ歯類を対象とした学術的な病原体保有調査であり、ヒト感染例の報告や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はヒト感染事例ではなく、野生齧歯類におけるBartonella属菌の分子疫学調査報告である。人獣共通感染症としての将来的な監視対象ではあるが、現時点でヒトへの感染や発症事例の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - MSF alerte sur l'inquiétant décalage entre les moyens financiers déployés et les lacunes de la réponse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola — MSF warns of the worrying gap between the funding deployed and the shortcomings of the response
article.articleSummary: Six months after the Ebola outbreak declaration in the Democratic Republic of the Congo—the deadliest in the country’s history—MSF warns that hundreds of millions mobilized have not translated into patient- and frontline worker-focused actions. Persistent gaps hinder the response: frontline staff are often untrained or unpaid; vehicles lack fuel; surveillance teams are absent; community workers lack phones or internet; and healthcare facilities lack essential equipment and technical support for suspected cases. Surveillance remains gravely deficient, with nearly two-thirds of last month’s Ebola deaths occurring in communities rather than treatment centers, and only 9% of Ebola patients treated by MSF in Ituri had been identified as contacts. North Kivu and Haut-Uele are under-resourced, and in Beni, about three-quarters of infections occurred in a health facility. While diagnostic capacity, isolation/treatment units, community outreach, and clinical trials progress, MSF urges urgent, concrete actions to close these gaps and better integrate private clinics and traditional healers into the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱 — MSFが資金投入と対応の不備との深刻な乖離を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪とされるエボラ流行が継続中で、サーベイランスや治療体制の深刻な不備がMSFにより指摘されており、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念と国際支援の必要性が示されている。
triage.notes: HautUele、Ituriはいずれもコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)内のADM1地域であり、国としてはDRCのみverified_locationsに記載。記事は既存の流行（発生宣言から6か月）の対応状況に関する報告であり、新規事象ではないが、死亡率の高さと対応の不備が継続的な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Постигнат е напредок во одговорот на епидемијата на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Progress has been made in the response to the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Progress has been made in the Ebola response, but the virus continues to spread in remote areas of the Democratic Republic of Congo. Chikwe Ihekweazu, WHO Incident Manager for Health Emergencies, notes encouraging signs with a decline in cases in former hotspots like Bunia in eastern DRC; however, new cases are emerging in more rural, hard-to-reach areas, and insecurity remains the main challenge. UN Ebola Special Coordinator Julien Harnais says the affected area is unimaginably vast, yet about 80% of cases see response activities carried out across that space. The outbreak has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases and extended from Congo into parts of East, Central, and West Africa. Authorities in mid-May attributed the outbreak to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. WHO data record 80 attacks on health facilities and workers in the outbreak zone.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:エボラ流行への対応で進展が見られる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が1万1千例を超えて拡大中で、治療薬・ワクチンが未承認、医療施設への攻撃も続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、周辺国（モザンビーク、アンゴラ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。東・中央・西アフリカへの拡大は言及されるが具体的な対象国名の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : malgré le renforcement de la riposte, la transmission reste active dans plusieurs zones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: despite the strengthening of the response, transmission remains active in several areas.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, diagnostic and case-management capacity has markedly improved but transmission remains active in multiple areas, notably Ituri and North Kivu. Since onset, over 11,000 cases and more than 5,000 deaths have been reported; about 400–500 new cases are still detected weekly. Laboratory capacity expanded from two to more than two dozen facilities, processing 500–600 samples daily; roughly 2,000 beds are available across 109 transit and treatment centers. Nearly 3,000 people have recovered; survivors are followed by 10 clinics in Bunia and Beni. Transmission persists along the Wamba-Bolébolé axis, west of Tshopo toward Bafwasende, and in southern Ituri and northern Nord-Kivu (Mambasa and Beni). Interruption of transmission hinges on stronger infection prevention in health facilities, strengthened surveillance, and community engagement, including addressing community resistance and collaborating with traditional healers. Financial and logistical support is urged through 2027 to sustain gains and achieve durable interruption.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：対応強化にもかかわらず複数地域で感染伝播が継続
triage.triage_reason: 発生6か月で症例11,000件超・死亡5,000人超、週400-500件の新規症例が継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と地域拡大リスクが認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Ituri州、北キヴ州（Mambasa, Beni）、Tshopo州（Bafwasende方面）など複数地域で感染伝播が継続中。2027年までの財政・物流支援が要請されている。

article.articleHeadline: ЕПИДЕМИЈА НА ЕБОЛА ВО АФРИКА: Над 11.000 заразени и илјадници починати во неколку земји
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic in Africa: Over 11,000 infected and thousands dead in several countries.
article.articleSummary: More than 11,000 people infected and thousands dead in an Ebola epidemic across Africa, with health experts warning the true death toll may be higher. Officials note the outbreak may have quietly started as early as February, with the official declaration on May 15. Ebola virus causes rapid dehydration, severe inflammatory responses, coagulation disorders, and progressive organ failure; delaying treatment after initial symptoms markedly raises fatality risk. Early symptoms resemble malaria, complicating timely isolation and hospital care. Alarmingly, there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy for the Bundibugyo strain. The virus has already spread to eight provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has crossed borders into Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda, raising regional concerns. Children bear the heaviest burden, representing a large share of lab-confirmed cases and facing the highest mortality risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行:複数国で11,000人以上感染、数千人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 複数国（DRC、ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）への越境拡大と大規模な死者数が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。ただし情報源の信頼性（マケドニア語の一般ニュースサイト、Bundibugyo株にワクチンが存在しないとの記述等）に疑義があり、事実確認が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はマケドニア語の一般ニュースサイトからの引用で、感染者数（11,000人超）やBundibugyo株に承認ワクチンがないとの記述など、既知の公式情報源（WHO/CDC等）との整合性確認が必要。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。一次情報源（WHO DON、Africa CDC等）での裏付けを優先的に確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемија на ебола во Африка: Над 11.000 заразени, илјадници мртви
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in Africa: Over 11,000 infected, thousands dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola epidemic in Africa: more than 11,000 infected and thousands dead. Real death toll could be higher; experts warn the virus may have spread undetected since February, months before the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Ebola is a severe, highly contagious disease caused by a group of viruses, capable of rapid dehydration, inflammatory responses, coagulation disorders, and organ failure. Delayed treatment increases the risk of death. For this strain, there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Early symptoms resemble malaria, leading to delays in isolation and care. Containment is especially challenging because the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or targeted treatment. To date, Ebola has spread to eight provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo and crossed borders, with cases reported in Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda. Health authorities note that children are hardest hit, representing a substantial share of confirmed cases and facing higher mortality risk.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラ出血熱流行:感染者11,000人超、数千人死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(Bundibugyo株)流行が8州に拡大し、複数国境を越えたとされる重大な内容。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきだが、数値の信憑性に疑義あり。
triage.notes: 記事が伝える感染者11,000人・数千人死亡という規模は、既知のDRCにおけるBundibugyo株エボラ流行の実際の報告規模（通常数十～数百例程度）と大きく乖離しており、誇張または誤情報の可能性が高い。信頼性の低いマケドニア語メディア単独ソースであるため、WHO・CDC等の公式発表との照合が必須。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの拡大も対象国リスト外（ナイジェリア・ケニアは非対象国）のため、DRCのみをverified_locationsとした。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la guerre et Ebola aggravent une crise alimentaire qui menace 30 millions de personnes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: War and Ebola Exacerbate a Food Crisis That Threatens 30 Million People
article.articleSummary: Six months into the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak, more than 5,400 people have died and over 11,000 infected, including more than one-third children. In Ituri (Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi, Rwampara) and Nord-Kivu (Butembo), transmission has slowed in some areas, but Bunia remains active with new cases down and treatment centers with more beds. The response is hindered by violence, with over 80 attacks on health facilities, complicating surveillance and contact tracing amid armed groups such as the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF). Concurrently, a record food-security crisis threatens 30.3 million Congolese (Jan–Jun 2027), up from 26.5 million in 2026, including more than 4 million in the emergency tier; eastern regions face crop disruption and rising prices. UN agencies WFP (PAM), FAO, UNICEF, and WHO call for urgent funding and unimpeded humanitarian access, plus seeds and tools ahead of the 2027 planting season.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：戦争とエボラが3000万人を脅かす食料危機を悪化させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行開始から6か月で死者5,400人以上、感染者11,000人超という極めて深刻な状況にあり、紛争による対応阻害と食料危機が重なり国際支援が急務であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（イツリ州、北キブ州）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ルワンダは国境近接国として言及されているのみで、同国内での発生は記載されていないため除外した。武力紛争（ADF）による医療施設攻撃80件以上が対応を著しく困難にしている点は特に注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC warns attacks on health workers hamper Ebola response in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC remains the epicenter of the ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, which since May 15 has expanded from 3 health zones to 67 across eight provinces. As of Nov 13, 2026, Africa CDC warns that armed attacks and assaults on healthcare workers and facilities are severely hindering containment, documenting 31 security incidents in the past six months: 4 armed attacks, 16 assaults on Ebola responders, and 11 facilities burned or targeted. In Cantine-Aloya, Cantine-Aloya locality, Beni territory, North Kivu, three health facilities were looted and burned; three health workers were among 66 civilians killed.
