More than 1,000 contacts have been lost to follow-up; surveillance teams cannot trace them, and three confirmed cases remain unaccounted after fleeing burned treatment centers. Attacks threaten village-centered contact tracing and the broader response; urgent protection for frontline responders and facilities is urged, with AU collaboration to bolster security.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対応が医療従事者への攻撃により妨げられていると警告
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが3保健地域から8州67地域に拡大し、医療従事者・施設への武装攻撃により接触者追跡が機能不全に陥っている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的支援も必要とされているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中アウトブレイク（Bundibugyoエボラ、2026年5月15日発生）の悪化事例。治安悪化により1,000人以上の接触者を追跡不能、確定症例3名が所在不明となっており、感染拡大リスクが増大している。AUとの協力による治安強化が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: ¡ATENCIÓN! Estados Unidos exige nuevo requisito a viajeros peruanos por el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attention! The United States imposes a new requirement on Peruvian travelers due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: A US Embassy in Peru announces a mandatory health declaration for all travelers to the United States or transiting through the U.S., effective November 3, 2026, to curb the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Passengers must confirm they have not stayed in the DRC in the previous 21 days; airlines must obtain a signed declaration (electronic or paper) at check-in or before boarding. Without the document, boarding is denied. The CDC established the rule, applying to international travelers regardless of nationality, with temporary restrictions for anyone who has been in the DRC within the preceding 21 days, including those only transiting in U.S. airports. The DRC outbreak continues, with 11,114 confirmed cases and 5,433 deaths as of November 10. WHO notes children are among the most affected, and insecurity and attacks on health facilities hinder response. Peruvian travelers should coordinate with airlines to meet the declaration before departure to avoid issues.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！米国、エボラ出血熱流行を受けペルー人渡航者に新たな要件を義務付け
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）における大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（11,114症例、5,433死亡）が継続しており、米国が渡航制限措置を実施するなど国際的な対応が既に発生している。IHR基準に複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事はペルーのメディアによる報道だが、実際の感染症イベントはDRCで発生しているエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクである。ペルー・米国は渡航制限措置の文脈でのみ言及されており、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外した。致死率の高さ（約49%）、医療施設への攻撃による対応の困難さ、小児への影響大など深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: El Nino Alert 2026-27: WHO Issues Highest-Level Warning, India Heatwaves, Disease Risks and Deaths | धरती बन जाएगी तंदूर! WHO के Grade 3 इमरजेंसी, भारत में प्रचंड गर्मी से 55000 मौतें, , इन बीमारियों का रहेगा तांडव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño Alert 2026-27: WHO Issues Highest-Level Warning, India Heatwaves, Disease Risks and Deaths | The Earth Will Turn Into a Tandoor! WHO's Grade 3 Emergency, 55,000 Deaths in India Due to Extreme Heat, These Diseases Will Wreak Havoc.
article.articleSummary: WHO has escalated its emergency response to Grade 3 for Oct 2026–Sep 2027 in response to El Niño‑related health risks. In India, extreme heat could cause about 55,000 additional deaths between Oct 2026 and Mar 2027, a heat‑related mortality estimate—not a total El Niño death toll. El Niño alters climate by increasing heat and shifting rainfall, potentially triggering drought, water scarcity, infections, and pressure on health systems. Five risks in India: heat stroke and dehydration; dengue and malaria; leptospirosis and other waterborne diseases; malnutrition and food shortages; and worse outcomes for people with heart, kidney, or respiratory diseases. IMD forecasts 2026 monsoon rainfall around 90% of average, with no guarantee of a full failure. Vulnerable groups include children, the elderly, pregnant women, disabled, those with pre‑existing illness, outdoor workers, and residents of low‑income areas. First six months require about $35 million for surveillance, vector control, clean water, and awareness.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョ警報2026-27：WHOが最高レベルの警告を発令、インドで熱波・疾病リスクと死亡者数増加の懸念
triage.triage_reason: WHOのGrade3緊急事態宣言やインドでの熱波関連死亡予測など懸念材料はあるが、記事内容は将来予測・シナリオベースであり、実際のマラリア・デング・レプトスピラ症の発生報告や確定症例数は示されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はエルニーニョに伴う将来的な健康リスク予測（2026-27年）を扱った内容で、実際の症例報告や統計データに基づくものではない。WHOのGrade3緊急事態宣言は実在するが、インド国内の具体的な感染症発生状況（症例数・死亡者数の実績）は不明。今後、実際の症例報告が出た場合はフルリスク評価への移行を検討すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Reportagem - Especialistas explicam por que o sarampo voltou a avançar nos EUA em meio à crise da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Report - Experts explain why measles has surged again in the United States amid the vaccination crisis.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in the United States surpassed 5,100 in 2026, the highest annual total in more than three decades, risking the country’s elimination status achieved in 2000. Brazilian epidemiologists Julio Croda and Eduardo Simões attribute the resurgence to declining vaccination coverage, rising misinformation, and relaxed school-entry vaccination rules. In the United States, about 92.4% of kindergarten children have received two doses of the MMR vaccine, below the 95% threshold needed to interrupt transmission. Religious or personal-belief exemptions in many states, notably Idaho after the 2025 Medical Freedom Act, have reduced coverage in some areas. Genetic analyses cited by The New York Times suggest transmission chains may have been active for over 12 months, with outbreaks in Utah and Arizona linked to Texas-sourced chains. A decision on maintaining elimination status is expected on November 17, while CDC and public health agencies discuss strategies to restore vaccination confidence and contain outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: レポート - 専門家が、ワクチン接種危機の中で米国ではしかが再び拡大している理由を説明
triage.triage_reason: 米国で麻疹症例が30年来最多の5,100件を超え、2000年に達成した排除状態を失うリスクがあり、ワクチン接種率低下と州をまたぐ感染連鎖が確認されているためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル人専門家が米国の麻疹流行について解説したものであり、実際の発生地は米国（アイダホ、ユタ、アリゾナ、テキサス）であり対象国リストには含まれない。ブラジルは発言者の国籍として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose : les décès reculent, mais la lutte contre l'épidémie reste à la traîne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: Deaths Fall, but the Fight Against the Epidemic Lags Behind.
article.articleSummary: TB caused 1.13 million deaths in 2025, down from 1.18 million, with over 10 million new infections, making it the leading killer among infectious diseases. Deaths fell 35% since 2015, but incidence declined only 14%, missing 2025/2030 targets. About 88% of new cases were in 30 high-burden countries, led by India and including Indonesia, the Philippines, China, and Pakistan; the DRC ranks among eight. Europe and Africa saw incidence declines of 42% and 30% since 2015; the Americas rose; the Eastern Mediterranean fell 6.6%. Of 10.6 million cases in 2025, 8.4 million were diagnosed; 2.2 million undetected. Only 42% of rifampicin-resistant TB patients were treated; six-month regimens expanding. International funding fell 14% to $940M; domestic funding rose 14% to $5.6B; total $6.6B in LMICs, far from the $22B/year needed. Three vaccine candidates reached late-stage trials. Half of affected households spend >20% of income. Ending TB remains unlikely without faster diagnosis, investment, and prevention. Treatments have averted 86 million deaths since 2000.

triage.headline_ja: 結核：死亡者数は減少するも、流行対策は依然として遅れている
triage.triage_reason: WHOの結核年次報告に基づく統計的概況記事であり、特定の異常な発生や急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はWHOの世界結核報告書に基づく年次統計のまとめであり、特定国における急性の異常発生事例ではない。結核は既知のエンデミック疾患であり、慢性的な公衆衛生課題として継続的モニタリング対象だが、個別のRRAを要するシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Wamendagri Wiyagus Ajak PKK hingga Babinsa Bergerak Bersama Jangkau Kontak Erat Pasien TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Wiyagus Calls on PKK and Babinsa to Join Forces in Tracing Close Contacts of TB Patients
article.articleSummary: 13 November 2026, Cirebon, West Java — Deputy Minister of Home Affairs Akhmad Wiyagus urged local governments to intensify community-based TB control by mobilizing PKK, Posyandu, RT/RW, Babinsa, and Bhabinkamtibmas to trace close contacts of TB patients and ensure prompt testing and treatment, rather than offering services passively. The effort integrates TB screening with free health checks (CKG) at the village/urban neighborhood level. He stressed TB treatment lasts about six months and can disrupt work, risking unemployment and household income. Indonesia remains the world's second-highest TB burden, with an estimated 1,090,000 TB cases and about 125,000 deaths per year (2025 estimates). He called for aligning TB targets with the Regional Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMD) to secure policy and funding, hoping multi-sector collaboration will speed TB elimination and improve livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: 内務副大臣ウィヤグス氏、PKKやバビンサに結核患者の濃厚接触者追跡への協働を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける既知の結核流行への恒常的な公衆衛生対策・啓発に関する行政活動の記事であり、新規の異常事態や急性の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアで既知の高負担疾患であり、本記事は新規アウトブレイクではなく既存の結核対策プログラム強化に関する政策的呼びかけである。

article.articleHeadline: CDC updates travel notice as dengue fever spreads
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever updates: CDC elevates travel notice to Level 1 'increased risk' for travelers, adding four new South/Central American countries—Cuba, Ecuador, Panama, Peru—plus Chad and Wallis and Futuna; Bolivia and Colombia remain listed, with Bangladesh, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Marshall Islands, Vanuatu and Vietnam also flagged. Precautions include wearing long sleeves, using insect repellent, and staying in air‑conditioned or screened rooms. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, can cause sudden high fever, severe headache, eye pain, and bone/joint pain; incubation 5–7 days; warning signs include bleeding gums, severe abdominal pain, vomiting, and lethargy; some infections are asymptomatic. US totals: 2,842 cases in US and territories this year; Florida 906 cases (382 travel-related, 524 locally acquired) and one death; Virginia 9 locally acquired. Hillsborough County declares local emergency; mosquito control active. No cure; treatment is supportive. A three‑dose vaccine for children 9–16 with prior infection reduces symptomatic infection by ~80%.}

triage.headline_ja: CDC、デング熱の拡大を受けて渡航情報を更新
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼は米国（フロリダ・バージニア）およびCDCの渡航勧告更新であり、対象国の中ではベトナムが「警戒対象国」として名前のみ挙げられているに留まり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の記述がないため、現時点では経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は米国CDCによる渡航者向けデング熱警戒レベル引き上げが主題。対象国のうちベトナムは「警戒対象国リスト」に名前が挙がるのみで、具体的な発生状況・症例数の記載はない。他の対象国（タイ、フィリピン等）は本記事では言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Barrick Mining met en congé une partie du personnel de la mine d'or de Kibali face à la menace Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Barrick Mining puts part of the Kibali gold mine staff on leave amid Ebola threat in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola threat near Kibali gold mine in Haut-Uélé, DRC. Barrick Mining temporarily places non-essential Kibali staff and contractors on leave after two Ebola-related deaths in a neighboring community, confirmed by INRB; investigators are checking for links to personnel. An internal note dated 12 November 2026 from Kibali's interim CEO says the precaution affects workers; no numbers or duration disclosed. Workers are advised to stay home if unwell and contact company medical services. This follows May 2026 precautions amid Ebola circulation. As of 10 November, ECDC reports 11,114 Ebola cases and 5,433 deaths in the DRC; Haut-Uélé has 499 cases and 216 deaths. Kibali production remains on track; ownership 45% Barrick, 45% AngloGold Ashanti, 10% SOKIMO; 2025 output ~673,000 oz; 2026 forecast 600,000–688,000 oz.

triage.headline_ja: バリック・マイニング、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ脅威を受けキバリ金鉱山の従業員の一部を休暇に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（累計11,114例、死亡5,433例）に関連し、主要鉱山企業が操業地域近隣での感染死を受けて人員を休暇対応させるなど、公衆衛生・経済活動双方への深刻な影響が確認されるため。
triage.notes: ECDC報告によるとDRC全体で11,114例・5,433死亡、Haut-Uélé州だけで499例・216死亡。鉱山企業（Barrick/AngloGold Ashanti/SOKIMO）が2026年5月に続き再度予防的措置を実施しており、経済活動への影響も継続的に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ДР Конго: вооруженные столкновения и нападения на медработников мешают борьбе с Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Armed clashes and attacks on healthcare workers hinder the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists amid deadly armed violence that hampers response. UN Ebola response co-ordinator Julien Arnais says assaults by the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) have killed more people than the virus recently, with attacks on dozens of villages in southern Ituri and North Kivu largely going unnoticed. WHO emergencies chief Chikwe Ihekweazu reports 400–500 new Ebola infections weekly, driven by rural and hard-to-reach areas. Preventive measures have markedly reduced transmission in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Rampare, and NiZi in Ituri, but attacks on health facilities and civilians continue; 66 people were killed in Kantine-Aloya (North Kivu), including three health workers. Two weeks earlier, a nurse was killed in Tshopo Province during an outbreak response. Since May, this is the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history, expanding across eastern and northeastern provinces. As of 13 November 2026, over 11,000 confirmed cases and more than 5,000 deaths. WFP warns about nearly 29 million people facing acute hunger, highlighting urgent needs for access and resources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：武力衝突と医療従事者への攻撃がエボラ対応を妨害
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行（1.1万人超感染、5千人超死亡）が継続中で、武装勢力による攻撃が対応を妨げており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月以降継続するDRC史上最大のエボラ流行。武装勢力ADFによる攻撃で医療従事者が殺害され対応が阻害されている。週400-500件の新規感染が報告され、約2900万人が急性飢餓に直面するなど人道危機も併発している。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil aprueba una vacuna contra 21 tipos de la bacteria detrás de neumonía y meningitis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil approves a vaccine against 21 strains of the bacterium behind pneumonia and meningitis.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's ANVISA approved Capvaxive, a 21-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine from MSD, targeting 21 Streptococcus pneumoniae serotypes to prevent invasive pneumococcal disease and pneumonia in adults aged 18+. Approval was published in the Official Journal on the 28th after regulatory review that included input from the U.S. FDA. Capvaxive uses purified polysaccharide capsules conjugated to a carrier protein to elicit antibodies; covered serotypes include 3, 6A, 7F, 8, 9N, 10A, 11A, 12F, 15A, OAc15B, 16F, 17F, 19A, 20A, 22F, 23A, 23B, 24F, 31, 33F, and 35B. Eight serotypes are unique to Capvaxive compared with existing vaccines: 15A, 16F, 23A, 23B, 24F, 31, 35B, OAc15B. Streptococcus pneumoniae can cause otitis media, sinusitis, and invasive disease such as sepsis and meningitis. Phase 3 trials across the Americas, Europe, Asia‑Pacific and Africa enrolled ~8,400 adults; ~5,500 received Capvaxive; age groups: 18–49 (32%), 50–64 (32%), 65–74 (29%), 75+ (8%). Safety demonstrated in adults. In Brazil’s public system (SUS), Capvaxive is not automatically included; Pneumo 20 covers children under 5 and certain priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、肺炎と髄膜炎の原因菌に対する21価ワクチンを承認
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン承認に関する規制・製品ニュースであり、感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は肺炎球菌ワクチン（Capvaxive）のブラジルでの承認に関する製品・規制ニュースであり、感染症の発生・流行事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Напредок во справувањето со еболата во Конго, но вирусот продолжува да се шири во руралните области
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Progress in tackling Ebola in Congo, but the virus continues to spread in rural areas.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, the World Health Organization reports progress in controlling the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, but transmission continues in remote, hard-to-reach rural areas. WHO Emergencies Programme head Chikwe Ihekweazu notes improvements, particularly in former hotspots such as Bunia in eastern DRC, though new cases are appearing across an increasing number of rural zones, where medical and humanitarian access is difficult. UN Ebola Emergency Coordinator Julien Harnais notes the outbreak area is exceptionally large, complicating organization of the response, though activities are underway in roughly 80% of affected areas. Confirmed cases exceed 11,000, with spread into parts of East, Central and West Africa. In mid-May, authorities attributed the outbreak to the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there were no approved treatments or vaccines at that time. Security concerns persist with 80 attacks on health facilities and workers.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ対策で進展、しかしウイルスは農村部で拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが継続し、確定症例が11,000例を超え、農村部での拡大・医療アクセス困難・保健施設への攻撃など深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念が複数確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、モザンビーク・アンゴラは発生地域リストに含まれるが本文で言及されていないため除外。'East, Central and West Africa'への拡大は言及されているが具体的な対象国の特定がないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में लंपी वायरस का खतरा, गोसेवकों ने निगम कमिश्नर को सौंपा ज्ञापन, अधिकारियों को लगी फटकार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of Lumpy Skin Disease in Bhopal, cow protection volunteers submit memorandum to Municipal Commissioner, officials reprimanded.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) alert in Bhopal, India, as cow protection volunteers from Go Samman Aahwan Abhiyan submit a memorandum to Municipal Commissioner Ram Prakash Ahirwar warning that LSD symptoms in cattle around Old Bhopal could spread citywide. They demand two quarantine centers around Old Bhopal, with dedicated vehicles to transport sick cattle, deployment of veterinarians, medicines, and regular monitoring, plus a broad vaccination drive to protect healthy cattle. Spokespersons Sarman Batham and Jay Singh Thakur, joined by Pawan Gurjar and Dinesh Mali, emphasize isolating ill cattle and timely treatment. The Commissioner, after hearing the plea, criticizes the lack of quarantine centers and veterinarians and promises immediate action to establish centers and appoint veterinarians.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールでランピースキン病の脅威、牛保護活動家が市長に覚書を提出、当局者が叱責される
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（牛のランピースキン病）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は報告されておらず、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛の感染症であり人獣共通感染症ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国があってもヒト公衆衛生上のイベントではない。地域住民（牛保護団体）や行政の関心は見られるが、動物疾患カテゴリでありEBSのヒト感染症シグナルとしては対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Where will Ebola spread next? Travel patterns offer clues
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached its 17th, deadliest outbreak, declared May 15, 2026; by November 2026 the World Health Organization reports >10,920 confirmed cases and 5,323 deaths. Ongoing containment faces conflict-imposed access barriers and a testing snafu causing missed diagnoses. A Science study (Nov 12 issue) by Scarpino and colleagues introduces a mobility-based simulation to predict where new Ebola cases will appear before laboratory confirmation, using FlowMinder mobile data on travel from three outbreak centers between April 24 and May 24. The model shows that actual movement—especially trips to larger regional hubs and travel time between centers—drives spread more than distance alone, with a slight uptick in risk 150–200 km from centers. A shared outbreak dashboard supported by UNICEF officials underscores using mobility insights to guide testing, vaccine trials, and targeted preparedness amid limited resources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは次にどこへ拡大するか？渡航パターンが手がかりを示す
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大・最も致死的な第17次エボラアウトブレイク（感染者1万人超、死者5000人超）が継続中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 紛争による対応困難と検査の不備が指摘されており、科学誌(Science)の移動データモデルを用いた拡散予測研究が紹介されている。WHO・UNICEFが関与する大規模な継続中アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia apresenta redução de 68% no número de casos de Mpox em 2026.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia reports a 68% reduction in the number of Mpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Bahia, Brazil: eight confirmed cases through epidemiological week 45 of 2026, a 68% drop from 25 cases in the same period of 2025. By November 12, 2026, Bahia logged 241 notified cases, 44 suspected, 189 discarded. Confirmed cases include one with probable infection in Osasco, São Paulo; two in Maceió, Alagoas; one in Salvador; and one in Mata de São João, Bahia. Three additional lab-confirmed cases are under investigation for probable infection locations, with residents in Salvador. Despite the decline, a national alert and rising cases in other states sustain epidemiological vigilance for timely case identification, clinical-laboratory investigation, contact monitoring, and prevention/control measures. Vaccination follows WHO guidance via SUS and is not mass-based; indicated for high-risk groups (e.g., people living with HIV/AIDS, adults with CD4 <100 or <200, PrEP users, laboratory workers), with a two-dose schedule 28 days apart at Immunization Reference Centers, not UBS.

article.articleHeadline: Wirus dengi coraz bliżej turystów. Eksperci ostrzegają przed zagrożeniem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The dengue virus is getting closer to tourists. Experts warn of the threat.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases surge among travelers as outbreaks hit Mexico, Bolivia, Peru, Colombia (+53% in four weeks); the Dominican Republic records 415 cases this year in La Romana and Puerto Plata tourism zones; Honduras exceeds 12,000 by Oct. Asia reports about 131,205 cases in Vietnam (+37% YoY) and 136,930 in Bangladesh, with 427 deaths. In Europe, the ECDC reports 84 locally acquired dengue cases in 2026: 76 in Italy and 8 in France, with on-site transmission in outbreaks; spread aided by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, warmer temperatures, and global mobility. Poland shows 2025 total dengue cases at 86; by Sept 2026, 84 cases, mostly travel-associated. Kraków hospital treated two teenagers with dengue in Feb 2026; experts warn such cases will rise as exotic tourism increases. Dengue is mosquito-borne, not person-to-person, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes.

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo - Myths, Microphones and Medicine: Child broadcasters use radio to tackle Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared 15 May in Ituri Province, eastern DRC, has spread to 67 health zones across eight provinces with over 11,000 infections and more than 5,300 deaths, about a quarter among children, making it the largest Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second largest globally. Six months into the outbreak, Save the Children supports a child-led radio program on Radio Mont Bleu and Radio Télé Salama, engaging 35 children (ages 8–17) who speak in local languages and are on air twice weekly, with daily pre-recorded spots, aided by 10 young adults. The broadcasts explain how Ebola spreads, how to prevent infection, symptoms to look for, and where to seek help, countering myths and fear. The initiative promotes trust and protective behaviors, including regular handwashing and safe handling of the deceased, while schools stay safer and communities report symptoms promptly.

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Rio Branco intensifica combate à dengue no Jorge Lavocart
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Branco City Hall intensifies the fight against dengue in Jorge Lavocart.
article.articleSummary: Rio Branco City Hall intensifies dengue control in Jorge Lavocart, focusing on Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Under Mayor Alysson Bestene, the Municipal Health Secretariat mobilized 13 endemic-control teams, with three on the ground in Jorge Lavocart on 13 November 2026, conducting house visits to identify breeding sites and advise residents to eliminate standing water. The intensified effort coincides with the rainy season, which creates favorable conditions for mosquito proliferation; authorities note ongoing year-round work but heightened activity during the Amazon winter with more frequent rains. Community participation is emphasized: weekly cleaning of water tanks and removal of containers that can hold water to disrupt the mosquito life cycle. Residents like Eno Cláudio da Silva praise the preventive work. The city stresses that public cooperation is essential to protect health.

article.articleHeadline: LIRAa aponta que Varginha passa do baixo para o médio risco de infestação do mosquito Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LIRAa indicates that Varginha has moved from low to medium risk of Aedes aegypti infestation.
article.articleSummary: Varginha, Brazil, moved from low to medium risk for Aedes aegypti infestation in the latest LIRAa rapid index survey conducted in early November 2026. Field teams inspected 3,147 properties (1,749 closed) and found 34 larval-positive containers, most inside homes, especially plant pots and buckets. The Municipal Health Department urges community participation to curb vector proliferation and provides preventive guidance: conduct weekly inspections of indoor and outdoor spaces; eliminate water-holding plant dishes and containers; check flower pots, buckets, bottles, and other items; keep water tanks covered; clean gutters and drains regularly; and avoid leaving tires, bottles, or other materials exposed to rain. Officials reiterate that eliminating breeding sites is the most effective way to protect the community from dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

article.articleHeadline: Programmatic Study Tracks Mortality in Zambian Patients with Drug-Resistant
article.articleSummary: Zambia-based retrospective cohort study of adults co-infected with drug-resistant tuberculosis (DR-TB) and HIV, using National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Programme records from 2018–2022 across all ten provinces. Among 655 participants with documented outcomes, mortality was 11.0% (72 deaths). Median age 37 years; 62.4% male. DR-TB defined as Mycobacterium tuberculosis resistant to at least one anti-TB drug. A complete-case multivariable analysis (n=127) found higher mortality with brief treatment interruption (adjusted risk ratio [aRR] 10.18; 95% CI 2.18–47.46; p=0.003), alcohol consumption (aRR 7.16; 95% CI 1.29–39.70; p=0.019), and female sex (aRR 4.63; 95% CI 1.07–20.09; p=0.040). Sensitivity analysis excluding alcohol use changed significance, with hospital admission and pallor emerging as factors. Authors note substantial missing data, rendering complete-case findings exploratory and call for longitudinal research. Programmatic recommendations include enhanced treatment adherence, routine alcohol screening, and closer monitoring for hospitalized patients and those with pallor to mitigate mortality.

article.articleHeadline: La ONU alerta de una crisis humanitaria sin precedentes en Congo: hambre, guerra y ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN warns of an unprecedented humanitarian crisis in Congo: hunger, war, and Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UN agencies warn of an unprecedented humanitarian crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to armed conflict, mass displacement, hunger, and outbreaks of Ebola, mpox, and cholera. An Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) analysis projects about 30.3 million people could be in crisis or worse from January to June 2027, including 4.2 million in emergency levels—the highest recorded scale. As of now, roughly 29 million Congolese face acute food insecurity, with 3.6 million in emergency. The eastern provinces of North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri bear the greatest burden, with over 11 million potentially in crisis or worse in early 2027 due to fighting, violence and displacement. Malnutrition among children under five worsens amid limited access to food, safe water, and health services. FAO, WFP, UNICEF and WHO call for urgent funding, agricultural and nutritional support, and safe humanitarian access to protect civilians and sustain aid operations.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: exames ajudam a definir cuidados e necessidade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Tests Help Determine Required Care.
article.articleSummary: As of November 13, 2026, dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and caused by four serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4), requires rapid diagnostic testing to guide care. In Brazil, clinical staging groups patients as A to D to determine management from outpatient to intensive care; the staging is dynamic. NS1 antigen tests or RT-PCR are preferred in days 1–5 of symptoms, with RT-PCR identifying the circulating serotype. After day 6, serology (IgM/IgG) is recommended. The CBC and serial hematocrit monitor plasma leakage and dehydration risk; leukopenia, lymphocytosis with reactive lymphocytes, and thrombocytopenia are common. Severe dengue (Groups C and D) prompts comprehensive lab assessment: liver (AST/ALT, albumin, bilirubin), pancreatic, renal function, lactate, glucose, cardiac markers (Troponin I, CK-MB), and coagulation studies (PT, aPTT, D-dimer). Differential RT-PCR can detect Zika, Chikungunya, Leptospirosis, Malaria, Influenza, and COVID-19. November 21 marks Brazil’s National Dengue Fight Day.

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من انتشار إيبولا في ريف الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of the spread of Ebola in the rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of Ebola spread in rural areas of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, six months into the outbreak. While infections have declined in initial hotspots, cases are rising in hard-to-reach remote regions. In Bunia, treatment centers are operating at about half capacity, and access to peripheral communities remains hampered by insecurity. UN OCHA in Geneva notes that progress is fragile and response capacity must be more flexible and rapid amid ongoing security challenges from armed groups. Recently, violence by the Allied Democratic Forces has caused more deaths than Ebola itself. As of Wednesday, the Ministry of Health reports 11,042 Ebola infections and 5,387 deaths. Efforts to bolster outbreak response face hurdles in establishing new treatment centers due to unstable security conditions.

article.articleHeadline: Denguefieber breitet sich aus: Was Urlauber wissen müssen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is spreading: What travelers need to know.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. WHO estimates 100–400 million infections annually, with tropical-region transmission and sporadic European cases. Symptoms arise 4–10 days after a bite: high fever, severe headache, myalgia, nausea, rash; many infections are asymptomatic; most recover in 1–2 weeks. Rare dengue hemorrhagic fever or shock, risk higher after reinfection. Regions at risk: Southeast Asia, Central/South America, and the Caribbean (Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Brazil, Mexico, Dominican Republic); India, Sri Lanka, Maldives, and parts of Africa. Germany reports imported cases; no proven local transmission. Prevention: bite avoidance with DEET/picaridin/IR3535, light clothing, nets, and eliminating standing water. Vaccination with Qdenga is for travellers 4+ with prior lab-confirmed dengue infection traveling to risk areas, two doses ≥3 months apart; no general recommendation. If fever abroad, seek medical care; rest, fluids; paracetamol; avoid NSAIDs. Check Auswärtiges Amt advisories and ensure travel insurance with repatriation.

article.articleHeadline: Escolas de São José da Lapa fecham por um dia após casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São José da Lapa schools close for one day after cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: Five confirmed cases of scabies (human itch) in São José da Lapa’s municipal schools prompted a one-day closure on 13 November 2026 for sanitation, with CEMEIs and facilities such as Nape, Educarte, and Bombeiro Mirim also shut and classes resuming on 16 November. Authorities cite preventive measures guided by Note Técnica 02/2026 from Vigilância em Saúde, referencing SES-MG Note Técnica 9/2026, and implement a 48-72 hour sanitary lull to interrupt the parasite’s life cycle (mite survives 2-3 days off skin). In nearby Vespasiano, five school cases led to suspension of the municipal network until 17 November for cleaning, the first closure triggered by one confirmed case at Escola Municipal Vovó Mariquita. The Sul de Minas region remains the outbreak hotspot in 2026, with Alfenas reporting 332 records and cases in Andradas, Paraguaçu, and Lavras. article.articleHeadline: Nigeria accounts for 4.9% of global TB cases, ranks sixth - WHO Report
article.articleSummary: Nigeria accounts for 4.9% of the estimated global tuberculosis (TB) burden, ranking sixth among eight countries that together host about two-thirds of TB cases, per the WHO Global TB Report 2026 (2025 estimates). Top shares are India ~25%, Indonesia 10%, Philippines 6.8%, China 6.5%, Pakistan 6.4%; Nigeria 4.9%; DR Congo 3.9%; Bangladesh 3.7%. Nigeria remains among the 10 countries with the largest gaps between estimated incidence and reported cases, though more than 80% of estimated TB cases were diagnosed and notified, indicating progress in detection. TB notifications in Nigeria rose 2019–2025, a trend attributed to improved reporting rather than higher incidence. The report notes Nigeria among high-burden countries that increased domestic TB funding in 2025. Globally, 10.6 million developed TB in 2025; 1.13 million deaths; 8.4 million newly diagnosed and reported (79% of estimated); 370,000 rifampicin-resistant TB. Total funding about $6.6B in 2025, with donors down 14%.

article.articleHeadline: Chegada de turistas estrangeiros acende alerta para risco de sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrival of foreign tourists raises alarm over measles risk.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, Brazil's Ministry of Health issued an alert for regions hosting foreign tourists ahead of the summer season. In Santa Catarina’s coast and at Porto de Itajaí, cruise ships bring visitors from multiple countries, raising the risk of measles reintroduction. Measles is highly contagious and preventable by vaccination. Health authorities urge maintaining up-to-date vaccination records, emphasizing the doses of the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine as a key preventive measure for both individuals and the broader community during the peak tourist period. The guidance underscores vaccination as a frontline defense against importation of measles linked to international travel and cruise-ship activity. The article does not report current measles cases or outbreaks; its focus is preventive vaccination to minimize transmission risk in the tourism-heavy season.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS appelle à combler les lacunes de préparation au Soudan du Sud - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO urges closing gaps in preparedness in South Sudan - ACP
article.articleSummary: WHO urges closing gaps in South Sudan's preparedness to prevent importation of Bundibugyo ebolavirus from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Progress in Yambio, Nzara and other high-risk zones is acknowledged, but remaining gaps include coordination of interventions, infection prevention and control supplies, and safe-patient referral procedures to enable rapid response to suspected cases. The risk of cross-border Ebola importation rose from 67% in June to 99% in October 2026, linked to proximity to DRC, porous borders, cross-border trade, population movements, and humanitarian flows. A September joint assessment identified 3,450 people crossing from DRC. End-October preparedness stood at 72.5% with 15 priority counties having reinforced measures; 150 health workers trained (May–Oct 2026); temporary infectious disease units in eight priority counties. Simulation exercises Oct 19–24 showed detection is possible but containment capacity remains inadequate. Calls to strengthen coordination, surveillance, screening, isolation of suspected cases, and community engagement to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOが南スーダンの準備態勢の不備を是正するよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）について、南スーダンへの越境流入リスクが6月の67%から10月には99%まで上昇しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱の南スーダンへの越境リスクに関するWHOの警告が主題。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。実際の症例発生地はDRC国内であり、南スーダンは予防的対応段階（越境例の確認情報はあるが感染症例自体の報告はなし）。

article.articleHeadline: UN hails progress in Ebola response, cites insecurity as biggest challenge
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is driven by the Bundibugyo species, with no approved treatments or vaccines. UN/WHO report encouraging signs, including falling case numbers in former hotspots such as Bunia in eastern DRC. However, cases are now emerging in more rural, hard-to-reach areas. The biggest ongoing challenge is rising insecurity, with 80 attacks on health facilities and workers reported. Médecins Sans Frontières says supplies are missing and transmission remains out of control. UN Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis notes the vast operational area, yet states that 80% of the time teams are able to operate across the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ対応の進展を称賛も、治安悪化が最大の課題と指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ(ブンディブギョ種)の継続的な流行で、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、治安悪化により対応が困難化しており、国際的な支援が必要とされている。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ種エボラには承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、治安悪化(医療施設・従事者への攻撃80件)が対応の最大の障壁となっている。MSFは物資不足と感染拡大の制御不能を指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Morcego morto em piscina assusta família após alerta de raiva na Capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dead bat in a pool scares family after rabies alert in the capital.
article.articleSummary: Dead bat found under a pool cover in the Santo Antônio neighborhood, western Campo Grande, prompted a rabies alert as the city reported its 15th bat positive for the disease. The incident occurred Friday morning (13 November 2026) when an 84-year-old retiree’s pool cleaner spotted the animal; the bat was removed with cleaning equipment while the family awaited guidance. The household also found a scorpion and a spider within two days; however, the concern centered on potential exposure to rabies, especially as the homeowner’s dog is vaccinated but could be at risk. Guidance: do not touch fallen or strange bats, isolate the area, and contact CCZ for instructions and safe collection. If direct contact occurred, seek immediate health care for rabies post-exposure prophylaxis; report suspected dog/cat exposure to zoonoses.

triage.headline_ja: プールで死んだコウモリが発見され、州都で狂犬病警戒後に家族が動揺
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンポグランデで死んだコウモリ1匹が狂犬病陽性となった事例で、人への感染事例ではなく局地的な動物衛生対応であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 市内で15匹目の狂犬病陽性コウモリという記載があり地域的な監視対象ではあるが、ヒトへの感染や大規模流行の兆候はなく、通常の動物衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: há riscos de surtos da doença além do Rio de Janeiro? Entenda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Are there risks of disease outbreaks beyond Rio de Janeiro? Find out.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Brazil shows rising cases, with Rio de Janeiro reporting 390 records as of November 13, 2026, raising concerns about spread to other cities along the Rio-São Paulo axis. Experts say there is no national outbreak or panic. Transmission is mainly through direct skin-to-skin contact with lesions and bodily fluids; respiratory spread is less prominent than in COVID-19. Preventive guidance includes avoiding close contact with cases, not touching lesions, avoiding kisses and sexual contact with infected individuals, not sharing personal items, and frequent hand hygiene. Symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, and body aches; seek healthcare early for evaluation and testing to interrupt transmission. Isolation should continue until all crusts fall and a new skin layer forms, typically 2–3 weeks, longer for immunosuppressed. Vaccination is targeted to risk groups; Brazil has 20,000 doses, with delivery in ~3 weeks. High-risk groups include immunosuppressed, HIV with low CD4, pregnant individuals, and young children.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:リオデジャネイロ以外でも感染拡大のリスクはあるのか？解説
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロを中心にMpox症例が増加し他都市への拡大懸念があるが、専門家は全国的流行やパニックはないとしており、情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: リオ・サンパウロ軸での拡大懸念が記事の主題。専門家は現時点で全国的流行ではないと評価しており、ワクチン対応（2万回分）も進行中。続報での症例数推移・地理的拡大状況を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Invité Afrique Midi - Ebola en RDC: "On ne comprend pas pourquoi l'argent n'arrive pas dans les poches des travailleurs", interroge MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guest on Africa Midday - Ebola in the DRC: "We don't understand why the money isn't reaching the workers' pockets," MSF questions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains uncontrolled six months after the outbreak was declared, with over 11,000 cases and around 5,000 deaths. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) denounces a paradox: hundreds of millions of dollars have been mobilized, yet frontline workers lack essential resources, surveillance systems are faltering, and some health facilities have become sources of transmission. Claire Nicolet, MSF's head of emergencies, discusses these concerns as a guest on Africa Midday. The briefing underscores critical gaps in funding distribution, supply chains, and infection-control measures, challenging the effectiveness of the current response on the ground in the DRC. This framing points to the urgent need for effective resource delivery and stronger health-system protections on the ground.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ・ミディ招待 - コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ: 「なぜ資金が労働者の手に届かないのか理解できない」とMSFが問いかける
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が6か月経過しても制御できておらず、11,000例・5,000人死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、資金・資源配分の失敗や院内感染など管理能力の課題が指摘されているため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く(約45%)、医療従事者への資金・資源不足や医療施設での感染拡大が報告されており、既存の流行対応の実効性に重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 대응에 수억달러 지원했는데..."현장선 급여도 못받아"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds of millions of dollars in Ebola response funding, but salaries on the ground couldn't be paid.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that despite hundreds of millions of dollars earmarked for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, frontline operations remain underfunded and poorly supplied after six months into the outbreak. In Ituri and North Kivu, essential equipment and salaries have not reached front-line workers; some responders lack training, ambulances lack fuel, and surveillance teams exist on paper rather than in practice. Community outreach workers lack mobile phones or data to report risks. The response is uneven, with slower support in Ituri’s and North Kivu’s Beni Health Zone, where about 75% of Ebola infections occurred in healthcare facilities. In the past month, roughly two-thirds of Ebola deaths occurred in the community rather than treatment centers, signaling weak epidemiological surveillance. Only 9% of patients were identified as contacts via surveillance. As of Nov 11, cumulative confirmed cases reached 11,197 with 5,471 deaths (case fatality 48.9%). Africa CDC noted about $700 million of the $960.2 million allocated had unconfirmed use.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応に数億ドルを支援したが…「現場では給与も支払われていない」
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は累計11,197症例・致死率48.9%と深刻で、サーベイランス機能不全や資金不足により国際的拡大・管理困難のリスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 資金配分（約960百万ドルのうち700百万ドルの使途不明）や地域医療従事者への給与未払いが指摘されており、対応体制の脆弱性がアウトブレイク長期化・拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: variante associada a casos mais graves avança no Brasil; sintomas e tratamento mudam?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Variant Associated with More Severe Cases Advances in Brazil; Are Symptoms and Treatment Changing?
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox mpox in Brazil is driven by the Ib clade, with rising cases in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Ceará. Ib has been linked to more severe disease, but experts say new lineage does not automatically signal a larger or more lethal outbreak; the priority is strengthened diagnostics, genomic surveillance, and early case and contact identification. Both Ib and clade IIB are circulating; Rio de Janeiro shows Ib predominance, with São Paulo trending since September 2026. Transmission remains via close contact with skin or mucosal lesions, including sexual contact, not a respiratory route. Symptoms include lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, and myalgias; some patients have few lesions, possibly genital/perianal. No routine antiviral treatment; management relies on positive tests, monitoring and isolation. PCR from lesions confirms diagnosis; sequencing aids surveillance. Isolation until lesions crusted and healed; pet transmission documented. 25,000 mpox vaccine doses acquired; not routine amid shortage; Bavarian Nordic is the manufacturer.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:より重症化と関連する変異株がブラジルで拡大中；症状と治療は変化するか？
triage.triage_reason: より重篤とされるMpoxクレードIbがブラジル国内（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、セアラ）で拡大しており、従来クレードIIbが主流だった地域への新規クレード侵入・拡大という国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: クレードIb（従来DRC等で報告された重症型）がブラジルで複数州（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、セアラ）に拡大していることが特徴的。ワクチン不足の中2.5万回分を確保しているが、ルーティン接種には至らず。性的接触を含む近接接触による感染が主体で呼吸器感染ではないとされるが、クレードI系統の新地域への拡大は国際的監視上重要なシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Dengue Listesine Küba, Ekvador, Panama ve Peru'yu Ekledi: Florida'da Yerel Vaka Sayısı 524'e Ulaştı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC Adds Cuba, Ecuador, Panama and Peru to the Dengue List: Local Case Count in Florida Reaches 524.
article.articleSummary: CDC updates dengue travel alerts, adding Cuba, Ecuador, Panama, and Peru; Chad (Central Africa) and Wallis and Futuna (French Polynesia) are also included. Bolivia and Colombia remain listed; Bangladesh, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Marshall Islands, Vanuatu, and Vietnam stay at Level 1. Travelers are advised long sleeves, repellent, and staying in screened or air-conditioned rooms; dengue risk exists even in non-listed countries. In the United States, dengue is usually travel-related, but Florida reports a local outbreak: 524 locally acquired cases, bringing Florida total to 906, with 382 travel-associated and one death (an 80-year-old Tampa woman, Sept 4). U.S. total this year reaches 2,842. Hillsborough, Pasco, and Pinellas counties declared emergencies; vector-control uses larvicides by day and adulticides by night against Aedes aegypti, focusing on stagnant water and discarded tires. Dengue symptoms include high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias; severe dengue can cause abdominal pain and vomiting; no specific antiviral exists; supportive care; El Niño could prolong transmission.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがデング熱注意リストにキューバ、エクアドル、パナマ、ペルーを追加:フロリダの地域内感染者数が524人に達した
triage.triage_reason: 米国フロリダ州で地域内感染によるデング熱アウトブレイクが拡大し、死亡例や複数郡での緊急事態宣言が出ており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）が2つ該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はCDCの渡航勧告更新と米国フロリダ州内の地域感染拡大が主題。ベトナム等対象国はCDCのレベル1リストに留まる旨の記述のみで、実際の発生事象の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Des jeunes de la Croix-Rouge participent activement à la riposte d'Ebola à Kisangani - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young people from the Red Cross actively participate in the Ebola response in Kisangani - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Young Red Cross volunteers in Kisangani, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, are actively engaged in the Ebola virus disease response amid an ongoing outbreak. They are conducting community sensitization on Ebola symptoms, transmission, prevention, and alert reporting in schools, markets, households, and other public spaces to curb transmission. The initiative aims to counter misperceptions that the Red Cross only buries the dead, underscoring ongoing frontline engagement in prevention and awareness. An online meeting of youth division chiefs, chaired by Dr Triphine Mangombo Malonga, director of youth at the RDC Red Cross, reviewed activities and encouraged bankable project ideas to secure future funding. The report does not provide Ebola case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or infection sources, but confirms intensified youth-led outreach as part of the response in Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字の若者たちがキサンガニでのエボラ対応に積極的に参加 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キサンガニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する継続的な対応活動の報告であり、重症度が高く人道支援・国際支援の必要性が示唆されるためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の進行中エボラアウトブレイクへの赤十字青年部の支援活動に関する内容で、新規症例数や死亡者数などの疫学的詳細は含まれていない。既存のアウトブレイクの継続状況として経過観察・最新情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola en Ituri - Les prestataires de contrôle et prévention en grève sur l'axe Komanda-Yedi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola in Ituri - Control and Prevention Service Providers on Strike on the Komanda-Yedi Axis
article.articleSummary: Ebola control and prevention activities on the Komanda–Yedi axis in Ituri's Irumu territory are paralyzed since 12 November 2026 due to a strike by service providers contracted through the International Organization for Migration (IOM) who are demanding several months of salary arrears. On-site handwashing stations and temperature screening posts remain unmanned, with no staff to test or monitor travelers along this mining-heavy axis. Local civil society warns that weakened surveillance could fuel the spread of Ebola virus disease in a region with intense mining activity. The IOM indicates the dispute should be resolved shortly and notes that workers on the Bunia, Aru, Mahagi, and Nia-Nia axes have already been paid. The article does not report new laboratory confirmations or case counts, focusing instead on the payment quarrel and potential containment gaps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：イトゥリ州のエボラ出血熱 - コマンダ・イェディ路線で防疫サービス提供者がストライキ
triage.triage_reason: 活動中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク地域で、給与未払いを理由にIOM契約の防疫活動（手洗い場・体温検査）が停止しており、鉱山労働者の往来が激しい地域でサーベイランスの空白が生じているため、拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例の確認や具体的な感染者数には言及しておらず、IOM契約労働者の給与未払いによるストライキで防疫活動（検温・手洗い）が停止している点が主題。既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応における管理体制の脆弱性を示す情報として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prihatin Kasus TBC di Indonesia, Pelajar Surabaya Ciptakan Inovasi Teknologi Kesehatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerned About Tuberculosis Cases in Indonesia, a Surabaya-based Student Creates Health Technology Innovations.
article.articleSummary: Surabaya-based high school student Jonathan Edward Sutadji developed sCODA (Scarcity-aware Constrained Optimization of Dosing Allocation), a health-technology platform to optimize tuberculosis (TB) drug dosing in Indonesia based on available treatment budgets. The 17-year-old Ciputra School Surabaya student built a mathematical model and computer simulation to allocate TB medications efficiently, addressing Indonesia’s persistent TB burden. He extracted laboratory data from TB time-kill assays published by ERA4TB and used regression analysis to fit Mycobacterium tuberculosis growth kinetics against isoniazid. The optimization system then simulates multiple regimens to identify dosing combinations that maximize therapeutic impact within budget. sCODA earned two international awards in 2026: World Science, Environment and Engineering Competition (Jakarta, Aug 11–14) and the International Science and Invention Fair (ISIF) (UI, Depok, Oct 12–17).

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの結核症例を憂慮し、スラバヤの学生が保健医療技術イノベーションを創出
triage.triage_reason: 記事は学生による結核治療最適化技術の開発を紹介する内容であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の発生状況報告ではなく、学生による治療最適化アルゴリズム開発の技術紹介記事であるため、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Após raiva em morcegos, Sesau vacina cães e gatos em 3 bairros da Capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After rabies in bats, Sesau vaccinates dogs and cats in three neighborhoods of the capital.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, runs this weekend (Nov 14–15, 2026) to protect dogs and cats after rabies was detected in bats across the city. House-to-house vaccination will be conducted in Guanandi on both days, with two fixed vaccination points opening Saturday from 08:00–12:00 at the Coophavila II Community Center (Avenida Marinha, 725) and at Jardim Batistão Community Center (Rua Egito, 158) to serve Guanandi and nearby areas such as Tarumã, Jardim Corcovado, Bela Laguna. The initiative aims to immunize pets not yet vaccinated in 2026. Bat rabies virus has been identified in bats in different neighborhoods, with 16 notifications to date and no concentrated hotspot. People should avoid touching fallen or unusual bats; CCZ responders will handle collection. Annual rabies vaccination for dogs and cats is advised, though schedule may be rain-delayed.

triage.headline_ja: コウモリの狂犬病発生後、保健局が州都3地区で犬猫にワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病ウイルス確認と予防的なペットワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、ヒト感染例の報告はないが、地域での継続的曝露の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物（コウモリ）における狂犬病確認で、地元保健当局がペットへの予防接種を実施。ヒトへの感染事例は記載なし。16件の通知があるが集中的なホットスポットはないとされ、routine な公衆衛生対応の範疇と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）：武装袭击阻碍埃博拉疫情防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Armed attacks hinder Ebola outbreak control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains the largest since May 2026, with more than 11,000 confirmed cases and over 5,000 deaths. Transmission persists in the eastern and northeastern provinces, notably Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with about 400–500 new infections weekly. Rural and hard-to-reach areas continue to seed new cases. Armed attacks by the Democratic Alliance Army have severely hampered response, targeting health workers and facilities. In Kantine-Aloya, North Kivu, 66 civilians died (including 3 healthcare workers) amid assaults; two nurses were attacked in Ituri two weeks earlier, and there were arson attempts on treatment centers and vehicle attacks. WHO urges safe access and sustained community engagement. Separately, hunger and displacement are escalating: about 29 million people face severe food insecurity, with mid-2027 projections to around 30.3 million, especially in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：武装攻撃がエボラ出血熱の疫病対策を阻害
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が11,000例・5,000人以上の死者を伴い拡大継続中で、武装攻撃により対応が妨げられており、国際的な公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による攻撃で医療従事者や施設が標的となり、対応能力が著しく損なわれている。WHOは安全なアクセスの確保を要請。食料不安・避難民問題も併発し、対応をさらに複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Vespasiano (MG) suspende aulas após aumento de casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vespasiano (MG) suspends classes after an increase in human scabies cases.
article.articleSummary: Vespasiano, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan region, Minas Gerais, Brazil, suspended classes across municipal schools after six confirmed human scabies cases—five students and one teacher. Five cases are in municipal schools; one in a state school. On Monday, a municipal school had paused classes after a student case; a state school also suspended for one day. The municipal network includes 41 schools and about 16,000 students. The four-day suspension—Thursday, Friday, Monday and Tuesday—is preventive to allow cleaning of facilities; classes will be provided remotely by school leadership groups to parents. Scabies is caused by a mite and spreads by direct skin contact or prolonged contact with contaminated clothing. Main symptom: intense itching, worse at night, often with small skin lesions. The Health Secretariat notes at least 11 municipalities in Minas have scabies outbreaks this year; cases are not mandatory-notifiable, with about 700 cases estimated citywide.

triage.headline_ja: ヴェスパジアーノ市(ミナスジェライス州)、人間疥癬の感染増加を受け授業を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡大リスクが低い一般的な皮膚疾患だが、学校での集団発生により授業停止措置が取られ、州内複数自治体で流行していることから経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は届出義務のない疾患であり、致死率・重症度は低いが、学校という閉鎖環境での集団感染と州内複数自治体での流行拡大が報告されているため、地域内公衆衛生対応として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: 12,5 tonnes de produits de prévention remises à l'aéroport de Ndjili, au ministère de la Santé, à la police et au CHU50 par la Fondation Angel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 12.5 tonnes of prevention supplies delivered to N'Djili International Airport, to the Ministry of Health, to the police, and to CHU50 by the Angel Foundation
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains active in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus—the 17th outbreak in the country. As of 11 November 2026, INSP reports 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 deaths (case fatality rate 48.9%), across eight provinces and 68 health zones. In Kinshasa, the Angel Foundation delivered 12.5 tonnes of hygiene and prevention supplies on 10–11 November to strengthen public health response: 4.5 tonnes to Ndjili International Airport’s Regie des Voies Aériennes (RVA) and 8 tonnes to other institutions, including 4 tonnes to the Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare, the Congolese National Police (PNC) General Commissariat, and the Cinquantenaire University Hospital Center (CHU50). The initiative, aligned with corporate social responsibility, aims to anticipate spread as Kinshasa remains unscathed. Authorities emphasize prevention and sustained public-private collaboration in the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（DRC）：エンジェル財団がンジリ空港、保健省、警察、CHU50に12.5トンの予防物資を提供
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で継続中の第17次エボラ流行（確定11,197例、死亡5,471例、CFR48.9%）に関する報道であり、既に大規模な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため、既知アウトブレイクながらフルRRA対象として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事自体はキンシャサでの予防物資配布に関する内容だが、背景として東部8州68保健地域にわたる進行中の大規模エボラ流行（CFR約49%）が明記されており、既存アウトブレイクの深刻度・規模からPICKUP判定とした。キンシャサは支援物資の集積地であり、感染確認地域ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox avança no DF com alta de 91%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox advances in the Federal District with a 91% increase.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil's Federal District (DF) rose to 44 confirmed cases, up 91% from 23 in the prior week, per SES-DF data published on 12 November 2026. All cases are male; 61.3% are aged 30–39, with 39 residents of DF. Symptoms emerged mainly in October–November. There is no confirmed sustained community transmission or localized outbreak yet. National data show Brazil surpassed 1,000 mpox cases in 2025, with the highest counts in Rio de Janeiro (390) and São Paulo (388), followed by Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), and DF. Most cases are mild or moderate; severe disease occurs in immunosuppressed individuals (e.g., AIDS). Vaccination: 25,000 doses procured; DF received 100 doses on 7 November; two-dose schedule with 28 days. Priority groups include HIV/AIDS patients with CD4 <100; remaining doses may go to others (CD4 <200, PrEP users, lab workers).

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区でMpoxが91%増加
triage.triage_reason: Mpox症例が週91%増加しているが、重症例は少なく持続的な地域内伝播は未確認。ワクチン接種等の対応策が既に進行中であり、現時点ではフルリスク評価より継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジル連邦直轄区（DF）における週次91%増加は局地的指標であり、全国的にはリオデジャネイロ・サンパウロが最多。HIV/AIDS患者等免疫抑制者への重症化リスクに注意が必要だが、ワクチン接種プログラムが既に稼働中。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia registra redução de 68% nos casos de Mpox em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia records a 68% reduction in Mpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases in Bahia, Brazil, total eight confirmed through epidemiological week 45 of 2026, a 68% drop from 25 cases in the same period last year. By November 12, Bahia logged 241 notifications: 44 under investigation and 189 discarded. Of the eight confirmed, probable infection locations include Osasco, São Paulo; two in Maceió, Alagoas; one in Salvador; one in Mata de São João (Salvador metropolitan area). Three lab-confirmed cases still have infection locations under epidemiological investigation; all residents are from Salvador. Despite the Bahia decline, surveillance remains active due to increasing cases in other states, with emphasis on timely case identification, clinical-laboratory investigation, contact monitoring, and preventive/containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: バイア州、2026年のMpox症例が68%減少
triage.triage_reason: 症例数は前年比68%減少と改善傾向にあり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められず、監視体制も平常通り機能している。
triage.notes: 記事は症例減少を報告する内容であり、他州での増加に言及しているが具体的データはなく、本記事の主題はブラジル・バイア州の状況改善である。

article.articleHeadline: GENEVA / DRC EBOLA AND CONFLICT
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Bundibugyo-virus Ebola outbreak, six months after declaration, is spreading in eastern and northeastern provinces, including Bunia in Ituri and North Kivu. As of 13 November 2026, more than 11,000 people have fallen ill and over 5,400 have died, with up to 500 new cases weekly. Children account for more than one-third of deaths. Transmission, though previously brought under control in early epicenters, remains fragile amid rising insecurity and more than 80 verified attacks on healthcare over six months, hindering surveillance, treatment, and access. UN Ebola Response Coordinator Julien Harneis notes violence in hundreds of villages and clashes with Allied Democratic Forces (ADF). The World Food Programme warns conflict and Ebola deepen a hunger crisis, with nearly 29 million people in acute food insecurity, projected to 30.3 million by mid-2027.

triage.headline_ja: ジュネーブ／DRCのエボラ出血熱と紛争
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクが6か月経過後も拡大し、1万人超の症例・5,400人超の死亡、紛争による医療妨害が続いており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 国連ジュネーブでの報道であり、紛争（ADFとの衝突、医療施設への80件以上の攻撃）が感染対策を妨げている点、食料危機との複合リスクも指摘されている。国境を越えた拡大の具体的証拠は本文に明記されていないため、国際的拡大リスクは地域紛争の文脈から推定。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil ultrapassa mil casos de mpox em 2026; veja cenário no ES - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil surpasses 1,000 mpox cases in 2026; see the outlook for Espírito Santo - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil, as of November 12, 2026, reaches 1,023 confirmed cases, 46 probable, and 581 suspected, with 1 death. Rio de Janeiro leads with 390 confirmations; São Paulo 388; Ceará 61; Minas Gerais 45; Distrito Federal 41; Santa Catarina 24. October and November together account for over half of 2026 cases (293 in October, 227 in November). The national peak occurred in 2022 with 10,591 cases and 4,265 in August. Since notifications began, Brazil has 15,455 cases and 19 deaths. Espírito Santo reports 17 confirmed mpox cases (7 Jan–Sep; 10 in October) and 197 discarded, all among men. MPXV, an Orthopoxvirus zoonosis, transmits via direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, contaminated objects, or prolonged close respiratory exposure; symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions. Mass vaccination is not routine; 25,000 imported doses were recently purchased for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2026年のMpox症例数が1,000件を突破；エスピリトサント州の状況
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年のMpox症例が1,000件を超えたが、致死率は低く（1例/1,023例）、既存の流行状況の定例報告に留まるため、直ちにフルリスク評価を要する新規性は乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事は国内サーベイランスの定例更新であり、2022年のピーク（10,591例）と比較して現在の流行規模は小さい。ワクチン接種（高リスク群向け2.5万回分）が実施されており、国として対応能力を有すると見られる。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": إيبولا يتفشى في الكونغو الديمقراطية - جريدة مانشيت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Manchit Newspaper
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in rural Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), per the World Health Organization. Latest Health Ministry data report 11,042 infections and 5,387 deaths. Six months into the outbreak, cases have declined in areas where initial infections appeared, but rise in remote, hard‑to‑reach zones. Bunia treatment centers operate at about half capacity, underscoring strained resources. Security remains precarious due to militia violence, complicating access and response efforts. UN OCHA Ebola coordinator in Bunia, Julian Harnie, cites the volatile security situation as the main challenge. In recent days, more deaths have occurred from violence by the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) than from Ebola. Africa CDC notes 66 civilians killed last week, including three health workers, and three health facilities looted or burned. WHO is bolstering flexible, rapid response to reach affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）:エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大 - マンシート紙
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（感染11,042人、死亡5,387人）が継続し、治安悪化によりアクセスが困難化、WHOが対応強化中であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 治安悪化（ADFによる民兵活動）が対応の主要な障害となっており、エボラ自体の死者数より紛争関連死が多いとの報告あり。国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクについては記事内に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Hunger Crisis: Record 30 Million Face Acute Hunger as WFP Ties Food Aid to Ebola Control
article.articleSummary: 30.3 million people in the DRC are projected to face Crisis-level hunger or worse between January and June 2027, up from 26.5 million in Jan-Jun 2026, in a joint release by FAO, WFP, UNICEF and WHO dated Nov 13, 2026. About 97% of those directly affected by the Ebola outbreak still need food assistance, prompting WFP to frame feeding families as part of stopping the virus. IPC classifies this period as Emergency-level hunger, with overall figures around 4.2 million. More than 11 million of the 30.3 million are in North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri. Nine territories are in Emergency: Djugu (Ituri); Lubero, Masisi, Oïcha (North Kivu); Fizi, Kalehe, Mwenga (South Kivu). WFP has delivered over 744,000 hot meals in 59 treatment and isolation facilities; plans include dry rations for relatives of patients and suspected cases and seeds before early-2027 planting. The release calls for funding and safe access.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ飢餓危機：2027年に過去最多3,030万人が深刻な食料不足に直面、WFPはエボラ対策と食料支援を連動
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行継続下で約3,030万人が深刻な食料危機に直面し、感染者の97%が食料支援を必要とするなど人道・公衆衛生上の複合的リスクが高く、国際支援の必要性が明示されているためフルRRAに進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける既存エボラ流行と食料危機の関連性を扱う人道支援報告であり、新規感染拡大の発生地域ではない。Fijiは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事内容と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo : l'Institut national de recherche biomédicale présente les résultats d'un projet - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Bundibugyo: The National Institute for Biomedical Research presents the results of a project - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, November 13, 2026 — Preliminary Phase I results from the EBO-BIOME project in the Democratic Republic of Congo address bacterial infections associated with Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease. Presented in Kinshasa and opened by Jean-Jacques Muyembe-Tamfum, director general of the National Institute for Biomedical Research, the seminar evaluated integrating multiplex PCR for bacteria into routine diagnostics. This molecular technique enables simultaneous detection of multiple bacterial agents from a single sample, aiming to improve identification of bacterial infections linked to Ebola Bundibugyo and to guide patient management. Funded by the Government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, EBO-BIOME supports national scientific research and mobilization of biomedical knowledge to bolster epidemic response. The initiative seeks to enhance diagnostic capacity and protect population health by strengthening routine laboratory workflows in the context of Ebola research.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギョ：国立生物医学研究所がプロジェクト結果を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスという重大な病原体に関する記事だが、本記事は研究プロジェクトの結果発表であり、新規の流行や患者発生の報告ではない。現在進行中の疫学的リスクの直接的な証拠がなく、情報不足のため要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はEBO-BIOMEプロジェクト（エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルスに関連する細菌感染症の診断能力強化プロジェクト）の研究結果発表セミナーに関するもの。新規患者発生や流行の拡大を示唆する情報は含まれていない。DRC政府支援の研究活動であり、政府の公開セミナーとして実施されている点から、既存の感染症対応能力の強化が主要テーマと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Governo reforça alerta para vacinação contra sarampo após novos casos no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government steps up alert for measles vaccination after new cases in the country
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak alert in Brazil. As of November 4, 2026, Brazil has confirmed 65 measles cases, with 41 in São Paulo, but transmission remains non-endemic nationwide. The federal government has intensified vaccination messaging after outbreaks in other countries. The measles vaccine (MMR: measles, mumps, rubella) is provided free by the SUS at basic health units. Schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months; people aged 12–29 years should have two doses; those 30–59 years should receive one dose if not previously vaccinated; health workers require two doses regardless of age. Measles is highly contagious and airborne; symptoms include high fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a red rash that starts on the face and spreads. Complications can include pneumonia and encephalitis, especially in young children and the immunocompromised. Pregnant women and severely immunosuppressed individuals should not receive the vaccine; seek medical advice if fever with rash and respiratory symptoms and inform the health unit in advance.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、国内での麻疹新規症例を受けワクチン接種の注意喚起を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹65例確認（うちサンパウロ41例）だが、現時点で非流行性と報告されており、政府は啓発強化段階。重症例・死亡等の情報がなく、続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹（はしか）に焦点。疾患名リストに風疹・ムンプス・脳炎が含まれるが、これはMMRワクチン関連の言及であり、実際の流行はMeasles(麻疹)のみ。重症度・死亡者数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Variante associada a casos mais graves avança no Brasil; sintomas e tratamento mudam? | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Variant associated with more severe cases advancing in Brazil; do symptoms and treatment change? | abc+.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, mpox in Brazil is rising, driven by clade Ib, with cases in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Ceará. Clade Ib, linked to severe disease, has not shown clear evidence of higher transmissibility or mortality in Brazil; risk remains higher for immunocompromised individuals (advanced HIV), pregnant women, and children. Both clade Ib and clade IIB are circulating; in Rio de Janeiro clade Ib predominates, and São Paulo shows advance, based on sequences since September 2026. Transmission is by contact with skin or mucosal lesions, including sexual contact; no routine respiratory spread. Symptoms: lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, and myalgias; some patients have few lesions, possibly genital or perianal. Diagnosis via PCR from lesions; clade typing by sequencing informs surveillance, not routine care. Management is monitoring and isolation. The Health Ministry has procured 25,000 mpox vaccine doses and promotes intradermal administration to stretch supply; vaccination is not routine.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:より重症化と関連する変異株がブラジルで拡大中;症状と治療は変わるのか?
triage.triage_reason: WHOが国際的懸念とするクレードIbがブラジル複数州（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、セアラ）で拡大しており、重症化リスクや免疫不全者・妊婦・小児への影響、ワクチン供給確保等の対策状況から公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: クレードIbはWHOが2024年にPHEICを宣言した変異株であり、ブラジルでの拡大・複数州への広がりは注視が必要。致死率・感染力の明確な上昇エビデンスは現時点でなしとされているが、免疫不全者等への影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil supera los mil casos del virus Mpox en 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil surpasses one thousand Mpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 1,023 mpox (Monkeypox) confirmed cases in 2026, with 46 probable, 581 suspected, and one death, per the Health Ministry as of 13 November 2026. Rio de Janeiro leads with 390 confirmed infections, followed by Sao Paulo (388), Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), the Distrito Federal (41), and Santa Catarina (24). Of the year's confirmed cases, 293 occurred in October and 227 in November. Since mpox surveillance began in Brazil, 15,455 infections and 19 deaths have been recorded. Mpox is caused by MPXV, an Orthopoxvirus zoonosis transmitted mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily secretions, or contaminated objects; symptoms include skin eruptions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, chills, and weakness. The Health Ministry plans to deploy 25,000 vaccine doses—procured via PAHO’s Revolving Fund with a Danish manufacturer—administered intradermally to extend coverage up to fivefold in high-risk groups (people living with HIV, PrEP users, and laboratory workers handling MPXV samples). Vaccination is targeted, not mass.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで2026年のMpox（サル痘）感染者数が1000人を突破
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxはブラジルで継続的なサーベイランス下にある既知の流行であり突発的異常性は低いが、症例数増加とハイリスク層への曝露継続が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 保健省はPAHO回転基金を通じてワクチン2.5万回分を調達し、HIV陽性者・PrEP使用者・検査従事者など高リスク層への標的接種を計画。累計では15,455例・19死亡と長期化している流行。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna humana já atinge pelo menos 17 cidades do Sul de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of human scabies has already reached at least 17 cities in southern Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreaks have spread to at least 17 municipalities in southern Minas Gerais, Brazil, surpassing the state's official tally of 11 outbreaks this year. The latest case is São Thomé das Letras, where 16 people were infected and a municipal committee was formed to coordinate response. Ingaí reports 22 confirmed cases as of November 13, with three municipal schools closed for two days for cleaning and infection control. Alfenas—first to confirm cases in August—now hosts the largest cluster, with over 330 infections, mainly among children up to five years in municipal day-care centers. Other southern towns with outbreaks include Paraguaçu, Andradas, Lavras, Caldas, Campos Gerais, Elói Mendes, Itutinga, Luminárias, Machado, Poços de Caldas, Santana da Vargem, São Lourenço, Turvolândia and Varginha. Outside the region, cases are noted in Belo Horizonte and its metro area, Lagoa Santa, Joaquim Felício, São Gonçalo do Pará, Itapecerica and Coronel Xavier Chaves. Transmission is primarily via prolonged direct skin contact; authorities emphasize surveillance and control measures, including school closures where needed.

triage.headline_ja: 南ミナスジェライス州の少なくとも17都市で疥癬（かいせん）の集団発生が拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内（ミナスジェライス州南部）で疥癬の集団発生が拡大しているが、疾患自体の重症度は低く、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬は人から人への直接接触で感染するが、致死性は低く重症度は限定的。地元自治体レベルでの学校閉鎖や委員会設置など対応が取られているが、外部（国際）支援の必要性は示唆されていない。続報があれば感染拡大の規模・持続性を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Equipes do mutirão contra a Dengue de Limeira percorrem três bairros neste sábado | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Teams from Limeira's dengue task force visit three neighborhoods this Saturday | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: 85 health agents will conduct a dengue-control blitz in Limeira, São Paulo, on Saturday, 14 November 2026, from 7:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. The teams will operate in Conjunto Residencial Victor D'Andrea (Cecap), Conjunto Residencial Parque Novo Mundo, and Jardim Residencial Vitória. The action aims to intensify prevention and control of Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector. The mobilization will feature uniformed agents wearing badges. The Secretaria de Saúde urges residents to welcome the teams, permit home inspections, and help identify and eliminate potential mosquito breeding sites. The operation is part of the municipality's ongoing efforts to prevent diseases and promote public health and well-being in the community.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラのデング熱対策チームが今週土曜日に3地区を巡回 | Rápido no Ar
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地方自治体によるデング熱予防活動（蚊の発生源対策・家屋訪問）の告知であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州リメイラ市における定例のデング熱予防活動（ブリッツ作戦）の告知であり、症例数や流行状況に関する記述はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、感染症イベントとしての異常性・緊急性がないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil ultrapassa a marca de 1000 casos de Mpox em 2026; Rio de Janeiro lidera registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil surpasses the 1,000-case Mpox milestone in 2026; Rio de Janeiro leads in records.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (MPXV, Orthopoxvirus) reached 1,023 confirmed infections in Brazil in 2026, with 46 probable and 581 suspected cases and one death as of 12 November. Rio de Janeiro state leads the national count with 390 confirmed cases, edging São Paulo (388). Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), the Federal District (41), and Santa Catarina (24) also report cases. Over October and November the outbreak intensified, with 293 confirmed cases in October and 227 provisional records in November, together accounting for more than half of 2026’s total. The country’s 2022 mpox outbreak remains the historic peak (10,591 cases; 4,265 in August). Transmission occurs mainly via direct skin-lesion contact, bodily secretions, contaminated objects, or prolonged close respiratory exposure. To curb spread, the Ministry of Health has purchased 25,000 new vaccine doses for high-risk groups; preventive measures include avoiding contact with lesions, not sharing personal items, and seeking medical assessment for compatible symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで2026年のMpox症例数が1000例を突破、リオデジャネイロ州が最多
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でMpox症例が急増（10月293例、11月227例）し死亡例も発生、複数州に拡大しており、WPRO基準で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 2022年の歴史的ピーク（10,591例）と比較すると現状は低水準だが、2026年単年での増加傾向と死亡例の発生が懸念される。保健省は高リスク群向けに新たなワクチン25,000回分を購入し対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Guterres, ébola, robots asesinos, Gaza... las noticias del viernes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guterres, Ebola, killer robots, Gaza... Friday's news.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak, the WHO reports over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths, with about 400–500 new cases weekly. Initial epicenters are under control, but rural transmission persists and treatment centers run at roughly half capacity. Violence against health workers complicates response, with more than 80 verified attacks in six months. Three experimental Ebola treatments are in trials, plus two post-exposure prophylaxis options, and candidate vaccines will be deployed in coming weeks. The outbreak has crossed into Nigeria (first patient detected there, a Swiss national who had traveled via Uganda) and has led to imported/exported cases in Kenya and Nigeria that have been contained with no further spread; the infection source remains unclear. The UN calls for a treaty banning autonomous weapons; in Gaza, rains exacerbate a fragile humanitarian crisis.

triage.headline_ja: グテーレス、エボラ、自律型兵器（キラーロボット）、ガザ…金曜日のニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は6か月で11,000例・5,400人死亡と深刻化しており、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境伝播も発生している。IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は国連ニュースの複合ダイジェストであり、エボラ以外（ガザ、自律型兵器）は本トリアージの対象外。ナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境例は封じ込め済みとされるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Rusya'da 'gizemli hastalık' paniği! Dikkat çeken 'Vietnam' detayı: Bu semptomlar görüldü - Bursa Hakimiyet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Panic over a 'mysterious disease' in Russia! Notable 'Vietnam' detail: These symptoms were observed.
article.articleSummary: Russia faces panic over a mysterious illness linked to tourists returning from Vietnam’s Nha Trang. An unidentified virus caused serious illness in vacationers, prompting a claimed emergency investigation. Patients showed high fever, severe headache, runny nose, and a cough that can last for weeks. Vietnamese doctors reportedly struggled to reach a definite diagnosis, describing the illness vaguely as a common flu virus. The episode follows a prior spike in concern after the sudden death of a laboratory worker at Irkutsk's plague research institute, with the new reports arising five weeks later. Daily Star is cited as the source of the information.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで『謎の病気』へのパニック拡大！注目される『ベトナム』の詳細：これらの症状が確認された
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム旅行帰りのロシア人観光客に原因不明の症状が報告されているが、病原体・重症度・患者数など具体的情報が乏しく、タブロイド系メディア（Daily Star発）の未確認情報であるため、現時点ではフルRRAには進まず続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はトルコのタブロイド紙がDaily Starを引用したもので、ベトナム人医師が『通常のインフルエンザ』と曖昧に説明したとされるなど、情報源の信頼性が低い。イルクーツクのペスト研究所職員死亡との関連も推測的であり、続報の信頼性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Agra News: आगरा में दो बच्चों समेत चार नए डेंगू के मरीज मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agra News: Four new dengue cases, including two children, were found in Agra.
article.articleSummary: Four new dengue cases, including two children, confirmed in Agra as cooler weather drives mosquitoes to shelter indoors. Of 17 samples from patients with high fever and body/mone pains, four tested positive for dengue; all patients are stable and receiving home care, with no hospitalizations. District malaria officer reported locating dengue larvae in 12 houses during inspections, noting mosquitoes hiding in corners, behind curtains, and on shelves indoors due to declining outdoor temperatures. Health teams conducted immediate anti-larval spraying and urged residents to maintain indoor cleanliness and eliminate standing water to curb transmission. This localized cluster indicates ongoing dengue transmission risk in Agra as of 14 November 2026, though there are no severe cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: アグラでデング熱新規4例、子ども2人を含む
