triage.triage_reason: 軽症・通常対応範囲内の小規模デング熱クラスターであり、重症例や入院もなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当性が低い日常的な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局が幼虫駆除などの通常対応を実施済み。全例軽症で在宅療養中、入院例なし。季節性の局地的事例と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria encontrada em queijo Italy tem riscos e pode causar meningite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacteria found in Italian cheese pose risks and can cause meningitis
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-13, Italian-sourced sliced mozzarella, lot 180926, has been linked to Listeria monocytogenes infection, prompting a recall and suspension of sale by Brazil's Anvisa. The Italian cheese is produced by Agroindústria Santo Anjo, which notified Anvisa and initiated the recall. Consumers with the affected lot should not consume the product and may seek refunds from the point of purchase or the manufacturer. Infected individuals should monitor for nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and fever, seeking medical care if symptoms appear. Listeriosis often causes no symptoms, but risk groups include pregnant people, children, elderly, and immunocompromised individuals; fetal infection can cause abortion during pregnancy. Gastrointestinal symptoms can appear within 24 hours; more severe illness may take weeks and requires antibiotic treatment. The bacterium can also contaminate produce, unpasteurized dairy, undercooked meats, and processed meats.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア産チーズに発見された細菌にリスクあり、髄膜炎を引き起こす可能性
triage.triage_reason: 単一ロットの製品リコール事案であり、現時点で感染者報告や集団発生の明確な情報はないが、リステリア菌の重症化リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: イタリア産モッツァレラチーズの特定ロットに関する製品回収報告であり、感染者数や発生地域の広がりについての情報は記事内に無い。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、ブラジルのAnvisaによるリコール対応が主題であるためBrazilのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: EASTERN PROVINCE RECORDS SEVEN SUSPECTED CHOLERA CASES - Zambia 24
article.articleSummary: 13 November 2026 — In Zambia's Eastern Province, seven suspected cholera cases were detected as part of heightened surveillance. The Eastern Province Health Office, through the public health emergency center, conducts surveillance at each health facility to detect emergencies for quick action. Public Health Specialist Dr. Bernard Chimungu said seven samples were later confirmed not to be cholera, returning as normal diarrhoea cases. Chimungu emphasized continued vigilance and ongoing sampling at health facilities to detect any emerging cases promptly. The health authorities urged the community to maintain high hygiene standards and proper waste management to prevent outbreaks. Nationwide, Zambia has reported 2,743 cholera cases and 62 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 東部州で疑いコレラ症例7件を記録 ― ザンビア24
triage.triage_reason: 地域での疑い症例は陰性と判明したが、ザンビア全国で2,743例・62名の死亡者を伴う進行中のコレラ流行が継続しており、重篤度と公衆衛生対応の必要性から監視継続が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事で報告された東部州の疑い症例7件は最終的に通常の下痢症と判明し、コレラではなかった。ただし全国規模での流行（2,743症例、62死亡）は継続しており、既存のアウトブレイク状況として監視を継続する必要がある。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Ebola in the DRC: What Puts Frontline Health Workers at Risk? | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: EBOLA outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with 10,879 confirmed cases and 5,302 deaths as of Nov 6. Frontline health workers face mounting infection risks: Africa CDC reported 427 infections and 67 deaths among health workers as of Nov 3. A confirmed frontline worker from North Kivu was flown by private jet to the United Kingdom for care. IPC gaps worsen exposure: in North Kivu, 41–50% of assessed workers were high risk; in Tshopo, 3 high-risk staff linked to the province’s 95th case; only 11% of staff trained in IPC. Post-exposure prophylaxis exists (601 recipients) and 66 confirmed patients received experimental treatment (63 remdesivir, 3 MBP134), though 22 workers paused prophylaxis due to threats. Attacks on health facilities and staff—nurse killed in Tshopo; treatment center partially burned; grenade at a North Kivu health zone office—demand security escorts. Strikes and pay issues in Bas-Uélé, Ituri, and Haut-Uélé further strain care and essential services.

triage.headline_ja: DRCにおけるブンディブギョ型エボラ出血熱：最前線の医療従事者を危険にさらす要因とは？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で10,879例・5,302死亡という大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、医療従事者の感染・死亡、治療拠点への攻撃、感染者の国際搬送など、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 英国への患者搬送は治療目的の国際移送であり、英国内でのアウトブレイク発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。感染拡大はDRC国内（北キブ、ツショピ、イトゥリ、バ・ウエレ、オー・ウエレ等）に限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: IOM urges wider Ebola surveillance as Uganda and DR Congo expand border cooperation
article.articleSummary: Ebola surveillance expansion faces $59.8 million funding shortfall, threatening IOM-led efforts to screen transit routes beyond official checkpoints in the DRC and along borders with Uganda. In the DRC, IOM-supported screening identified 71 Ebola cases, 95% detected on informal routes. On Nov 4, Uganda and the DRC agreed on a cross-border health security roadmap to expand joint surveillance at entry points and border communities, improve information sharing, and coordinate outbreak response. The plan follows WHO International Health Regulations recommendations; WHO urged neighboring countries to coordinate land-crossing surveillance and share follow-up information on exposed individuals. Ongoing insecurity and displacement in eastern DRC hinder access to affected communities; IOM called for sustained funding to keep screening and frontline worker support. The WHO continues to deem Ebola outbreak a PHEIC; the DRC updated its national plan through January 2027.

triage.headline_ja: IOM、ウガンダとDRCの国境協力拡大に伴いエボラ監視体制の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行はWHOにより引き続きPHEICとされており、国境を越えた拡大・非公式ルートでの検出多数など公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として挙げられているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。資金不足（約5980万ドル）によるサーベイランス縮小リスクが特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria De Saúde De São Bernardo Esclarece Dúvidas Sobre Mpox - ABC Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Bernardo Health Department Clarifies Questions About Mpox - ABC Now
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in São Bernardo do Campo, Brazil, reports three confirmed cases in 2026 (two city residents and one from another municipality), a 63% decline from eight cases in 2025. Officials say there is no outbreak, but surveillance is intensified after confirmation. A technical note was distributed to all health facilities to guide case management and ensure immediate notification within 24 hours. Nationally, by mid‑November 2026 there were 908 cases in Brazil, including 320 in São Paulo state and 11 in the Grande ABC region. Mpox transmission is mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, crusts, mucous membranes, or contaminated objects; incubation is 3–16 days (up to 21). Main symptoms include skin lesions (which may be localized, including genital/perianal), fever, chills, headache, myalgias, lymphadenopathy, and malaise; fever may be absent. Individuals with symptoms should seek care at a UPA for containment and isolation guidance if confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: サンベルナルド保健局、Mpoxに関する疑問を解消
triage.triage_reason: 症例数は減少傾向にあり、当局もアウトブレイクを否定しており、既知の流行継続に関する定例的な情報提供記事であるため。
triage.notes: 症例数は前年比63%減少し、当局はアウトブレイクではないと明言。既存のMpox流行状況のアップデート記事であり、新規の重大シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: EASTERN RECORD SEVEN SUSPECTED CHOLERA CASES - Zambia 24
article.articleSummary: Eastern Province, Zambia, heightens surveillance after seven suspected cholera cases were detected. Public Health Specialist Dr. Bernard Chimungu said the Public Health Emergency Center enables surveillance at all health facilities for rapid action. All seven suspected cholera samples were tested and found not to be cholera, instead normal diarrhoea. Residents are urged to maintain high hygiene standards and proper waste management to prevent an outbreak in the Eastern Province. Nationally, Zambia has recorded 2,743 cholera cases and 62 deaths to date, highlighting ongoing risk and the need for vigilance. The report is from Diamond Media, authored by Samuel Khwawe, published 2026-11-13.

triage.headline_ja: 東部州で疑いコレラ症例7件を記録 - Zambia 24
triage.triage_reason: 今回報告された東部州の疑い7例は検査の結果コレラではなく通常の下痢と判明したが、ザンビア全国では累計2,743例・62名の死亡という継続的なコレラ流行が存在し、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は疑い例がコレラではないと確認された内容だが、全国的なコレラ流行（2,743例、62名死亡）が継続している点から、今後の症例動向を継続的に監視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: இந்தியாவில் காசநோய் உயிரிழப்பு கணிசமாக குறைந்தது - உலக சுகாதார அமைப்பு தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Plague deaths in India have significantly decreased - WHO information.
article.articleSummary: WHO data show plague deaths in India have fallen sharply since 2015; India’s plague mortality rate dropped from 28 per lakh in 2015 to 18 per lakh in 2025, a 38% decline, surpassing the global average reduction of 35%. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare attributes progress to rapid detection, timely treatment, AI-based X-ray screening, and other innovations under the National Plague Eradication Programme, delivering a 94% treatment success rate. Under Prime Minister Modi’s leadership, the campaign has become a mass movement: since 2024, 25 crore people have been screened for plague, about 11 crore X-ray scans performed, and 48.64 lakh cases detected and started on treatment. This consolidation reflects a strong treatment infrastructure and sustained government support toward a plague-free India.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおける結核による死亡数が大幅に減少 - WHO報告
triage.triage_reason: 記事は結核（原文の「காசநோய்」は結核を意味し、Bluedotの疾患名「Plague」は誤訳・誤分類）による死亡率がインドで大幅に減少したという肯定的な保健統計報告であり、新規感染症イベントやアウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名はPlague（ペスト）とタグ付けされているが、記事内容は結核（Tuberculosis）に関するものであり、疾患分類の誤りと思われる。内容自体も死亡率減少という好転を示す報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性やシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: ПАНДЕМИЯТА ПО-БЛИЗО ОТ ВСЯКОГА? Плъзна нова смъртоносна болест!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The pandemic closer than ever before? A new deadly disease has spread!
article.articleSummary: Russia's Rospotrebnadzor opened an urgent inquiry into an unidentified viral illness affecting people who vacationed in Vietnam, notably in the resort city of Nha Trang. Dozens of Russian tourists reportedly fell ill after returning, presenting high fever, severe headache, runny nose, and a relentless cough lasting weeks. Vietnamese physicians reportedly struggle to diagnose, describing the illness as a vaguely circulating influenza-like virus. Russia's consumer safety agency has formally requested information from Vietnam's Ministry of Health and the Russian Association of Tour Operators for immediate answers and epidemiological data on the outbreak. This follows five weeks after fears of a deadly plague outbreak in Siberia linked to a lab death in Irkutsk's plague institute. Potential imported cases in Russia raise concerns of cross-border transmission until lab confirmation clarifies the pathogen.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミックがこれまで以上に近づいている？新たな致死性の病気が拡大！
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンから帰国したロシア人観光客多数が原因不明のインフルエンザ様疾患を発症し、現地医師も診断に苦慮していることから、異常性と国際的拡大リスクの両方でIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナム・ニャチャンで発生した未確定の呼吸器疾患にロシア人観光客が罹患した事例。ロシア・イルクーツクのペスト研究所関連の件は5週間前の別事案として言及されているのみで、本イベントの主たる発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Com projeção de aumento de casos, SES reforça prevenção contra dengue e chikungunya - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã/MS e Pedro Juan Caballero/PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With projected increase in cases, SES reinforces prevention against dengue and chikungunya - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã/MS and Pedro Juan Caballero/PY.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports 12,984 probable chikungunya cases in 2026 (11,076 confirmed by SINAN) with 32 deaths across Dourados, Bonito, Jardim, Fátima do Sul, Douradina, Guia Lopes da Laguna, Itaporã, Ponta Porã, Nioaque, Corumbá and Dois Irmãos do Buriti; 127 chikungunya cases are in pregnant women. Dengue totals reach 4,030 probable cases (2,327 confirmed), with one confirmed death in Bonito and another under investigation. The state notes co-circulation of DENV-3 and chikungunya, and stresses household vector control. A national projection for 2027 estimates about 860,000 dengue cases and over 90,000 chikungunya cases, with El Niño potentially boosting transmission. Vaccination shows 223,322 of 241,030 dengue doses administered to 10–14-year-olds (11 months 29 days) on a two-dose, 3-month interval schedule. Authorities urge against self-medication and to seek municipal health units for dengue or chikungunya symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 症例増加の予測を受け、保健局（SES）がデング熱とチクングニア熱への予防対策を強化 - Ponta Porã Informa（ポンタ・ポラン/MS、ペドロ・フアン・カバジェロ/PYのニュース）
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソ・ド・スル州で1万件超のチクングニア熱症例と32人の死亡、デング熱との同時流行（DENV-3との共循環）が報告されており、州保健局が予防対策を強化するなど行政の関心が高く、媒介動物による持続的曝露・流行しやすさの観点からリスクがあるため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで季節性・風土病的に発生する感染症であり、今回の報告も例年の流行拡大予測に基づく定例的な公衆衛生情報に近いが、死亡者数（32人）や妊婦症例（127件）、DENV-3との共循環など、重症度・流行継続性の観点から注視が必要。2027年の全国予測（デング熱86万件、チクングニア熱9万件超）も踏まえ、継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Fortaleza zera bairros com alto risco de infestação pelo mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fortaleza zeros out neighborhoods with a high risk of dengue mosquito infestation.
article.articleSummary: Fortaleza, Brazil, reported zero high‑risk neighborhoods for Aedes aegypti infestation in the fourth LIRAa 2026 survey (Oct 19–Nov 4). Despite improvements, 54 of 121 monitored bairros remain in alert (infestation 1.0–3.9%), while 67 are satisfactory (<1%). The infestation index fell 68% from 3.57% in the second cycle to 1.14% in the fourth, continuing a downward trend from 2.16% in the third cycle. Dengue transmission persists with localized cases across the city. Bairros with the lowest indexes include Álvaro Weyne (0.17%), Mondubim (0.24%), Itaperi (0.28%), Jóquei Clube (0.33%), São Bento (0.35%), Cais do Porto (0.36%), Boa Vista (0.37%), Edson Queiroz (0.39%), Parreão (0.40%), and Vila Velha (0.41%). Hotspots in alert include Parque São José (3.92%), Parque Iracema (3.90%), Coaçu (3.54%), and Jacarecanga (3.03%). Heat, rain, and El Niño conditions may sustain breeding; year‑round prevention and community participation remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: フォルタレザ市、デング熱媒介蚊の高リスク地区をゼロに
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の生息密度調査の改善を伝える内容で、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報はなく、既存の季節的デング対策の経過報告に過ぎない。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域で常在的に発生しており、本記事は蚊の密度調査結果の改善を報告する内容。重症例や死亡者数の急増等の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : les prestataires de la riposte contre Ebola en grève illimitée à Butembo - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Ebola-response service providers go on an indefinite strike in Butembo - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Indefinite Ebola-response workers’ strike in Butembo, North Kivu, DRC, began Nov 12 amid the 17th Ebola outbreak. Nurses, hygienists, and frontline supervisors at the Ebola Treatment Center in Kitatumba and centres in Katwa, Matanda, Musienene, plus UCG university clinics and ITAV, halted services to demand higher pay and regular contracts. They report four months without official contracts and salaries not aligned with the Ministry of Health pay scale, seeking increased risk allowances, salary parity, and application of the 2026 SMIG. They sent letters to the Butembo mayor following Oct/Nov démarches, including a 14-day ultimatum from Oct 13 and a 7-day deadline from Nov 4. They cite threats and community violence; concerns include continuity of care, disinfection, and infection control. Civil-society coordination supports the demands; authorities promise continued care for suspects/confirmed cases. A meeting with Prisca Kamala is planned; no restart yet.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラ対応従事者がブテンボで無期限ストライキ - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行において、対応従事者の無期限ストライキにより治療・感染対策活動が停止し、アウトブレイク制御に重大な支障をきたす恐れがあるため。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中の第17次エボラ流行（DRC北キブ州）における対応従事者のストライキを報じており、賃金・契約問題により治療継続・感染制御に支障が出ている。既存のアウトブレイク対応への影響として、フルRRAでの追跡が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a registrar aumento de casos no RS, mas hospitalizações seguem em queda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 once again records an increase in cases in Rio Grande do Sul, but hospitalizations continue to fall.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 activity rises again in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, while hospitalizations fall. In recent weeks RS reported higher case numbers, though nationwide hospitalizations declined and Brazil's COVID-19 cases fell about 69% in 2026 versus the same period in 2025. Specialists say the fluctuation reflects the virus's high transmissibility and ongoing circulation, with elevated risk for vulnerable groups. A heart transplant recipient in Porto Alegre continues masking. Vaccination remains the main protection against severe disease; SUS vaccines are available for older adults 60+, children 6 months to <5 years, pregnant people, and those with comorbidities including immunocompromised and transplant recipients. Uptake at the Posto Modelo in Porto Alegre is described as low, but vaccine supply is normal, with a new shipment due on Friday, November 13, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19、リオグランデ・ド・スルで症例増加も入院は減少傾向
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の季節的なCOVID-19症例変動に関する通常の報道であり、入院は減少傾向、重症度や異常性も認められないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体による既存の流行状況の軽微な変動であり、COVID-19は既にエンデミック化した疾患として扱われているため新規シグナルとしての価値は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas realiza mutirão de combate ao Aedes neste sábado, 14
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas holds an Aedes control campaign this Saturday, the 14th.
article.articleSummary: Campinas hosts a Grande Mutirão Municipal de Enfrentamento ao Aedes aegypti on Saturday, November 14, 2026, as the city closes the 2nd Semana Municipal de Mobilização para o Enfrentamento das Arboviroses. The house-to-house campaign targets Aedes aegypti breeding sites to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission. Neighborhoods covered: Jardim Santo Antônio, Parque Eldorado dos Carajás, Núcleo Residencial Santos Dumont, DIC IV, DIC V, Jardim Filadélfia, and Parque Vista Alegre. Actions include removing breeding sites, large-volume waste removal, cleaning catch basins, and Civil Defense monitoring; coordinated by multiple city departments and the Comitê Municipal de Enfrentamento das Arboviroses e Zoonoses. The effort responds to El Niño-related climate risk increasing mosquito proliferation, aiming to bolster public engagement and intersectoral prevention.

triage.headline_ja: カンピナスが11月14日（土）にアエジプチイエカ対策の一斉活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 行政による定例的な蚊対策キャンペーンの告知であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態を示す情報がないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な一斉清掃活動の告知であり、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の具体的な発生状況や症例数は記載されていない。El Niñoによる蚊の増殖リスクへの対応として平時の予防活動が報じられている。

article.articleHeadline: Caxias vai reforçar ações de combate ao mosquito da dengue | Duque de Caxias | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caxias will reinforce actions to combat the dengue-carrying mosquito | Duque de Caxias | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Duque de Caxias, Brazil, launches intensified arboviral disease prevention this November via the SVAVZ’s Levantamento Rápido de Índices para Aedes aegypti (LIRAa) to map dengue, Zika, and chikungunya risk. The program expands home visits by Endemic Combat Agents across the four districts to identify breeding sites and counsel residents on eliminating them. Cemetery inspections will address water in plant pots and other containers after All Souls’ Day to prevent Aedes aegypti proliferation. Superintendent Zé do Amendoim says LIRAa-guided priorities will target areas with higher incidence. Residents should routinely check yards, water tanks, plant pots, gutters, and other water-holding receptacles. For guidance or to report breeding sites, Disque Dengue is available via WhatsApp (21) 2342-1810; in-person visits at SVAVZ headquarters, Avenida Actura 30, Campos Elíseos, Mon–Fri 8:00–17:00.

triage.headline_ja: カシアス市、デング熱媒介蚊対策を強化へ | ドゥッケ・デ・カシアス | O Dia
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的なデング・ジカ・チクングニア予防活動（蚊の繁殖地調査・住民啓発）に関する報道であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増等は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常の蚊媒介性疾患予防プログラムの告知記事であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Health officials inspect dengue prevention measures
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, dengue prevention measures were inspected in Kanpur's Subhauli and Bhukhanahi villages under Sarsaul CHC after vector-borne cases were reported. A district team led by Nodal Officer for vector-borne diseases Dr. Rajeshwar Singh reviewed fever surveys, mosquito-breeding site identification, source-control work, and preventive actions for dengue-positive patients. At health camps, 78 patients were examined; Subhauli tested 23 for malaria, dengue, and typhoid, while 37 of 55 were tested in Bhukhanahi. No dengue positives were found, and no sample was sent to SSH laboratory for dengue testing. Ongoing measures include entomological surveys, larvicidal spraying, and awareness campaigns. Residents were advised to remove stagnant water, eliminate breeding sites, apply natural repellents, and keep skin covered. Reporting channels: UHM Chikitsalaya control room (0512-2333810, 9335301096) and Nagar Nigam control rooms (0512-2526004/5).

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、デング熱予防対策を視察
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的監視活動の報告であり、デング熱陽性者は確認されず、異常な拡大や重症例の報告もないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体による日常的なベクター媒介疾患予防活動の視察報告であり、デング熱検査でも陽性者は確認されていない。対象国リストのIndiaは発生地域に含まれるが、本記事は通常の予防措置報告でありシグナルには該当しないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Variante da Mpox avança no Brasil; veja recomendações do Ministério da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox variant advances in Brazil; see recommendations from the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Brazil reaches 1,009 cases this year, with data through Nov 11, per the Ministry of Health. The circulating clade 1b variant, linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, is mainly in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro and may be associated with more severe cases. No clear evidence of increased deaths or pediatric cases yet. Symptoms include fever, body aches, and skin lesions on the face, hands, feet, mouth, genitals, or anus. Transmission occurs via contact with mucous membranes or lesion material and can involve sexual contact. Diagnosis relies on laboratory testing of lesion secretions, with crusts acceptable once lesions dry. Treatment is supportive; no mpox-specific drug. Vaccination priority in Brazil targets people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 counts below 100 or 200 cells/mm³, PrEP users, laboratory personnel handling mpox samples, and high-risk contacts after risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでMpoxの変異株が拡大；保健省の推奨事項
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のクレードⅠbのMpoxがブラジル国内（サンパウロ・リオデジャネイロ）で今年1,009例確認され、より重症化しやすい可能性が指摘されており、国際的拡大と異常性の観点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: DRCはクレード1bの起源として言及されているが、本記事の主題はブラジル国内での感染拡大であるためDRCはverified_locationsに含めない。死亡例・小児例の増加は現時点で明確なエビデンスなしとされている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra mais de mil casos de mpox em seis estados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records more than 1,000 mpox cases in six states.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 1,023 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with 46 probable, 581 suspected, and 1 death, per the Health Ministry. By Nov 12, the top states are Rio de Janeiro (390) and São Paulo (388), followed by Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), Distrito Federal (41), and Santa Catarina (24). In 2026, November accounts for 227 confirmed and October 293, together over half of the year’s total. Mpox is caused by the mpox virus (MPXV), an Orthopoxvirus zoonosis; transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects, and can involve prolonged close contact and respiratory secretions. A vaccine exists and the Ministry recently procured 25,000 doses. Since monitoring began, Brazil has recorded 15,455 mpox cases and 19 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルが6州でmpox症例1,000件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でmpox症例が1,000件を超え死亡例も発生しており、複数州にわたる持続的な感染拡大とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、保健当局も対応（ワクチン調達）を進めていることから社会的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル保健省の統計報告に基づくもので、2026年の累計症例数（1,023件確定）と年間累積（15,455件・死亡19件）が示されている。国際的な新規拡大や渡航制限の記述はないが、継続的な国内流行として監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Ebola continue à gagner du terrain sur fond d'insécurité, après six mois d'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola continues to gain ground amid insecurity, after six months of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) enters its 17th outbreak, six months after the May 15 declaration, with 11,197 cases and 5,471 deaths (about 50% mortality). Ituri remains the epicenter, but rising cases and deaths are reported in Beni, North Kivu, as violence hampers the response. ADF rebels linked to Islamic State killed at least 110 people in a week, including 3 health workers in Cantine-Aloya (Nov 5). In Cantine-Aloya and in the Babila Babombi area of Mambasa Territory, attacks have produced dozens of fatalities; health facilities have been looted or burned. Over 80 attacks on health sites have occurred in six months. WHO and Africa CDC warn insecurity is delaying containment; MSF says the outbreak remains out of control. More than 1,000 contact cases are unaccounted; some patients remain missing. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and causes hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ、治安悪化の中で拡大続く、流行発生から6カ月が経過
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、死者5,471人に達する大規模エボラ流行が継続し、武装勢力による攻撃で対応が妨げられ国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO・Africa CDC・MSFが治安悪化による封じ込めの遅延を警告しており、接触者1,000人以上が行方不明。継続的なフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: XFG: tudo sobre a variante da Covid-19 predominante no Brasil - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: XFG: Everything about the predominant COVID-19 variant in Brazil - Folha Vitória
article.articleSummary: XFG, a subvariant of Omicron, is the predominant SARS-CoV-2 lineage circulating in Brazil in 2026, alongside its descendants, representing about 90% of analyzed samples. The Ministry of Health reports 2,199 sequenced specimens collected between epidemiological weeks 1 and 42 of 2026; these figures reflect samples analyzed, not total cases. The World Health Organization continues to monitor XFG, with no evidence it causes more severe disease than other circulating variants. Symptoms are typical of COVID-19 and other respiratory infections, including runny nose, cough, sore throat, fever, body aches, malaise, and nasal congestion, with shortness of breath in more severe cases. Vaccination remains protective against severe disease, with schedules updated per health guidance. 18 states, including Espírito Santo, show rising notifications, likely due to seasonality and new variants; overall risk remains low. Preventive measures: up-to-date vaccination, hand hygiene, avoiding crowded indoor spaces, ventilation, masking when symptomatic, and protecting vulnerable contacts.

triage.headline_ja: XFG:ブラジルで優勢なCOVID-19変異株について - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: XFG株はWHOにより重症化リスクの増加は確認されておらず、全体的なリスクは低いとされており、既存の流行株情報の範疇に留まるため見送り。
triage.notes: WHOはXFG変異株について既存株と比較し重症度増加のエビデンスなしと報告。全体リスクは低いとされる季節性の通常の感染報告増加事例。

article.articleHeadline: O que é a Listeria monocytogenes, bactéria encontrada em queijo proibido pela Anvisa?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Listeria monocytogenes, the bacterium found in cheese banned by Anvisa?
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Anvisa has recalled lot 180926 of Italy-brand sliced mozzarella after Listeria monocytogenes was detected in a 25-gram sample. The recall and suspension of sale, distribution, advertising, and use were issued under Resolution RE nº 4.423/2026, following Laudo de Ensaio 56058/2026. Manufacturer Agroindústria Santo Anjo Ltda. initiated voluntary withdrawal. Listeria monocytogenes, found in soil, water, and vegetation, can contaminate foods during production and storage and may multiply at refrigeration temperatures. Ingestion can cause listeriosis, with mild symptoms such as diarrhea, fever, and muscle pains, and potentially severe septicemia or meningitis. High-risk groups include pregnant women, older adults, and immunocompromised individuals; infection in pregnancy can cause abortion, premature birth, or neonatal illness. Antibiotics are effective when diagnosed early. Voluntary recalls can become mandatory per RDC 655/2022, with compliance within 48 hours.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisaによって禁止されたチーズから検出された細菌、リステリア・モノサイトゲネスとは？
triage.triage_reason: 単一製品ロットの自主回収事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: イタリア産ブランドのモッツァレラチーズ製品からリステリア菌が検出されブラジル国内で回収された事例。発生地域にItalyが含まれるが、サマリー上は製品ブランド名であり実際の発生国はブラジルのみ。感染者数や患者報告はなく、製品回収・規制対応のニュース。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Qué es la viruela símica 'Mpox' y cuáles son sus síntomas? Brote en Brasil genera alerta en Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is mpox and what are its symptoms? An outbreak in Brazil triggers an alert in Argentina.
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreak in Brazil triggers health alerts in Argentina; Brazil reports 832 confirmed cases and 1 death in 2026, while Argentina has 23 cases, including four of the clade Ib variant. The Brazilian surge centers on São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, with recent two‑month increases linked to cross‑border travel. Argentina has intensified epidemiologic surveillance and issued preventive guidance. Mpox is caused by the mpox virus (orthopoxvirus); transmission occurs mainly via close skin‑to‑skin contact, including sexual contact, and via contaminated bedding, towels, or utensils, with possible droplet spread in prolonged contact. Incubation is 1–21 days. Symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, and fatigue; lesions often begin on the face and may involve the genitoanal area. Risk groups include people with multiple sexual partners, health workers, shared items, and travelers from affected areas. Brazil ordered 25,000 vaccine doses for at‑risk groups; Argentina has no mass vaccination policy or vaccines registered. Emphasized measures: hygiene, avoiding close contact, and early medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox（サル痘）とは何か、その症状は？ブラジルでの発生がアルゼンチンに警戒をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpoxクレードIb変異株を含む832例・死亡1例が報告され、隣国アルゼンチンへの越境拡大（23例、クレードIb4例含む）が実際に確認されているため、国際的拡大リスクと異常性の観点からフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし越境事例として国際拡大リスク評価には反映した。クレードIb変異株の検出は通常中央アフリカ由来の変異株であり、南米での検出は異例。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento expressivo de casos de Covid-19 em Campinas acende sinal de alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sharp rise in COVID-19 cases in Campinas raises a red flag.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil, records a sharp rise in COVID-19 cases, with a 118% October increase (98 positives) vs September, totaling 1,054 cases and 16 deaths in 2026. In São Paulo state, 1,402 COVID-19–related SRAG cases and 196 deaths were logged through November 10, 2026, lower than 2025 but warrant ongoing vigilance. The Regional Metropolitan of Campinas shows the surge concentrated in the city; neighboring municipalities maintain ambulatory and basic surveillance, and hospital pressure remains limited for adults but pediatric ICU admissions are rising. In Campinas this year, ages 0–9 lead infections (188 cases), followed by 20–29-year-olds. Authorities urge vaccination for priority groups: children 6 months–4 years, elderly 60+, pregnant/puerperal, immunocompromised, and 5+ with comorbidities. By early November, São Paulo state administered 2,499,269 doses in 2026, with 76.72% coverage among pregnant women.”} (Note: Date reference as of 2026-11-13.) } } }}<|vq_9450|>  {

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスでCOVID-19症例が急増、警戒信号点灯
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19は既知の病原体であり、カンピーナス市での季節的な症例増加が報告されているが、成人への医療逼迫は限定的でワクチン接種など通常の公衆衛生対応が行われており、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに高くない。
triage.notes: 小児ICU入院の増加が言及されているが、全体として既知の疾患の季節的変動であり、地方自治体レベルで対応可能な状況。続報の必要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Parasita que afeta cavalos é encontrado pela 1ª vez em boto-cinza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parasite affecting horses found for the first time in gray river dolphin.
article.articleSummary: Parasites that cause neurological disease in horses were detected in gray river dolphins off Brazil. In a USP study, 1,103 samples from 159 cetaceans across 21 species found dead or stranded on Brazilian shores (2004–2022) yielded parasites in 14 animals. Sarcocystis neurona was confirmed in two gray river dolphins, with one of them also positive for Toxoplasma gondii. A previously undescribed Sarcocystis lineage was found in six offshore cetaceans—dwarf sperm whale, Cuvier’s beaked whale, Fraser’s dolphin, Atlantic spotted dolphin, and Clymene dolphin—suggesting offshore circulation. Water runoff from land and rivers may transport terrestrial parasites to the ocean; birds could disseminate the offshore lineage. The health impact on the dolphins is unknown, and population-level effects cannot be determined. Sarcocystis neurona is endemic in the Americas and causes equine protozoal myeloencephalitis in horses.

triage.headline_ja: 馬に感染する寄生虫、ボルトイルカから初めて検出
triage.triage_reason: 野生イルカにおける寄生虫検出に関する学術的報告であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響や異常性・拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ヒト感染事例の報告ではなく、野生海洋哺乳類における寄生虫の生態学的研究結果。公衆衛生上の直接的懸念は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Gizemli hastalık paniği, doktorlar çaresiz kaldı: O ülkeden dönen turistlerde belirtiler görüldü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious Disease Panic: Doctors Left Helpless as Symptoms Observed in Tourists Returning from That Country.
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists returning from Nha Trang, Vietnam, report high fever, severe headache, runny nose, and weeks-long severe cough, triggering concern of a possible outbreak. Vietnamese doctors have yet to diagnose the illness, describing it as an unspecified, widespread flu-like virus. The cases revive fears after a mysterious death at an Irkutsk plague research institute occurred about five weeks earlier, with officials offering limited explanations. Authorities in Vietnam are investigating the infection source as they monitor imported cases to Russia and determine whether the illness represents a new pathogen. No confirmed laboratory identification or pathogen name is provided. The episode underscores anxiety about travel-associated transmission and potential emergence of an unknown virus linked to tourism corridors in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 謎の病気パニック：医師も手立てなし。その国から帰国した観光客に症状が確認される
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンから帰国したロシア人観光客に原因不明のインフルエンザ様疾患が集団発生し、現地医師も診断できていない。病原体未特定かつ国境を越えた輸入例が確認されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: イルクーツク（ロシア）のペスト研究所での謎の死亡事例は時期的・地理的に別件として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題はベトナム・ニャチャンからの帰国者における未特定の呼吸器疾患の集団発生である。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外した。病原体が未特定であり、続報での病原体同定・重症度情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC Completes Contact Monitoring, Records No Secondary Transmission
article.articleSummary: Nigeria completed the 21-day monitoring of 62 contacts linked to its imported Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case with no secondary transmission. The index case, confirmed on 20 October 2026, was evacuated to Switzerland for treatment, recovered, and discharged after testing negative there. 13 contacts developed fever or symptoms during monitoring, but none tested positive for Ebola. Seven suspected alerts from Adamawa, Rivers, Borno, Lagos and Ekiti were investigated and all negative. Completion of contact monitoring does not automatically end an outbreak; Nigeria will continue surveillance and follow WHO criteria. The National Emergency Operations Centre remained at Level Three, coordinating clinical care, contact tracing, surveillance, infection prevention and control, and health worker protection, with training and communication ongoing. Nigerians and travelers are urged to stay vigilant ahead of December gatherings; travelers should complete health declarations, disclose travel history, and avoid unprotected contact with blood or body fluids. Ebola remains in DRC, sustaining risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ナイジェリア疾病対策センター（NCDC）、接触者モニタリングを完了、二次感染なし
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアの輸入エボラ症例は二次感染なく収束したが、DRCでのエボラ流行が継続しており今後の輸入例発生リスクが残るため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアにおける輸入エボラ症例の接触者追跡完了であり、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは流行の継続要因として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題事象の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Плъзна нова смъртоносна болест, лекарите не знаят как да я лекуват
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new deadly disease has spread; doctors don't know how to treat it.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, Russia reports a second mysterious illness amid fears of a pandemic. Health authorities launched an urgent investigation after travelers who vacationed in Vietnam fell seriously ill with an unidentified virus. The outbreak is centered around Nha Trang, a resort city in Vietnam, and is linked to imported cases among returning tourists. Social media claims describe dozens of tourists affected, prompting public concern. Patients exhibit a severe cluster of symptoms: high fever, severe headache, runny nose, and a relentless, long-lasting cough that can persist for weeks. Vietnamese physicians treating the vacationers report difficulty establishing a precise diagnosis, labeling the illness as a vaguely circulating influenza-like virus while patients remain bedridden. No confirmed laboratory diagnosis or case/death counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな致死的疾患が蔓延、医師も治療法が分からず
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム旅行者由来の未診断疾患がロシアに持ち込まれ、国境を越えた拡大と診断困難という異常性が確認されるため、IHR基準を2つ満たしフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ロシア発の報道（タブロイド系メディア）であり、実験室診断や症例数・死亡者数は未確認。ベトナム・ニャチャンが発生源とされるが、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報での検査結果確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria ends 21-day Ebola contact monitoring with no secondary transmission
article.articleSummary: Nigeria ends 21-day contact monitoring for 62 contacts of an Ebola case; none developed disease, though 13 reported fever but tested negative. The index case—a Swiss woman who had travelled to Uganda—was diagnosed Oct 20 in Nigeria; she and her husband were evacuated to Switzerland where she recovered and was discharged. NCDC notes that completing 21 days of monitoring does not conclude the outbreak; WHO requires a 42-day countdown from last recovery before an official end-of-outbreak declaration. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials. The Nigeria event follows outbreaks identified in Ituri, eastern DRC in May, with cases in eight DRC provinces, Uganda, France, Kenya, and Nigeria. In DRC, the Bundibugyo strain has infected over 11,000 and killed over 5,000; no approved vaccines or treatments exist. Seven Nigerian Ebola alerts across five states tested negative.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、21日間のエボラ接触者監視を終了、二次感染なし
triage.triage_reason: 背景にあるDRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは11,000人超感染・5,000人超死亡という深刻な規模で、承認されたワクチン・治療法もなく、既に複数国（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランス・スイス）へ国際的に拡大しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事自体はナイジェリアでの接触者監視終了（二次感染なし）という収束方向の続報だが、発端となったDRC（イツリ州含む8州）での大規模アウトブレイクは依然進行中で深刻。WHOの終息宣言には最後の回復者から42日間の経過観察が必要とされており、継続的な監視が必要。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・スイスは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يهدد بأكبر تفشٍ في تاريخه.. هل تفقد الكونغو السيطرة على الفيروس خلال الأشهر الستة المقبلة؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threatens the largest outbreak in its history... Will the Congo lose control of the virus within the next six months?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo threatens to become the largest in history, six months after its May 2026 start. Confirmed infections exceed 11,000 and deaths surpass 5,000; WHO data show 10,920 confirmed cases and 5,323 deaths (CFR 48.7%) across 67 health zones in eight provinces, with about 65–67 new cases daily. Ituri’s Bunia region is a hotspot, and security constraints have driven 80 attacks on health facilities and workers. MSF reports only 9% of Ebola patients treated were known contacts, and roughly two-thirds of recent deaths occurred in communities, signaling detection gaps. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. Imperial College estimates 2,000–3,000 true infections, with potential transmission into 2027, and three scenarios: gradual containment, continued rural spread, or a hyper-epidemic exceeding 2014–2016 West Africa. Global risk remains low, though local risk is high.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、史上最大の流行の恐れ…コンゴは今後6か月でウイルスの制御を失うのか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が確定症例1万人超・死者5千人超・CFR約49%に達し、史上最大規模となる恐れがあるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（イトゥリ州ブニア等）の流行のみが言及されており、Angolaでの発生は確認されていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en el Congo suma casi 5 mil 500 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Congo has reached nearly 5,500 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains the country’s deadliest, with 11,197 cases and 5,471 deaths (case fatality 48.9%), per the National Institute of Public Health. The latest 24-hour update adds 83 infections and 38 deaths. About 1,676 people are hospitalized or in isolation, and 3,045 have recovered. The epicenter is Ituri province, accounting for 69.3% of cases, with eight affected provinces: Ituri; North Kivu; South Kivu; Tshopo; Haut-Uele; Bas-Uele; Nord-Ubangi; Sud-Ubangi. The UN warns the outbreak and conflict are worsening a hunger crisis, with 30.3 million people expected to face acute food insecurity between January and June 2027 (up from 26.5 million in 2026), including 4.2 million in emergency. WFP, FAO, UNICEF, and WHO call for safe access and large-scale food assistance to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行、死者数が5,500人近くに達する
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（1.1万例超、致死率48.9%）が8州に拡大し、紛争・食料危機とも連動して国際支援が要請されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（イトゥリ州を中心に北キブ・南キブ・ツショピ・オートウエレ・バウエレ・北ウバンギ・南ウバンギの計8州）での大規模エボラ流行と、それに伴う食料危機の深刻化を報告。国連機関が安全なアクセスと大規模食料支援を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: l'OMS alerte sur la propagation du virus dans des zones rurales reculées de la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO warns of the spread of the virus in remote rural areas of the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists, with the World Health Organization warning that the virus is spreading into remote, hard-to-reach rural areas. According to Chikwe Ihekweazu, head of WHO’s health emergencies program, insecurity prevents placing health facilities closer to these communities, and workers cannot stay overnight in some areas. The WHO is relying on MONUSCO and local authorities to negotiate access. UN officials noted a decline in weekly cases from about 700 to roughly 400, but contact tracing remains inadequate. The tally reported in the DRC stands at more than 11,000 lab-confirmed cases and 5,387 deaths. The report underscores persistent challenges in surveillance and response due to insecurity and limited access, with ongoing transmission in rural zones.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOがコンゴ民主共和国の遠隔農村地域でのウイルス拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が継続しており、11,000例以上の確定症例と5,387人の死者が報告されている。治安上の理由で保健医療アクセスが制限され、接触者追跡も不十分であり、WHOが国際的な懸念を表明している。
triage.notes: WHOおよびMONUSCOが治安上の理由でアクセス困難な地域への対応に苦慮していることが強調されている。週間症例数は減少傾向（約700→約400）だが、接触者追跡の不備により継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Recebeu alerta sobre sarampo no WhatsApp? Veja se precisa atualizar a vacina - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did you receive a measles alert on WhatsApp? See if you need to update your vaccination - Folha Vitória.
article.articleSummary: Measles alert via GovBR WhatsApp in Brazil as measles cases rise in the Americas in 2026. PAHO reports at least 55,792 infections across the Americas, about five times higher than before. Brazil remains free of endemic measles transmission; cases are imported or linked to contacts abroad. Brazil has 65 confirmed measles cases: 41 in São Paulo, 21 in Amazonas, 2 in Acre, 1 in Rio de Janeiro. Espírito Santo has had no cases since 2020, but residents receive the alert. The Ministry urges checking vaccination status and visiting a Basic Health Unit to update doses if needed. The MMR vaccine is available free at UBS; Espírito Santo reports 300,759 doses statewide, with 170,230 stored in the state cold chain. Target vaccination: ages 12 months through 59 years; children 5–29 should have two doses; adults 30–59 should have one dose; health professionals two doses. Visit UBS to verify vaccination status and receive necessary doses.

triage.headline_ja: WhatsAppで麻疹アラートを受け取った？ワクチン接種の更新が必要か確認を - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: PAHOによるとアメリカ大陸全体で麻疹症例が例年の5倍に急増しており、ブラジルでも複数州で輸入例を含む65例が確認され、政府が全国的なワクチン接種呼びかけを行うなど社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（サンパウロ、アマゾナス、リオデジャネイロ等）での麻疹輸入例とアメリカ大陸全体の増加傾向について報じている。カナリア諸島・スペインは発生地域に含まれるが記事の主題ではないため除外。重症度（死亡者数等）の具体的記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Após alta de 71% nos casos de sarampo, governo alerta população sobre vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a 71% rise in measles cases, the government warns the public about the vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Brazil have risen about 71% in 2026, with at least 65 confirmed episodes, up from 38 in 2025. The Health Ministry reports São Paulo (41) and Amazonas (21) account for roughly 95% of 2026 cases, while Acre (2) and Rio de Janeiro (1) make up the remainder. In 2025, first-dose measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage reached about 93%, but full protection fell to 78%. In 2026, nearly 16 million vaccine doses have been distributed, yet at least four states report vaccination coverage below 70%. Authorities are issuing public alerts via messaging apps to emphasize vaccination, with vaccines provided free through SUS for people aged 12 months to 59 years. Measles is highly contagious and spreads via airborne transmission. Brazil was recognized as endemic-free in 2024 after a three-year gap, with earlier outbreaks peaking in 2019 (about 20,000 cases).

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹症例71%増加を受け、政府がワクチン接種を国民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除認定を受けたが2026年に症例が71%増加し、複数州でワクチン接種率が70%未満となるなど流行しやすい状況があり、政府が公衆衛生的対応（注意喚起）を行っているため。
triage.notes: 2024年に麻疹排除認定を受けたブラジルで症例が再増加。サンパウロとアマゾナス州に集中(約95%)。ワクチン接種率低下が一因とされ、政府はSUSを通じた無料接種とメッセージアプリでの注意喚起を実施中。重症例・死亡例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo disparam 71% em 1 ano; governo alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases surge 71% in one year; government warns.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases increased 71% in the last year, prompting a government warning on vaccination. São Paulo and Amazonas together account for 95% of confirmed cases in 2026, with additional confirmations in Acre and Rio de Janeiro. First-dose coverage of the measles-containing vaccine (triple viral) reached 93% of the target population in 2025, but complete immunity fell to 78%. Four states registered vaccination coverage below 70% this year. The measles vaccine is provided free through the Unified Health System (SUS) for individuals aged 12 months to 59 years. The ministry reiterates the need to complete the two-dose schedule to ensure protection.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹症例が1年で71%急増、政府が警告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹症例の増加とワクチン接種率低下が報告されているが、重症度・死亡等の詳細情報が不足しており、ブラジル国内での流行拡大の可能性を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（サンパウロ、アマゾナス州中心）の麻疹症例増加とワクチン接種率低下を報じている。重症例や死亡者数の記載がなく、国際的拡大の兆候も明記されていないため、続報を注視するWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de sarna humana atinge onze municípios em Minas Gerais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of human scabies affects eleven municipalities in Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: Eleven municipalities in Minas Gerais are reporting outbreaks of human scabies this year, spanning the South, Central, Midwest, and Metropolitan regions. In Vespasiano, part of the Greater Belo Horizonte area, all municipal schooling has been suspended starting November 12 due to the outbreak, announced by Mayor José Winston on social media. The main symptom of human scabies is intense itching, especially at night, often with small skin lesions; transmission occurs through direct, prolonged skin-to-skin contact with an infected person. The State Health Secretariat advises that, upon symptom onset, individuals should seek care at a Basic Health Unit and follow guidance on isolation and measures to prevent further transmission. The article does not provide case counts or laboratory confirmation details, but highlights an active multi-municipality outbreak and public health response in Minas Gerais.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の11自治体で人体疥癬の集団発生
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重篤性・国際拡大リスクは低いが、複数自治体での集団発生と学校休校措置により地域の公衆衛生対応が必要であり、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 疥癬は寄生虫性皮膚疾患であり国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しないが、学校閉鎖など地域対応が取られている点から経過観察とする。症例数・検査確定情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Possível caso de sarna humana mobiliza dedetização em Câmara Municipal de outra cidade da Grande BH
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Possible case of human scabies prompts pest-control measures at the City Council of another city in the Greater Belo Horizonte area.
article.articleSummary: Possible human scabies case triggers pest-control measures at the Santa Luzia City Council in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area; as of Nov 13, 2026, the council building will be isolated for three days pending confirmation. Across Greater Belo Horizonte, preventive actions include closing Vespasiano schools for disinfection after five municipal and one state cases, with classes set to resume Nov 17. São José da Lapa also suspended in-person school activities on Nov 13, with reopenings planned for Nov 16. SES-MG states no outbreak classification, but maintains surveillance and guidance on isolation and hygiene. Transmission is via close, prolonged skin-to-skin contact; mites can survive 3–7 days off the body, underscoring the need to wash clothes, towels, and bedding. Free treatment is available via SUS; individuals with persistent itching are advised to seek care at a basic health unit. Education and vigilance remain central to control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の疑い例、ベロオリゾンテ都市圏の別の市議会で駆除作業を促す
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬の小規模な集団発生で、保健当局はアウトブレイク認定していないが、学校閉鎖等の対応が取られており継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 疥癬は重症度が低く公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威には該当しないが、学校・公共施設での集団発生として地域メディアの関心を集めている。SES-MGはアウトブレイクとは認定していない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a preocupar em Belo Horizonte; testes positivos chegam a 7% | Sou Notícia | SN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is once again a concern in Belo Horizonte; positive tests reach 7%.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains a concern in Belo Horizonte, the capital of Minas Gerais, Brazil, with the test-positivity rate rising to 7% in the last week of October 2026, up from 1% earlier in the month. Since January, the city has recorded 27,885 suspected cases, 449 confirmed infections and nine deaths, eight of which occurred in people aged 60 years or older. Officials say the uptick has not translated into pressure on health services, and vaccines remain available at local posts. Priority vaccination groups include the elderly, children 6 months to under 5 years, pregnant people, healthcare workers, and others defined by the vaccination calendar. For those 60+, two booster doses per year are recommended with a six-month interval; pregnant individuals should receive a dose during pregnancy. Minas Gerais shows a broader rise in positivity, with Fiocruz noting more severe cases, though hospitalizations stay low per InfoGripe. Preventive measures—ventilation, hand hygiene, and masking when symptomatic—are advised, with care sought if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19がベロオリゾンテで再び懸念に；陽性率は7%に達する
triage.triage_reason: 陽性率上昇はみられるが、医療逼迫や重症化の急増はなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクも認められないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 既知の季節的変動の範囲内であり、ワクチン供給や予防策も通常運用の範囲内。医療逼迫なし、入院率も低いとの報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's Ebola Outbreak Surpasses 11,000 Cases, Nvidia's CEO Resigns Amid Spy Allegations, Paraguay Impeaches President Peña
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,000 confirmed cases, signaling sustained transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-11-13. Kenya has discharged its last Ebola patient and begun the countdown toward an Ebola-free declaration, indicating progress toward regional containment. The update centers on laboratory-confirmed infections within DRC and tracks the outbreak's trajectory, though it does not provide details on exact infection sources or vaccination efforts. This infectious-disease development is part of a broader weekly news roundup that includes climate, geopolitics, and security topics, but the key public-health item for this date is the scale of the DRC outbreak and Kenya’s milestone toward an Ebola-free status.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が11,000症例を突破、NVIDIA CEOがスパイ容疑で辞任、パラグアイ大統領ペニャが弾劾
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱症例数が11,000例を超え持続的な伝播が継続しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大（ケニアへの波及）の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: ケニアは最後の患者が退院しエボラフリー宣言に向けた段階にあるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Aumenta el temor a un regreso del cólera en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The fear of a cholera resurgence is rising in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreaks surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with three new cases reported on the outskirts of Kinshasa as the country endures its worst cholera wave in decades. Since early 2026, more than 60,000 cases and about 1,800 deaths have been recorded, and the World Health Organization reports a roughly 3% case-fatality rate, high for cholera. Most infections have been detected in North Kivu and South Kivu in the eastern DRC, where protracted conflict with armed groups including M23 hinders public health response. Kinshasa faces spillover as three cases emerged in Kingabwa, raising concerns that the rainy season could spread infection via water. Doctors warn rapid dehydration and death if untreated; MSF emphasizes safe water, sanitation, hygiene, and oral cholera vaccination, though access remains limited by insecurity and logistics. Ebola outbreak in the region compounds the public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でコレラ再流行への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで数十年来最悪のコレラ流行（6万例以上、死者約1800人、致死率約3%）が続き、キンシャサへの波及やエボラ流行との複合、紛争による対応阻害など深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にキンシャサ、北・南キブ州）でのコレラ流行とエボラ流行の併発を主題としており、他の対象国への言及はない。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する明確な情報は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | пятница: КС-31, Украина, Эбола, автономное оружие
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Friday: KS-31, Ukraine, Ebola, Autonomous Weapons
article.articleSummary: Significant update on Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo: declared in May 2026, it is now the largest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history, with over 11,000 confirmed cases and more than 5,000 deaths. Ongoing violence by armed groups against civilians and health workers greatly complicates control efforts and humanitarian response. Health authorities warn insecurity blocks case finding, contact tracing, and vaccination campaigns, undermining containment across affected areas. The UN notes that attacks on medical teams and infrastructure threaten surveillance, treatment, and vaccination activities, hampering overall outbreak response. The report underscores severe security challenges as a critical backdrop to the outbreak, with no new clinical details provided.

triage.headline_ja: 本日の主要ニュース｜金曜日：KS-31、ウクライナ、エボラ、自律型兵器
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行（11,000人超の感染、5,000人超の死亡）が継続し、武装勢力の暴力により対応が著しく阻害されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は臨床的新情報を提供せず、治安悪化が対応活動を阻害している点を強調する内容。史上最大規模の流行継続中であり、フルリスク評価に進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Scoping Review Maps Pathogen Frequencies in Acute Undifferentiated Fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue, malaria, scrub typhus, leptospirosis, enteric fever, and non-scrub rickettsioses drive acute undifferentiated febrile illness (AUFI) in India, per a scoping review of 90 studies published up to Nov 9, 2024. Dengue appeared in 63 studies, malaria in 30, leptospirosis in 28, scrub typhus in 27, enteric fever in 21, and non-scrub rickettsioses in 4. Among 28 broad-panel AUFI studies, dengue led in 13, scrub typhus in 7, malaria in 4, leptospirosis in 3, and enteric fever in 1. Median pathogen proportions were higher in pathogen-directed studies for malaria (32.1% vs 8.6%), scrub typhus (20.0% vs 12.5%), and leptospirosis (17.2% vs 6.2%), with dengue similar across designs (25.3% vs 27.5%). Diagnostic approaches varied: dengue frequently used high-certainty NS1/molecular tests (47/63), while scrub typhus and leptospirosis often relied on serology (20/27; 23/28). The study highlights geographic, design, and diagnostic heterogeneity and maps selected infections rather than a complete national etiologic picture.

triage.headline_ja: スコーピングレビューがインド全土の原因不明急性熱性疾患における病原体頻度をマッピング
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去の学術研究（90件の研究のスコーピングレビュー）のまとめであり、新規の発生事例やアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術的レビュー論文の紹介であり、特定の発生イベントではないため、対象国での実発生事例としての検証対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: مسؤول أممي يحذر من استمرار انتشار فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN official warns of continued Ebola virus transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, Ebola virus transmission continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spread to new areas despite measurable progress over the past six months in outbreak response. UN Ebola Emergency Coordinator Julian Harneys said transmission remains ongoing and calls for continued efforts and strengthened on-the-ground measures to contain the virus. He outlined three operational priorities, the first being safe, unhindered access to affected areas, noting that violence in parts of eastern DR Congo continues to impede response and contact tracing. He added that recent violence has caused more fatalities than Ebola deaths in the country in the days immediately preceding the briefing. The report does not specify case counts or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: 国連当局者、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス感染拡大継続を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な疾患がDRCで新たな地域に拡大しており、国連当局者が警告するなど国際的関心も高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数や検査確認の詳細は記事に記載なし。治安悪化が対応・接触者追跡を妨げている点が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Avanço da variante da mpox no Brasil e os novos desafios para a Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of the mpox variant in Brazil and the new challenges for public health.
article.articleSummary: Mpox variant clade Ib is rising in Brazil, prompting strengthened epidemiologic surveillance, diagnostic capacity, and genomic monitoring. The surge is focused in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Ceará, and the Federal District, with Brazilian health authorities noting predominance of clade Ib in RJ while clade IIb remains circulating. Clinically, mpox presents with skin or mucosal lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, and myalgias, consistent across variants. PCR detects mpox virus; subsequent sequencing identifies the exact clade at reference laboratories. Isolation and case-contact tracing remain central to control, with no expectation of a widespread panic. Vaccine measures face global Bavarian Nordic shortages; the Ministry of Health recommends intradermal administration of available doses to maximize stock for high-risk groups. Emphasis stays on strict isolation until lesions fully heal, transparent communication, and ongoing epidemiologic vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるmpox変異株の拡大と公衆衛生の新たな課題
triage.triage_reason: 国際的に懸念されるクレードIbがブラジルで拡大しており、複数州にまたがる異常事態かつワクチン供給不足という管理可能性の課題もあるため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: クレードIb（国際的に懸念される変異株）がブラジル国内（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、セアラ、連邦区）で拡大していると報告。ワクチン（Bavarian Nordic製）の世界的供給不足が管理上の課題となっている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 嬰甲流不治 年內第三童 - 20261114
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infant H1N1 influenza proves fatal; third child this year.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports an infant girl fatality from influenza A(H1N1) with acute necrotizing encephalopathy and multi-organ failure. She, previously healthy and unvaccinated for seasonal flu, developed fever and cough on Oct 26 and soon had convulsions. This season's severe pediatric influenza cases total 29: 22 recovered, 2 stable, 2 critical, 3 deaths. Centre for Health Protection notes influenza activity remains above baseline despite a recent decline. Last year, unvaccinated children had about five times the risk of severe complications or death versus vaccinated children. Officials urge vaccination for children aged 6 months and older unless contraindicated. Seek urgent care for rapid breathing, wheeze, cyanosis (blue lips), chest pain, altered consciousness, persistent fever, or seizures.

triage.headline_ja: 嬰児のA型(H1N1)インフルエンザ死亡、今年3人目の小児死亡例
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児重症・死亡例が継続発生しており、重症度・流行性の基準に該当し、公衆・行政の関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 香港での季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)による小児重症・死亡例の報告。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、国内での重症化・死亡例の継続とワクチン接種率の低さが懸念材料。香港特別行政区はChina(1814991)として計上。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde do Estado de São Paulo reforça vigilância contra sarampo e rubéola em 645 municípios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo State Health Department reinforces surveillance against measles and rubella in 645 municipalities.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo State Health Department reinforces measles and rubella surveillance across 645 municipalities via the 'Dia S' active-case finding campaign for sarampo (measles) and rubéola (rubella). In Rio Preto, the effort includes reviewing medical records, rechecking laboratory tests, and conducting home visits to identify individuals who may have exhibited symptoms. The initiative strengthens epidemiological surveillance amid measles cases reported in the state. While no case counts are provided, the campaign signals heightened vigilance to detect and respond to infections, support timely isolation when needed, and sustain vaccination and public-health outreach across the region.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州保健局、645市町村で麻疹・風疹サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州内で麻疹症例の報告を受けたサーベイランス強化活動だが、具体的な症例数や重症度が不明のため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事は州政府によるサーベイランス強化の発表であり、症例数や死亡者数などの詳細データが提供されていない。麻疹はヒト-ヒト感染しやすく、ワクチン未接種者への流行可能性があるため警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ¡ATENCIÓN! Embajada de EE.UU. en Perú revela NUEVO REQUISITO SANITARIO para viajeros tras brote de peligrosa EMFERMEDAD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ATTENTION! U.S. Embassy in Peru reveals NEW HEALTH REQUIREMENT for travelers after outbreak of dangerous disease.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts a new U.S. travel health measure announced by the U.S. Embassy in Peru on 2026-11-03. To prevent international spread via commercial air travel, the CDC requires all passengers flying to the United States or transiting through it to confirm they have not visited the DRC in the preceding 21 days. Airlines will collect a sworn declaration from each passenger at check-in or before boarding, in either physical or electronic form. The policy is described as preventive. The World Health Organization reports more than 11,100 confirmed Ebola cases and about 5,433 deaths over six months, with recent cases detected in Kenya and Nigeria indicating border risk. The measure applies regardless of final destination or transit status and anticipates compliance via airline screening.

triage.headline_ja: 注意！在ペルー米国大使館、危険な感染症の流行を受けて渡航者向けの新たな衛生要件を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定症例11,100人超、死亡約5,433人）がケニア・ナイジェリアへ拡大の兆候を示し、米国CDCが渡航制限措置を導入するなど国際的対応が本格化しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はペルーでの米国渡航措置発表を報じているが、感染症の発生国はDRCであるため、米国・ペルー・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれず除外した（ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外）。

article.articleHeadline: UN official warns Ebola continues to spread in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), UN Senior Ebola Coordinator Julien Harneis said on 14 November 2026, despite significant progress against the outbreak over the past six months and spread to new areas. Continued transmission requires sustained efforts and stronger on-the-ground measures to contain the outbreak. Harneis outlined three operational priorities, including ensuring safe and unhindered access to affected areas, a key challenge as violence in parts of eastern DRC hampers response and contact tracing. He stressed that violence in recent days has killed more people than Ebola, highlighting the need to address security and humanitarian access as part of outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: 国連当局者、DRCでエボラの感染拡大続くと警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な疾患がDRCで継続的に拡大しており、紛争による対応阻害も報告されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 国連エボラ調整官による公式声明であり、治安悪化が対応を阻害している点が重要な懸念材料。継続的な拡大状況のため、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PIC participa de mobilização contra o Aedes aegypti com revista educativa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PIC participates in mobilization against Aedes aegypti with an educational magazine.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil: PIC (Plano pela Primeira Infância Campineira) participates in the 2nd Municipal Week Mobilization to Fight Arboviroses through November 14, 2026. The program disseminates awareness, distributes educational materials, and launches a comic, 'As Aventuras dos Pequenos Mosqueteiros contra Dengue, Zika e Chikungunya,' explaining Aedes aegypti, dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, their life cycle, breeding sites, and prevention. In the story, Ana, Chico, and João guide children through games to reinforce learning. On November 11, during 'Servidor multiplicador,' PIC distributed the publication and other materials to municipal staff to promote preventive measures in workplaces and communities. The Comitê das Crianças participates to acquaint kids with the Municipal Committee for Arboviruses and Zoonoses and public actions against dengue. Coordinator Thiago Ferrari notes that involving children broadens outreach, and dengue can be deadly. The week runs November 9–14, ending with a Municipal Mobilization including house-to-house visits, waste removal, gutter cleaning, and area monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: PIC、ネッタイシマカ対策キャンペーンに啓発冊子で参加
triage.triage_reason: 教育啓発活動に関する記事であり、新規感染事例や異常な流行状況の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱に関する市民啓発キャンペーン（教育冊子配布、地域清掃活動など）を紹介するもので、感染症の発生・流行そのものを報じる内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil ultrapassa mil casos de mpox e tem uma morte no Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil surpasses one thousand mpox cases and has one death in Rio
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is circulating in Brazil with 1,055 laboratory-confirmed cases and one death as of November 13, 2026. Rio de Janeiro leads with 390 cases, more than triple 2025's total (123); São Paulo has 388. The Rio fatality occurred in a patient with an unspecified underlying condition. In São Paulo, Instituto Adolfo Lutz identified mpox clade Ib in 103 cases, mainly in the metropolitan area; 2025 cases were largely clade IIb. Early symptoms are fever, body pains, headache, and malaise, followed by painful skin and mucosal lesions which can be large and sometimes recur. Transmission occurs via direct contact with lesions or secretions, including sexual contact, and via contaminated objects. The Ministry of Health purchased 25,000 mpox vaccine doses (Nov 9) for the SUS, with a two-dose regimen; priority for HIV patients with CD4 <100 and other high-risk groups; São Paulo has administered 2,084 doses in 2026 so far.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでmpox感染者が1000人を超え、リオで1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでmpoxクレードIbが新たに確認され、死亡例を伴い症例数が急増しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 2025年は主にクレードIIbだったが、2026年にクレードIbがサンパウロで103例確認されており、より重症度の高いクレードの新大陸での拡大が懸念される。HIV患者等の高リスク群への感染拡大やワクチン対応状況の継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Médico denuncia diagnósticos irregulares de hanseníase em Cuiabá e pede investigação ao CRM-MT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor denounces irregular diagnoses of Hansen's disease in Cuiabá and calls for an investigation by CRM-MT.
article.articleSummary: As of November 13, 2026, Dr. Zeno Augusto alleges irregular Hansen’s disease (leprosy) diagnoses in Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, Brazil, with at least five patients reportedly exposed to questionable assessments. He claims a group of physicians may be acting for commercial gain linked to a compounding pharmacy owned by a mother in Cuiabá, with two doctors and the family participating; one patient diagnosed with Hansen’s disease after fibromyalgia evaluation later found, via a São Paulo biopsy, to have small fiber neuropathy rather than leprosy. He criticizes reliance on neuromodulation, peripheral nerve ultrasound with Doppler, and whole-body thermography as essential for fibromyalgia. The Regional Medical Council of Mato Grosso (CRM-MT) says it will notify the physician to provide details, but no formal investigation or names are established yet; authorities encourage formal complaints through official channels. The case remains unproven pending verification.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がクイアバでのハンセン病誤診を告発、CRM-MTに調査を要請
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、個別の医療倫理・診断不正疑惑に関する報道であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンセン病の感染拡大ではなく、特定医師による誤診・不正診断疑惑に関するローカルな医療倫理問題を扱っている。感染症サーベイランスのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Diphtheria in Thailand 2026
article.articleSummary: 61 suspected diphtheria cases in Thailand (Jan 1–Nov 9, 2026) with 8 deaths (case-fatality 13%), age 8 months–82 years (median 18; highest in children <4; male:female 1.14:1). Narathiwat reports 10 cases; southern border provinces and four Songkhla districts account for 21 cases and 5 deaths, 3 lab-confirmed; no nationwide outbreak, but continued risk. Diphtheria spreads via coughing/sneezing or contact with secretions; incubation 2–5 days; symptoms include fever, sore throat, difficulty swallowing, and a grayish-white throat membrane; severe cases can cause airway obstruction and cardiac or nervous-system complications. DDC is increasing surveillance, contact tracing, and readiness of diphtheria antitoxin; expanding vaccination access, especially in the south. Vaccination: five-dose series at 2,4,6 months with boosters at 18 months and 4 years; school-age boosters; adults should receive dT boosters. Parents should check records and seek care for suspicious symptoms; mask and hygiene measures advised.

triage.headline_ja: タイにおけるジフテリア 2026年
triage.triage_reason: 2026年にタイで61例の疑い例、8名の死亡（致死率13%）が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が推奨される。
triage.notes: 南部国境県（ナラティワート、ソンクラー）を中心に発生。ワクチン接種率の低さが関与している可能性があり、DDCが監視・接触者追跡・抗毒素準備・ワクチン接種拡大を実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS reporta 11.000 casos y 5.400 fallecidos por ébola en el Congo | HSB Noticias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths from Ebola in the Congo | HSB Noticias
article.articleSummary: WHO reports 11,000 Ebola infections and 5,400 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, six months after the outbreak was declared a public health emergency. About one third of fatalities are children. Urban foci have been contained and hospital occupancy reduced to roughly 50%, but community transmission persists in rural, isolated areas with 400–500 new cases weekly. Insecurity, including more than 80 armed attacks on health workers and facilities, hampers response efforts. Three experimental antiviral treatments have entered clinical trials, and two new vaccine candidates are expected in the coming weeks. Cases detected in Nigeria and Kenya were controlled without local transmission, underscoring the importance of surveillance and international cooperation to prevent broader spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのエボラ出血熱で11,000人の感染者と5,400人の死者を報告 | HSB Noticias
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラの大規模流行（11,000症例、5,400死亡）が継続中であり、公衆衛生緊急事態として既に宣言されている。ナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境拡大事例もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニアでは症例は検知されたが現地での二次感染はなく封じ込められたとされているため、主たる発生国はDRCのみとした。ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。武装勢力による医療従事者への攻撃が80件以上あり、対応の継続的な困難要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: nova variante que circula pelo Brasil já causou surto na África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: new variant circulating in Brazil has already caused an outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: In 2026, Brazil reports a mpox surge driven by a new clade 1b variant circulating in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. São Paulo state identified 103 clade 1b cases, concentrated in the Greater São Paulo region; Rio de Janeiro logged 30 clade 1 and 11 clade 2 cases this period, plus one mpox death. Nationally, Brazil totals 1,055 cases, with 409 in São Paulo and 395 in Rio de Janeiro, accounting for over 76% of cases. The clade 1b lineage previously triggered outbreaks in Africa in 2024, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 78,000 cases and 1,000 deaths). Transmission is via close contact with skin lesions or mucous membranes, or contaminated objects; common symptoms include rash, mucosal lesions, fever, headache, myalgias, back pain, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy, lasting 2–4 weeks. Vaccines offer cross-protection but may be less effective against clade 1b; vaccination remains advised for high-risk groups, with strengthened genomic surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：ブラジルで流行中の新変異株が、アフリカで既に大規模発生を引き起こしていた
triage.triage_reason: clade 1b系統がアフリカ域外のブラジルで1,000例超・死亡例を伴い拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさが認められるためフルリスク評価へ進むべき。
triage.notes: DRCは2024年の過去の流行として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題はブラジルでのclade 1b流行であるため、DRCは検証済み地域から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarna humana são confirmados em bebês de creche municipal de Ouro Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Human Scabies Confirmed in Babies at Ouro Preto's Municipal Daycare
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, cases of human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) have been confirmed among infants at Ouro Preto’s Municipal Daycare Arnaldo Bastos in Cachoeira do Campo, Central Minas Gerais, Brazil. In the B0 and B1 nurseries, an anonymous source says at least seven cases were recorded this week; the municipal administration did not disclose exact figures. Classes were suspended Thursday and Friday for Vigilância Sanitária and Vigilância Epidemiológica inspections, with normal operations planned for next Monday, except B0/B1, which will remain closed for seven days to interrupt transmission and eliminate mites. SES-MG reports 11 outbreaks in 2026 across Belo Horizonte, Lavras, Alfenas, Itapecerica. Symptoms include intense itching and small skin lesions; transmission is via prolonged skin contact and, less often, shared textiles. Treatment is topical or prescribed medication; wash clothing and bedding hot, or seal non-washables for at least three days. Seek care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: オウロ・プレト市立保育園の乳児に疥癬（ヒゼンダニ症）の集団感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大な緊急事態には該当せず、地域限定の保育施設内アウトブレイクで管理可能な事例であり、国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染する慢性皮膚疾患で重症度・致死性は低い。保育施設内での集団発生として地域衛生当局が対応中。ミナスジェライス州内で2026年に11件の アウトブレイクが報告されているが、いずれも局地的管理下にある。

article.articleHeadline: Bactéria associada a infecções graves é encontrada em lote de queijo vendido no Brasil - Acorda Cidade - Portal de notícias de Feira de Santana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A bacterium associated with severe infections is found in a batch of cheese sold in Brazil - Acorda Cidade - Feira de Santana News Portal.
article.articleSummary: As of 12 November 2026, Brazil’s Anvisa suspended the sale, distribution, and consumption of batch 180926 of Italy-brand sliced mozzarella after detecting Listeria monocytogenes in 25 g of the sample. Agroindústria Santo Anjo has initiated a voluntary recall; affected packages should be discarded or returned to the point of sale. Listeria monocytogenes is found in soil, water, sewage and decaying organic matter and can multiply at refrigeration temperatures, increasing contamination risk in ready-to-eat foods, processed meats, and dairy products. Listeriosis presents in non-invasive form with fever, muscle pains, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea lasting 1–3 days; invasive disease can be fatal, causing headache, neck stiffness, confusion, balance loss, meningitis or sepsis, particularly in pregnant women, newborns, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. No illnesses linked to this product have been reported yet. Consumers who ate the cheese and develop symptoms should seek medical advice and report the product ingestion.

triage.headline_ja: 重篤な感染症に関連する細菌が、ブラジルで販売されたチーズのロットから検出される - Acorda Cidade（フェイラ・デ・サンタナのニュースポータル）
triage.triage_reason: 単一ロットの食品回収事例であり、関連する発症例は報告されていない。ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は限定的。
triage.notes: 製品名に『Italy』を含むがブランド名であり、イタリアでの発生を示すものではない。規制当局(Anvisa)による予防的な自主回収であり、症例報告は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Social Stigma and Family Dynamics Shape Tuberculosis Care Delays in West
article.articleSummary: West Java, Indonesia—A qualitative descriptive study at the DOTS clinic of RSUD dr. Slamet in Garut interviewed nine TB outpatients (seven female, two male, 18–42 years). Delays in help-seeking and treatment non-adherence were driven more by the social meanings of tuberculosis, stigma (including aib), and family dynamics than by knowledge gaps, with structural barriers such as mandatory digital registration worsening access. Early TB symptoms were often normalized; extrapulmonary signs were rarely linked to TB, and healthcare experiences featured fragmented diagnostics and inconsistent communication. Family relationships emerged as the most influential factor, with six participants noting their impact on adherence. Medication fatigue, ongoing fear, and distress from clinical interactions further hindered adherence. Participants used self-monitoring strategies like cautionary witnessing to learn from peers who stopped treatment. The authors urge family-inclusive, stigma-reducing, patient-centered programs and proactive self-monitoring tools from treatment onset.

triage.headline_ja: 社会的スティグマと家族のダイナミクスが西ジャワにおける結核ケアの遅延に影響
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は単一施設での定性的研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核患者9名を対象とした質的研究であり、アウトブレイクや新規症例急増等の公衆衛生イベントではないため、対象国リストへの発生国としての計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: UN hails progress in Ebola response, cites insecurity as biggest challenge
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reaches six months since mid-May declaration, with confirmed cases surpassing 11,100 and deaths over 5,400, making it the second-worst Ebola outbreak on record. The Bundibugyo virus drives transmission across eight provinces in east, central and west Congo, now spreading to more rural, hard-to-reach areas. No approved treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo Ebola. Children account for more than one-third of deaths, with up to 500 new cases weekly. The biggest challenge is rising insecurity: 80 attacks on health sites/workers to date, including a North Kivu assault last week that killed 66 civilians and three health workers; three facilities looted and over 1,000 contacts lost to follow-up. Africa CDC notes capacity gains—30 labs (from 2), about 4,300 daily tests, 2,000 beds, and 3,000+ recoveries—though surveillance and access remain critical. About $3B pledged, 45% disbursed; funding not yet translating to ground impact.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、エボラ対応の進展を称賛するも、治安悪化を最大の課題と指摘
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は確認症例11,100超・死亡5,400超と史上2番目の規模で、治療薬・ワクチン未承認、治安悪化による対応阻害も深刻であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認された治療薬・ワクチンが存在せず、治安悪化（医療施設への攻撃80件、北キブでの66人死亡事件等）が対応を著しく阻害している。資金拠出は約45%にとどまり、国際支援の継続的必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bebês de creche municipal de Ouro Preto, em MG, são diagnosticados com sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Babies at Ouro Preto's municipal daycare in Minas Gerais are diagnosed with scabies.
