article.articleSummary: Scabies diagnosed among babies in the B0 and B1 nurseries of the Arnaldo Bastos Municipal Daycare in Ouro Preto, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The outbreak prompted closures on Thursday 12 November and Friday 13 November 2026 as Sanitary Surveillance and Epidemiological Surveillance teams conducted inspections and advised control measures and appropriate treatment to stop transmission and eradicate the mites. Normal operations were planned to resume on Monday 16 November 2026, with the B0 and B1 nursery classes remaining suspended for seven days to complete the outbreak containment measures. The infestation was identified specifically in the Cachoeira do Campo district facility, and local authorities emphasize actions to interrupt transmission and ensure proper treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州オウロ・プレトの公立保育園の乳児らが疥癬と診断される
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は国際的に懸念される重篤な感染症ではなく、単一保育施設内の局所的な発生で、既に当局により封じ込め措置が取られている。
triage.notes: 疥癬は軽症の皮膚寄生虫症であり、既に当局が検査・隔離・治療を実施済み。公衆衛生上の重大リスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Secretaria estadual de Saúde confirma primeira morte pela doença no país este ano; paciente é da cidade do Rio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: State Department of Health confirms first death from the disease in the country this year; patient is from the city of Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Rio de Janeiro State, Brazil: first mpox death this year, a Rio de Janeiro city resident aged 40–49 with pre-existing immunosuppression. SES-RJ reports 382 confirmed mpox cases, about two-thirds since 13 September; 55 hospitalizations; mean age 33.8 years. The city of Rio accounts for 70% of cases. Authorities say no epidemic, but rising case counts require heightened surveillance. In early November, the Health Ministry provided more than 2,000 mpox vaccine doses to SES-RJ for Rio de Janeiro City, targeting lab workers handling Orthopoxviruses, people living with HIV/AIDS with immunosuppression, and high-risk contacts after risk assessment; a two-dose schedule with 28-day interval. Prevention focuses on avoiding direct contact with lesions, avoiding intimate contact if signs are present, and not sharing personal items. Seek care for suspected lesions—especially genital, anal, or oral—even without fever or swollen lymph nodes. Most cases are mild to moderate and managed with supportive care.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：リオデジャネイロ州保健局、今年国内初の死亡例を確認。患者はリオデジャネイロ市在住
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でMpoxによる今年初の死亡例が確認され、症例数も382例と増加傾向にあり、WPRO基準（重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 死亡例は免疫抑制のある基礎疾患患者。当局は『流行ではない』としつつも症例増加に伴う監視強化とワクチン配布を実施しており、HIV陽性者など高リスク層への対応が焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito da dengue está espalhado por Uberaba; 16 regiões têm infestação acima de 5%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The dengue-carrying mosquito has spread throughout Uberaba; sixteen regions have infestation rates above 5%.
article.articleSummary: As of November 3–6, 2026, Uberaba's Aedes aegypti infestation index (LIRAa) reached 6.9%, nearly double the 3.5% recorded in November 2025. Sixteen of the 18 evaluated regions posted indices above 5%, signaling expanded risk for dengue, Zika, and chikungunya with the rainy season and higher temperatures ahead. The index reflects the share of properties with immature larvae/pupae, about seven in 100 premises. The strongest concentration occurred in Stratum 3 at 11.5% (multiple neighborhoods listed), followed by Strata 11 (9%), 10 (8.5%), 8 (8.1%), and 12 (8%). Lower levels were in Strata 17 (3.7%) and 13 (2.7%). About half of foci (50.1%) involved movable containers (Type B); other notable foci included garbage/scrap (D2, 23%), fixed installations (C, 10.3%), tires (D1, 8.7%), and ground-level water deposits (A2, 7.1%). Dengue cases: 200 in 2026, vs 5,317 in 2025. Residents are urged weekly 10-minute checks; ensure reservoirs are covered. No imported/exported cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱媒介蚊がウベラーバ市全域に拡大、16地域で感染指数5%超
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の幼虫指数上昇とデング・ジカ・チクングニア拡大リスクが示唆されるが、実際の症例数は2025年比で大幅減少しており、現時点では公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は限定的。今後の雨季に向けた推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 蚊の幼虫指数（LIRAa）上昇は媒介蚊対策の観点から注視すべきだが、2026年のデング症例数（200件）は2025年（5,317件）より大幅に少なく、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生インパクトは確認されていない。輸入・輸出症例の報告もなし。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro capacita 500 profissionais para atender casos de Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro trains 500 professionals to handle Mpox cases
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: the state health department trained 500 health professionals—doctors and nurses—from multiple municipalities to diagnose, manage, and prevent Mpox cases. As of November 13, 2026, Rio de Janeiro state has 382 lab-confirmed Mpox cases in 2026, with 124 cases from Jan 1 to Sep 12 and 258 from September to November 13. Of the confirmed cases, 55 required hospitalization, and the mean age is 33.8 years. The city of Rio de Janeiro accounts for 71.2% of all cases and has recorded one death. Health authorities emphasize preventing transmission by avoiding direct physical contact with people showing suspected infection signs, especially skin or mucosal lesions; avoid intimate contact or sexual relations with symptomatic individuals; refrain from sharing personal items; and seek medical care promptly on signs of Mpox.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、Mpox症例対応のため500人の医療従事者を研修
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でMpox症例が9月以降急増（258例）し死亡例・入院例も発生しており、WPRO基準の重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさに該当し、行政の対応（研修実施）という社会的関心も確認できるため。
triage.notes: 記事は継続的な国内流行に対する行政の研修実施報告であり、新規の異常事態ではないが、症例数増加と死亡例の発生から経過観察・RRA実施が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: RJ registra a primeira morte por Mpox no país | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro records the first Mpox death in the country | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil, reports the country’s first mpox (monkeypox) death, with the patient hospitalized at the Evandro Chagas Institute in Rio de Janeiro city. As of November 13, 2026, there are 382 laboratory-confirmed mpox cases in the state; 124 were diagnosed Jan 1–Sep 12 (pre-Single Epidemiological Week 37) and 258 from Sep 13–Nov 13 (post-SW 37). Confirmed-to-notified case ratio rose from 23.6% to 49.5%. Among confirmed cases, 55 required hospitalization (13.7% pre-SW37; 14.7% post). Mean age is 33.8 years, and Rio de Janeiro city accounts for 71.2% of statewide cases. About 500 health professionals received virtual mpox management training. The Ministry of Health provided over 2,000 vaccine doses to SES-RJ for distribution; vaccination is two doses, 28 days apart, targeting high-risk groups such as Orthopoxvirus-lab workers, people with HIV/AIDS, and close contacts after risk assessment. Preventive guidance: avoid direct contact with lesions, suspend intimate contact when symptomatic, do not share personal items, and seek care for suspicious lesions, especially genital, anal, or oral.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、国内初のMpox死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内初のMpox死亡例であり重症度は認められるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の情報がなく、ワクチン配布等の対策も進行中であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ケース数の増加傾向（Sep13-Nov13で258例）と初死亡例が確認されているが、政府による対策（ワクチン配布、医療者訓練）が既に進行中であり、管理可能性は比較的高いと判断。続報でのケース数推移・死亡例の詳細（基礎疾患の有無等）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: aumento de casos no Brasil era esperado, mas exige atenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: rise in cases in Brazil was expected, but requires attention.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 is rising in Brazil, with increased cases reported in 18 states, a surge authorities anticipated due to waning immunity, new subvariants, and relaxed preventive measures. While most infections are mild, SARS-CoV-2 still risks severe illness and long COVID, especially for older adults and the immunocompromised. The Ministry of Health emphasizes continued prevention: vaccination up to date, well‑ventilated spaces, and mask use by symptomatic individuals. Although the international health emergency has ended, the virus remains circulating and mutating, with periods of higher transmission possible. Three factors explain the uptick: diminishing protection against infection over time; emergence of subvariants that may evade immunity; and changes in behavior, including reduced masking and more time in closed settings. Symptoms can include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, fatigue, and muscle aches; high‑risk groups may require care. Vaccination, masks in high‑risk settings, ventilation, testing, and seeking care when needed are advised.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19:ブラジルでの症例増加は予想されていたが、注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: 予想されていた季節的な増加であり、重症度や異常性の観点で基準を満たさず、公衆衛生緊急事態への該当もないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的なCOVID-19症例増加に関する一般的な注意喚起であり、既知の免疫低下・新亜種・行動変化による予想された増加と説明されている。国際保健緊急事態は既に終了済みと記載。

article.articleHeadline: 国家卫健委：重点人群应优先接种流感疫苗 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Health Commission: Priority populations should receive influenza vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-14, China’s National Health Commission urges influenza vaccination as the most cost-effective preventive measure. Because influenza viruses mutate, annual vaccination is advised to lower the risk of severe illness, hospitalization, and death. Priority groups should be vaccinated: children aged 6 months and older (if there are no contraindications), especially infants, the elderly, and patients with chronic diseases; staff in schools, childcare facilities, elder care facilities, and medical institutions should also be prioritized. Public service workers with high exposure, such as delivery riders and ride-hailing drivers, are encouraged to get vaccinated. Maintain hand hygiene, cover the nose and mouth when sneezing or coughing, and ensure good indoor ventilation; avoid crowded, poorly ventilated places. If fever or cough appears, rest and seek medical care as needed; do not go to work sick. Influenza can lead to pneumonia; early rest and treatment after diagnosis are advised. In crowded settings like subways, malls, and hospitals, wear a mask according to guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 国家衛生健康委員会：重点人群はインフルエンザワクチンを優先接種すべき
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種を推奨する通常の公衆衛生広報であり、異常な感染拡大や重症化の報告はないため。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの予防啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: У заповіднику Май-По два зразки дали позитивний результат на вірус H5 -- Anadolu Agency
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Mai Po Nature Reserve, two samples tested positive for the H5 virus — Anadolu Agency.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 November 2026, two samples collected on Wednesday during routine monitoring at Mai Po Nature Reserve in Hong Kong tested positive for the highly pathogenic avian influenza H5 virus, confirmed by a research group from the University of Hong Kong School of Public Health, per Anadolu Agency citing the South China Morning Post. Authorities have intensified surveillance around Mai Po, with notices urging visitors to observe personal hygiene and enhanced cleaning and disinfection of visitor facilities, including bird-watching shelters and the floating boardwalk. No poultry farms within a three-kilometer radius of the sampling site. Live poultry supply chains are under heightened oversight: the AFCD monitors local poultry farms and wholesale markets, while the FEHD separately tracks risks associated with H5 at live poultry shops.

triage.headline_ja: マイポ自然保護区で採取された2検体がH5ウイルス陽性 — アナドル通信
triage.triage_reason: 野鳥からのH5高病原性鳥インフルエンザ検出事例で、ヒト感染や家禽発生は報告されておらず、現時点では監視強化対応にとどまる。
triage.notes: 野生鳥類（サンプル）でのH5検出であり、ヒト感染や家禽発生の報告はない。香港は対象国リストのChinaに含めて計上。当局は監視強化・消毒対応を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: País supera mil diagnósticos de mpox e contabiliza óbito em solo fluminense
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The country surpasses 1,000 mpox diagnoses and records a death in the state of Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) in Brazil totals 1,055 confirmed cases and one death as of 13 November 2026, according to the Ministry of Health epidemiological panel. The Rio de Janeiro state leads with 389 diagnoses, followed by São Paulo state with 388, with a substantial share of São Paulo cases linked to the viral lineage clade Ib in the metropolitan area. Early signs mimic other viral illnesses (fever, malaise, body aches) but rash and mucosal lesions are characteristic and require medical follow-up. Transmission is primarily via direct contact with secretions or lesions, including sexual contact, and through contaminated objects such as clothes and sheets. Most cases are among cisgender men. In response, the Health Ministry is securing additional mpox vaccines, prioritizing high-risk groups (e.g., people living with HIV with significant immunosuppression); expansion depends on supply and regional epidemiology.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでmpox診断が1,000件を超え、リオデジャネイロ州で死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox Clade Ib系統を含む症例が1,000例を超え死亡例も発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州の症例の相当数がClade Ib系統と関連しており、国際的に懸念される系統（Clade Ib）がアフリカ以外の地域で持続的に伝播している可能性がある点が特に注目される。ワクチン供給状況や外部支援の要否については記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina registra 24 casos de mpox; Brasil ultrapassa mil confirmações em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina records 24 mpox cases; Brazil surpasses 1,000 confirmed cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) in Brazil reached 1,023 confirmed cases in 2026, with 46 probable and 581 suspected, and one death, according to the Health Ministry and Agência Brasil, updated through November 12, 2026. Santa Catarina reports 24 confirmed cases this year, ranking among the six states with the most records; nationally, Rio de Janeiro leads with 390, São Paulo 388, Ceará 61, Minas Gerais 45, Distrito Federal 41. October brought 293 cases and November 227 (through the 12th), together 520 in two months, more than half of 2026 total. Since monitoring began, Brazil has 15,455 cases and 19 deaths. Monkeypox is caused by MPXV in Orthopoxvirus genus; transmission via direct contact with lesions, body fluids, contaminated objects, or prolonged close contact with respiratory secretions; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin/mucosal lesions. Vaccination is recommended for high-risk groups; Brazil recently acquired 25,000 doses through PAHO Revolving Fund.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でエムポックス24例を記録、ブラジルは2026年の確定症例が1000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでエムポックス(mpox)症例が増加傾向（10-11月だけで520例）にあるが、致死率は低く国際的拡大の兆候もないため、継続的な経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: ブラジルではmpoxが地域流行化しており、2026年の累計1,023例・死亡1例、監視開始以来の累計は15,455例・死亡19例。直近2か月で急増傾向が見られるため、今後のトレンドを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mắc cúm A, bệnh nhân đã âm tính vì sao vẫn chưa thể xuất viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infected with influenza A, the patient has tested negative—why can't they be discharged yet?
article.articleSummary: As of 14 November 2026, Hanoi’s Thanh Nhàn Hospital Infectious Diseases Unit reports a surge of influenza A with about 50 patients under care, many elderly with comorbidities (hypertension, diabetes, heart failure, adrenal insufficiency) and immunosuppression, including cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy. A 75-year-old Hanoi woman with influenza A developed pneumonia and respiratory failure; despite negative influenza A tests, she remains hospitalized due to instability. A post-stent coronary patient also contracted influenza A, highlighting added respiratory risk after cardiovascular procedures. Dengue fever is also treated in the same unit, with roughly 10 dengue patients currently, some severe. A 26-year-old from Bat Trang, Hanoi, initially with a high fever and unclear home COVID test results, was diagnosed with influenza A after hospital admission. The report cautions against self-medication, emphasizes lab confirmation over rapid home tests, and notes oseltamivir dosing should consider kidney function; annual flu vaccination is advised.

triage.headline_ja: A型インフルエンザに感染、陰性になったのになぜまだ退院できないのか
triage.triage_reason: ハノイの一病院でのインフルエンザA・デング熱の季節的な増加を報じる内容で、重症例や基礎疾患患者への影響はあるが、国際的拡大や異常性を示す明確な根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 単一病院での季節性インフルエンザA・デング熱の増加報告であり、全国的・国際的な異常事態を示す情報はない。続報で患者数の推移や地域拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Teste criado no Rio identifica doença fatal com apenas uma gota de sangue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test developed in Rio de Janeiro identifies a fatal disease with just one drop of blood.
article.articleSummary: As of 13 November 2026, researchers in Rio de Janeiro developed a rapid diagnostic test for hantavirus disease that detects infection in 15–20 minutes from a single drop of blood. Created by Fiocruz in collaboration with the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ), the assay analyzes cellular and biochemical changes caused by hantavirus. Anvisa approved the technology, enabling production and use across Brazil's health services. With symptoms mimicking influenza or dengue, this test offers earlier and more precise diagnosis to start treatment sooner. Hantavirus disease is transmitted mainly through contact with wild rodents or their excreta (urine, feces, saliva). Incubation is 1–6 weeks; early symptoms include fever, diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal, muscular, and head pains. Severe disease may feature red or purple skin spots, gum bleeding, tachycardia, kidney failure, reduced urine output, dry cough, and dyspnea.

triage.headline_ja: リオで開発された検査、血液一滴で致死性疾患を特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はハンタウイルス感染症の新しい診断検査の開発に関する科学技術ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや症例急増の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規診断技術（迅速検査）の開発発表であり、アウトブレイク事例や患者数増加の報告ではない。ブラジルでの疾患発生そのものを報じるものではないため、verified_locationsも空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro lidera casos de mpox no Brasil em 2026; Santa Catarina tem 24

article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil reached 1,023 confirmed cases in 2026 as of November 12, with 46 probable, 581 suspected, and one death. Santa Catarina registered 24 confirmed cases in 2026, ranking sixth behind Rio de Janeiro (390) and São Paulo (388), Ceará (61), Minas Gerais (45), and the Federal District (41). The country’s cumulative total since monitoring began is 15,455 cases and 19 deaths. October accounted for 293 cases; by November 12, 227 cases had been logged that month, totaling 520 cases in Oct–Nov—over half of the year’s total. Mpox is caused by the MPXV orthopoxvirus, transmitted mainly via direct contact with lesions or body fluids, contaminated objects, or prolonged close contact with respiratory secretions. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal lesions. Brazil’s Health Ministry announced the purchase of 25,000 mpox vaccine doses for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロが2026年ブラジルのMpox症例数で首位に；サンタカタリーナ州は24例
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで2026年のMpox症例が年間を通じて増加し、特に10～11月に急増（520例、年間の半分以上）しており、政府がワクチン調達を発表するなど対応の必要性が認められるため。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省がハイリスク層向けに2.5万回分のワクチン購入を発表。累積症例15,455件・死亡19件と流行が継続しており、10～11月の症例急増が注目点。

article.articleHeadline: Rio de Janeiro capacita 500 profissionais para atender casos de Mpox - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro trains 500 professionals to treat Mpox cases - Sim Notícias
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Brazil: Rio de Janeiro state health department trained 500 health professionals, including physicians and nurses, to diagnose, manage, and prevent mpox cases across municipalities. As of November 13, 2026, the state reports 382 laboratory-confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with 124 from January 1 to September 12 and 258 from September 13 to November 13. Authorities advise avoiding direct physical contact with individuals showing skin or mucosal lesions, refraining from intimate contact, and not sharing personal items; seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear. triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州、Mpox症例対応のため医療従事者500人を研修 - Sim Notícias
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州で2026年のMpox確診例が382例（うち9月13日以降258例と急増）、入院55例・死亡1例が報告されており、地域保健当局が大規模研修を実施するなど行政的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 記事はリオデジャネイロ州内のMpox症例増加と医療従事者研修に関する内容であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記載なし。症例数の増加傾向（9月以降倍増）が継続監視の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: River Confluence Microbes Show Complex Genomic Potential During Mass
article.articleSummary: At the Sangam confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna in Prayagraj, India, the Mahakumbh pilgrimage triggers episodic perturbations of river microbiota, with major inputs of organic matter, nutrients, pharmaceuticals, personal-care products, fecal material, and skin microbes from upstream runoff. 16S rRNA sequencing shows baseline dominance of Proteobacteria, Firmicutes, Actinobacteria, and Bacteroidetes, including Pseudomonas, Acinetobacter, Bacillus, Aeromonas, and Streptomyces; during mass bathing, blooms of Escherichia, Klebsiella, and Vibrio appear, with metal-tolerant taxa rising. Pre-event BOD is 2.37 mg/L, rising to ~6.37 mg/L during the festival and about 4.93 mg/L post-event; earlier festivals reported BOD 14 mg/L, COD 67 mg/L, ammonium 2.15 mg/L, and a ~130-fold biomass increase with 792 and 482 MPN/100 mL for total and fecal coliforms. COD peaks near 30 mg/L; pH shifts from 8.17 to 8.53, then 8.33; DO declines with respiration. The review defines genomic resilience as a population’s capacity to maintain or recover function after disturbance via genetic or regulatory changes, and distinguishes it from resistance, acclimation, and adaptation. An observational ecogenomic framework is proposed, noting many taxa are freshwater natives and source attribution remains unresolved.

triage.headline_ja: 大規模巡礼時の河川合流点における微生物の複雑なゲノムポテンシャル
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の人的被害やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、河川微生物叢の環境ゲノム研究に関する学術的サマリーであり、公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はVibrio属等を含む河川微生物叢の環境研究であり、ヒトの感染症発生事例ではないため対象国の疾病発生とは認められない。
